article.articleHeadline: Dấu hiệu nhận biết 4 bệnh lây truyền qua đường tình dục phổ biến
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Signs to recognize the four most common sexually transmitted diseases.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam highlights four common sexually transmitted infections: Chlamydia, Gonorrhea, Trichomoniasis, and Genital Herpes. Many STIs are asymptomatic yet transmissible, making safe sex and routine screening essential to prevent infertility and pregnancy complications. Chlamydia often has no early signs; when present, symptoms may appear 1–3 weeks after exposure and include painful urination, abdominal discomfort, discharge, and pain during sex. Gonorrhea signs typically emerge about 10 days after exposure and can include thick discharge and dysuria, with possible pelvic or rectal symptoms. Trichomoniasis, caused by Trichomonas vaginalis, may appear 5–28 days after contact; women commonly have vaginal discharge with odor, itching, and painful urination or sex. Genital herpes presents with red bumps, blisters, or ulcers and itching; the first outbreak is most severe, and transmission can occur without visible sores. Emphasizes prevention and treatment adherence.

article.articleHeadline: Perubahan Iklim Perluas Habitat Nyamuk Penyebab DBD
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Climate change expands the habitat of dengue-carrying mosquitoes
article.articleSummary: Climate change and extreme El Niño are expanding the habitat of Aedes aegypti, raising dengue fever risk in Indonesia. By October 2026, Indonesia logged 98,946 dengue cases and 265 deaths across 467 districts/cities in 33 provinces, with 488 of 514 districts still experiencing annual increases. UGM epidemiologist Riris Andono Ahmad notes regional variation due to ecology and seasons. Beyond climate, household water management shapes mosquito populations; during dry seasons, water storage can create breeding sites. The Pontang coastal region illustrates how limited clean-water access drives rainwater storage that sustains mosquitoes even in dry periods. Warmer temperatures may let Aedes aegypti survive in subtropical and highland areas, broadening endemic zones. Recommended actions include multi-source surveillance (weather, mobility, etc.), cross-sector coordination, persistent larval source management, and strong community engagement. Early warning relies on case numbers exceeding five-year averages; prevention starts at home.

article.articleHeadline: Paraná registra 14 casos de mpox em 2026; veja cidades com confirmações
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Paraná records 14 mpox cases in 2026; see cities with confirmed cases.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) in Paraná, Brazil: As of November 2026, Paraná has 14 confirmed mpox cases this year, far fewer than the 44 registered across all of 2025. Londrina leads with 5 cases, followed by Marialva (3) and Curitiba (2); Foz do Iguaçu, Maringá, Araucária and Ivaiporã each recorded one case. The 2026 cases are predominantly male (13 men, 1 woman); age 20–39 accounts for 12 cases (11 men, 1 woman), with two additional men aged 40–59. Common symptoms include skin lesions, fever, lymphadenopathy, weakness; headaches, myalgias, chills, sweating, and rashes may accompany. Transmission occurs mainly through close contact with an infected person or contaminated objects, with potential respiratory-droplet spread; infection persists from symptom onset until lesion healing. Suspected cases should seek care and observe isolation; hygiene and protective measures advised for contacts. Brazil recently purchased 25,000 mpox vaccine doses; vaccination uses two doses 28 days apart. Data for 2026 remains provisional.

The article also covers non-disease topics in DKI Jakarta, including education funding discussions for Special Schools and urban development plans, but TB surveillance at the prison stands as the primary public-health item described.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Next week, the Congo tests two new vaccines to confront the deadliest Ebola strain | Cairo News
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo will start clinical trials next week on two candidate Ebola vaccines targeting the Bundibugyo strain: ChAdOx1 (Oxford University/Serum Institute of India) using a chimpanzee adenovirus vector, and mRNA-1469 (Moderna) using mRNA technology. Trials, conducted under the Tumaini framework in Bunia, Ituri province, northeastern DRC, are scheduled to begin Phase II on November 26–27 to assess safety and immunogenicity, with results guiding progression to Phase III. Both vaccines have completed early Phase I testing, and WHO expert groups endorsed their inclusion. The ring-vaccination approach will immunize contacts of cases and high-risk individuals to curb transmission, with expansion to additional sites beyond Bunia anticipated. Separately, since October 23, Ervebo (rVSV-ZEBOV) is being evaluated for cross-protection against Bundibugyo. Over 140 people have enrolled; thousands expected, with initial Phase II findings anticipated in early 2027.

article.articleHeadline: GC녹십자엠에스, 한타바이러스 진단 키트 2종 수출허가 획득
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: GC Green Cross MS has obtained export approval for two hantavirus diagnostic kits.
article.articleSummary: GC Green Cross MS (GCMS) has secured export approvals from South Korea's Ministry of Food and Drug Safety for two hantavirus diagnostics: a rapid immunodiagnostic kit and a PCR-based molecular kit. The rapid kit was approved on Oct 30, followed by Nov 12 for the PCR kit, expanding GCMS’s hantavirus line beyond ELISA-based research-use reagents. Hantavirus, mainly rodent-borne, can cause severe diseases such as hantavirus hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (HFRS) and hantavirus pulmonary syndrome (HPS). The company aims to leverage accumulated diagnostic tech to broaden global markets, using its overseas sales network to increase countries and product offerings. Future targets include mpox and Ebola. Separately, GCMS announced a strategic cooperation with China’s Yuwell to expand home healthcare, including CGM, strengthening domestic and regional competitiveness.

article.articleHeadline: Nhiều bệnh truyền nhiễm gia tăng tại Vĩnh Long
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Many infectious diseases on the rise in Vĩnh Long.
article.articleSummary: Vĩnh Long Province, Vietnam, reports rising infectious diseases: dengue fever, hand-foot-and-mouth disease, rabies, and meningococcal meningitis. Dengue cases total nearly 7,300 this year, up over 12% versus the same period last year, with about 50 severe cases and 2 deaths. Hand-foot-and-mouth disease numbers exceed 7,200, up 70% year-on-year. A rabies exposure incident occurred Oct 30–Nov 2 in Phú Thành hamlet, Giao Long commune: nine residents bitten by a stray dog; the dog died and tested positive for rabies. Public health actions include intensified surveillance, early outbreak detection, and containment of new foci; the provincial CDC will closely monitor transmission and aim to fully contain outbreaks. Coordination with the Department of Livestock and Veterinary Medicine is being used to manage dogs/cats and the rabies outbreak. Hospitals will ensure triage, screening for dengue and hand-foot-mouth, and maintain isolated treatment areas; localities supervise households and nurseries.

article.articleHeadline: Sábado é o Dia Nacional de Combate à Dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Saturday is the National Day for the Fight Against Dengue.
article.articleSummary: National Dengue Fight Day is this Saturday, November 21, as Brazil steps up dengue prevention and Aedes aegypti control ahead of peak transmission. Official data show dengue rising nationwide, with the Southern Region reporting high incidence per 100,000, notably in Paraná, Santa Catarina, and Rio Grande do Sul. Drivers include climate warming, rapid urbanization, and introduction of new virus serotypes; DENV-3 circulation has been detected in Santa Catarina. Dengue symptoms start with sudden high fever, muscle and joint pain, headache, retro-orbital pain, fatigue, and a red rash; the period of greatest danger is when fever falls between days 3–7, with abdominal pain, vomiting, bleeding, or dizziness requiring urgent care. NSAIDs should be avoided; hydration is essential. Preventive measures focus on homes: weekly ten-minute inspections, eliminating standing water, and using repellents, screens, and protective clothing. Qdenga vaccine is available in SUS for 10–14-year-olds, reducing severe disease but not replacing vector control.

article.articleHeadline: Xác minh khoảng 20 học sinh nhập viện có triệu chứng giống nhau
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Investigation confirms approximately 20 students hospitalized with similar symptoms.
article.articleSummary: About 20 students from a single school in Long Khanh Ward, Dong Nai City, were hospitalized with abdominal pain, vomiting, diarrhea, and fever beginning 17 November. On 18 November, the Dong Nai Department of Health said it is coordinating with relevant units to verify the cause of the outbreak, with an initial diagnosis of a gastrointestinal (enteric) infection. From around 10:00 on 17 November to the morning of 18 November, roughly 20 cases were brought to local health facilities for examination and treatment. While some were admitted to Long Khanh General Hospital, others were treated at nearby facilities. Do Thi Nguyen, Director of the Dong Nai Department of Health, stated the department has requested Long Khanh General Hospital to report on the case and that details will be provided once the report is available.

article.articleHeadline: Nhiễm liên cầu lợn gây đột quỵ và hỏng van tim
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Streptococcus suis infection causes stroke and valvular damage.
article.articleSummary: Streptococcus suis infection caused ischemic stroke and infective endocarditis with two vegetations on the aortic valve, severe aortic regurgitation, and moderate mitral regurgitation in a 60-year-old woman from Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. She presented with 20 days of fever, sudden loss of consciousness, and right-sided weakness. Echocardiography confirmed vegetations on the aortic valve; S. suis is a pig-borne bacterium that can infect humans through contact with pigs, pig blood or tissue, or undercooked pork. Her family works in pig slaughter, indicating high exposure. Initial treatment focused on antibiotics and antiplatelet therapy; surgery was deferred to balance stroke and infection risk. After nearly five months, she underwent combined valve surgery: aortic valve replacement with a bioprosthesis and repair of the mitral valve. Recovery was uneventful; extubation at 4 hours and discharge one week later. Prevention: protective gear for pig workers and avoidance of raw pork.

article.articleHeadline: Children's Ebola Radio Shows Reach 800,000 as DR Congo Response Strains | EconoTimes
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak, declared by WHO on May 15, involves Bundibugyo, a rare strain with no known cure. As of The Independent’s report, about 11,000 people have been infected and at least 5,430 have died, across 67 health zones in eight provinces, with children making up roughly a quarter of deaths. Africa CDC warned the outbreak remained out of control; less than half of the $2.9 billion pledged had been disbursed, with some health workers unpaid since August and medical supplies missing in hard‑hit areas. In Bunia, 35 child presenters—youngest eight, oldest 16—host live and prerecorded segments on Radio Mont Bleu and Radio Télé Salama, reaching over 800,000 listeners. Programs explain how Ebola spreads, warning signs, and where to obtain care, supporting the response. Save the Children urged expanded primary care, while Concern Worldwide warned funding for DR Congo programs could end within three months.

article.articleHeadline: Remedi Korea Bangun Industri Alat Kesehatan di Indonesia, Dukung Percepatan Eliminasi TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Remedi Korea Builds the Medical Devices Industry in Indonesia, Supporting the Acceleration of TB Elimination.
article.articleSummary: Remedi Inc., a South Korean health-tech firm, plans to establish PT Remedi Medika Indonesia to spur investment, technology transfer, and growth of Indonesia’s medical devices sector while accelerating tuberculosis (TB) elimination. Announced on 17 November 2026, the initiative partners PT Madina Mentari Utama, PT Posco International Indonesia, RSUP Persahabatan, the Indonesian Pulmonary Doctors Association (PDPI), and KEIND, following the Indonesia-Korea Healthcare Collaboration forum held in Jakarta on 28 October 2026. The program envisions expanding TB diagnostics access through portable and mobile X-ray technologies, developed in cooperation with local firms and aligned with Ministry of Health and BAPETEN radiology safety standards and TKDN (domestic-content) requirements. Remedi aims to build domestic manufacturing capacity, transfer know-how, and strengthen Indonesian professionals, while piloting community-based services and capacity-building with partners, including Muhammadiyah as a strategic ally.

article.articleHeadline: Quatro casos de sarna humana em Nova Andradina acendem alerta da Saúde -- AconteceuMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four cases of human scabies in Nova Andradina trigger a health alert
article.articleSummary: Four confirmed human scabies cases in Nova Andradina, Mato Grosso do Sul (MS), Brazil, trigger a public health alert in November 2026. Cases involve a 3-year-old child, a 5–9-year-old child, a 20–34-year-old adult, and a 50–54-year-old adult. The MS state outbreak context is expanding, with Dourados reporting 74 cases as of November 16. Scabies is caused by the Sarcoptes scabiei mite and spreads mainly through prolonged skin-to-skin contact; hygiene status and pets are not implicated. Symptoms include intense nocturnal itch and skin lesions such as small bumps and burrows, often between the fingers, on the palms, soles, or scalp. Management emphasizes prompt medical evaluation, avoiding self-medication, and preventive measures: do not share clothing, towels, or bedding; wash items in hot water and dry thoroughly; household members may require simultaneous treatment. School return follows health unit guidance and treatment criteria. Early identification and adherence to treatment are crucial to interrupt transmission.

article.articleHeadline: Santa Catarina volta a alojar aves nas granjas após conter surto da Doença de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santa Catarina resumes housing poultry on farms after containing a Newcastle disease outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak containment enables resumption of poultry housing on farms in western Santa Catarina, Brazil, with restrictions lifted in areas where foci were recorded, though export restrictions and sanitary-vacuum periods remain in place as of 2026-11-18. The first outbreak was confirmed at a commercial turkey broiler facility, triggering immediate interdiction and a temporary suspension of bird movement in the affected area. A 60-day zoosanitary emergency was declared by the federal government and the incident notified to the World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE) and international partners. Investigations covered municipalities including Nova Itaberaba, Nova Erechim, and Coronel Freitas, with thousands of backyard holdings and hundreds of commercial poultry establishments within a ten-kilometer radius inspected for clinical signs and biosecurity. After cleaning and disinfection, affected sites were released; no animals showed symptoms. Laboratory confirmation was coordinated by the Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock. The disease affects domestic and wild birds; consumption of inspected chicken meat and eggs remains safe.

article.articleHeadline: Waspadai Tempat Perkembangbiakan Nyamuk yang Tak Terduga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be wary of unexpected mosquito breeding sites.
article.articleSummary: Breeding sites for mosquitoes that transmit dengue fever are not limited to obvious locations; in Indonesia, water containers behind refrigerators and dispensers can harbor larvae. As the rainy season begins, poorly managed standing water increases Aedes populations and dengue risk. Dr. Riris Andono Ahmad of Universitas Gadjah Mada emphasizes that mosquito control is ongoing, but the challenge is ensuring communities perform source reduction (PSN) consistently, widely, and over time. During the dry season, households tend to store more water, which—if not managed properly—can become breeding sites. Dengue prevention is a shared responsibility starting at home; sustained PSN is key to reducing transmission. This Liputan6.com report from Jakarta, dated 18 November 2026, underscores the need for community engagement to curb dengue risk in Indonesia.

article.articleHeadline: Nadda launches Khushi chatbot, JOSH teams for TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan
article.articleSummary: TB elimination gains momentum in India as Union Health Minister JP Nadda launches Khushi, an AI-powered video chatbot built on CoRover's BharatGPT for the TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan. Khushi supports text and voice in 12 regional languages and provides information on TB symptoms, medication side effects, and nutrition; it also offers daily medicine reminders via Ni-kshay data integration and uses GPS to help patients locate the nearest Ayushman Arogya Mandir. The rollout accompanies the Joint Squad for Health (JOSH) teams, a cross-ministry initiative from Health, Youth Affairs and Sports, and Defence. In its first phase, 55 districts across 11 states will host youth-led community mobilisation and grassroots TB awareness. Attended by Union Minister Mansukh Mandaviya, Minister of State for Defence Sanjay Seth, and Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta; Ankush Sabharwal of CoRover/BharatGPT contributes.

triage.headline_ja: ナッダ氏、TBムクト・バーラト・アビヤーンのためのチャットボット「Khushi」とJOSHチームを発足
triage.triage_reason: 新規の感染拡大事案ではなく、インド政府による結核対策プログラムの広報・ツール発表に関する記事であり、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 結核の新規発生や流行拡大に関する情報ではなく、既存の結核対策プログラムのデジタルツール導入・啓発活動の発表記事。

article.articleHeadline: ICMR-NIMR at 50: Fifty years of fighting malaria
article.articleSummary: Malaria in India has turned around. In 2025, malaria deaths were in double digits, down more than 90% from over 1,000 annually a decade earlier; between 2015 and 2025, cases and deaths fell by ~80%, with high-burden districts dropping 155 to 33. In 160 districts, no locally acquired cases occurred 2022–2025. India aims for zero indigenous cases by 2027 and elimination by 2030. The ICMR-National Institute of Malaria Research (ICMR-NIMR)—marking 50 years in 2026—grew from the 1958 Malaria Eradication Programme to tackle vector biology, parasite genetics, and transmission. Key findings include distinguishing Anopheles species, mapping vectors and resistance, testing bed nets and rapid tests, and guiding ACT therapy. CCMP informed DAMaN; 33 districts account for 64% of cases and 54% of deaths. Five priorities for the next decade include climate-informed vector tracking; sustained prevention with nets and insecticides; and diagnosis advances.

triage.headline_ja: ICMR-NIMR設立50周年：マラリアとの闘い50年の歩み
triage.triage_reason: マラリア流行の悪化を示す内容ではなく、インドにおけるマラリア対策の成功と研究機関の50周年を振り返る解説記事であり、公衆衛生上の新たな脅威や異常事態は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリア症例・死亡数の大幅な減少と2030年根絶目標に向けた進捗を報じる肯定的な内容であり、シグナルとしての緊急性はない。

article.articleHeadline: 74.609 Ekor Anjing Telah Divaksin Rabies di Denpasar Bali, Distan Temukan 10 Ekor Positif
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 74,609 Dogs Have Been Vaccinated Against Rabies in Denpasar, Bali; Distan Found 10 Rabies-Positive Dogs.
article.articleSummary: Denpasar, Bali conducts aggressive rabies vaccination to reach a rabies-free status by end-2026. The city’s dog population is 84,369, with 74,609 vaccinated (88.43%), short of the 2026 target of 92.7%. About 9,760 dogs remain unvaccinated. Vaccination efforts include door-to-door campaigns in neighborhoods and densely populated residential areas, and services via Puskeswan (animal health centers). Despite progress, 10 rabies-positive dogs have been identified and are managed through Emergency Response to curb further transmission. In addition to vaccination, the Department of Agriculture runs animal health care and sterilization programs and continues public-awareness campaigns, urging owners to vaccinate regularly and prevent dogs from roaming. These measures form part of Denpasar's ongoing rabies-control efforts as of November 18, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: デンパサール(バリ)で犬74,609頭が狂犬病ワクチン接種済み、農業局が陽性犬10頭を確認
triage.triage_reason: 動物での狂犬病発生・管理状況の報告であり、ヒトへの感染拡大や重大な公衆衛生イベントの明示はないが、エンゾーティックな狂犬病対策として継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は動物（犬）の狂犬病対策・ワクチン接種状況が中心で、ヒト感染例の報告はなし。バリは狂犬病流行地域として既知であり、新規性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: ആലപ്പുഴയിലെ പക്ഷിപ്പനി വ്യാപനം; 26,000ത്തിലധികം വളർത്തുപക്ഷികളെ കൊന്നൊടുക്കും
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza spreads in Alappuzha; over 26,000 poultry birds will be culled.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (H5N1) confirmed in Alappuzha district, Kerala, prompting culling of more than 26,000 domestic poultry across Alappuzha city corporation’s 13 wards, Haripad and Mavelikkara municipalities, and 36 rural panchayats, with four Pathanamthitta panchayats also affected. Culling starts today under containment measures; a one-week ban on selling or moving poultry, meat, and eggs is enforced within the surveillance zone. Laboratory tests confirmed H5N1 from samples collected in the affected areas. The article notes common human symptoms of avian influenza—fever, body aches, cough, diarrhea, sore throat, and shortness of breath—with blood in sputum indicating potential severe disease. Growers allege compensation for previous losses remains unpaid. No human cases reported in the article, but authorities warn of transmission risk and advise personal protection.

triage.headline_ja: アラップーザで鳥インフルエンザが拡大；26,000羽以上の家禽を殺処分へ
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州で家禽のH5N1感染が確認され大規模殺処分と流通制限が行われているが、ヒト感染例は報告されておらず、国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生影響の証拠は現時点でない。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・ケララ州アラップーザ地区およびパタナムティッタ地区での家禽H5N1アウトブレイクに関するもの。ヒト感染例は未報告。地元の家禽取引・移動制限が実施されているが、国際的な渡航制限等の情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情半年失控！剛果逾1.1萬人感染 兒童死亡率驚人
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak out of control for six months! Over 11,000 infected in Congo; astonishing child mortality rate.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has run for six months since May 15, 2026, driven by Bundibugyo virus. As of November 17, WHO reported over 11,000 infections and more than 5,400 deaths. Children account for about 25% of confirmed cases, with roughly 70% of under-5 confirmed pediatric cases dying. The outbreak has spread to eight provinces and 67 health zones, with weekly new cases around 400–500. Control efforts are hampered by security issues and limited resources: attacks on health workers, distrust of responders, and salary delays causing strikes (some unpaid since August). A recent attack killed 66 civilians, including three healthcare workers, and left over 1,000 contacts untracked. Two weeks earlier, a nurse was killed and another health worker seriously injured in East Tshopo Province. International pledges total about $2.9 billion, but actual disbursement remains under half, complicating response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が半年間制御不能に！コンゴで1万1000人超が感染、子どもの死亡率が驚異的
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）の大規模流行が6か月継続し、感染者1.1万人超・死者5400人超、8州67保健地域に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 治安悪化（医療従事者襲撃、給与未払いによるスト）と資金不足（国際誓約27億ドルのうち実際の拠出は半分未満）が対応を著しく阻害しており、WHOによる継続的な監視と追加支援が必要と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: الأمم المتحدة: إيبولا يفتك بأطفال الكونغو ومخاوف من اتساع التفشي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United Nations: Ebola is ravaging Congo's children, with fears of the outbreak widening.
article.articleSummary: On 18 November 2026, the United Nations warned that the Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is worsening, with rising infections and deaths six months after it was declared. The UN said the virus continues to claim children’s lives, reporting 1,730 child deaths. Children account for more than a quarter of confirmed cases and about a third of fatalities, and seven in ten infected children under five have died, highlighting the vulnerability of young populations. The crisis intersects with armed conflict, displacement, and severe food insecurity, with more than 30 million people in Congo projected to face acute food insecurity in early 2027, and over 39 million people facing hunger-related insecurity by early 2027. Cross-border risk is noted: Kenya reported nine cases linked to an imported case, underscoring the need for regional health coordination. The outbreak remains a complex health and humanitarian challenge amid weak services.

triage.headline_ja: 国連：エボラ出血熱がコンゴの子供たちを襲う、感染拡大への懸念
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のアウトブレイクが悪化し、多数の死者（子供を含む）が発生、ケニアへの越境感染例も報告されておりIHR基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていないが、越境感染事例として重要な情報。

article.articleHeadline: Belford Roxo realiza ação de vacinação contra a raiva em Santa Amélia - Prefeitura de Belford Roxo - Belford Roxo 24h
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Belford Roxo carries out rabies vaccination campaign in Santa Amélia - Belford Roxo City Hall - Belford Roxo 24h.
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination campaign by Belford Roxo Municipal Health Department vaccinated 282 animals in the Santa Amélia neighborhood of Belford Roxo on Friday, November 13. Conducted by the Vector and Zoonoses Coordination, the operation mobilized 30 endemic-control agents who conducted door-to-door visits to immunize pets and support dengue prevention, rodent-control activities, and fumigation logistics. A follow-up vaccination event is scheduled for Saturday, November 14, at Policlínica Palmeirinha in the Andrade de Araújo neighborhood, Belford Roxo, from 9:00 to 13:00, located on Avenida Nunes Sampaio. This vaccination drive aims to reduce rabies transmission risk by immunizing animals and integrating with urban health measures.

triage.headline_ja: ベルフォード・ロショがサンタ・アメリア地区で狂犬病ワクチン接種キャンペーンを実施 - ベルフォード・ロショ市役所
triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防的動物ワクチン接種キャンペーンの告知であり、異常な疾病発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は地方自治体の定期的な狂犬病予防接種活動の広報であり、感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、イベントの性質上シグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculose, uma doença que não pode ser negligenciada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis, a disease that cannot be neglected.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis in Londrina, Brazil, remains a public health challenge despite free diagnosis and treatment via the SUS and a high child vaccination rate. In 2026, Londrina reported 251 cases and seven deaths; the partial year already shows higher notifications than 2025 among the most vulnerable groups—people experiencing homelessness, those deprived of liberty, and people living with HIV/AIDS. National Tuberculosis Day (observed on November 17) underscores prevention, symptoms, diagnosis, and treatment. Experts emphasize overcoming stigma, along with early case finding, active case finding, patient follow-up, and contact investigations. Classic symptoms include a persistent cough for three weeks or more, fever, night sweats, and weight loss. BCG vaccination coverage in Londrina is 99.25% but broader strategies—stronger health networks, surveillance, continuous treatment, and policies targeting vulnerable populations—are still needed.

triage.headline_ja: 結核、放置できない疾患
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ロンドリーナにおける結核の啓発記事であり、既知の風土病に関する定例報告・意識啓発内容で、急性の公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 対象国リストにブラジルは含まれているが（3469034）、本記事は結核の啓発・意識向上を目的とした定例的な内容であり、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。念のため発生地域IDは記載するが、対象国リストの定義上Brazil(3469034)は含まれるため、ルールに従い含める。

article.articleHeadline: A Hunger Crisis Is Making Ebola Even Deadlier
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (epicenters Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) is the fastest-growing in history, with more than 5,500 deaths, driven by the Bundibugyo strain. It fuels a hunger crisis: 2.3 million people in crisis hunger over five months, and 3.6 million in food emergencies; projected to 4.2 million next year as movement limits persist and insurgency disrupts farming. Women account for about 60% of infections, and infections in children under five are far deadlier (roughly seven in ten under-5s vs three in ten adults). Travel bans and fishing limits complicate care and feeding. The World Food Programme provides hot meals in centers and 21-day isolation rations, but has raised less than a quarter of the $214 million needed for six months. Cross-border moves exist, with a man jailed in Uganda after crossing illegally.

triage.headline_ja: 飢餓危機がエボラ出血熱をさらに致死的にしている
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国における史上最速拡大のエボラ流行で死者5,500人超、重度の人道・食料危機を伴い、越境移動も確認されておりIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境移動事例が記載されているが、発生地域としての主題はDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WFPの資金不足（必要額の4分の1未満）が国際支援の必要性を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Lo ngại nguy cơ sốt xuất huyết vì người sống chung lơ là diệt muỗi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concern over dengue fever risk as household members neglect mosquito control.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever risk rises during peak season as households neglect mosquito control in Vietnam. In Ho Chi Minh City’s Đức Nhuận ward, 72-year-old Mrs. Chau vaccinates after witnessing a relative’s costly severe illness and maintains cleaning routines to prevent mosquito breeding, even worrying about aquarium water. In Nhơn Trạch, Đồng Nai, 24-year-old Hoàng Nguyên, sharing a rented room with two coworkers, pushes for cleanliness but remains concerned about others’ laziness, and also opts for vaccination. Transmission is via Aedes aegypti bites, not direct person-to-person spread, though one infected person can seed infection in the household via mosquitoes. By September 2026, Tâm Anh Hospital treated an 8-year-old girl after five relatives contracted dengue. Nationwide, over 170,000 cases and 21 deaths, with all four dengue serotypes circulating; Đồng Nai reports widespread local transmission. The vaccine is for ages 4 and up, two doses 3 months apart, reducing infection by ~80% and hospitalization by >90%; pregnancy timing should be discussed with a clinician. Seek care for fever, headache, myalgia, abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, bleeding, or lethargy. Avoid self-treatment with NSAIDs.

triage.headline_ja: 家庭での蚊対策の怠りによりデング熱リスクへの懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおける季節性デング熱流行（全国で17万例以上、21人死亡）だが、例年発生する季節性感染症であり突発的異常事態とは言えないため、続報の経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 全国で170,000例超・21死亡、4血清型すべてが流行中、ドンナイ省で広範な地域内伝播との記述あり。ただし季節性の年次流行であり、記事は一般向け予防啓発が主目的。

article.articleHeadline: PAHO urges countries to step up efforts to stop measles outbreaks and move towards elimination in the Americas
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks continue across Americas, prompting PAHO to urge intensified vaccination and elimination efforts. After the 10–13 November meeting, endemic transmission is re-established in Bolivia, Mexico, and the United States, with each losing elimination status. Endemic transmission means the same virus genotype and lineage circulated for 12 months or more. Americas, the first region to eliminate measles, achieved elimination in 2024 after Venezuela and Brazil interrupted transmission, but Canada lost elimination status in 2025; Bolivia, Mexico, and the United States now follow, while Canada interrupted its outbreak and seeks to regain status. As of 13 November 2026, the region reports 58,213 confirmed measles cases and 82 deaths, up from 12,806 cases last year. Measles is highly contagious and can cause pneumonia, encephalitis, or death. Resurgence reflects immunity gaps; PAHO calls for vaccination campaigns, stronger surveillance, rapid response, risk assessment, case finding, vaccine-reaction classification, and resources including protection for health workers.

triage.headline_ja: PAHO、麻疹の流行を食い止め、米州における排除に向けて各国に対策強化を要請
triage.triage_reason: 米州地域で麻疹の風土病的伝播が複数国で再確立し、症例・死亡者数が急増しているため、IHR基準の複数項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大）に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はPAHO（米州保健機構）地域全体の麻疹再流行に関する報告であり、具体的に言及されている国（ボリビア、メキシコ、米国、カナダ、ベネズエラ、ブラジル、スペイン）はいずれも対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に該当しない。ブラジルは記事中で既に排除状態を達成した国として言及されており、現在の流行主体ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Trẻ mắc RSV gia tăng, nhiều ca sơ sinh suy hô hấp nặng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RSV infections rising among children, many newborns with severe respiratory failure.
article.articleSummary: RSV infections are rising among children in Ho Chi Minh City, with several cases progressing to respiratory failure even in full-term, healthy newborns. At Children's Hospital No. 2, the neonatal unit reports rising RSV activity, including two term infants requiring CPAP. One child was admitted for enteritis before developing respiratory symptoms; another presented with pneumonia and distress; both tested RSV-positive. Clinicians warn that younger age carries higher risk; RSV often begins with cold-like symptoms but can rapidly cause tachypnea, retractions, wheeze, cyanosis, or apnea. Transmission is via droplets, direct contact, and contaminated surfaces. RSV positivity has increased since August 2026 and remained high through October–November, with eight RSV-positive infants in the NICU on 17 November and 10–20 daily admissions at peak. Preventive measures include hand hygiene, avoiding crowds, smoke-free homes, and early medical evaluation for infants under 3 months. Prophylaxis includes maternal vaccination (Abrysvo) during pregnancy and monoclonal antibodies for infants.

triage.headline_ja: RSV感染が増加、重症呼吸不全の新生児症例も多数
triage.triage_reason: 季節性RSVの流行で小児科領域での症例増加が見られるが、通常の季節的変動の範囲内であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。地域の医療逼迫状況を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: RSVは既知の季節性呼吸器ウイルスであり、ワクチンやモノクローナル抗体による予防策も確立されている。ホーチミン市の小児病院での症例増加は季節的流行と考えられ、IHR基準には該当しないが、新生児の重症化例が報告されており医療現場の負荷状況を継続的に観察する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: ക്രിസ്‌മസ്‌ വിപണിക്ക്‌ മുന്നോടിയായി വീണ്ടും പക്ഷിപ്പനി; വിട്ടൊഴിയാതെ വൈറസ്‌ ഭീതി
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ahead of the Christmas market, avian influenza resurges again; the fear of viruses remains unabated.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza re-emerges in Alappuzha district, Kerala, as Christmas markets approach, with infections on farms in Ambalapuzha North, Ambalapuzha South and Chennithala Grama Panchayats. About 26,000 poultry within a 1 km radius of the outbreak centers are slated for culling, including 10,044 birds within Ambalapuzha North. Six rapid-response teams—each with a doctor, two livestock inspectors, two attendants—plus Panchayat, police and revenue staff, will operate in a 10 km containment zone across 36 panchayats. Lab confirmation was provided by the National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases, Bhopal. Migratory birds are deemed the primary source; the region’s history includes outbreaks in 2014 (Thakazhi), 2016 (Thakazhi/Edathva), 2021 (Kuttanad; H5N8/H5N1), and 2022 (Harripad). Human risk is generally low, but precautions are urged as authorities strengthen surveillance, sampling and farm biosecurity to prevent spread to markets.

triage.headline_ja: クリスマス市場を前に鳥インフルエンザ再発；ウイルスへの懸念は収まらず
triage.triage_reason: 家禽での鳥インフルエンザ発生で大規模殺処分と封じ込め対応が行われているが、人への感染報告はなく人のリスクは低いとされているため、フルRRAには至らずWATCH対応とする。
triage.notes: インドのケーララ州アラップザ県で家禽の鳥インフルエンザ発生、約26,000羽の殺処分と封じ込め対応中。人への感染報告はなく、ヒトリスクは低いと記載されている。渡り鳥が感染源とされ、過去にも同地域で複数回発生歴あり。

article.articleHeadline: Santa Luzia, na Grande BH, confirma casos de sarna humana enquanto prefeituras suspendem aulas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santa Luzia, in the Greater Belo Horizonte area, confirms cases of human scabies as municipalities suspend classes.
article.articleSummary: Santa Luzia, in the Belo Horizonte metropolitan area, confirmed human scabies cases, prompting school suspensions amid Minas Gerais’ 2026 wave. The municipality did not report case counts or schools; authorities emphasize treatment and clinical monitoring. The state SES-MG says scabies is not a compulsory-notification disease and urges disinfection while maintaining the academic calendar. Across the region, Ouro Preto reported infections in five schools; Ribeirão das Neves registered 11 positives in two municipal institutions, leading to two days of school closure for cleaning; São José da Lapa confirmed four cases and closed the municipal network on a Friday. Belo Horizonte registered 12 community-origin outbreaks in 2026, averaging about six cases per outbreak. In Sul de Minas, Alfenas had 332 confirmed cases by early November; Andradas >50 suspected; Paraguaçu >30 confirmed; Lavras, Poços de Caldas, Caldas, and Varginha also reported outbreaks. Machado recorded seven cases in three schools but kept classes open with home isolation and after-hours disinfection. Sarcoptes scabiei (human scabies) transmits mainly by prolonged skin-to-skin contact; symptoms include intense nocturnal itching and red lesions.

triage.headline_ja: ベロオリゾンテ都市圏のサンタルジア市、学級閉鎖の中でヒト疥癬症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: ミナスジェライス州各地（サンタルジア、オウロプレット、リベイランダス・ネヴェス、アルフェナス等）で疥癬の集団発生が多発し、学校閉鎖が相次ぐなど社会的関心が高く、WPRO基準の複数（異常性・長期曝露・流行しやすさ）に該当するためフルRRAへの移行対象とする。
triage.notes: 疥癬（Scabies）は重症度・致死性が低く、ブラジル州保健局（SES-MG）も届出義務疾患ではないとしている。ただし多数の自治体・学校で集団発生と学級閉鎖が報告され、地域的な公衆衛生上の関心は高いため、重症度は低いが監視継続・情報収集の価値はある。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はなし。

article.articleHeadline: മുംബൈയില്‍ മധുരപലഹാരം കഴിച്ച് യുവാവ് മരിച്ചു; അഞ്ചുപേര്‍ ആശുപത്രിയില്‍: ഭക്ഷ്യവിഷബാധയെന്ന് സംശയം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A man dies after consuming a sweet intoxicant in Mumbai; five people in hospital: suspected food poisoning.
article.articleSummary: A 35-year-old man, Subair Ansari, died in Mumbai after consuming a sweet called Aflatoon at Sagar Sweets and Bakery, with five others hospitalized from suspected food poisoning; one patient tested positive for typhoid. Post-mortem results will confirm the cause of death, and authorities sealed the shop, collecting samples of the sweets. Over ₹4.58 lakh worth of food items were seized from the establishment. In a broader crackdown, Maharashtra’s Food Safety department seized adulterated/substandard goods worth ₹1.97 crore, suspended five establishments, and suspended licenses of four outlets in Mumbai and Nagpur for safety violations. The incident underscores ongoing food-safety enforcement across Maharashtra amid suspected contaminated confections.

triage.headline_ja: ムンバイで甘いお菓子を食べた青年が死亡、5人が入院：食中毒の疑い
triage.triage_reason: 単発の食中毒事例であり、1名がチフス陽性だったものの、集団発生や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報はなく、国際的拡大リスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 食品安全当局による取締り強化の一環として報じられており、チフスは死亡事例とは直接関連していない可能性が高い。食品安全規制の文脈の記事であり、感染症アウトブレイクのシグナルとしての重要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情半年失控 刚果逾1.1万人感染 | 中國報 China Press
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak has been out of control for six months; over 11,000 people infected in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 17 November, the Democratic Republic of the Congo's eastern Ebola outbreak, now six months old, has infected over 11,000 people and caused more than 5,400 deaths. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Since its declaration on 15 May, cases have risen at a record pace, spreading to eight provinces and 67 health zones, with confirmed cases more than doubling in six months. Children under five represent about a quarter of cases but around one third of deaths; among these young children, roughly 70% of confirmed cases die. Weekly incidence remains around 400–500 cases, with some early hotspots contained while transmission continues in other areas.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疫情が半年間制御不能、コンゴで1.1万人超が感染
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国8州で拡大し、感染者1.1万人超・死者5400人超と深刻化しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 半年間で8州67保健ゾーンに拡大、5歳未満児の致死率約70%と極めて高い。国際的な支援と封じ込め対応の継続状況を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Kết quả xác minh tin đồn lây nhiễm HIV qua việc chơi Pickleball ở Đắk Lắk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Findings from verification of rumors of HIV transmission through playing Pickleball in Đắk Lắk
article.articleSummary: On 17 November, the Đắk Lắk Department of Health announced that the provincial CDC completed verification of rumors that an individual in Ea Ning commune contracted HIV and transmitted the infection to several others after playing Pickleball. The 60s news bulletin dated 18 November 2026 references this verification as a notable item, but provides no details on laboratory confirmation or the current outbreak status. The key location is Đắk Lắk Province, Vietnam, specifically Ea Ning commune. The piece emphasizes public health surveillance and rumor verification surrounding potential HIV transmission via recreational activity, with no explicit confirmation of transmission in the available text.

triage.headline_ja: ダクラク省でのピックルボールによるHIV感染の噂に関する検証結果
triage.triage_reason: HIVがピックルボールを通じて感染するという噂を検証した結果に関する報道であり、科学的に感染経路として成立せず、実際の感染拡大や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す根拠がない。
triage.notes: 記事はHIVがレクリエーション活動（ピックルボール）を通じて感染したという地域の噂を当局が検証したという内容。HIVの感染経路としてピックルボールは科学的に成立せず、実際の感染拡大を示す証拠は提示されていない。地域的な噂への対応・デマ打消しの報道であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Duale: How we kicked Ebola out of Kenya and why we won't drop the ball yet
article.articleSummary: As of 18 November 2026, Kenya has recorded no Ebola infections, but the outbreak remains ongoing in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). An imported case from the DRC produced nine confirmed infections and two deaths. Kenya has conducted an unprecedented contact-tracing operation and screened more than 810,000 travelers at 26 entry points; three laboratories can test suspected cases with results in 9-12 hours. A 42-day countdown toward an Ebola-free declaration is underway, with formal declaration targeted on 23 December 2026 if no further infections occur. New Public Health Rules impose a mandatory 21-day quarantine and medical monitoring for Kenyans returning from affected areas; travel restrictions and intensified screening for arrivals from the DRC are in place. Cross-border surveillance has been harmonised with neighbours, unofficial crossings sealed, and community health promoters trained; WHO and other partners are coordinating responses. The government remains vigilant.

triage.headline_ja: デュアレ氏：いかにしてエボラをケニアから排除したか、そしてなぜ気を緩めないのか
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ輸入症例がケニアで9例確定・2死亡しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大・渡航制限）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアでの対応成功を強調しているが、アウトブレイクの発生源・継続地はDRCであり、対象国リストにケニアは含まれないためDRCのみを検証済み地域とした。

article.articleHeadline: بعد معاناة طويلة.. بدء تجارب لقاحات ضد سلالة "إيبولا" في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After a long ordeal, vaccine trials for the Ebola strain begin in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Two candidate vaccines against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola will enter trial phase next week in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the outbreak persists. World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced at a Geneva press briefing that these vaccines—developed specifically for this Ebola variant—will begin testing as soon as possible. Congo reports 11,376 Ebola infections and 5,568 deaths in the current outbreak, with approximately 400–500 new cases weekly. Notably, about two-thirds of confirmed deaths occur outside treatment centers, underscoring care-access gaps. The outbreak was officially declared on May 15, and to date, no licensed vaccine or approved treatment exists for Bundibugyo Ebola. Trials aim to evaluate safety and efficacy of these candidate vaccines against this strain.

triage.headline_ja: 長い苦難の末、コンゴでエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）に対するワクチン治験が開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で11,376人の感染者・5,568人の死者を出す大規模なエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行が継続中で、WHOが関与しワクチン治験を開始するなど国際的関心が高く、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ジュネーブ・スイスは発生地域ではなくWHO記者会見の開催地のため除外。承認済みワクチン・治療法が存在しない特殊なブンディブギョ株による大規模流行であり、週400〜500例の新規感染と死亡者の約3分の2が医療施設外で発生している点が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Esporotricose no Rio Grande do Sul atinge 1.465 pessoas; Canoas lidera casos na Região Metropolitana em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sporotrichosis in Rio Grande do Sul affects 1,465 people; Canoas leads cases in the Metropolitan Region in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Sporotrichosis in Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, recorded 1,465 human cases in 2026, with 2,752 notifications—7% higher than 2025. Transmission is mainly through scratches or bites from infected cats; soil contact also drives exposure, and human-to-human spread is rare. The Metropolitan Region of Porto Alegre bears most cases, led by Canoas (156), Porto Alegre (142), and Alvorada (119); another 1,051 diagnoses are under investigation. Diagnosis relies on fungal culture, with final results in 15–30 days, as direct microscopy often misses low fungal burden. In animals, 2,510 notifications were reported, of which cats account for 99% and dogs 1%. The disease is also called “gardener’s disease” due to soil exposure. SUS provides free antifungal treatment for 3–12 months; early care prevents bacterial superinfection. In Guaíba (25 cases), courts ordered an emergency plan with a 10-day deadline to distribute free meds; UCZ overcrowding prompted action.

triage.headline_ja: リオグランデ・ド・スル州のスポロトリコーシスが1,465人に拡大、2026年の都市圏ではカノアスが最多
triage.triage_reason: 動物由来真菌症で人から人への感染は稀、症状は抗真菌薬で管理可能だが、継続的な曝露と症例増加があるため経過観察が妥当。国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。
triage.notes: 動物（主に猫）由来の地方流行性真菌症で、裁判所が緊急対応計画を命じるなど地域的な行政対応が見られるが、国際的な拡大リスクは低い。続報があれば症例数の推移を確認する。

article.articleHeadline: Αμερική: Έκκληση για εμβολιασμό παιδιών κατά της ιλαράς
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: America: Appeal for immunization of children against measles.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak prompts PAHO to call for intensified immunization across the Americas. As of 13 November 2026, the region reports 58,213 confirmed measles cases and 82 deaths, up from 12,806 at the same time last year. Endemic transmission has reemerged in Bolivia, Mexico, and the United States, leading PAHO to declare loss of regional elimination status after the virus circulated endemically for at least 12 months by the same genotype. Canada remains linked to transmission but has interrupted the chain and seeks to regain elimination status; Venezuela and Brazil had previously eliminated transmission but were affected earlier. Vaccination gaps, uneven coverage, access barriers, misinformation, and hesitancy drive the resurgence, putting vulnerable infants and others unable to be vaccinated at risk. PAHO urges vaccination campaigns, strengthened surveillance, rapid response teams, high-risk population assessments, health-worker protection, and sustained efforts to reach at least 95% two-dose coverage in every community.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカ大陸：子どもへの麻疹（はしか）ワクチン接種を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: PAHOがアメリカ地域での麻疹流行拡大と地域排除状態の喪失を宣言しており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際的拡大）に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 主な発生国（ボリビア・メキシコ・米国・カナダ・ベネズエラ）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ブラジルは過去に排除状態だったが地域流行の一部として言及されているため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Khoảng 20 học sinh nhập viện có cùng triệu chứng, cơ quan chức năng vào cuộc
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: About 20 students hospitalized with the same symptoms, authorities have stepped in.
article.articleSummary: As of 18 November 2026, about 20 students at a school in Long Khanh Ward, Dong Nai Province, Vietnam, developed fever, abdominal pain, vomiting and diarrhea on 17 November. They were hospitalized or treated at local facilities, with initial diagnoses of gastrointestinal infection. The Dong Nai City Department of Health coordinated with relevant units, requesting Long Khanh Regional General Hospital to concentrate care and report updates. By 18 November morning, around 20 cases had sought medical attention at facilities in the area. Some patients were treated at Long Khanh Hospital; others at nearby clinics. In response, authorities sent meal samples to the Pasteur Institute in Ho Chi Minh City for laboratory testing to determine the cause. No final etiologic agent has been reported; investigation ongoing, including potential infection source; no information on imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 約20人の生徒が同じ症状で入院、当局が調査に乗り出す
triage.triage_reason: 学校での集団発症事例だが、現時点では食中毒疑いの胃腸炎症状であり、原因病原体や感染経路は未確定のため続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 発生地域はDong Nai省であり、Bluedotの発生地域（Ho Chi Minh City）とは異なる点に注意。食中毒（食事サンプルの検査）か感染症かは未確定。

article.articleHeadline: Upper East: Over 164,000 people targeted for river blindness treatment
article.articleSummary: Onchocerciasis (river blindness) treatment in Ghana's Upper East Region targets 164,525 people for the second round of the 2026 Mass Drug Administration (MDA). The Upper East Regional Health Directorate of the Ghana Health Service (GHS) announced the campaign, scheduled from November 15 to 28, 2026, in 14 sub-districts across Bawku West, Builsa South, Kassena-Nankana West and Tempane, identified as high-risk areas. The MDA aims to deliver treatment to residents to curb river blindness. No case counts or fatalities are reported. This effort reflects ongoing public health measures in the region to reduce transmission and morbidity from onchocerciasis through targeted interventions in high-risk districts.

triage.headline_ja: アッパーイースト州:164,000人以上が河川盲目症治療の対象に
triage.triage_reason: オンコセルカ症に対する既存の大量投薬キャンペーンに関する定例的な公衆衛生対応の報告であり、異常事態や新規の公衆衛生リスクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 計画的な大量投薬（MDA）キャンペーンの告知であり、症例数や死亡者数の報告はない。既知の風土病に対する定例的対策。

article.articleHeadline: Shivraj Chouhan to dedicate India's first indigenous bird flu vaccine on Nov 20 in Bhopal - english.punjabkesari.com
article.articleSummary: On November 20 in Bhopal, Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan will dedicate India’s first indigenous vaccine against H5N1 bird flu to the nation. Developed by the ICAR-National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (NIHSAD) in Bhopal, this vaccine fills a gap, as India previously had no specific indigenous H5N1 vaccine. India has recorded more than 500 outbreaks of H5N1 and H5N8 avian influenza since 2006, causing heavy losses to poultry farmers and disruptions to production. Bird flu is highly contagious among birds, often necessitating culling to prevent spread and resulting in economic impact. The vaccine is expected to strengthen India’s preparedness for future outbreaks and bolster the country’s large poultry sector, a key component of food security and rural livelihoods.

triage.headline_ja: シブラージ・チョウハン氏、11月20日にボパールでインド初の国産鳥インフルエンザワクチンを献呈へ
triage.triage_reason: 新規の感染拡大やヒト感染事例を報じるものではなく、ワクチン開発・発表に関する動物衛生分野のニュースであるため、現時点でのシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は新規の鳥インフルエンザ発生事例ではなく、インド政府による国産H5N1ワクチンの発表イベントを報じるもの。過去の発生状況（2006年以降500件超）への言及はあるが、現時点での新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Researchers Sequence Genomes of Bongkrekic Acid-Producing Bacteria from
article.articleSummary: Genomic sequencing of 16 bongkrekic acid–producing Burkholderia gladioli pv. cocovenenans isolates from retail wood ear samples in China confirms toxigenic potential and expands the genomic reference for food-derived strains. Identification used VITEK MS; bongkrekic acid production confirmed by LC-MS/MS; bon genes detected by real-time PCR. Illumina NovaSeq 6000 sequencing with SPAdes assembly, fastp filtering, and GTDB-Tk taxonomic classification identified all isolates as B. gladioli. Genomes span 8.15–8.50 Mb, ~68% GC, with 100% completeness and 2.33–3.86% contamination (CheckM2). Data are deposited in NCBI SRA and GenBank (BioProjects PRJNA1475073, PRJNA1475080); Figshare provides metadata and ANI values. Originating from Anhui Province's Fuyang and online retailers, the study reinforces food-safety concerns regarding wood ear products in China.

triage.headline_ja: 研究者らがキクラゲ由来のボンクレキン酸産生細菌のゲノムを解読
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、食品由来のボンクレキン酸産生菌(Burkholderia gladioli)に関するゲノム研究報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態や症例報告ではない。
triage.notes: 疾患名がMelioidosis(類鼻疽、Burkholderia pseudomallei)とタグ付けされているが、記事内容はボンクレキン酸産生菌(Burkholderia gladioli pv. cocovenenans)のゲノム解析に関する研究報告であり、全く別の病原体・事象である。実際の症例発生やアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、研究論文の紹介記事のためDISMISS対象とした。

article.articleHeadline: Shivraj Chouhan to dedicate indigenous H5N1 bird flu vaccine on Nov 20
article.articleSummary: India will dedicate its first indigenous H5N1 avian influenza vaccine in Bhopal on November 20, developed by the ICAR-National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (NIHSAD). Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan will unveil the vaccine, marking a milestone in strengthening India's ability to control bird flu, protect poultry, and reduce farmer losses. Since 2006, India has recorded more than 500 outbreaks of avian influenza (H5N1 and H5N8), underscoring recurring spillovers in poultry populations and the economic impact on the sector. The indigenous vaccine, not previously available, is expected to bolster preparedness and response to future outbreaks. The event in Bhopal highlights Indian scientific contributions to animal health and food security; the vaccine will be formally dedicated to the nation on November 20.

article.articleHeadline: Dịch tả lợn châu Phi xuất hiện tại 12 xã, phường ở Ninh Bình
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African swine fever outbreak detected in 12 communes and wards in Ninh Bình Province
article.articleSummary: as of November 18, 2026, African swine fever (ASF) outbreaks detected in 12 communes/wards of Ninh Binh Province, Vietnam, with 50% of affected localities experiencing re-emergence. Since early November, pig herds in Dong Thai, Tay Hoa Lu, and Nho Quan have required large-scale culling. The situation is described as complex due to weather and epidemiology; leadership, surveillance, and enforcement gaps in slaughter and transport controls, plus improper disposal of dead pigs and infected products, are highlighted. Provincial authorities mandate intensified, coordinated control measures, daily and weekly outbreak reporting, and strict regulation of pig movement within outbreak zones. Culling must follow veterinary law and the Ministry's guidance (Document 11145), based on professional diagnoses and conducted transparently. Commune chairs are held accountable for delayed action and potential spread.

triage.headline_ja: ニンビン省の12のコミューン・区でアフリカ豚コレラの発生を確認
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾患（アフリカ豚コレラ）であり、ヒトの公衆衛生への直接的影響は確認されていないため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当性が低い。
triage.notes: アフリカ豚コレラは豚のみに感染する動物疾患でありヒトへの感染は報告されていない。畜産業への経済的影響はあるが公衆衛生上の緊急事態には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. Loses Measles Elimination Status for First Time Since 2000 | EconoTimes
article.articleSummary: United States loses measles elimination status for the first time since 2000, per PAHO on Nov 17, 2026; Bolivia and Mexico also lost their designations. Independent commission traced U.S. transmission chain to Jan 20, 2025; the chain persisted for over 12 months, crossing the endemic transmission threshold. The CDC counted 5,412 confirmed measles cases in 2026 through Nov 12, more than double 2025's 2,289 (preliminary), with 96% linked to outbreaks. Elimination does not require zero cases and can persist after an imported case if sustained transmission does not occur; rubella and congenital rubella syndrome status remain unchanged. MMR coverage among kindergartners fell to 92.4% in 2025-2026 from 95.2% in 2019-2020; vaccination gaps raise risks for infants and those medically unable to vaccinate. To regain designation, the U.S. must document 12 months without endemic transmission and implement a stronger plan; PAHO requires a corrective action plan. Brazil regained elimination in 2024.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、2000年以来初めて麻疹排除ステータスを喪失
triage.triage_reason: 公衆衛生上重要な事案だが、発生国（米国・ボリビア・メキシコ）はいずれも対象国リストに含まれず、記事中のブラジルは2024年に排除ステータスを回復した対照例として言及されているに過ぎないため、対象国に関するシグナルとしては該当しない。
triage.notes: イベントは米国・ボリビア・メキシコで発生しており、対象国リスト外。ブラジルは本文中で『2024年にelimination再取得』という過去の対照事例として触れられているのみで、現イベントの発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Shandong Listeria Study Links Food and Clinical Isolates Using Genomic
article.articleSummary: Listeria monocytogenes in Shandong, China, shows broad genomic diversity with close ties between clinical infections and contaminated foods. In 2023–2024, 156 isolates from food and patients were sequenced, revealing two evolutionary lineages, four serogroups, 21 sequence types, and 17 clonal complexes. LIPI-1 was universal; LIPI-3 appeared in 5.77%, LIPI-4 in 19.23% and was exclusive to clonal complex 87. Premature stop codons in inlA occurred in 28.21% (44 isolates). The study identified 15 antimicrobial resistance genes (5 intrinsic), six plasmid types, and 11 prophage types, highlighting an accessory genome capable of gene exchange. High-resolution SNP analysis linked four clinical isolates to food isolates within 50 SNPs, and one food isolate to a clinical isolate within 20 SNPs, underscoring dietary sources as infection links. CC87 emerges as a high-priority lineage for surveillance due to virulence markers; whole-genome sequencing underpins source tracking and risk assessment.

triage.headline_ja: 山東省のリステリア研究、ゲノムプロファイリングで食品由来株と臨床分離株の関連を解明
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2023-2024年の既存分離株に関するゲノム疫学的研究報告であり、新規アウトブレイクや急性の公衆衛生事象を示すものではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は過去の分離株データに基づく学術研究であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクではない。対象国リストに山東省（中国）は含まれるが、進行中の公衆衛生イベントではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Shivraj Singh Chouhan to unveil India's first indigenous H5N1 bird flu vaccine on Nov 20
article.articleSummary: India to unveil its first indigenous inactivated H5N1 avian influenza vaccine for chickens on Nov 20, developed by ICAR-NIHSAD, Bhopal, targeting Clade 2.3.2.1a strains driving outbreaks since 2006. No prior commercial vaccine against this clade existed. Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (bird flu) causes near-100% mortality in infected poultry, with culling and trade restrictions driving heavy farmer losses. Since 2006, India has recorded over 500 combined H5N1/H5N8 outbreaks. A major outbreak could cut GDP by up to 1.5% and threaten more than 20% of the poultry population if unchecked. The 2006 outbreak caused estimated direct/indirect losses of Rs 2,200–3,000 crore; a Manipur outbreak caused losses equal to 0.5% of the state’s GDP. WHO reports 1,003 human H5N1 cases with 479 deaths across 25 countries since 2003, with three additional human cases recently detected linked to this strain.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola deaths in DRC cross 5,500 as armed attacks and funding shortages impede containment - BT News
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is the fastest-spreading outbreak on record, caused by the Bundibugyo strain with no approved treatment. As of 14 November 2026, 11,376 confirmed cases and 5,568 deaths have been reported, with about half of infections in the DRC. The outbreak has reached eight of DRC’s 26 provinces in the eastern and northeastern regions, notably North Kivu, which accounts for roughly half of new infections. Genomic sequencing shows community transmission in Ituri by mid-February; the outbreak was declared May 15. Frontline efforts are severely underfunded and under-equipped; donors have released about $1.3 billion of a $2.9 billion pledge, leaving many workers unpaid and facilities lacking fuel, phones, and supplies. MSF notes transmission within health facilities (e.g., 75% of infections in Beni’s health zone). 80% of new cases occur outside confirmed contact lists; 65% of deaths occur outside health centers. Armed groups, including M23 and ADF, impede response, with an ADF attack near Cantine-Aloya killing 33 civilians and displacing patients, heightening community spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ死者数が5,500人を超える、武装攻撃と資金不足が封じ込めを妨げる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目が該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）し、WPRO基準も全項目で懸念があり、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 史上最速の拡大スピードを示すアウトブレイクで、確認症例11,376件・死者5,568人、8/26州に拡大。武装勢力（M23、ADF）による攻撃や資金不足（$2.9Bの誓約のうち$1.3Bのみ拠出）が対応を著しく妨げており、医療施設内感染（Beniでは75%）や接触者リスト外での新規感染（80%）が見られる深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Scientists at IISc suggest combining antibiotics to tackle drug-resistant TB
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis remains a persistent health challenge. At IISc Bengaluru, researchers report that combining isoniazid with vancomycin can restore isoniazid activity against drug-resistant TB. The approach was tested on clinical isolates of M. tuberculosis from patient sputum samples with diverse isoniazid resistance, in collaboration with the National Tuberculosis Institute, Bengaluru. The combination reversed isoniazid resistance in vitro and reduced bacterial burden in a mouse model. This strategy, if proven safe and effective, could augment frontline therapy; however, the team notes that extensive safety assessments and clinical trials in drug-resistant TB cases are required before any patient use. Location: Bengaluru, India. Disease: tuberculosis (Mycobacterium tuberculosis). Drugs involved: isoniazid and vancomycin. Status: preclinical findings aiming for clinical trials.

article.articleHeadline: En RDC, Ebola tue massivement les enfants : " Je ne peux même pas le prendre dans mes bras pour le réconforter "
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola is killing children in large numbers: "I can't even hold him in my arms to comfort him."
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is devastating the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Bunia and Beni as outbreak epicenters. Nearly three-quarters of children under five infected with Ebola do not survive, highlighting extreme pediatric vulnerability. More than 2,280 children have become orphans as mourning ripples through affected communities. Kavira Musumbuko Dorcas’s world “froze” on the 28th, illustrating the personal toll of the spreading outbreak. The report underscores the severe impact on families and health workers amid ongoing transmission in the region, documenting the fatal course of infection in young children and the cascading social consequences, signaling an urgent need for intensified public health response in the DRC.

article.articleHeadline: Musim Hujan Datang Picu Genangan, Dinkes Kobar Imbau Warga Waspada DBD
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rainy season arrives, triggers standing water; Kotabaru Health Office urges residents to be vigilant for dengue fever (DBD).
article.articleSummary: Rainy season triggers standing water in Kotawaringin Barat Regency (Kobar), Central Kalimantan, Indonesia, prompting the Kotawaringin Barat Health Office to urge vigilance against dengue fever (Dengue). Although no dengue cases have been reported yet, authorities warn that water pooling creates breeding sites for Aedes aegypti mosquitoes carrying dengue virus. Prevention centers on the 3M Plus movement: drain standing water containers, tightly cover water storage, and repurpose or reuse containers that can hold water. Additional measures include fish that eat larvae, mosquito nets, repellents, planting mosquito-repellent plants, and regular environmental cleaning, especially around homes, drainage, and other potential stagnation sites. Residents should recognize early dengue symptoms—high fever, headache, muscle/joint pain, nausea, vomiting, and red skin rashes—and seek prompt medical evaluation at community health centers (Puskesmas). The Health Office, via the Gerakan Masyarakat Hidup Sehat (GERMAS), emphasizes routine vector control and community participation.

article.articleHeadline: Opao Elementary School intensifies dengue prevention
article.articleSummary: Dengue outbreak at Opao Elementary School intensified prevention after misting on November 17, 2026 and a cleanup on November 18. Cacanog said teachers and PTA officers joined the drive, with barangay authorities coordinating. To cut mosquito breeding, staff removed stagnant water from containers and watering cans, checked uncovered storage, and cleared other potential breeding sites. Temperature checks and symptom monitoring are ongoing, with parents contacted to monitor children at home. Maintenance crews are replacing damaged classroom window screens, and the school uses anti-mosquito sprays and nets provided by the Department of Education. Cacanog emphasized continued collaboration with parents and barangay officials to strengthen prevention, and urged parents to seek immediate medical care if dengue symptoms appear.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hong Kong records one imported monkeypox case; the patient is in stable condition.
article.articleSummary: One imported monkeypox case in Hong Kong as of 18 November 2026. A 38-year-old man tested positive and is isolated at Queen Elizabeth Hospital; his condition is stable. Epidemiological investigations are underway, and the case will be reported to the World Health Organization. Since 2022, Hong Kong has recorded 121 monkeypox cases: 94 locally acquired and 27 imported, all male. The patient developed chills and fatigue on November 11, followed by anal pain, with high-risk sexual contact with a man met via social media during the latent period. Laboratory confirmation was provided by the Public Health Laboratory Service. Authorities have intensified outreach, adding a dedicated vaccination center and NGO campaigns; since September 28, over 1,000 high-risk individuals have been vaccinated at multiple sites. Two-dose vaccination reduces infection risk by 82% and lowers spread to other body parts by 87%. Hotline 2125 2373 operates 9:00–18:00 for risk assessment and vaccination, advising prompt vaccination and avoidance of high-risk contact, and to keep partner contact details for tracing.

article.articleSummary: HIV rumor linked to pickleball spreads in Đắk Lắk Province, Vietnam, particularly in Ya Ning Commune, on November 12–13. Social media claimed a local resident infected with HIV transmitted the virus to multiple others after playing pickleball, triggering public alarm and psychological distress for the named individual. The Đắk Lắk Provincial Center for Disease Control, in collaboration with medical centers, Ya Ning Commune People’s Committee, and local health stations, reviewed HIV infection management and treatment records. Investigations found the person cited in the rumor was not listed in the local HIV infection management system nor had treatment management records. Police have questioned two individuals involved in disseminating the information. Authorities report no evidence of an abnormal increase in HIV cases in the area and deem the rumor unfounded.

article.articleHeadline: Health: Uganda study backs shorter TB treatment for children
article.articleSummary: MSF/Epicentre in Uganda and the Philippines found that 95% of 214 children, including 72 in Uganda, completed a four-month regimen for non-severe, drug-susceptible TB, instead of the standard six months. At therapy start, 73.8% were eligible for the shorter regimen: 50% of Ugandan children compared with 85.9% in the Philippines. The findings, released November 17 at the Union World Conference on Lung Health in Rio de Janeiro, show the shorter treatment can be introduced in routine health facilities, potentially reducing the cost and burden of repeated visits for children and caregivers. The study indicates non-severe, drug-susceptible TB can benefit from shorter treatment when health workers can assess disease severity and eligibility. Governments should invest in training health workers, strengthening diagnostics, ensuring access to child-friendly medicines, and supporting families throughout treatment.

Since 2022, Hong Kong has recorded 121 monkeypox cases, comprising 94 locally acquired and 27 imported cases, all male. Among 28 cases reported since August, all indicated high-risk sexual activity during incubation, including sex with unfamiliar men or multiple partners without condoms; most had not received monkeypox vaccination.

article.articleHeadline: India Develops First Homegrown H5N1 Vaccine As Bird Flu Outbreaks Return, To Be Launched On November 20
article.articleSummary: India develops its first indigenous H5N1 poultry vaccine, to be dedicated in Bhopal on November 20 by ICAR-NIHSAD. The vaccine targets H5N1 clade 2.3.2.1a. Fresh outbreaks of H5N1 avian influenza have been reported in Tamil Nadu’s Cuddalore district and Andhra Pradesh’s Anantapur district, with Tamil Nadu confirming H5N1 in November after sudden bird deaths. As of November 13, about 35,647 birds died in the affected zone and around 40,000 chickens were culled. Containment includes a one-kilometre culling radius and movement restrictions. Anantapur outbreak occurred in October with infected and surveillance zones. The 2025-26 annual report lists outbreaks in multiple states. Deployment details, vaccine availability, and protocols were not disclosed; the vaccine marks a significant preparedness milestone. H5N1 infections in humans are rare and not yet sustained.

triage.headline_ja: インドが初の国産H5N1ワクチンを開発、鳥インフルエンザ流行再燃により11月20日に発売予定

triage.notes: 記事はインド国内の家禽におけるH5N1流行とワクチン開発に関するもの。ヒト感染例は報告されておらず、現時点では動物衛生事象としての性格が強いが、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dabie Bandavirus Fatality Linked to Genotype B in Coastal East Asia
article.articleSummary: Dabie bandavirus–driven severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS) shows inland-high-incidence versus coastal-high-fatality in East Asia. In 2010–2023 China recorded 27,457 cases and 1,326 deaths across 27 provinces, with 99.05% of infections and 99.62% of fatalities in seven core inland provinces. Inland provinces (Henan, Hubei, Anhui) had 7.31/100,000 incidence and 2.61% case fatality, while coastal Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Shandong, and Liaoning had 3.84/100,000 and 8.04% CFR (coastal infection RR 0.52; coastal CFR ~3.08× inland). One-month lag analyses link higher infection risk to warmer temperatures: inland Xinyang peaks at 20.6°C (RR 4.85), coastal Zhoushan at 22.6°C (RR 3.07); sunshine >200 hours/mo elevates coastal risk. Genomic analysis of 1,820 genomes reveals five genotypes (A–E); inland provinces harbor genotypes A/C/D, while coastal Zhejiang aligns with genotype B clades shared with Japan, Korea, and Thailand. Zhejiang shows marked micro-evolutionary compartmentalization between Xiangshan and Ningbo.

triage.headline_ja: 沿岸東アジアにおけるダビエバンダウイルスの致死率はジェノタイプBと関連
triage.triage_reason: 2010-2023年の既存データを用いた学術的な疫学・ゲノム解析研究の紹介であり、新規アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: SFTS（重症熱性血小板減少症候群）は中国において既知のエンデミック疾患であり、本記事は2010-2023年の既往データに基づく内陸・沿岸地域の発生率・致死率・ゲノム型の比較研究を紹介する学術記事。新規症例報告やアウトブレイクの発生を報じるものではないためDISMISSと判定。日本・韓国・タイのゲノム型との類似性に言及があるが、これらの国での発生を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: CHP investigates imported Mpox case
article.articleSummary: Imported mpox (Monkeypox) case in Hong Kong: a 38-year-old man developed chills and fatigue on November 11 and anal pain, was admitted for isolation on November 16 at Queen Elizabeth Hospital; lab-confirmed by the CHP Public Health Laboratory Services Branch. He reported high-risk sexual contact with a man met via social media outside Hong Kong during incubation. CHP is conducting an epidemiological investigation and will report to the WHO. Since 2022, Hong Kong has 121 mpox cases (94 local, 27 imported), all male. Among 28 cases since August, infections linked to high-risk sexual activity with male partners; many unvaccinated. CHP expanded vaccination outreach, adding a centre at the CHP Building; over 1,000 high-risk individuals vaccinated since September 28. Two-dose mpox vaccine reduces infection risk by about 82% and lowers transmission by 87% in local data. Mpox is not transmitted via respiratory droplets; avoid close contact and seek care for symptoms. Mpox hotline 2125 2373 (9am–6pm).

triage.headline_ja: 衛生防護中心（CHP）、輸入性Mpox症例を調査

triage.notes: 香港はChina (1814991) に含めて報告。CHPはWHOへの報告を実施予定であり、既存のワクチン接種プログラムと監視体制で管理されている既知の流行継続事例。

article.articleHeadline: ബേക്കറിയിൽ നിന്ന് മധുരപലഹാരം കഴിച്ച യുവാവിന് മരണം; 5 പേർക്ക് ഭക്ഷ്യവിഷബാധ, കോടികളുടെ മായംചേർത്ത ഭക്ഷ്യവസ്തുക്കൾ പിടികൂടി
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A young man died after consuming a sweet from a bakery; five people suffered food poisoning, and crores-worth adulterated food items were seized.
article.articleSummary: In Mumbai, a 35-year-old man, Zubair Ansari, died with suspected food poisoning after consuming a sweet named ‘Aflatoon’ from Sagar Sweets & Bakery. Five others who ate the same item were hospitalized with symptoms including vomiting and abdominal discomfort; one patient tested positive for typhoid. Health authorities sealed the bakery and began sample testing; post-mortem results were awaited to confirm the cause. The incident prompted a state-wide food-safety crackdown: more than Rs 4.58 lakh worth of food items were seized from the bakery, and inspections across Maharashtra recovered adulterated foods valued at about Rs 1.97 crore. Five establishments were shut down, and licenses of four establishments in Mumbai and Nagpur were suspended as part of enforcement. Investigation continues to determine the infection source and scope of adulteration.

article.articleHeadline: Congo, allarme dell'Onu: si aggrava l'epidemia di Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo, UN warning: the Ebola epidemic is worsening.
article.articleSummary: Ebola continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with worsening insecurity in eastern regions hindering health and humanitarian interventions. UN warns the outbreak is worsening. National authorities, cited by UN spokesperson Farhan Haq, report more than 11,400 confirmed Ebola cases and over 5,500 deaths as of 15 November. The World Health Organization notes progress in containing transmission in some early epicenters and a substantial strengthening of diagnostic and therapeutic capacities. The update underscores persistent response challenges due to insecurity, while highlighting improvements in surveillance, testing, and treatment capacity in the affected regions of the DRC.

article.articleHeadline: Đồng Nai: Xác minh vụ hàng chục học sinh trường liên cấp bị nôn ói, tiêu chảy
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dong Nai: Investigating a case of dozens of students at a K-12 school experiencing vomiting and diarrhea.
article.articleSummary: Over 20 students at a K-12 school in Long Khánh Ward, Long Khánh Town, Dong Nai Province, Vietnam, developed fever, abdominal pain, vomiting and diarrhea on November 17, 2026. By November 18, health facilities reported dozens seeking care; cases are stable, with some students discharged and others still hospitalized for observation. The school independently organized meals for students; authorities have not yet issued a final diagnosis. The Long Khánh Regional General Hospital is treating patients, and the Dong Nai Department of Health is coordinating the investigation, with food samples sent to Pasteur Institute Ho Chi Minh City for testing to determine the infection source. Official conclusions are pending; updates will be provided based on hospital reports and investigation findings. The incident highlights a potential gastrointestinal infection linked to school meals, with an ongoing inquiry into the exact cause.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shivraj Singh Chouhan to launch India's first domestically produced avian influenza vaccine on November 20.
article.articleSummary: From New Delhi, India will launch its first domestically produced inactivated H5N1 avian influenza vaccine for chickens on November 20, announced by Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan. Developed by ICAR-NIHSAD, Bhopal, the vaccine targets the circulating clade 2.3.2.1a H5N1 strain, for which there is no commercial vaccine. Highly pathogenic avian influenza is lethal to poultry, with near 100% mortality and major economic losses from culling and trade disruption. Since 2006, India has reported over 500 H5N1/H5N8 cases. If outbreaks run unchecked, GDP growth could slip by up to 1.5% and more than 20% of the poultry population could be at risk, with past outbreaks costing around ₹2,200–3,000 crore and Manipur suffering about 0.5% GDP loss. WHO confirms 1,003 human H5N1 cases globally since 2003, with 479 deaths; the 2.3.2.1a clade underlies most poultry infections. The vaccine aims to curb spread and protect livelihoods and trade.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mysterious fever spreading in Nellai and Tenkasi districts... people throng hospitals.
article.articleSummary: Mysterious fever is spreading in Tirunelveli (Nellai) and Tenkasi districts of Tamil Nadu, with residents seeking care in government and private hospitals. In government facilities, more than 85 children and 105 adults are being treated for fever, and two cases have dengue fever. In private hospitals, 74 children and 86 adults are hospitalized for fever. Outpatient visits are high, with thousands of children and adults visiting daily. At Nellai Palayankottai Government Hospital, fever patients exceed 100. Doctors attribute the surge to seasonal weather changes and dehydration, and emphasize appropriate treatment. Siddha medicine teams are distributing Nilavembu Kashayam (Andrographis) and Kapasura Kudineer, and health camps and sanitation drives are being organized in affected areas. Areas cited include Nanguneri, Ambai, Valliyoor (Tirunelveli district) and Alangulam, Pavoorchatram, Sivakiri, Vasudevanallur, Kadayanallur (Tenkasi district).

article.articleHeadline: India To Launch First Indigenous H5N1 Bird Flu Vaccine For Chickens On November 20
article.articleSummary: India will launch its first indigenous H5N1 avian influenza vaccine for chickens on November 20, dedicating the vaccine at the National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (NIHSAD) in Bhopal. Developed by the ICAR-NIHSAD, the inactivated vaccine targets the H5N1 Clade 2.3.2.1a strain circulating in India. A single dose is expected to protect layer and breeder chickens for up to six months, with trials indicating favorable safety and effectiveness. The vaccine addresses recurring bird flu outbreaks, aims to reduce dependence on imported vaccines, and strengthen preventive measures on commercial poultry farms to safeguard the poultry industry. India has reported bird flu since 2006, with outbreaks impacting poultry health and trade; H5N1 can spill over to humans through exposure, so controlling poultry infections may lower zoonotic risk and support public health.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The first domestically produced bird flu vaccine has been developed in India; Shivraj Singh Chouhan will inaugurate it on November 20.
article.articleSummary: India has developed its first domestically produced H5N1 bird flu vaccine, created by ICAR-NIHSAD in Bhopal. The vaccine aims to shield poultry from avian influenza and protect the country’s poultry economy amid ongoing outbreaks. Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan will inaugurate it in Bhopal on November 20. Recent outbreaks include Tamil Nadu reporting about 50,000 poultry deaths; Kerala’s Alappuzha district with virus presence in around 26,000 quails, chickens, and ducks; Maharashtra culling about 150,000 chickens in May; and Karnataka recording roughly 50 peacock deaths. Although human transmission is rare, consuming infected poultry can pose a risk. The vaccine is expected to reduce farmer losses, bolster poultry farming, and strengthen surveillance and response to avian influenza across India.

article.articleHeadline: Khoảng 20 học sinh ở Đồng Nai nhập viện, nghi nhiễm trùng đường ruột
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: About 20 students in Dong Nai Province were hospitalized, suspected of having a gastrointestinal infection.
article.articleSummary: As of 18 November 2026, about 20 students in Long Khanh Ward, Dong Nai Province, were hospitalized with suspected gastrointestinal infection.
