The Dong Nai Department of Health is coordinating with relevant agencies to determine the cause, and the health facility is providing intensive care. The school has sent food samples to the Pasteur Institute of Ho Chi Minh City for testing; results are pending and will be released once investigations clarify the source and confirmation. No further details on laboratory confirmation or infection source are available yet.

triage.notes: 食品サンプルをパスツール研究所に送付し検査中。原因・感染源は未確定だが、単一校内の限定的な集団発生であり食中毒の可能性が高い。続報があれば再評価が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Bhopal Scientists Develop India's First Indigenous H5N1 Bird Flu Vaccine
article.articleSummary: India’s first indigenous H5N1 avian influenza vaccine, developed by ICAR-NIHSAD in Bhopal, targets clade 2.3.2.1a and is an inactivated vaccine designed to immunize chickens for up to six months with a single dose. Unveiling is scheduled in Bhopal on 20 November 2026 by Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan; rollout will proceed in phased, veterinarian-supervised stages across commercial poultry farms. Trials on laying hens and breeder flocks showed promising protection, with the aim to shield long-lived layers and breeders whose losses are economically devastating when outbreaks trigger mass culls. India’s bird flu history includes its 2006 outbreak, which cost the industry an estimated ₹2,200–₹3,000 crore, with over 500 national cases. H5N1 is zoonotic; global WHO data cite 1,003 human cases and 479 deaths since 2003. Controlling poultry infections reduces human risk and supports farm livelihoods.

article.articleHeadline: മരണസാധ്യത കൂടുതലുള്ള വൈറസ്; പക്ഷിപ്പനിയെ പിടിച്ചുകെട്ടാൻ തദ്ദേശീയ വാക്സിൻ വികസിപ്പിച്ച് ഇന്ത്യ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A highly lethal virus; India develops an indigenous vaccine to contain avian influenza.
article.articleSummary: India develops its first vaccine against avian influenza (H5N1) to curb outbreaks. Developed by ICAR-NIHSAD in Bhopal, it will be submitted to Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan. Until now India had no H5N1 vaccine. With outbreaks in Kerala, Tamil Nadu and Andhra Pradesh, authorities rely on culling to control spread, hurting farmers. Experts note H5N1 is about 100 times more lethal than COVID-19; since 2003 WHO records show 1,003 human infections and 479 deaths. Transmission occurs from infected poultry to humans via handling and consumption of meat and eggs; human-to-human spread remains unlikely, but possible if mutation occurs. Symptoms in humans include fever, diarrhea, headache, vomiting, abdominal pain, cough, and pneumonia. Preventive measures: PPE, handwashing, thoroughly cooking meat and eggs, proper disposal of dead birds, and safe decontamination with alkaline solutions and lime. Report unusual bird deaths within 1 km to authorities and seek medical care if sick.

triage.headline_ja: 致死率の高いウイルス；鳥インフルエンザ制圧へ、インドが国産ワクチンを開発
triage.triage_reason: インドでH5N1の家禽アウトブレイクが継続し国産ワクチン開発に至っているが、人への新規感染事例の報告ではなく科学・政策的ニュースのため、フルRRAに進めるほどの緊急性はないが動向注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は家禽でのH5N1アウトブレイク継続とインドによるワクチン開発を報じており、新規の人感染確定例の報告ではない。ケララ、タミルナードゥ、アンドラプラデーシュでの家禽淘汰が継続中である点は長期曝露・流行しやすさの観点から注視対象。

article.articleHeadline: Brucellosis Knowledge Deficits and Behavioral Gaps Found Along Southwestern
article.articleSummary: Brucellosis knowledge deficits and behavioral gaps were identified along Guizhou Province’s cattle value chain in a study of 771 stakeholders (142 farmers, 123 slaughterers, 109 vendors, 397 consumers) conducted Aug–Oct 2024. Brucellosis is expanding in China, with Guizhou newly endemic; cattle numbers reached 4.69 million by 2024. Awareness averaged 49.59%—far below the 90% national target; 57.1% had heard of brucellosis and 46.7% recognized its zoonotic transmission. Farmers showed the deepest gaps (31.7% recognizing susceptible animal species; 25.4% aware of zoonotic risks). Positive attitudes prevail—61.2% prioritize preventing human transmission; 68.6% willing to participate in education, with 89.4% of farmers and 93.6% of vendors open to training. Yet only about one-third consistently adopt safety measures; PPE use remains low, especially for masks and boots, despite high willingness (vendors 90.8% vs actual use). Attitude-practice correlation strongest (rs=0.299). Slaughterers and vendors had higher KAP than farmers/consumers, signaling need for node-specific interventions in this endemic setting.

triage.headline_ja: 中国南西部の牛バリューチェーンにおけるブルセラ症の知識不足と行動ギャップ
triage.triage_reason: ブルセラ症の流行拡大とナレッジギャップに関する学術的調査結果であり、緊急の公衆衛生事象ではないが、中国での新規流行地域拡大という継続的な曝露リスクがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本記事は貴州省における疫学的・行動学的調査研究であり、急性のアウトブレイクではない。ブルセラ症が中国で拡大傾向にあり貴州が新規流行地域となっている点は継続監視の価値がある。

article.articleSummary: Avian influenza A(H5N1) confirmed in domestic birds in Kerala across Alappuzha and Pathanamthitta districts. A one-week surveillance zone is imposed, prohibiting sale and movement of poultry, eggs, and meat (including chickens and ducks). Containment measures are being implemented; no human cases are reported in the article. Published 2026-11-18, reflecting current outbreak response in these districts of Kerala.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amid the deaths of thousands of chickens, India takes a significant step; a domestic vaccine is ready for Bird Flu.
article.articleSummary: India unveils its first domestically developed H5N1 poultry vaccine, produced by ICAR-NIHSAD in Bhopal, to be dedicated on November 20 by Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan. Amid Bird Flu outbreaks, Tamil Nadu’s Cuddalore district reported 35,647 dead chickens as of November 13, with about 40,000 birds culled; Andhra Pradesh is also affected. H5N1 can rarely infect humans, especially those with close contact to infected birds; avoid handling sick or dead birds and ensure poultry meat and eggs are thoroughly cooked. article.articleHeadline: L'Unicef indique que les enfants forment un tiers des décès d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UNICEF says that children account for one-third of Ebola deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: authorities report 11,000 cases in six months, with children making up about a quarter of cases and one-third of deaths. The Bundibugyo strain circulating has no vaccine or treatment. UNICEF emergency-head Jérôme Kouachi told franceinfo on November 17 that the situation is dramatic and children remain the most vulnerable. UNICEF is pushing for early detection, pediatric care improvements, and education-system outreach to inform communities, but the eastern DRC’s long-running conflicts cripple medical capacity and hinder response. The WHO said in early November that two vaccine candidates could be evaluated in DRC within 2–3 weeks in clinical trials: Moderna’s mRNA vaccine and a Oxford University–Serum Institute of India collaboration, both aimed at Bundibugyo, with results expected in early 2027. A successful vaccine would accelerate containment.

article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (H5N1) confirmed in samples from Alappuzha district, Kerala, triggering mass culling beginning today (Nov 18, 2026). More than 26,000 poultry birds within infected or surveillance zones will be culled, with operations expanding across 36 local self-government areas, including Alappuzha Municipality, Harippad, and Mavelikkara municipalities, plus four gram panchayats in Pathanamthitta district. The public is urged to follow personal protective measures to reduce zoonotic transmission. Early human symptoms include fever, body aches, cough, diarrhea, sore throat, and shortness of breath; blood in sputum or severe pneumonia requires urgent medical care.

article.articleHeadline: India's First Indigenous H5N1 Bird Flu Vaccine to Launch on Nov 20
article.articleSummary: India launches its first indigenous inactivated H5N1 vaccine for chickens, targeting the Clade 2.3.2.1a strain driving recurrent poultry outbreaks. Developed by ICAR-NIHSAD in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, the vaccine will be dedicated on November 20, 2026, by Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan in a ceremony in Bhopal. This is the domestic market’s first vaccine tailored to the circulating strain, addressing a major void since 2006 when India logged over 500 H5N1/H5N8 outbreaks. The outbreak risk threatens more than 20% of poultry stock and could trim national GDP growth by about 1.5% if uncontained. Globally, the WHO records 1,003 human H5N1 cases and 479 deaths in 25 countries since 2003, with spillover into mammals and three human infections reported in India. article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in DR Congo exceeded 11,500.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak has surpassed 11,500 laboratory-confirmed infections, reaching 11,504 since the May outbreak began in DR Congo and Uganda. In the past 24 hours, 72 new cases were identified, with 39 new deaths, bringing lab-confirmed deaths to 5,630 (case fatality rate 48.9%). There are 1,743 people in medical isolation or quarantine with suspected Ebola, and contact tracing stands at 81.6%. The epicenter is Ituri Province, DR Congo. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain for which there are no WHO-approved medicines or vaccines. Uganda declared its outbreak over on July 28, later confirmed by WHO. Kenya reported a first Ebola case on October 6, and Nigeria announced a case on October 20 on its national territory.

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết ở Đà Nẵng diễn biến phức tạp, một bệnh nhi tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever in Da Nang with a complicated course; one child dies.
article.articleSummary: Da Nang, Vietnam is facing a dengue fever surge with a complicated course. Year-to-date, the city has reported 10,724 dengue cases, up 3.4-fold versus 2025. By 13 November, cumulative cases reached 8,782 (286.47 per 100,000 population); week 45 alone saw 1,376 cases across 58 small outbreaks. In mid‑November, a 12-year-old resident of An Hai ward died after hospital admission on 23 October, with dengue hemorrhagic-like illness accompanied by severe pneumonia and obesity as comorbidities; death occurred on 5 November after 17 days of treatment. Vector control is hampered by damaged spraying equipment, dwindling Permethrin, and exhausted Chloramine B, delaying second-round interventions. CDC Da Nang urges intensified prevention and public communication, including daily 10–15 minute checks to remove standing water, larval habitats, mosquito avoidance measures, and prompt medical care for warning symptoms; home treatment is not advised.

article.articleHeadline: Surveillance Across China Identifies High PRRSV2 Prevalence and Extensive
article.articleSummary: PRRSV2 remains the dominant swine pathogen in China. A 2022–2025 nationwide survey across 30 provinces analyzed 23,962 clinical samples from pigs with abortion or respiratory signs; 7,977 were ORF6-positive by qRT-PCR, for an overall positive rate of 33.29% (95% CI 32.69–33.89). Four major lineages circulate (1, 3, 5, 8) with sublineages 1.8 (NADC30-like) and 1.5 (NADC34-like) prominent. ORF5 sequencing of 2,433 field samples yielded: sublineage 1.8 1,171 sequences (48.13%), sublineage 1.5 394 (16.19%), lineage 8 398 (16.36%), lineage 5 286 (11.76%), lineage 3 184 (7.56%). Historically, lineage 8 predominated before 2013; 1.8 emerged in 2013; 1.5 arose in 2017. Phylogenetic analysis used MEGA 11 (1,000 bootstrap) on ORF5. The study confirms persistent, widespread circulation of PRRSV2 in Chinese swine herds during 2022–2025.

triage.headline_ja: 中国全土の調査でPRRSV2の高い流行率と広範なゲノム組換えが判明
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は豚の病原体PRRSV2（豚繁殖・呼吸障害症候群ウイルス）に関する動物疾患サーベイランス報告であり、ヒトへの健康影響や公衆衛生上の緊急性は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 疾患名タグ『Coccidioidomycosis』は記事内容（PRRSV2＝豚の家畜感染症）と一致しておらず、Bluedotのタグ付け誤りと思われる。ヒト感染症ではないためトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Illegal Mining Linked to Significant Malaria Surge in Roraima, Brazil
article.articleSummary: Malaria surveillance in Brazil’s Roraima state (2015–2024) shows a sharp rise in autochthonous cases, increasing from 6,176 to over 30,000 annual notifications in the SIVEP-Malaria system. Mining-associated malaria fluctuated, peaking in 2022 when 46% of autochthonous cases were linked to illegal gold-mining in the Yanomami Indigenous Land; by 2024, this proportion fell to 4.3% (p<0.0001). Affected populations skew male (70.4–80%), predominantly Brown ethnicity (64.5–88.5%), mostly adults 20–59 with low education; pregnant women account for 0.8–4.9%. Plasmodium vivax is identified in 60.2–91.9% of cases, with 95.9–100% showing symptoms. While Roraima houses the majority, notifications expanded to Maranhão, Pará, and Amazonas since 2019; Boa Vista is the focal municipality for mining-associated malaria. Authors urge curbing illegal mining and implementing interventions to interrupt transmission toward elimination.

triage.headline_ja: 違法採掘とブラジル・ロライマ州における顕著なマラリア急増の関連
triage.triage_reason: 違法金採掘に関連したマラリア（主に三日熱マラリア原虫）の増加と、マラニャン・パラ・アマゾナス州への拡大傾向が報告されているが、本記事は2015-2024年の疫学サーベイランス研究であり、急性アウトブレイクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はSIVEP-Malariaシステムによる長期サーベイランスデータの分析報告であり、違法採掘との関連は2022年にピーク（46%）を迎えた後、2024年には4.3%まで低下している。地理的拡大（新規州への波及）は継続的モニタリングの対象として注視すべきだが、現時点では緊急シグナルとは判断されない。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India has developed the first indigenous vaccine for avian influenza, to be launched on November 20.
article.articleSummary: India launches first indigenous H5N1 avian influenza vaccine for poultry, to be dedicated on November 20. Developed by ICAR's National Institute of High Security Animal Disease (NIHSAD) in Bhopal, the inactive vaccine targets the H5N1 virus clade 2.3.2.1A in chickens. This marks the first domestic vaccine against this virus in India, addressing poultry farmers' losses from bird flu. Bird flu, or avian influenza, has caused multiple outbreaks since 2006 in India, including H5N1 and H5N8 with hundreds of outbreaks overall, jeopardizing chickens, eggs, and chicken meat trade. The government estimated direct and indirect losses of about INR 2,200–3,000 crore in 2006, and up to over 20% of India's poultry could be affected in larger outbreaks. WHO data since 2003 indicate 1,003 human H5N1 cases and 479 deaths across 25 countries, underscoring the need for vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: インドが鳥インフルエンザ初の国産ワクチンを開発、11月20日に発売予定
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はインドの家禽用H5N1ワクチンの開発・発売に関する情報であり、新規の疾病発生や人への感染拡大を示すものではないため、トリアージ対象としない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン開発・発売のニュースであり、現在進行中の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではないため、地域検証の対象外（発生地域なし）とした。過去の鳥インフルエンザ流行歴への言及のみで、新規イベントとしての情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkot vaksinasi puluhan hewan penular rabies di Cengkareng Timur
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City Government Vaccinates Dozens of Rabies-Transmitting Animals in East Cengkareng
article.articleSummary: West Jakarta's Food Security, Maritime, and Agriculture Service (KPKP) vaccinated 70 rabies-transmitting animals at Sekretariat RW 12, Cengkareng Timur: 55 cats, 11 dogs, and 4 macaques. The effort aims to curb rabies transmission and raise pet-owners' awareness of animal health. The vaccination event took place on Tuesday, 17 November, with follow-up sessions planned on Wednesday, 18 November (RW 18) and Thursday, 19 November (RW 19) in Cengkareng Timur. Through end-May 2026, authorities vaccinated 3,692 HPR out of an annual target of 9,300, a figure that continues to rise as vaccination expands to eight subdistricts in West Jakarta. The program underscores ongoing rabies prevention and community education in the municipality.

triage.headline_ja: 市政府、東チェンカレンで狂犬病媒介動物数十匹にワクチン接種

article.articleHeadline: 10 Warga Subang Positif Malaria Sepanjang Januari-Oktober 2026, Kecamatan Kalijati Titik Terbanyak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 10 Subang Residents Test Positive for Malaria Throughout January–October 2026, Kalijati District Has the Most Hotspots
article.articleSummary: Malaria in Subang Regency, Indonesia: 10 imported malaria cases were recorded from January through October 2026, with no indigenous transmission since Subang earned a malaria-elimination certificate in 2022. All infections occurred in residents who contracted malaria outside Subang and became ill after returning home. Kalijati district accounted for six of the import cases, while the remaining four occurred in other areas. Subang remains malaria-free domestically, but ongoing risk relates to travel to endemic regions. Destination areas include Papua, Papua Barat, Kalimantan, Nusa Tenggara Timur, and Maluku. The Subang Health Office urges residents planning travel or returning from endemic areas to report to local public health centers (puskesmas) promptly and stay vigilant for malaria symptoms. Timeframe: January–October 2026; published November 18, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年1月〜10月、スバン県住民10人がマラリア陽性、カリジャティ郡が最多

triage.notes: 輸入症例のみで現地伝播なし。マラリア流行地（パプア、パプアバラット、カリマンタン、マルク等）への渡航関連の注意喚起記事であり、通常の公衆衛生モニタリング報告に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: ചി​റ​ക​ടി​ച്ച് ആ​ശ​ങ്ക, ആ​ല​പ്പു​ഴ​യി​ൽ വീ​ണ്ടും പ​ക്ഷി​പ്പ​നി; ര​ണ്ട്​ പ​ഞ്ചാ​യ​ത്തി​ൽ സ്ഥി​രീ​ക​രി​ച്ചു | Alappuzha Bird Flu Outbreak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu scare as it resurfaces in Alappuzha; confirmed in two panchayats | Alappuzha Bird Flu Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (bird flu) resurfaces in Alappuzha district, Kerala, confirmed on two farms in Ambalapuzha North and Chennithala Grama Panchayats. About 26,000 poultry within a one-kilometer culling radius will be culled, including 10,044 birds in Ambalapuzha North. Laboratory confirmation came from NIHSAD in Bhopal. Culling is planned for Wednesday, carried out by six rapid-response teams, each with one doctor, two livestock inspectors, two assistants, and four workers, with support from local officials. A 10-km surveillance zone surrounds the outbreak centers. An emergency meeting chaired by District Collector Shaji V. Nair coordinated the response with disaster-management, veterinary, health, police, revenue, and panchayat departments.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザが再発、アラップーザで懸念高まる。2つのパンチャーヤトで確認
triage.triage_reason: 家禽における鳥インフルエンザの発生で、人への感染報告はなく、地元当局による通常の防疫対応（殺処分・監視区域設定）が実施されている定型的な動物疾病事例である。
triage.notes: ヒトへの感染報告はなく、家禽における鳥インフルエンザのアウトブレイクで、地方当局（郡長主導）による標準的な殺処分・監視体制が確立されている。ケララ州では過去にも繰り返し発生しており、異常性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: ONU: Ebola tue des enfants au Congo, et risque d'une propagation plus importante
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UN: Ebola kills children in the Congo, and poses a risk of wider spread.
article.articleSummary: The United Nations warns that Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo are worsening six months into the epidemic, with rising cases and deaths. To date, 1,730 children have died. Children make up more than a quarter of confirmed cases and about a third of deaths, with seven in ten under-five infections resulting in death. The crisis is fuelled by conflict, displacement, and a looming food emergency, with more than 39 million people expected to face acute food insecurity by early 2027, and over 30 million in the Congo facing severe food insecurity in the coming months. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stresses the vulnerability of children. Cross-border risk is highlighted, as Kenya reports nine Ebola cases linked to an imported case.

triage.headline_ja: 国連:コンゴでエボラが子どもたちの命を奪い、さらなる拡大のリスクも
triage.triage_reason: エボラ流行が深刻化し死者が増加、ケニアへの越境感染も報告されており、国際的拡大リスクが高い。IHR基準複数該当のためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: ケニアでの9例は輸入症例に関連した二次感染だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。食料不安や紛争が流行を悪化させている複合危機。

article.articleHeadline: India develops 1st indigenous bird flu vaccine
article.articleSummary: India's first indigenous vaccine against H5N1 avian influenza has been developed by ICAR-NIHSAD in Bhopal and will be launched November 20 in Bhopal by Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan. The vaccine targets chickens and the H5N1 clade 2.3.2.1a. The development comes amid ongoing bird flu outbreaks and mass poultry culling to curb spread, with movement restrictions on poultry. Notable recent outbreaks: Tamil Nadu's Cuddalore district and Andhra Pradesh's Anantapur district. In Cuddalore, H5N1 confirmation followed sudden farm bird deaths, triggering culling of about 40,000 chickens; Kerala also plans widespread culling, about 26,000 birds to be culled on Wednesday. The Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying's 2025-26 annual report lists avian influenza outbreaks across Maharashtra, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Andhra Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Telangana, Karnataka and Bihar. H5N1 is highly pathogenic in poultry, causing severe disease and high mortality.

triage.headline_ja: インドが初の国産H5N1鳥インフルエンザワクチンを開発
triage.triage_reason: 複数州にわたるH5N1高病原性鳥インフルエンザのアウトブレイクが継続し、大規模な家禽殺処分や移動制限が実施されており、政府（農業大臣）がワクチン発表に関与するなど行政の関心も高いため、フルリスク評価に進む価値がある。
triage.notes: 記事はヒト感染例を報告しておらず、主に家禽における動物衛生上のアウトブレイクとワクチン開発に関する内容。ただしH5N1 clade 2.3.2.1aは人獣共通感染症としてのパンデミックポテンシャルがあり、複数州（マハラシュトラ、チャッティースガル、ジャールカンド、アーンドラ・プラデーシュ、マディヤ・プラデーシュ、テランガーナ、カルナータカ、ビハール、タミル・ナードゥ、ケーララ）での継続的な発生と大量殺処分が報告されているため、動物衛生面でのモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India's First Indigenous H5N1 Vaccine, Shivraj Singh Chouhan, Avian Influenza Vaccine | Will there be a break in chicken deaths due to bird flu? India has developed the first domestic vaccine.
article.articleSummary: India has developed the first indigenous H5N1 avian influenza vaccine for chickens, produced by ICAR-NIHSAD in Bhopal and to be dedicated by Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan on 20 November in Bhopal. The inactivated vaccine targets H5N1 clade 2.3.2.1A, the predominant poultry lineage in India, and aims to contain outbreaks, shield poultry farmers, and reduce spillover risk to other animals and humans. Bird flu can disrupt production, supplies, and prices, with potential GDP damage up to 1.5% if widespread; past losses include INR 2200–3000 crore in 2006, and Manipur’s outbreak caused about 0.5% GDP damage. Globally, since 2003 WHO records 1,003 human cases and 479 deaths in 25 countries; India has reported three human infections of this clade. There is currently no commercial vaccine against this clade in India, underscoring the significance of a domestic option.

article.articleHeadline: பறவைக் காய்ச்சல் அறிகுறியா? - திருவள்ளூரில் 300 வாத்துகள் மர்ம மரணம் - களத்தில் இறங்கிய தேசிய குழு!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu symptoms? - 300 ducks die under mysterious circumstances in Thiruvallur - National team deployed to the field!
article.articleSummary: More than 300 ducks died suddenly at a duck farm in Thiruvallur district, in the Poondi union area of the northern part of the district. The farm owner is named Venkatesan. The deaths occurred during the recent monsoon, prompting a field visit by a team from the National Centre for Disease Control. They collected samples from the dead ducks and sent them for laboratory testing to confirm whether avian influenza is involved. In the interim, health authorities advised preventive measures and containment, conducting outreach in Uttukkottai, Kachur, and Mambakkam and setting up medical camps to treat residents. Lab results are awaited. A local resident, Raman, claimed chickens also died and were buried, but officials said no bird flu has been confirmed. The investigation continues with the aim of confirming the infection source and guiding response.

Developed by ICAR-NIHSAD, the inactivated vaccine targets H5N1 Clade 2.3.2.1a and is India’s first vaccine against this clade. HPAI bird flu can cause nearly 100% poultry mortality, with outbreaks since 2006 totaling over 500 across H5N1 and H5N8. The vaccine aims to curb spread, protect livestock, and enable rollout across high-risk farming regions, where no commercial vaccine existed.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 72 % des moins de cinq ans infectés sont morts, selon l'UNICEF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 72% of children under five who were infected have died, according to UNICEF.
article.articleSummary: UNICEF reports that as of Nov 4, 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has caused 1,737 deaths among those under 18 since the outbreak began; 2,959 minors tested positive. Under-18s account for 28% of confirmed cases and 35% of deaths; among under-fives, 14% of cases and 21% of deaths, with about 72% of infections in this age group dying. By Nov 14, total confirmed cases reached 11,376 and 5,568 deaths nationwide (ECDC). About four in five child deaths occur outside Ebola treatment centers, prompting calls for pediatric care within centers. The Nord-Kivu Cantine-Aloya attack (Nov 5–6) killed 66 civilians, including 3 health workers, linked to the ADF; three facilities looted and over 1,000 contacts untraceable, with 400–500 new weekly cases. More than 2,280 children have become orphans or separated; 16 creches support them. Approximately 7,500 schools with 2.5 million pupils lack prevention measures; vaccination uptake lags in Tshopo and South Kivu, and Nord-Kivu births in facilities fell ~18% (Jan-Sep).

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱（コンゴ民主共和国）：UNICEFによると感染した5歳未満児の72％が死亡
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で感染者11,376人、死者5,568人に達する大規模なエボラ流行が継続中であり、小児の致死率が極めて高く、武装勢力による攻撃で接触者追跡が困難になるなど感染拡大・管理上の深刻な懸念がある。
triage.notes: 武装勢力ADFによる攻撃で医療施設が略奪され、1,000人以上の接触者が追跡不能となっており、週400〜500例の新規感染が継続。小児の死亡の多くが治療センター外で発生しており、国際的な小児医療支援の必要性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Число подтвержденных случаев заражения Эболой в Конго превысило 11 500
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has exceeded 11,500.
article.articleSummary: As of 18 November 2026, laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have surpassed 11,500, with 11,504 confirmed and 5,630 deaths (case fatality 48.9%). In the past 24 hours, 72 new cases were reported and 39 more deaths. A total of 1,743 people are suspected and in medical isolation or quarantine. Six months after the outbreak was officially declared, the situation remains uncontrolled, hindered by resource shortages, security instability, and coordination gaps. The outbreak is driven by a Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, described as spreading faster than any previously recorded outbreak. The National Institute of Public Health notes an 81.6% rate of detection and monitoring among contacts of Ebola patients. Reuters corroborates that the situation continues to be challenging.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱感染確定症例数が11,500人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約49%、1万人超の確定症例、6か月経過しても制御不能な大規模アウトブレイクであり、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の複数該当が確認される。
triage.notes: Bundibugyoエボラウイルス株による過去最速の拡大速度とされ、資源不足・治安不安・調整不足により制御困難な状況が継続している。

article.articleHeadline: Un allié d'Eisenkot à la tête du Parlement israélien, la rougeole de retour aux États-Unis, un sommet inédit entre Xi Jinping, Poutine et Trump... Notre récap de l'actualité internationale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An Eisenkot ally at the head of the Israeli Parliament, measles back in the United States, an unprecedented summit between Xi Jinping, Putin and Trump... Our recap of international news.
article.articleSummary: Measles resurges in the United States amid declining vaccination rates, with the report linking the outbreak to reduced immunization but providing no specific case counts, deaths, or laboratory confirmation in the excerpt. This health note sits within a broader international roundup, which also covers a historic unprecedented summit among Xi Jinping, Vladimir Putin, and Donald Trump, the election of a new speaker in the Israeli Parliament, and other geopolitical developments. The piece frames the U.S. measles resurgence as a notable infectious-disease update in the current global news cycle dated 2026-11-18, highlighting vaccination trends as a key public health context.

article.articleHeadline: 民主剛果伊波拉疫情釀5568死　WHO：將展開疫苗試驗
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak has claimed 5,568 lives; WHO says vaccine trials will be launched.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 11,376 cases and 5,568 deaths, according to the World Health Organization (WHO). The ongoing epidemic is the worst Ebola event in DRC history and has been declared a public health emergency of international concern. There is currently no vaccine or therapy for Bundibugyo virus, but two candidate vaccines are set to enter clinical trials next week in the outbreak zone. The Tumaini trial will assess multiple vaccines within a single framework and employ ring vaccination to immunize contacts at high risk of infection. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said the trials will move quickly, marking a pivotal step toward curbing transmission while the outbreak continues.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴのエボラ流行で死者5568人、WHOがワクチン試験を開始へ
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最悪のエボラ流行でPHEICが宣言されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当するため、フルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: WHOにより既にPHEIC宣言済みの大規模エボラ流行。ワクチン臨床試験（Tumaini試験）開始という重要な進展があり、継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: RDC: Louis Watum mobilise 1,1 millions USD comme contribution du secteur minier à la riposte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Louis Watum mobilizes $1.1 million as a contribution from the mining sector to the Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo faces the Ebola virus disease as the 17th outbreak wave. Mining Minister Louis Watum Kabamba announced a $1.1 million sector contribution to the Ebola response, presented on November 17, 2026 to the General Coordination for the Ebola Incident Management System (SGI MVE 17), represented by Dr. Jean-Jacques Muyembe. The ceremony in Grand Orientale was attended by national deputies and senators and ministry officials. The gift aligns with national mobilization spearheaded by President Félix Antoine Tshisekedi Tshilombo and implemented under Prime Minister Judith Suminwa Tuluka, reflecting cross-sector solidarity. Watum Kabamba, a native son of Grand Orientale, underscored collective responsibility to protect populations affected by Ebola. Muyembe welcomed the support, noting its importance in current outbreak response. A representative of Grand Orientale also thanked the minister, highlighting a humanitarian dimension alongside the mining sector’s contribution.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：ルイ・ワトゥム氏、鉱業セクターからの資金110万米ドルをエボラ対応に拠出
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（第17波）に関する政府・産業界の対応動員が報じられており、WPRO基準（重症度、持続曝露、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）に複数該当し、政府・社会的関心も高いため。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知の第17波エボラアウトブレイクへの資金拠出に関する報道であり、新規シグナルというよりは既存事案の継続的対応状況を示す内容。フルRRAでは既存のアウトブレイク評価との統合が必要。

article.articleHeadline: RDC-Bunyakiri: suite aux combats entre FRN et armée, l'insécurité complique l'accès aux soins dans une zone touchée par le choléra et le paludisme
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC-Bunyakiri: Following clashes between FRN and the army, insecurity is hampering access to healthcare in an area affected by cholera and malaria.
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak and a malaria surge in the Bunyakiri health zone, South Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, amid intensified fighting between FARDC (backed by militias) and FRN since November 6, have driven mass displacement and disrupted access to healthcare and essential medicines. MSF warns that deteriorating security and reduced treatment capacity raise the risk for communities already burdened by disease. On November 13, drone strikes near Bulambika close to populated areas and the Bunyakiri Referral General Hospital, which MSF supports, prompted relocation of hospital services to Maibano and the transfer of 76 inpatients. The hospital had logged an average of over 1,280 admissions per month recently, including 1,438 in October. MSF temporarily reduced local staffing, relocating teams to Bitale and Bukavu to limit exposure, while continuing to donate medicines and supplies to district health centers. MSF calls on all parties to respect international humanitarian law and protect civilians and health facilities to ensure safe access to care.

triage.headline_ja: DRC・ブニャキリ：FRNと政府軍の戦闘により、コレラとマラリアが流行する地域での医療アクセスが困難に
triage.triage_reason: コレラ流行とマラリア急増に加え、武力衝突による医療アクセス遮断と国内避難民の発生が重なり、MSFが国際的な懸念を表明しているため、フルリスク評価に進むべき事案と判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域にSomaliaが含まれているが、記事サマリーはDRC・南キブ州ブニャキリのみに言及しており、Somaliaは関連性なしと判断し除外した。武力紛争による医療崩壊がコレラ・マラリア対応を一層困難にしている点が主要な懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: Esporotricose: entenda a doença que já afetou mais de 1.400 pessoas no Rio Grande do Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sporotrichosis: Understand the disease that has affected more than 1,400 people in Rio Grande do Sul.
article.articleSummary: Sporotrichosis in Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, shows 1,465 confirmed human cases in 2026, 2,752 notifications, and 1,051 under investigation as of Nov 17, 2026. Caused by Sporothrix fungi, it affects humans and animals, especially cats, with transmission from skin injuries, scratched or bitten by infected animals, or contact with contaminated soil, plants, or wood. Porto Alegre's metropolitan region accounts for many cases. Symptoms start as skin lesions, may form nodules or ulcers, with possible mucosal involvement and lymphatic spread; incubation 1 week to 6 months. Treatments include itraconazole, potassium iodide, and terbinafine; amphotericin B for severe disease. Diagnosis relies on clinical assessment and lesion culture; treatment is provided free by SUS. Do not abandon infected cats; since 2025 the disease is nationally notifiable.

triage.headline_ja: スポロトリコーシス：リオグランデ・ド・スルで1,400人以上に影響を与えた疾患を理解する
triage.triage_reason: ヒト-ヒト感染はなく重症例も少ないため国際的リスクは低いが、症例数が多く継続的な曝露が懸念されるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 動物（主にネコ）由来の人獣共通真菌感染症で、ヒト-ヒト感染はない。ブラジル南部で症例数が増加し2025年から全国届出義務化されているが、治療法が確立しSUSで無償対応されているため国際的な拡大・貿易制限リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: يبولا يفتك بالكونغو الديمقراطية.. 5500 وفاة وأكثر من 11 ألف إصابة فى تفشٍ قياسى.. هجمات على الفرق الطبية ونقص الإمدادات والتمويل يعرقل احتواء الوباء.. مسئولون أمميون: انعدام الأمن عقبة رئيسية أمام جهود الاحتواء
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola ravages the Democratic Republic of the Congo... 5,500 deaths and more than 11,000 cases in a record outbreak... Attacks on medical teams and shortages of supplies and funding hinder containment of the outbreak... U.N. officials: Insecurity is a major obstacle to containment efforts.
article.articleSummary: Ebola continues to ravage the Democratic Republic of the Congo, marking a record eastern outbreak with more than 11,000 cases and over 5,500 deaths since it was declared on May 15, 2026. The seventh Ebola outbreak in DRC and the second-largest globally by case count, it is driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain, complicating response as transmission spreads beyond the epicenter in Ituri province. Security threats, logistics gaps, shortages of medical supplies, and weak coordination are hampering containment. Attacks on medical teams and limited access to affected communities exacerbate the crisis; MSF warns supplies remain unavailable outside the outbreak center in Ituri. Health workers have faced delayed pay and some strikes amid funding shortfalls. Donors pledged about $2.9 billion, but less than half has been disbursed, underscoring critical funding gaps amid insecurity.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴ民主共和国を襲う…死者5,500人、感染者1万1千人超の記録的流行…医療チームへの攻撃、物資・資金不足が封じ込めを妨げる…国連当局者：治安の欠如が封じ込め努力の主要な障害
triage.triage_reason: DRCで記録的規模（1万1千人超の感染、5,500人超の死亡）のエボラ流行が継続しており、稀な株による感染拡大・治安悪化・資金不足が複合しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: イトゥリ州（Ituri）はDRC国内の地域区分であり、国としてはDRCのみをverified_locationsに計上。資金援助は約29億ドルが誓約されたが半分未満しか拠出されておらず、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Chuva e calor entre novembro e janeiro podem aumentar casos de dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rain and heat between November and January can increase dengue cases.
article.articleSummary: Nov 2026–Jan 2027 in Southeast Brazil is expected to be highly conducive to Aedes aegypti proliferation, boosting dengue, chikungunya, and Zika transmission. Temperatures are projected 1–2°C above averages, with late-spring to early-summer rainfall and El Niño amplifying outbreak risk in the region. Rio de Janeiro saw mean temperature rise from 26.5°C to 27.1°C; humidity and heat accelerate vector replication. Ministry of Health data show mortality in the Southeast rising from 48 to 62 deaths; dengue cases nationwide exceeded 185,000 (95,000 in the Southeast) in 2023/24, and about 210,000 (88,000 in the Southeast) in the following cycle. Chikungunya and Zika declined from 12,400 to 9,800 and 890 to 640, respectively. New serotypes 3 and 4 are circulating, increasing outbreak risk. Preventive measures include aggressive vector control; dengue vaccination available for ages 10–59 in public health networks, while elderly, children, pregnant and immunocompromised not recommended; repellents advised.

triage.headline_ja: 11月から1月の雨と暑さがデング熱症例を増加させる可能性
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル南東部における季節性のデング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱増加の予測記事であり、新規の異常事態ではないが媒介蚊増殖や新血清型流行など経過観察が必要な要素がある。
triage.notes: 本記事は季節性気候要因によるデング熱等の増加予測に関する分析記事であり、既存のエンデミック疾患の季節的変動を扱っている。新規血清型3・4の流行拡大や死亡者数の増加傾向は注視すべきだが、現時点で異常事態や渡航制限等のIHR基準には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 張啓楷路邊尿尿沒洗手就拜票！醫揭細菌危機　當心傳播「1疾病」
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Zhang Qikai pees by the roadside, doesn't wash his hands, then canvasses for votes! Doctor reveals a bacterial threat—beware the spread of 'a disease'.
article.articleSummary: Chiayi City, Taiwan—mayoral candidate Zhang Qikai was seen urinating by the roadside and then campaigning without handwashing, triggering public hygiene concerns. A physician warns that post-urination hand contact with the genitals can leave bacteria on the hands, which may be spread by handshakes or touching objects, raising infection risk. Dr. Huang Gaobin, deputy director of the China Medical Infection Control Center, notes bacteria near the urinary and reproductive tract—such as Escherichia coli, Gram-negative intestinal bacteria, and anaerobes—can transfer if hands aren’t cleaned. If such bacteria reach another person and are touched to the eyes or nose, they can cause bacterial conjunctivitis. The doctor urges comprehensive hand hygiene beyond the usual after-toilet and before meals: after any contact with the body or potentially contaminated items, wash hands regularly to prevent bacterial spread between people and the environment in daily life in Chiayi City, Taiwan.

triage.headline_ja: 張啓楷、路上で排尿し手も洗わず票集め！医師が細菌リスクを警告　「ある疾患」の拡散に注意
triage.triage_reason: 個別の衛生マナーに関する一般的な医学解説記事であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクや症例報告ではないため、公衆衛生上の懸念基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 台湾の政治家の衛生マナーに関する話題記事であり、実際の感染症発生事例ではない。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Среща между китайската панда, заразения с чума плъх от Санкт Петербург и американския бабуин с изцапано червено дупе, но в златен фрак
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Meeting Between the Chinese Panda, the Plague-Infected Rat from Saint Petersburg, and the American Baboon with a Stained Red Butt, but in a Golden Tailcoat.
article.articleSummary: An article in Bulgarian presents a satirical scenario about a forthcoming Shenzhen meeting on 18 November between Chinese President Xi Jinping, U.S. President Donald Trump, and Russian President Vladimir Putin. It imaginatively features a Chinese panda, a plague-infected rat from Saint Petersburg, and an American baboon with a stained red butt, all wearing a gold tailcoat. Quoted Russian commentator Igor Eydman, the Facebook post proposes several variants for how to report the event. The piece uses plague imagery to lampoon geopolitical spectacle rather than describe an actual outbreak; no laboratory confirmation, case counts, or real epidemiological data are provided. The setting links Saint Petersburg and Shenzhen in a provocative, symbolic cross-border satire about high-level diplomacy.

triage.headline_ja: 中国のパンダ、サンクトペテルブルクのペスト感染ネズミ、金色の燕尾服を着た赤く汚れたお尻のアメリカのヒヒの出会い
triage.triage_reason: 記事は政治風刺記事であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクを報告するものではない。疫学的データや症例報告は一切含まれない。
triage.notes: 本記事は米中露首脳会談を風刺する政治コメディであり、ペスト感染の実例を報じたものではないため、感染症シグナルとしての実体がない。

article.articleHeadline: Đồng Nai xác minh vụ khoảng 20 học sinh nhập viện với triệu chứng giống nhau
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dong Nai Province confirms incident involving about 20 students hospitalized with similar symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Approximately 20 students in Long Khánh Ward, Dong Nai City, Dong Nai Province, Vietnam, were hospitalized with fever, abdominal pain, vomiting, and diarrhea. On 17 November, many students at a local school developed similar symptoms and were treated at Long Khánh Regional General Hospital. On 18 November, the Dong Nai Department of Health, in coordination with authorities, confirmed a cluster of gastrointestinal infection among the students; investigations are ongoing to determine the cause. Food samples from the school have been sent to the Pasteur Institute Ho Chi Minh City for laboratory testing to identify the etiological agent. Authorities continue to investigate the source and assess whether cases are linked, with surveillance and control measures ongoing as results unfold.

triage.headline_ja: ドンナイ省、約20人の生徒が同様の症状で入院した事件を確認
triage.triage_reason: 学校での集団胃腸炎（食中毒疑い）事例で原因調査中だが、国際的拡大や重篤性を示す情報は乏しく、続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 食品由来の集団発生が疑われ、病原体特定のため検査中。ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性は低いとみられる。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1
Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N8

article.articleHeadline: Bird Flu Can Cost Rs 3,000 Crore Loss To India But Now There Is 'Made In India' Solution
article.articleSummary: India will launch its first indigenously developed vaccine against H5N1 avian influenza, an inactivated vaccine by ICAR-NIHSAD, targeting Clade 2.3.2.1a. Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan will announce the achievement on 20 November 2026 at ICAR-NIHSAD, Bhopal. The vaccine is notable because no specific commercial vaccine against this virus is currently available in India. HPAI can cause mortality approaching 100% in infected birds, with outbreaks prompting culling, trade restrictions and substantial losses. Since 2006, India has reported more than 500 outbreaks of H5N1 and H5N8. A major outbreak could trim GDP growth by up to 1.5%, risking over 20% of the poultry population; the 2006 outbreak caused direct and indirect losses of Rs 2,200–3,000 crore. H5N1 Clade 2.3.2.1a has infected animals, with three human cases reported and 1,003 infections and 479 deaths across 25 countries since 2003. The launch strengthens India's disease prevention capabilities.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザはインドに300億ルピーの損失をもたらす可能性があるが、今や「メイド・イン・インディア」の解決策がある
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は新規の鳥インフルエンザ感染事例の報告ではなく、インド産H5N1ワクチンの開発・発表に関するニュースであり、過去の統計や経済影響の紹介が中心のため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は新規アウトブレイクではなく、インド農業省傘下ICAR-NIHSADによるH5N1不活化ワクチンの開発発表（2026年11月20日予定）に関する内容。過去の疫学データ（2006年以降500件超のH5N1/H5N8アウトブレイク、世界で1,003例・479死亡）は背景情報として引用されているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : ONU Femmes mobilise le secteur privé pour renforcer la riposte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: UN Women mobilizes the private sector to strengthen the Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, 17 November 2026: UN Women, with the Ministry of Public Health, Hygiene and Social Welfare, UN Global Compact RDC, and OCDD, organized a workshop to mobilize private-sector resources for a gender-responsive Ebola virus disease (EVD) response in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The event aims to secure financial, material, and technical contributions to enhance prevention, awareness, and humanitarian interventions, while informing private firms about the evolving epidemiological situation and the social and economic impacts on communities, especially women and girls. It also highlights priority interventions needing funding and seeks concrete commitments. UN Women’s Setcheme Jeronime urged firms to support government and partners in prevention and response, stressing private-sector leadership. Health Ministry adviser Bamangaye Kalukembi Ghislain underscored the central role of women in the response and in interrupting transmission. As of 14 November 2026, the national tally stands at 11,376 confirmed cases, 5,568 deaths, 3,083 recoveries across 68 health zones.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：UN Womenが民間セクターを動員しエボラ対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行は11,376例確認・5,568名死亡という大規模アウトブレイクであり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的関心が継続しているためフルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: 本記事自体は資金動員のための会議報告だが、背景にあるエボラ流行は68保健地域に及ぶ大規模なものであり、既存の重大イベントとして継続監視・評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Congo, oltre 11.500 casi e 5.630 morti: è allarme
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo, over 11,500 cases and 5,630 deaths: it's alarming.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 11,500 confirmed cases and 5,630 deaths, with 72 new cases and 36 deaths reported in the last 24 hours, bringing totals to 11,504 infections and 5,630 fatalities. The outbreak began in May last year and is driven by the Bundibugyo strain; transmission occurs from wildlife to humans and between people via blood and other infected fluids. No vaccines or approved treatments exist for this strain, though experimental vaccine and therapeutic candidates are under evaluation. Kenya’s health minister Aden Duale announced 21 days of quarantine and active monitoring for Kenyans returning from affected areas, including the DRC. By contrast, the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak caused about 28,600 cases and over 11,300 deaths, underscoring ongoing global public health risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱、感染者11,500人超・死者5,630人に達し警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行が継続中（感染者11,500人超、死者5,630人）、ワクチン・承認治療薬がなく、近隣国が渡航者への検疫措置を導入するなど国際的な波及が見られるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの流行拡大が主題。ケニアは渡航者への検疫措置を導入したのみで流行発生国ではなく、対象国リストにも含まれないため verified_locations から除外。アンゴラも同様に対象国リスト外かつ主題外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Siap Eliminasi Malaria 2028, Dinkes Paniai Latih Ulang ATLM Puskesmas se-Kabupaten Paniai
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ready to Eliminate Malaria by 2028, Paniai Health Office Retrains Puskesmas ATLM Throughout Paniai Regency.
article.articleSummary: On 18 November 2026, Paniai Regency in Central Papua, Indonesia, conducted a malaria microscopy refresher for Medical Laboratory Technologists (ATLM) across Puskesmas, part of the plan to eliminate malaria by 2028. The training, held at the Paniai Health Office, aims to raise knowledge, skills, and capacity in microscopic malaria examination to improve public health service quality. Opened by Benny Degei, SKM., M.KM., Head of Prevention and Control of Disease (P2P) at Dinkes Paniai, the briefing stressed that accurate microscopic readings are crucial for correct diagnosis and treatment. ATLM are frontline in malaria diagnosis at Puskesmas, and misreads can lead to inappropriate treatment. The refresher seeks to standardize competencies across Paniai and ensure readiness to meet the 2028 elimination target.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア撲滅2028年目標に向け準備、パニアイ保健局がプスケスマスのATLM(検査技師)を再研修
triage.triage_reason: マラリア撲滅計画の一環としての通常の研修活動を報じる内容であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリア症例の急増や異常事態ではなく、2028年撲滅目標達成のための検査技師向け定例研修を報じるもの。

article.articleHeadline: Wamenkes: Butuh banyak inovasi pengendalian jentik untuk atasi dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deputy Health Minister: Needs Many Innovations in Larval Control to Tackle Dengue.
article.articleSummary: As of 18 November 2026 in Jakarta, Deputy Health Minister Dante Saksono Harbuwono urged that dengue control in Indonesia requires multiple innovations in larval (Aedes aegypti) control, not reliance on community participation alone. He cited a 95% target for larval-free indices nationwide, noting many regions fall short. He pointed to Bontang, East Kalimantan, where Wolbachia has been used but larval control remains around 60% while dengue cases rose by about 57%, illustrating that Wolbachia cannot stand alone and must be complemented by broader vector interventions. He warned climate change could expand breeding conditions, especially after long dry spells followed by rain. He called for cross-sector involvement—government, academia, business, and society—and for policy recommendations from the policy dialogue to strengthen dengue control.

triage.headline_ja: 保健副大臣:デング熱対策にはボウフラ駆除の多くの技術革新が必要
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおけるデング熱対策の政策的言及であり、特定の急性アウトブレイクではないが、症例増加や気候変動によるリスク拡大への言及があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は政策・対策強化の呼びかけが主眼であり、具体的な症例数や地域的急増データは限定的（Bontangでの57%増加のみ言及）。デング熱はインドネシアで季節的に継続する公衆衛生課題であり、新規性・異常性は低い。

Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N8

article.articleHeadline: भारत को मिलेगी पहली स्वदेशी बर्ड फ्लू वैक्सीन, 20 नवंबर को शिवराज सिंह चौहान करेंगे लोकार्पण
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India will receive its first domestically produced avian influenza vaccine; on November 20, Shivraj Singh Chouhan will inaugurate it.
article.articleSummary: India’s first domestically produced avian influenza vaccine for chickens has been developed by researchers at ICAR-National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (NIHSAD) in Bhopal. The H5N1-targeted vaccine will be officially dedicated to the nation on November 20 by Chief Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan. This milestone follows more than 500 outbreaks of H5N1 and H5N8 in India since 2006, which have strained the poultry sector and caused farmer losses. The vaccine aims to protect chickens from H5N1 infection, curb disease spread, and mitigate financial damage to small and medium-scale poultry farms. Previously, India relied on non-domestic vaccine options. The November 20 unveiling in Bhopal marks a significant step in national animal health and poultry disease control, potentially strengthening outbreak prevention in the sector.

triage.headline_ja: インド初の国産鳥インフルエンザワクチン、11月20日にシヴラージ・シン・チョウハンが発表へ
triage.triage_reason: 記事はワクチン開発・発表に関する内容であり、ヒトへの感染や新規アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、家禽向け対策の進展を伝えるもの。
triage.notes: 記事は家禽向けワクチン開発のニュースであり、ヒト感染症例の報告はない。影響カテゴリも'animals'のみで、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19. Nova variante a espalhar-se. Quais os sintomas e as diferenças?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19. A new variant is spreading. What are the symptoms and the differences?
article.articleSummary: As of November 18, 2026, a new Covid-19 variant PJ.2.1 is spreading worldwide and is now dominant in the United States, Spain, France, Australia, New Zealand, Israel, and Brazil. PJ.2.1 derives from MC.10.1.7, itself from JN.1, which circulated until May 2025. A Journal of Infection study reports the spike protein of PJ.2.1 has a greater capacity to bind a protein on human cell surfaces, potentially aiding its growth. No distinct symptom cluster has emerged; common symptoms include cough, fever, sore throat, nasal congestion, muscle pains, and fatigue, with possible loss of taste or smell and occasional digestive or respiratory symptoms. Tests can confirm SARS-CoV-2 infection. The study found no evidence of more severe disease, and current vaccines and antibodies remain effective against PJ.2.1, though hospitalizations and deaths were not analyzed. Vaccination and surveillance remain important as the variant circulates in multiple major countries.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19。新変異株が拡大中。症状と従来株との違いは？
triage.triage_reason: 新変異株PJ.2.1が複数国で優勢化しているが、重症度増加の証拠はなく、既存ワクチンも有効とされているため、現時点でのフルRRAの緊急性は低いが拡大動向は注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は複数国（米国・スペイン・フランス・豪州・NZ・イスラエル・ブラジル）での変異株優勢化を報じているが、対象国リストに該当するのはブラジルのみ。重症化や入院・死亡データは未分析であり、現行ワクチン・抗体は有効とされている。

article.articleHeadline: SIGAP-TB Hadir di RS Bhayangkara Semarang, Pasien TBC Dipantau hingga Tuntas Berobat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SIGAP-TB Arrives at Bhayangkara Hospital Semarang, TB Patients Monitored Until They Complete Treatment.
article.articleSummary: TB patients at Bhayangkara Hospital Semarang, Indonesia are now monitored via SIGAP-TB (System Integration, Alarm, and TB Patient Assistance), a digital system that sends reminders for follow-up visits and enables staff to track patients who miss treatment. Internal data for 2023–2025 show TB treatment dropout rates of 10% or higher with little improvement. Beyond case finding, ensuring adherence to anti-tuberculosis therapy (OAT) until completion is critical, as Loss to Follow-Up (LTFU)—defined as stopping treatment for two months or more and becoming unreachable—risks progression to drug-resistant TB or MDR-TB, which are harder and more costly to treat. SIGAP-TB aims to reduce LTFU and improve cure completion among TB patients in Semarang.

triage.headline_ja: SIGAP-TBがスマラン・バヤンカラ病院に導入、結核患者を治療完了まで追跡監視
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核治療管理プログラムの紹介記事であり、異常な公衆衛生事象や新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。
triage.notes: 既存の結核対策システム（デジタル追跡）の導入に関する地域医療記事であり、新規感染拡大や異常事象の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: "இனியும் எத்தனை உயிர்கள் போகணும்?" - 4 வயது குழந்தை டெங்குவுக்கு பலி.. அதிகாரிகள் அலட்சியம் என மக்கள் புகார்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "How many more lives must be lost?" - A 4-year-old child died of dengue fever... People accuse officials of negligence.
article.articleSummary: On 18 November 2026, a 4-year-old girl, Maisa Rasul, died of dengue fever in Vallakkulam village near Sikkal, Ramanathapuram, Tamil Nadu, after a 10-day fever and treatment at a private school and later in Madurai. The death has sparked allegations of negligence by health authorities and local governance. Residents cite months of neglect—unclean drinking-water tanks, stagnant sewage, and garbage—fostering mosquitoes. Several other children in the area are also reported to be affected by dengue or fever. The community urges authorities to immediately run medical camps, clean water tanks and ensure safe water, clear drains and garbage, and intensify vector-control and dengue-prevention measures to prevent further deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 「これ以上何人の命が失われなければならないのか」―4歳児がデング熱で死亡…住民は当局の怠慢を非難
triage.triage_reason: 単発の死亡事例と地域住民の訴えであり、インド国内の既知流行病であるデング熱の地域的発生報告にとどまるが、周辺で他の小児にも感染が疑われ媒介環境の問題が指摘されているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 地域住民の苦情報道であり、公式な症例数・流行規模のデータは記事中に示されていない。デング熱はタミル・ナードゥ州で季節的に発生する既知の疾患であり、国際的拡大やIHR通報相当の事象ではないと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: भारत की पहली स्वदेशी H5N1 चिकन वैक्सीन 20 नवंबर को राष्ट्र को समर्पित करेंगे शिवराज
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shivraj to dedicate India's first indigenous H5N1 poultry vaccine to the nation on November 20.
article.articleSummary: India will dedicate its first indigenous inactivated H5N1 (clade 2.3.2.1a) poultry vaccine to the nation on November 20, developed by ICAR-NIHSAD in Bhopal. The vaccine targets the highly pathogenic avian influenza virus affecting chickens, with mortality up to 100% and major farm losses due to culling, trade restrictions, and farmer losses. Since 2006, India has reported over 500 outbreaks of H5N1 and H5N8. The disease could drag GDP growth by up to 1.5% and threaten more than 20% of poultry stock if uncontrolled; 2006 losses estimated at INR 2,200–3,000 crore. Manipur outbreak caused 0.5% GDP loss. WHO data show 1,003 human cases and 479 deaths across 25 countries since 2003, with three human infections reported. The clade 2.3.2.1a strain drives most poultry outbreaks and has been detected in other species; no commercial vaccine against this clade existed—until now.

triage.headline_ja: シヴラージ氏、11月20日にインド初の国産H5N1鶏ワクチンを国に捧げる
triage.triage_reason: 新規の発生事例報告ではなく、国産H5N1家禽ワクチンの発表という政策・開発ニュースであり、直近の公衆衛生上の異常事象や緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は2006年以降の過去の発生動向や経済的影響の背景説明を含むが、今回の報道自体はワクチン開発・発表に関するものであり、新規アウトブレイクの探知情報ではない。

article.articleHeadline: 38歲男子確診猴痘 曾與在社交平台認識男子有性接觸 - 香港商報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 38-year-old man diagnosed with monkeypox, who previously had sexual contact with a man he met on a social platform - Hong Kong Commercial Daily
article.articleSummary: An imported monkeypox case in Hong Kong involves a 38-year-old man who developed fever, fatigue and anal pain starting November 11 and was admitted to Queen Elizabeth Hospital on November 16; Public Health Laboratory Service confirmed monkeypox. He reported high-risk sexual contact during the incubation period with a man met via a social media platform. Epidemiological investigation is ongoing; case will be reported to the WHO. Since August, 28 local cases have reported high-risk sex during incubation (sex with strangers or multiple partners without condoms; most unvaccinated). Many used dating apps to find partners; some could not contact new partners for tracing. The Centre has intensified prevention messaging on social media and via dating apps, and urges high-risk individuals to vaccinate promptly, avoid high-risk sexual contact, and keep partner contact details for tracing; WHO notification is planned.

triage.headline_ja: 38歳男性が猴痘（サル痘）と診断、SNSで知り合った男性と性的接触あり - 香港商報
triage.triage_reason: 香港での輸入性サル痘症例単発事案であり、過去8月以降に28例の高リスク性行為関連症例が報告されているが、大規模な公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大の明確な兆候は現時点で確認されない。継続的な性的接触を介した感染拡大の可能性があり経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 香港はChina (1814991)に含める。本件は輸入症例かつ性的接触による感染経路で、過去の継続的な症例報告（28例）があることから性感染症的拡大傾向に留意。WHOへの報告が予定されている点は通常の症例報告プロセスであり、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Đà Nẵng đã có hơn 10.700 ca sốt xuất huyết, tăng 3,4 lần so với cùng kỳ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Da Nang has over 10,700 dengue fever cases, up 3.4 times compared with the same period.
article.articleSummary: Da Nang, Vietnam, faces a worsening dengue fever outbreak in 2026. By Nov 13, cumulative dengue cases reached 10,724, 3.4 times higher than in 2025; by week 45 the city had 8,782 cases (286.47 per 100,000) and 58 small outbreaks. In week 46 (Nov 9–13), cases rose by 531 (38%). A 12-year-old girl died on Nov 5 at Da Nang Hospital for Obstetrics and Pediatrics after 17 days of treatment; death attributed to severe dengue with pneumonia and obesity. The response is hampered by shortages of vector-control chemicals and equipment: Permethrin stocks are low; Cloramin B 25% has run out; many spray machines are nonfunctional. CDC Da Nang urged the Department of Health to secure funds, supplies, and strengthen surveillance; push communications; and intensify community prevention—eliminating standing water, larviciding, bed nets, long sleeves, and repellents—while stressing prompt medical care and adherence to regulations to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ダナンでデング熱患者が10,700人を超え、前年同期比3.4倍に増加
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ダナンでデング熱が例年比3.4倍に急増し死亡例も発生しているが、国境を越えた拡大や渡航制限等の国際的影響は示されておらず、国内での流行拡大への注視が必要な段階。
triage.notes: 媒介制御用薬剤・機材の不足が指摘されており、行政対応能力に懸念あり。デング熱は毎年流行する風土病的性質があり、IHR基準の『国際的拡大リスク』は現時点で低いと判断。続報（死亡者数、症例数の推移、資材供給状況）の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Cegah Penyebaran PMK, Sarif Abdillah Minta Stok Vaksin Ternak di Jateng Dipastikan Aman
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: To Prevent the Spread of Foot-and-Mouth Disease, Sarif Abdillah Urges Central Java's Livestock Vaccine Stock to Be Guaranteed Safe.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-Mouth Disease (PMK) threatens Central Java’s livestock, with Deputy Speaker Sarif Abdillah urging the provincial government to ensure safe, sufficient vaccine stocks. He notes PMK often surfaces during transitional seasons when variable, humid weather weakens herd immunity and facilitates viral spread. Routine vaccination of healthy livestock is described as the most effective control, alongside ongoing surveillance for early detection. Abdillah emphasizes broad vaccination coverage to reduce transmission and prevent economic losses to farmers, and calls for expanded collaboration with universities’ veterinary faculties to assist vaccination campaigns, plus socialization efforts to help farmers understand prevention roles. Although PMK does not affect human health, it can cause drastic economic harm to the livestock sector and the food supply. The appeal targets Central Java, including Banyumas and Cilacap, urging persistent vaccination and stakeholder engagement.

triage.headline_ja: 口蹄疫(PMK)の拡大防止へ、サリフ・アブディラ氏が中部ジャワの家畜ワクチン備蓄の安全確保を要請
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫は動物疾病でヒト健康には影響せず、政治家による予防的なワクチン備蓄要請に関する記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は動物衛生(家畜の口蹄疫)に関する地方政治家の予防提言であり、ヒト感染症のEBS対象としての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Universitas Trisakti perkuat kader kesehatan cegah TBC di Jakbar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trisakti University Strengthens Health Cadres to Prevent TB in West Jakarta
article.articleSummary: Trisakti University strengthens TB prevention in West Jakarta’s Kalideres by training 12 health cadres from seven kelurahan and eight Kalideres Puskesmas staff through the Si-Kasep (Know, Observe, Screen, Educate, and Treat Information System) program. Led by PKM coordinator Purnamawati Tjhin, the initiative emphasizes active community involvement beyond health facilities, enabling cadres to recognize TB symptoms, encourage testing, provide education, and support patients during treatment. The effort is supported by Kalideres UKM and focuses on initial screening, treatment monitoring, and case reporting via digital tools, complemented by flipchart-based health communication. The goal is to produce competent, autonomous cadres and to broaden replication of the model to raise public awareness, enable early TB case finding, and contribute to Indonesia’s TB elimination efforts.

triage.headline_ja: トリサクティ大学、西ジャカルタでTB予防のため保健ボランティアを強化
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核予防啓発活動に関する記事であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の地域流行病であり、本記事は大学主導の予防教育プログラムの紹介に過ぎず、新規アウトブレイクを示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Rutan Balikpapan Latih Warga Binaan Jadi Kader Kesehatan, Cegah Penularan TBC dan HIV
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Balikpapan Detention Center Trains Inmates to Become Health Cadres, Prevent TB and HIV Transmission.
article.articleSummary: On 18 November 2026, Balikpapan Detention Center (Class IIA) in Balikpapan, Indonesia, conducted training to empower inmates as health cadres to prevent transmission of infectious diseases, notably tuberculosis (TB) and HIV, within the facility. The program follows the Directorate General of Corrections directive PAS 08.03-089 (dated 30 October 2026) approving inmate training as health cadres. Opened by Dava Ario Seno, Head of Detention Services, the session outlined the duties and functions of health cadres and explained their distinct role from tamping in supporting activities around the prison. Health clinic staff delivered lessons on disease basics, transmission, prevention, the importance of health checkups, and proper care, plus coverage of Healthy Living Behavior (PHBS). Inmates were taught to act as role models and mobilizers for healthier living, aiming to create a cleaner, healthier, and more humane detention environment.

triage.headline_ja: バリクパパン拘置所、TBとHIV感染予防のため収容者を保健推進員として養成
triage.triage_reason: 刑務所内での既存の予防研修・教育活動の紹介であり、異常な発生や新規アウトブレイクを示す情報ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア・バリクパパンの拘置所における結核・HIV予防研修プログラムの紹介であり、具体的な感染拡大や症例数の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Kalbar catat 1.230 kasus chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Kalimantan Health Office records 1,230 Chikungunya cases.
article.articleSummary: West Kalimantan, Indonesia: The Provincial Health Office (Kalbar) reports 1,230 chikungunya cases across several regencies and cities, with 1,179 suspected and 51 laboratory-confirmed. In Pontianak, Health Chief Erna Yulianti stressed transmission by Aedes mosquitoes and urged intensified mosquito control ahead of the rainy season. Chikungunya characteristically causes abrupt fever above 38.5°C, severe joint pain, rash, and malaise. Citizens are advised to differentiate chikungunya from dengue fever, which presents with high fever, headache, muscle pain, nausea or vomiting, and potential bleeding; both share the Aedes vector. Preventive measures focus on the 3M vector-control program: drain water containers, keep water storage tightly closed, and recycle or dispose of items that can breed larvae. Enhanced environmental sanitation and cleaning are emphasized during heavy rains. Citizens are urged to visit health facilities promptly for fever with severe joint pain to enable early diagnosis and containment. Ongoing monitoring and district mapping are in place.

triage.headline_ja: 西カリマンタン州保健局、チクングニア熱1,230例を記録
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア西カリマンタン州でチクングニア熱の症例が多数（1,230例）報告されているが、重症例・死亡等の情報はなく、国際的拡大の兆候も不明なため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: チクングニア熱とデング熱の両方がAedes蚊により媒介され、季節性（雨季前）の媒介蚊対策強化が呼びかけられている。地域内での発生であり、国際的な懸念は現時点で確認されない。

article.articleHeadline: भारत ने बनाई बर्ड फ्लू के लिए पहली घरेलू H5N1 वैक्सीन, 20 नवंबर को होगी लॉन्च
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India has developed the first domestically produced H5N1 vaccine for bird flu, to be launched on November 20.
article.articleSummary: India’s ICAR- NIHSAD in Bhopal has developed the first domestically produced inactivated H5N1 avian influenza vaccine for poultry, targeting H5N1 clade 2.3.4.1a. It will be launched on November 20, 2026, with Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan dedicating it to the nation in Bhopal. The vaccine aims to curb bird flu outbreaks that have caused widespread poultry deaths nationwide, protect supply chains, and reduce economic losses. Government notes that uncontrolled outbreaks could reduce GDP growth by up to 1.5% and affect up to 20% of poultry; past outbreaks in 2006 caused losses of 2,000–3,000 crore. Vaccination may also mitigate zoonotic risk, as infected poultry can spread the virus to humans upon consumption. This domestically produced vaccine strengthens outbreak preparedness for poultry and public health.

triage.headline_ja: インドが鳥インフルエンザ向け国産初のH5N1ワクチンを開発、11月20日に発売予定
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は新規アウトブレイクの発生報告ではなく、国産H5N1家禽用ワクチンの開発・発売に関する政策・対策ニュースであるため、直接のPICKUP基準には該当しないが、鳥インフルエンザの継続的流行状況とヒトへのズーノティックリスクの観点から経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は家禽向けH5N1ワクチンの国内開発・発売に関する内容で、現時点での新規ヒト感染症例の報告ではない。過去（2006年）の経済的損失や家禽への大規模被害が言及されているが、現在進行中の具体的な感染拡大規模や重症度についての情報は記載なし。ズーノティックリスク（感染家禽の消費によるヒトへの感染）が言及されている点は注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Gut Bacterium Parabacteroides distasonis Alleviates ETEC Diarrhea in Weaned
article.articleSummary: Parabacteroides distasonis HNAU0205 mitigates Escherichia coli enterotoxigenic (ETEC) diarrhea in weaned piglets from Ningxiang, Hunan, China. In a 24-piglet 2x2 factorial trial (control, ETEC challenge, P. distasonis alone, and P. distasonis plus ETEC), 21-day-old crossbred barrows received daily oral gavage of 1×10^9 CFU/mL P. distasonis (10 mL) for 14 days, with ETEC K88 challenge on day 15 and continued dosing until day 17; euthanasia with tissue sampling on day 18. Prophylaxis reduced ETEC-associated weight loss and significantly lowered diarrhea rates. ETEC density in ileal mucosa decreased; tight junctions were reinforced, circulating bacterial toxins and pro-inflammatory cytokines declined, and intestinal stem cell–driven epithelial renewal was stimulated, preserving growth. Fecal secretory IgA levels correlated with Parabacteroides distasonis abundance, supporting microbiome-based nutritional strategies to protect piglets during weaning and reduce antimicrobial use.

triage.headline_ja: 腸内細菌パラバクテロイデス・ディスタソニスが離乳子豚のETEC下痢を軽減
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は実験動物研究（離乳子豚への微生物介入による下痢軽減効果の基礎研究）であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の懸念事象ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は実験室内での動物実験（研究論文紹介）であり、実際の疾病発生事例ではないため、発生地域（中国湖南省）の対象国フラグも実イベントとしては該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Sốc nhiễm khuẩn do viêm mủ màng phổi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Septic Shock Due to Pleural Empyema.
article.articleSummary: Septic shock due to left pleural empyema in a 35-year-old man with type 2 diabetes in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. He presented with fever, cough, and weight loss; hyperglycemia and septic shock were diagnosed, with pleural pus and infection spreading through the chest wall toward the left abdominal wall. CT showed bilateral inflammatory lesions with left lung volume loss, atelectasis and consolidation; the left pleural space contained many abscesses. Given high surgical risk in shock, a multidisciplinary team performed a minimally invasive drainage via a 1 cm incision at the left fifth intercostal space to drain pus and lavage the cavity, alongside antibiotics and metabolic control. After seven days, infection and respiration improved, the left lung re-expanded, and discharge followed. Prolonged hyperglycemia can impair immune function in diabetics, worsening infection outcomes.

article.articleHeadline: দেশে প্রথম তৈরি হল বার্ড ফ্লু টিকা, আসবে নভেম্বরেই, পাখির মড়ক ঠেকাতে বড় পদক্ষেপ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The country's first bird flu vaccine has been developed; it will arrive in November; a major step to curb the avian outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 18 November 2026, India's first domestically developed bird flu vaccine, created by ICAR-National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases in Bhopal, will officially launch on 20 November 2026. The vaccine targets H5N1 clade 2.3.2.1a and is claimed to counter any circulating avian influenza variant in the Indian climate. With new outbreaks reported in Tamil Nadu and Andhra Pradesh, the poultry sector is under strain, and human infections have been reported, underscoring zoonotic risks. Existing vaccines are not available domestically, and antigenic shifts have reduced their effectiveness; Moderna’s mRNA bird flu vaccine exists but has not yet reached India. The indigenous vaccine is expected to reduce viral spread in poultry and indirectly lower human exposure, though specific vaccination guidelines or rollout timelines beyond the November 20 launch have not been finalized.

triage.headline_ja: インドで初の国産鳥インフルエンザワクチンが開発、11月に登場へ──鳥の大量死を食い止める大きな一歩
triage.triage_reason: タミル・ナードゥ州とアンドラ・プラデーシュ州で新たなH5N1発生があり人への感染も報告されているが、重症度や感染者数など詳細情報が不足しており、記事の主眼は国産ワクチン開発であるため継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は主にICAR-NIHSADによる国産H5N1ワクチン開発を報じているが、タミル・ナードゥ州およびアンドラ・プラデーシュ州での新規発生と人への感染報告にも言及しており、今後の続報（人的感染の規模・重症度等）を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo prepares to test two experimental vaccines against deadly Ebola strain - TV47 Digital
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's northeastern Ituri Province, centered on Bunia, is contending with an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo strain, with 11,376 cases and 5,568 deaths to date—the worst in the country. WHO plans to start Nov 26–27 two experimental vaccines—ChAdOx1 (adenovirus-based, Oxford) and mRNA-1469 (Moderna)—in the Tumaini programme, alongside Ervebo, the approved Zaire-strain vaccine. Trials aim to assess safety and immune response, and to determine whether these candidates could protect against Bundibugyo, which currently lacks an approved vaccine or specific treatment. A ring vaccination approach targets contacts and other vulnerable individuals. More than 140 participants are enrolled; thousands of contacts are expected. If Phase 2 succeeds, Phase 3 studies could follow. The outbreak persists at 400–500 new weekly cases, with many fatalities occurring outside specialised facilities; children account for over 25% of infections and about one-third of deaths. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、致死性エボラ株に対する2種類の実験的ワクチンの試験準備を開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最悪規模のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが継続中であり、承認ワクチンがないため国際的な実験的ワクチン治験が開始される重大事案。IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株には承認済みワクチン・特異的治療法がなく、WHO主導でChAdOx1・mRNA-1469の治験が11月26-27日開始予定。週400-500件の新規症例が継続し、小児の感染・死亡割合も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Комары принесли в Швейцарию опасную лихорадку чикунгунья
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mosquitoes brought dangerous Chikungunya fever to Switzerland.
article.articleSummary: Four autochthonous chikungunya cases were confirmed in Switzerland, all residents of the Ticino canton, with no recent travel to endemic areas. The infection source remains unidentified. Patients experienced joint pain; illness was generally favorable. The World Health Organization notes Asian tiger mosquitoes (Aedes albopictus) are established in several Swiss cantons, including Ticino, capable of transmitting chikungunya. Following case confirmation, authorities conducted active case finding, mosquito surveillance, vector-control measures, and risk communication to healthcare workers and the public. No new cases were detected. The WHO warned ongoing transmission could occur if the virus enters mosquito habitats, but the current risk is low due to seasonal reduction in mosquito activity. Separately, it was reported yesterday that since the May 15 outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola has infected over 11,000 people and caused over 5,500 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊がスイスに危険なチクングニア熱を持ち込んだ
triage.triage_reason: 記事内でスイスの自然発生チクングニア症例報告とともに、DRCのエボラ出血熱が5月15日以降に11,000人超の感染・5,500人超の死亡を記録したと報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はスイスにおける自然発生チクングニア熱（スイスは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外）だが、付随してDRCのエボラ出血熱の大規模流行（11,000人超感染、5,500人超死亡）が具体的数値とともに報告されているため、DRCを対象国として抽出した。

article.articleHeadline: Emergenza Ebola: in Congo quasi 5.600 morti. Scatta la quarantena obbligatoria in Kenya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Emergency: Nearly 5,600 Deaths in Congo. Mandatory quarantine comes into effect in Kenya.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo Ebola emergency intensifies: 11,504 confirmed cases and 5,630 deaths since April, per the National Institute of Public Health. In the latest 24 hours, 72 new cases, 36 deaths, and 33 recoveries were recorded, underscoring ongoing strain on health facilities and broader regional border precautions. Kenya imposes a mandatory 21-day quarantine for anyone arriving from the DRC to curb cross-border spread of the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, for which no vaccines or targeted therapies are approved. Ebola was first identified in 1976 in the region now the Democratic Republic of the Congo; transmission occurs via contact with infected wildlife and between people through blood, secretions, and other body fluids. The situation recalls the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, with over 11,300 deaths and about 28,600 cases, mainly in Guinea, Sierra Leone, and Liberia, reinforcing vigilance across East and Central Africa.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ緊急事態：コンゴで死者ほぼ5,600人。ケニアで強制隔離措置発動
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）が大規模流行し死者5,630人・症例11,504例に達し、ケニアが越境流入者に強制隔離を課すなど国際的拡大・渡航制限の両方が確認されるためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。承認済みワクチン・治療薬がないブンディブギョ株による大規模流行であり、継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: US Loses Measles-Free Status After 26 Years As Outbreak Hits 5,412 Cases In 2026: Could This Be A Warning For India?
article.articleSummary: US measles outbreak 2026 reaches 5,412 confirmed cases through November 12, ending 26 years of elimination after PAHO confirmed continuous circulation for over 12 months on November 17, linked to the 2025 Texas outbreak. Canada joined Mexico and Bolivia in losing elimination status in the latest determination. Measles is highly contagious, spreading via respiratory droplets; one infected person can infect 12-18 unvaccinated people. Incubation 10-14 days; symptoms include high fever, cough, runny nose, Koplik spots, and a red rash; severe complications include pneumonia, encephalitis, diarrhea, and death, especially in young children and immunocompromised individuals. Two MMR doses provide ~97% protection (one dose ~93%); herd immunity requires >=95%. In India, vaccination improved to 98% first-dose and 95% second-dose in 2025, but ~4.53 lakh children missed first dose; 18,774 cases in 2025 and ~26,627 in the first half of 2026, with endemic transmission ongoing. WHO/CDC guidance notes targeted boosters for high-risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、26年ぶりに麻疹排除国認定を喪失 ― 2026年に5,412症例、インドへの警鐘か？
triage.triage_reason: 米州（米国・カナダ・メキシコ・ボリビア）で麻疹排除状態が相次いで失われ、PAHOが12か月超の継続伝播を確認するなど国際的な拡大・異常事態に該当し、インドでも2025年18,774例、2026年上半期約26,627例の地域流行継続という具体的データが示されている。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は米国・米州地域の麻疹排除状態喪失だが、対象国リストに該当するのはインドのみ。インドについては2025年18,774例、2026年上半期約26,627例という具体的な地域流行データが示されており、単なる比較言及を超えた実態報告と判断しverified_locationsに含めた。米国・カナダ・メキシコ・ボリビアは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Beni - Les autorités de Bulongo sensibilisent les responsables religieux et scolaires contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Beni — Bulongo authorities raise awareness among religious and school leaders about Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Six confirmed Ebola virus disease cases, including one death, have been reported in Bulongo, Beni territory, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo. On November 16, municipal authorities led by Mayor Jean-Paul Kahindo Katembo convened religious leaders and school administrators to reinforce prevention measures. Measures focus on reducing transmission in mass gatherings: routine handwashing and entry-temperature checks at places of worship; organizing multiple worship services and splitting congregations into smaller groups. Schools face overcrowding, complicating physical distancing; authorities are collaborating with the education sector and UNICEF to strengthen prevention support. Regular follow-up will monitor adherence to measures. Residents are urged to report suspected cases promptly and seek care at designated health facilities to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:ベニ — ブロンゴ当局がエボラ対策で宗教・学校関係者への啓発活動を実施
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確定症例6例（死亡1例）が報告されており、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際的拡大リスクのある疾患であるため、フルリスク評価に進めるべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ベニ地域の学校や礼拝所など人が密集する場での感染拡大リスクが指摘されており、UNICEFとの連携による対応強化が進行中。エボラは致死率が高く、ヒト-ヒト感染のリスクが継続する点で継続監視が必要。
