article.articleHeadline: പക്ഷിപ്പനി പ്രതിരോധം ശക്തമാക്കാൻ ഇന്ത്യ; രാജ്യത്തെ ആദ്യ എച്ച്5എൻ1 വാക്സിൻ നവംബർ 20ന് പുറത്തിറക്കും | India Develops First Indigenous H5N1 Bird Flu Vaccine
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: To bolster defense against bird flu, India; the country’s first H5N1 vaccine will be released on November 20.
article.articleSummary: India will release its first domestically produced vaccine against H5N1 avian influenza, developed by ICAR-NIHSAD, on November 20 in Bhopal. The clade 2.3.2.1a–targeting vaccine aims to bolster poultry protection amid ongoing avian influenza outbreaks. Tamil Nadu’s Cuddalore district reported unusual poultry deaths, with 35,647 birds died as of November 13, prompting culling of about 40,000 birds within a one-kilometer containment zone. Andhra Pradesh’s Anantapur district (Siddhapuram village, Bukkarayasamudram Mandal) also confirmed infections in October. The 2025-26 annual report notes outbreaks across Maharashtra, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Andhra Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Telangana, Karnataka, and Bihar. Officials say the vaccine could double national preparedness; distribution protocols and vaccination guidelines will be announced in coming days. Human infection risk from birds remains low, but precautions for handlers are advised; properly cooked poultry remains safe.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ対策強化へ、インドが初の国産H5N1ワクチンを11月20日に発表予定
triage.triage_reason: インド全土で家禽のH5N1感染・大量死が継続しているが、人間への感染事例は報告されておらず人体リスクは低いとされているため、動物衛生面での経過観察に留める。
triage.notes: 本記事は家禽向けH5N1ワクチン開発・発売に関する内容で、人への感染拡大の報告はない。複数州（マハラシュトラ、チャッティースガル、アンドラプラデシュ、マディヤプラデシュ、テランガナ、カルナタカ、ビハール等）で家禽の流行が継続している点は動物衛生上のモニタリング対象。

article.articleHeadline: La Zambie lance les travaux de la première usine de vaccins contre le choléra
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Zambia breaks ground on the first cholera vaccine plant.
article.articleSummary: As of 18 November 2026, Zambia began construction in Lusaka on its first cholera vaccine manufacturing plant, to be run by ZAMVAX Limited. The facility will have an annual capacity of up to 20 million doses and will start with fill-finish, finishing, packaging, and quality control of oral cholera vaccines from imported raw materials. The project is a public-private partnership between the state-owned Industrial Development Corporation (IDC) with 60% equity and China's Jijia International Medical Technology with 40%, featuring technology transfer, job creation, and strengthened national pharmaceutical capacity. It enables Zambia to shift from importer to regional vaccine producer. The move follows recurring cholera outbreaks, including the 2023–2024 epidemic that WHO counted at over 23,000 cases and more than 700 deaths, underscoring the need for greater vaccine availability.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビア、初のコレラワクチン工場建設に着手
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はコレラワクチン製造工場の建設開始に関する産業・経済ニュースであり、現在進行中の感染症アウトブレイクを報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は過去（2023-2024年）のコレラ流行への対応としてのワクチン製造能力強化に関する内容であり、現時点での新規アウトブレイクの報告ではないためDISMISSと判定。中国企業が出資パートナーとして関与しているが、中国国内での発生事例ではないためChinaはverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Nova variante PJ.2.1 da Covid-19 espalha-se em vários países e mantém sintomas comuns
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New PJ.2.1 COVID-19 variant spreads in several countries and maintains common symptoms.
article.articleSummary: PJ.2.1 is a new SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19) variant spreading across the United States, Spain, France, Australia, New Zealand, Israel, and Brazil. Derived from MC.10.1.7, which traces back to JN.1 circulating until May 2025, PJ.2.1 carries more genetic changes and a spike protein with greater binding affinity to human cell receptors, potentially explaining its transmission. No specific symptoms unique to this variant have been identified; common symptoms include cough, fever, sore throat, nasal congestion, muscle aches, and fatigue. Alterations in taste and smell, respiratory or digestive symptoms may occur but are not unique to PJ.2.1. Tests are recommended to confirm SARS-CoV-2 infection. A study in the Journal of Infection found no evidence that PJ.2.1 causes more severe disease than circulating variants, and vaccine/antibody effectiveness appears unchanged.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルスの新変異株PJ.2.1が複数国で拡大、一般的な症状は変わらず
triage.triage_reason: 新変異株の拡大が報告されているが、重症化や既存対策への影響は認められておらず、対象国（ブラジル）での具体的状況も不明なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 研究ではPJ.2.1は既存株より重症度が高いとの証拠はなく、ワクチン・抗体の有効性も維持されているとされる。ブラジルでの具体的な症例数や対応状況は記事中に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Two Bundibugyo‑Targeted Ebola Vaccines to Begin Phase‑2 Trials in DRC
article.articleSummary: Two Bundibugyo-targeted Ebola vaccine candidates developed by Oxford University with the Serum Institute of India and Moderna will enter Phase-2 trials in Bunia, Democratic Republic of Congo, on 26–27 November. The Tumani trial, launched 23 October and enrolling more than 140 participants, will incorporate the Phase-2 results to assess safety and immunogenicity before potential Phase-3 efficacy studies. WHO approved the move to Phase-2. The Bundibugyo outbreak has reported over 11,300 cases and more than 5,500 deaths; security challenges, attacks on health workers, and delays in case detection hinder containment in the DRC. The vaccines are specifically designed for the Bundibugyo species, different from the Zaire strain targeted by most existing vaccines. Across the region, Kenya has nine Ebola infections and two deaths as of 15 November 2026, signaling regional vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョ株対応のエボラワクチン2種、DRCで第2相試験開始へ
triage.triage_reason: 既存のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクが11,300症例・5,500死亡に達し、隣国ケニアへの拡大も報告されており、IHR基準の複数該当とWHO関与による社会的関心の高さからフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン第2相試験の開始に関するものだが、背景として進行中の大規模エボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクと治安上の封じ込め困難、ケニアへの感染拡大が報告されている。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: भोपाल के वैज्ञानिकों का ऐतिहासिक कमाल: देश को मिला बर्ड फ्लू का पहला स्वदेशी टीका; 6 महीने तक मुर्गियों को मिलेगी सुरक्षा, 20 नवंबर को होगी लॉन्चिंग
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Historic feat by Bhopal scientists: the country receives its first domestically developed vaccine for avian influenza; chickens will be protected for six months, to be launched on November 20.
article.articleSummary: India's first domestically developed avian influenza vaccine, created by NIHSAD in Bhopal under DG ICAR M.L. Jat, with NIHSAD Director Dr. Aniket Sanyal and team, targets H5N1 (clade 2.3.2.1a). A single dose protects chickens for six months and is intended for layers and breeders. The vaccine will be launched on November 20, 2026, marking a milestone in national self-reliance for poultry disease control and food security. By mitigating bird flu losses, it aims to reduce the economic damage seen since the 2006 outbreak, which involved over 500 infections and an estimated ₹3,000 crore in losses to India's poultry sector, strengthening resilience of both the poultry industry and export potential.

triage.headline_ja: ボパールの科学者による歴史的快挙:国内初の鳥インフルエンザ国産ワクチンが完成、鶏を6ヶ月間保護、11月20日に発売
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は家禽向け鳥インフルエンザワクチンの開発・発売に関する内容であり、ヒトへの感染事例や新規アウトブレイクの報告ではないため、トリアージ対象のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は家禽用ワクチン開発のニュースであり、ヒト感染や新規アウトブレイクの発生を示すものではない。公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められず、家畜衛生・産業政策的な話題として分類される。

article.articleHeadline: El Nino Kuat Picu Risiko DBD Hampir 2 Kali Lipat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Strong El Niño Triggers Dengue Fever Risk Almost Twofold.
article.articleSummary: Strong El Niño increases dengue fever risk in Indonesia by about twofold. Analysis of 34 provinces from 2010–2024 shows dengue incidence during strong El Niño years at 77 per 100,000, versus 39 per 100,000 in other years—a roughly 96% rise. Lag time of three to four months after ONI increases provides a window for preparedness. In North Sumatra, dengue peaks typically begin in October, while Jakarta, West Java, and Bali peak around April, underscoring regional differences for control strategies. Climate effects operate through heat, water, and human behavior; drought prompts water storage that can foster mosquito breeding. A predictive model developed since 2016 in Yogyakarta uses BMKG climate data and health surveillance to forecast dengue up to two months ahead, validated in Sleman, Bantul, Gunungkidul, Kulon Progo (2017–2023). Authors recommend two-tier early warning: long-term El Niño/ENSO risk mapping and local-condition integration to tailor interventions.

triage.headline_ja: 強いエルニーニョがデング熱リスクをほぼ2倍に引き上げる
triage.triage_reason: 気候要因とデング熱リスクに関する学術的・予測的な分析記事であり、特定の急性アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドネシアにおけるデング熱の季節性・気候相関分析及び早期警戒モデルの研究紹介であり、現時点での突発的な流行拡大や異常事態を報告するものではない。デング熱はインドネシアで毎年流行する既知の風土病であり、通常のサーベイランス範囲内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: BPOM-Bio Farma Kembangkan AI untuk Uji Vaksin Polio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: BPOM-Bio Farma Develop AI for Testing Polio Vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Bandung, Indonesia – BPOM and Bio Farma are accelerating the use of artificial intelligence to test the safety of the poliovirus vaccine, focusing on neurovirulence testing to ensure no harmful effects on the nervous system. Currently, testing relies on animal models and manual histopathology readings of neural tissue, with hundreds to thousands of samples demanding high expert attention, lengthy processes, and fatigue risk. The AI system will read scanned tissue images using algorithms trained on standard criteria and prior results, aiming to speed and harmonize assessments. If successful, testing could be shortened by about 50%. Key steps include compiling standardized image datasets from Bio Farma and BPOM and integrating workflows in the Green Laboratory, with regulatory oversight to safeguard safety, quality, and efficacy—and potential new rules. The effort aligns with FDA/EMA standards, with deployment anticipated within one year.

triage.headline_ja: BPOM-Bio Farma、ポリオワクチン試験用のAIを開発
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はポリオワクチンの開発・試験プロセスの技術革新に関する報道であり、ポリオウイルスの実際の流行・感染事例ではない。公衆衛生上の急迫した危機を示す証拠がない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン開発における技術的進展（AI導入による試験効率化）に焦点を当てており、感染症イベント（患者発生・流行）ではない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu outbreak in Alappuzha; decision to cull around 26,000 poultry.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (H5N1) confirmed in Alappuzha district, Kerala, India, specifically Ampalappuzha North and Chennithala grama panchayats. To curb spread, authorities decided to cull about 26,000 domesticated poultry, with an emergency meeting chaired by District Collector Shaji V. Nair approving immediate rapid-response culling. Lab tests from affected areas confirmed the H5N1 strain. There are currently no reported human infections; public health and animal husbandry officials urge heightened vigilance and precautions. The culling is part of measures to prevent further spread among poultry and potential spillover to humans. As of 18 November 2026, authorities are enforcing the culling and monitoring within the designated zones.

triage.headline_ja: アラップーザの鳥インフルエンザ感染拡大；約26,000羽の家禽を殺処分する決定
triage.triage_reason: 家禽でのH5N1確認と大規模殺処分だが、ヒトへの感染は報告されておらず、現時点では動物衛生事象として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 現時点でヒト感染例の報告はないが、家禽での感染拡大とスピルオーバーリスクがあるため、続報（ヒト感染の有無）を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Climate Models Project Shifting Echinococcosis Transmission Risk Across
article.articleSummary: Western China faces climate-driven shifts in echinococcosis risk. Ecological niche modeling of Echinococcus multilocularis (alveolar echinococcosis) and Echinococcus granulosus sensu lato (cystic echinococcosis) predicts nonuniform geographic reconfiguration under warming. Using 1981–2010 baseline climates, MaxEnt models trained on 1,247 unique human cases (1981–2016) from the National Echinococcosis Control Program across Gansu, Ningxia, Xizang, Qinghai, Xinjiang, and western Sichuan show six provincial-level regions with heterogeneous suitability changes: high-altitude plateaus gain suitability for both species, while arid and low-elevation margins contract. CE (E. granulosus s.l.) begins expanding outward from current endemic boundaries; AE (E. multilocularis) shifts into higher elevations. Model performance was excellent (mean training AUC >0.96; Boyce indices 0.886 for AE, 0.984 for CE) with 10-arc-minute grid cells and CHELSA 2.1 bioclimatic predictors; results emphasize distinct thermal and hydrological thresholds shaping each parasite's risk.

triage.headline_ja: 気候モデルが中国西部におけるエキノコックス症の伝播リスクの変化を予測
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は過去症例データに基づく気候変動予測モデルに関する学術研究であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクや急性の公衆衛生事象を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は1981-2016年の過去データを用いた予測モデリング研究であり、現在発生中の感染症イベントではない。将来的なリスク地域の変化に関する科学的知見であり、トリアージ対象の急性シグナルには該当しない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Bird Flu Vaccine: তৈরি হয়ে গেল দেশের প্রথম বার্ড ফ্লুর টিকা H5N1! কোন রাজ্য বানিয়ে ফেলল প্রথম দেশীয় ভ্যাকসিন জানেন? চলতি মাসের শুরু থেকেই পাওয়া যাবে বাজারে
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird Flu Vaccine: India's first H5N1 avian influenza vaccine has been developed! Do you know which state has produced the country's first indigenous vaccine? It will be available in the market from the start of this month.
article.articleSummary: India's first indigenous H5N1 avian influenza vaccine has been developed by ICAR-NIHSAD in Bhopal. The vaccine targets H5N1 clade 2.3.2.1a and, according to the institute, can neutralize any antigenic variant of the avian influenza virus. It will be launched commercially on November 20, 2026. This comes as Tamil Nadu reports rising bird-flu cases, with Kudalur district recording 35,647 poultry deaths as of November 13 and authorities culling around 40,000 birds within affected zones and banning poultry transport. In Andhra Pradesh, H5N1 infections were confirmed in Anantapur district in October, with Siddharamapuram village affected and containment measures enacted. The 2025-26 surveillance list shows outbreaks across Maharashtra, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Andhra Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Telangana, Karnataka, and Bihar, underscoring the need for domestic vaccine production and intensified surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザワクチン：インド初のH5N1鳥インフルエンザワクチンが完成！どの州が国内初の国産ワクチンを開発したか知っていますか？今月初めから市場に出回る予定
triage.triage_reason: 複数州で家禽のH5N1アウトブレイクが継続しているが、記事サマリーにはヒトへの感染事例の報告がなく、動物衛生（家禽）に関する内容が中心のため、公衆衛生上の深刻性は現時点では確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事は家禽のH5N1アウトブレイクとインド国産ワクチン開発に関するもので、ヒトへの感染事例は言及されていない。複数州（タミル・ナードゥ、アーンドラ・プラデーシュ、マハーラーシュトラ等）での家禽大量死・殺処分が報告されており、動物衛生面での継続的な監視が必要。ヒト感染の続報があればPICKUPへ格上げを検討。

article.articleHeadline: Brasilien aktivierte den Notfallplan nach isoliertem Awa-Kontakt.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil activated its emergency plan after an isolated Awa contact.
article.articleSummary: Brazil activated its emergency plan after an encounter between approximately 20 members of the isolated Awa and a neighboring Guajajara community in the Brazilian Amazon. The gathering began around 16 November near a state access control post and the Tawari Guajajara village in the Arariboia Indigenous Territory, Maranhão state. The Ministry of Indigenous Peoples stated the Awa were sighted approaching the area and reaffirmed that protecting the right to isolation remains the policy, noting that a short encounter does not imply a decision to pursue sustained contact. The Awa are listed in the official database of isolated peoples and are monitored by Funai (Federal Agency for Indigenous Affairs), which has activated an emergency coordination mechanism to assess contact situations and health risks. Indigenous health personnel and Funai staff are in the region. Isolated groups are vulnerable to infections due to limited exposure to pathogens. Survival International cites about 100 uncontacted Awa; COAPIMA calls for cautious government action given disease risks.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、孤立民族アワ族との接触を受け緊急対応計画を発動
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な感染症の発生は確認されておらず、孤立民族と先住民コミュニティとの接触による感染症リスクへの予防的対応段階であるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 疾患名は『Unknown Illness』で具体的な感染症は未特定。孤立民族アワ族と先住民グアジャジャラ族の接触事案で、感染症曝露リスクへの予防的・監視的対応が主眼。実際の発症・感染報告があれば改めてフルRRAを検討すべき。

Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: 三种流感毒株同步活跃，存在反复感染风险！医生提醒：年轻人也要当心
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three influenza strains are active simultaneously, posing a risk of reinfection! Doctors warn: Young people should also be careful.
article.articleSummary: Three influenza strains are co-circulating in Nanning, China: influenza A (H3N2), influenza A (H1N1), and influenza B, with weak cross-protection raising reinfection risk. At Nanning Maternal and Child Health Hospital, pediatric fever clinics report rising flu-like visits featuring high fever and body pains; influenza B in children often includes vomiting and diarrhea, leading to potential misdiagnosis as gastroenteritis. Vaccination is advised for eligible individuals even after infection; those recently recovered should wait 2–4 weeks before vaccination. Egg allergy is no longer a contraindication; consult a clinician if unsure. Post-fever myocardium vulnerability lasts 1–3 weeks, so avoid intense exercise and seek care for chest symptoms. High-risk groups include adults ≥65, children <5, pregnant women, immunocompromised, chronic diseases, and obesity. Antivirals (oseltamivir and baloxavir marboxil) are prescription-only and should be used within 48 hours of onset under medical guidance.

triage.headline_ja: 3種類のインフルエンザ株が同時流行、再感染リスクあり！医師が注意喚起：若者も油断禁物
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ（A型H3N2、A型H1N1、B型）の同時流行に関する一般的な医療啓発記事であり、通常の季節性流行の範囲内で異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザ（A/H3N2, A/H1N1, B型）の同時流行に関する医療啓発記事。重症例の急増や異常なクラスター発生の報告はなく、毎年見られる季節性パターンの範囲内と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Épidémie d'Ebola en RDC : plus de 11.000 cas et 5.400 décès, l'OMS alerte sur les obstacles à la riposte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the DRC: more than 11,000 cases and 5,400 deaths, WHO warns of barriers to the response.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has 11,000+ cases and 5,400+ deaths over six months, across 67 zones in eight provinces. Children account for over a quarter of cases and a third of deaths, with seven in ten under-five patients dying. Nine imported cases in Kenya (two deaths) and one in Nigeria mark regional spread; Kenya’s last patient has been discharged, with a 42-day countdown without new cases. WHO warns travel bans hinder response and urges targeted, data-driven measures. Diagnostics have expanded to over two dozen laboratories; nearly 2,000 treatment beds exist, while 400–500 new weekly cases and 3,000 recoveries are reported. Trials enrol over 900 participants; an Ervebo vaccine trial started, and Bundibugyo-specific vaccines are expected soon. Two-thirds of deaths occur outside treatment centers; insecurity, including the Cantine-Aloya attack (66 civilians killed, including 3 health workers), and delays in health-worker pay impede contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行：1万1000人以上の症例と5400人以上の死亡、WHOは対応への障害を警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行（症例1万1000超、死者5400超）が継続中で、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境拡大も確認されており、WHOが対応への障害を警告していることからフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアへの輸入症例による地域拡大が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。治安悪化（Cantine-Aloya襲撃）や医療従事者への給与遅延が対応を阻害している点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: ICMR launches infectious disease surveillance network for early outbreak warnings
article.articleSummary: ICMR launches a syndromic surveillance initiative for infectious diseases in India to provide early outbreak warnings. The network links 70 Virus Research and Diagnostic Laboratories (VRDLs) and Infectious Disease Research & Diagnostic Laboratories (IRDLs) to collect real-time data for rapid analysis of outbreak size, spread, and speed. It replaces fragmented, disease-specific testing with India-specific priority pathogen lists for major syndromes—Acute Febrile Illness (including Acute Undifferentiated Fever, Fever with Rash, Fever with Lymphadenopathy), Acute Encephalitis Syndrome, Acute Respiratory Illness, and Acute Diarrhoeal Disease—to guide diagnostics, surveillance, and policy. Pathogens are graded from Priority 1A (common) to 3 (rare). High-priority factors include endemic or outbreak-prone areas, post-monsoon and flooding seasons, animal exposure history, and screening a subset of negative samples. The framework also supports indigenous industry partners in developing cost-effective countermeasures.

triage.headline_ja: ICMR、早期アウトブレイク警報のための感染症サーベイランスネットワークを開始
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイクに関する報告ではなく、ICMRによるサーベイランス体制構築・制度整備に関する記事であるため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は具体的な感染症アウトブレイク事例ではなく、インドのICMRによる全国的な症候群サーベイランスネットワーク（VRDL/IRDL連携）の立ち上げを報じたもの。疾患名『Unknown Encephalitis』はシステム上の分類であり、実際の脳炎アウトブレイクの報告ではないため、対象国の実発生イベントとはみなさない。

article.articleHeadline: Instituto Butantan inaugura Centro de Tecnologia em Arbovírus para estudar e combater sequelas crônicas causadas por chikungunya, dengue e zika
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Butantan Institute Inaugurates Center for Arbovirus Technology to Study and Combat Chronic Sequelae Caused by Chikungunya, Dengue and Zika
article.articleSummary: Butantan Institute inaugurates the Center for Arbovirus Technology (CeTA) to study chronic sequelae of arboviruses, including Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), Dengue virus (DENV), Zika virus (ZIKV), and Yellow Fever virus (YFV). Center aims to map and validate molecular targets responsible for inflammatory, neurological, and joint manifestations to guide therapeutic and prophylactic strategies. CeTA will operate through multinational collaborations with the Ragon Institute (affiliated with MIT, Mass General Brigham, and Harvard University) and CNPEM, home to the Sirius synchrotron in Campinas, São Paulo, Brazil. Approved in 2026 by FAPESP CCD, the five-year initiative is funded by FAPESP and the Fundação Butantan. It will serve as a platform for target discovery using cellular/molecular biology, bioinformatics, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and 3D structural modeling, integrating NB3 containment labs, Biobank, and postdoc training and exchanges.

triage.headline_ja: ブタンタン研究所、チクングニア熱・デング熱・ジカ熱による慢性後遺症を研究・対策するためのアルボウイルス技術センターを開設
triage.triage_reason: 研究施設の開設発表であり、感染症の発生・流行に関する情報ではないため、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は研究センターの開設に関する発表であり、具体的な感染症の発生・流行事例を報告するものではない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、イベントの性質上シグナルとして扱う必要はない。

article.articleHeadline: El test genético que descubrió el covid-19 y que ahora salva vidas al detectar casi todas las infecciones
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The genetic test that discovered COVID-19 and that now saves lives by detecting almost all infections.
article.articleSummary: In December 2019, virologists in three Chinese cities analyzed samples from hospitalized patients with severe pneumonia who had visited the Huanan seafood market in Wuhan. Metagenomic analysis revealed a pathogen highly similar to the coronavirus family, marking the discovery of COVID-19 and enabling rapid development of diagnostic tests and vaccines; metagenomics is increasingly used to diagnose sepsis and unexplained illnesses in hospitals. In CNS care, metagenomic testing of cerebrospinal fluid helps distinguish viral, bacterial, and autoimmune causes of meningitis and encephalitis in time-critical cases. For example, Dr. Charles Chiu treated a patient with meningitis and liver failure; metagenomics identified hepatitis E, allowing antiviral therapy and avoiding liver transplantation. Previously, sequencing took days to weeks, but modern machines deliver results in 1–2 hours with AI, accelerating care for immunocompromised patients such as transplant recipients, cancer patients, and those with autoimmune diseases. As of 2026-11-18.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルスを発見し、現在ではほぼすべての感染を検出して命を救っている遺伝子検査
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はメタゲノム解析技術の有用性を紹介する科学解説記事であり、2019年のCOVID-19発見の歴史的経緯や診断技術の進歩を扱ったものであって、現在進行中の感染症アウトブレイクを報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はCOVID-19発見の経緯とメタゲノム診断技術の進歩を解説する科学記事であり、現在の疾病発生に関する速報ではない。2019年の武漢での発見について触れているが、現行のアウトブレイク情報ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Passengers on 2 Thai Airways flights urged to watch for measles symptoms
article.articleSummary: Measles exposure linked to two Thai Airways flights (TG340 Dhaka–Bangkok, seat 46D; TG475 Bangkok–Sydney, seat 36D). An infectious traveler who flew from Bangladesh to Bangkok before continuing to Sydney developed fever, cough, runny nose and sore throat on Nov 2, with a rash appearing Nov 8; laboratory-confirmed measles. The Sydney leg arrived Nov 7 at 21:10; the traveler sought care at Canterbury Hospital in Campsie on Nov 8. New South Wales health authorities issued a public health alert; information was shared with Thailand under IHR. Thailand's Department of Disease Control urged all passengers and crew on TG340/TG475, especially those near 46D and 36D, to monitor for 21 days after exposure (through Nov 28). Symptoms include fever, cough, runny nose, red eyes, and rash. If symptoms develop, avoid close contact, wear a mask, and report travel history. Bangladesh faces a major measles outbreak (>50,000 cases, ≥350 deaths).

triage.headline_ja: タイ国際航空の2便の乗客に麻疹症状への注意を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: バングラデシュでの大規模麻疹流行（5万人超の症例、350人以上の死亡）を背景に、感染者が搭乗した国際便（バンコク経由）での曝露が確認され、タイ・オーストラリア両当局がIHRに基づき情報共有と乗客への注意喚起を行っており、国際的拡大リスクと社会的関心が認められる。
triage.notes: 感染者本人の感染地はバングラデシュと推定されるが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。タイは乗継地かつ当局が公衆衛生対応（DDCによる乗客モニタリング要請）を行った国として検証対象に含めた。オーストラリア（シドニー）は対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ramai Dugaan Makan Sushi Picu Keracunan, Amankah Konsumsi Ikan Mentah?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There Are Many Claims That Eating Sushi Can Cause Food Poisoning; Is It Safe to Consume Raw Fish?
article.articleSummary: Several food-poisoning cases linked to raw fish were spotlighted after a TikTok user reported illness hours after dining on sushi at Sushi Yay in Bogor, Indonesia, consuming all-you-can-eat Ultimate with sashimi and takeout. The complainant and companion developed abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea, and the issue remained unaddressed for months before going viral. The article attributes the illness to non-fresh ingredients, though it notes raw fish has long been consumed (sashimi, sushi) and can be safe when fresh. Risks rise if fish is not handled properly. Raw fish and other uncooked foods can harbor pathogens such as Listeria, Salmonella, and E. coli, posing greater danger to pregnant individuals and other vulnerable groups. If symptoms occur, seek hospital care. The U.S. CDC recommends cooking fish to 62°C (or until color changes and the flesh separates); shellfish should be fully cooked or open.

triage.headline_ja: 寿司を食べて食中毒になったとの訴えが拡散、生魚の摂取は安全か？
triage.triage_reason: 単一の飲食店での個別の食中毒疑い事例であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。一般的な食の安全啓発記事に近い。
triage.notes: SNSで話題になったボゴールの寿司店での個別食中毒疑い事例。病原体は特定されておらず、公的機関による調査・確認の記載もない。一般的な生魚摂取の安全性に関する啓発記事の体裁。

article.articleHeadline: ДРК: за полгода более 1700 детей скончались от Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Over six months, more than 1,700 children died from Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo is experiencing its largest Ebola outbreak in its history, with about 3,000 pediatric cases—roughly 28% of all infections. As of November 4, 2026, at least 1,737 children have died from Ebola. Mortality is highest among under-5s: 72% of infected children in this age group who progress to death. About one-third of under-5 children hospitalized with Ebola die within 24 hours. The outbreak has left more than 2,280 children orphaned, amid conflict and displacement that hinder prevention and access to medical care. North Kivu is hardest hit, where health facilities declined by 18% compared with last year. UNICEF calls for intensified pediatric care in the region, protection of health workers, and increased humanitarian assistance. Overall, 14.9 million people in the DRC need aid, including 8 million children.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:半年間で1700人以上の子供がエボラで死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで史上最大規模のエボラ流行が進行中であり、重篤な死亡率・医療崩壊・紛争地域での対応困難などIHR/WPRO基準を複数満たすためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: UNICEFによる人道支援要請が出ており、国際的な関心が高い。紛争・避難民状況が感染拡大を助長している点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Santa Luzia confirma casos de sarna humana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santa Luzia Confirms Human Scabies Cases.
article.articleSummary: As of 18 November 2026, Santa Luzia, in the Belo Horizonte Metropolitan Region, confirmed human scabies cases; the precise count was not disclosed, but all patients have been evaluated, treated, and are under follow-up. The report aligns with wider scabies activity across Minas Gerais, prompting school-focused preventive actions. Ouro Preto reported cases in five municipal education units; the total number of diagnoses is still being determined. Ribeirão das Neves recorded 11 confirmed cases across two municipal schools, with two days of classes suspended to allow cleaning. São José da Lapa confirmed four cases (two adults, two children); the entire municipal education network suspended on 13 November for sanitization. Vespasiano likewise suspended classes citywide after cases in schools. Scabies is a mite-driven skin disease causing intense itch and lesions; transmission is mainly through prolonged direct skin-to-skin contact; symptomatic individuals should seek care.

triage.headline_ja: サンタ・ルジア、ヒト疥癬の症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は公衆衛生上重篤性が低く、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクもない地域的な学校関連の事例であり、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 疥癬はヒト-ヒト直接接触で広がるが重症度は低く、学校の一時休校・消毒などローカルな公衆衛生対応で管理可能。ブラジル・ミナスジェライス州内の複数自治体（サンタ・ルジア、オウロ・プレト、リベイロン・ダス・ネヴェス、サンジョゼ・ダ・ラパ、ヴェスパシアーノ）で報告されているが、国際的な懸念事項ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Le secteur minier débloque 1,1 million de dollars pour soutenir la riposte contre Ebola | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | The mining sector unlocks $1.1 million to support the Ebola response | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo continues national fundraising for the Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) response amid the 17th wave. The mining sector contributes 1.1 million USD to the national effort. The donation, a cheque for 1,100,000 USD, was presented by Mines Minister Louis Watum Kabamba to the General Coordination of the Ebola Virus Disease Incident Management System (SGI MVE 17), represented by Dr. Jean-Jacques Muyembe. The ceremony was attended by national MPs and senators. The contribution signals cross-sector solidarity in support of the government’s response to the Ebola outbreak, aligned with actions led by President Félix-Antoine Tshisekedi Tshilombo and Prime Minister Judith Suminwa Tuluka. It underscores the importance of engaging diverse sectors beyond health to bolster outbreak response and resilience in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: ニュース | 鉱業セクターがエボラ対応支援のため110万ドルを拠出 | mediacongo.net
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラ出血熱第17波流行への継続的対応であり、重症度が高く人対人感染リスクのある疾患で、国を挙げた資金調達・政治的関与が見られるため、社会的関心と管理支援の必要性からPICKUPと判断。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知のエボラ出血熱第17波流行に対する資金支援（鉱業セクターからの寄付）に関する政治・経済的ニュースであり、新規の疫学的情報（感染者数・死亡者数・地理的拡大等）は含まれていない。既存のフルリスク評価が行われている場合は、本記事は追加情報として扱われるべき。

article.articleHeadline: Kenyan Peacekeepers Secure Civilians and Support Ebola Response in Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC)
article.articleSummary: KENYA Defence Forces’ 5th Quick Reaction Force (KENQRF 5) takes over a Static Combat Deployment in Nia Nia, Ituri Province, DRC, under MONUSCO to protect civilians and support the Ebola response. Assuming duties from the Nepal Quick Reaction Force after a Relief-in-Place, the two-month-old deployment continues MONUSCO’s security presence amid threats from illegal armed groups and ongoing Ebola outbreak efforts. KENQRF 5 will focus on protecting civilians, supporting Ebola prevention awareness, and securing treatment centres and other vital infrastructure to ensure uninterrupted access to healthcare for communities, healthcare workers, and partners. Beyond security, the unit will promote community confidence-building and public health messaging, acknowledging that effective disease containment depends on safe facility access and cooperation between security personnel, healthcare providers, and affected populations. The deployment reinforces Kenya’s role in MONUSCO’s mission to protect civilians and facilitate humanitarian access in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア平和維持部隊、コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でエボラ対応を支援し民間人を保護
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに対し、武装勢力の脅威下で国連平和維持部隊が治療施設の警備と対応支援を行っており、公衆衛生上の深刻性と国際支援の必要性が確認されるため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC・イトゥリ州における既存のエボラ対応に関するもので、ケニア・ネパールは平和維持部隊派遣元国であり発生地域ではないため除外。武装勢力による治安悪化がエボラ対応の障害となっている点が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde orienta afastamento de alunos após surtos de catapora no Acre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Department advises suspending students after varicella outbreaks in Acre.
article.articleSummary: Varicella (chickenpox) outbreaks in Cruzeiro do Sul, Acre, Brazil, in 2026, with two school clusters and 13 total notifications. The Municipal Health Secretariat warns parents and school staff to ensure vaccination and to isolate symptomatic individuals. Varicella-zoster virus is highly contagious and spreads by airborne droplets and direct contact; infectious from two days before rash until all lesions crust. Common symptoms include fever, malaise, intense itching, and red skin spots that become fluid-filled vesicles and crust. Vaccination is available at all Basic Health Units: first dose at 15 months via tetraviral vaccine (measles, mumps, rubella, varicella) and a second dose at age 4. School containment protocols include removing symptomatic students and staff from classrooms until crusting, immediate notification of surveillance for suspected cases (especially multiple cases in a class), maintaining ventilation, frequent handwashing, avoiding lesion contact, and monitoring close contacts.

triage.headline_ja: 保健局、アクレ州での水痘流行後に生徒の登校停止を指導
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の1地域（アクレ州クルゼイロ・ド・スル）で学校クラスター2件・通報13件程度の水痘流行であり、重症度や国際的拡大のリスクは低く、通常の学校感染対策の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: 水痘は小児に一般的な疾患で、地域の学校内流行であり地方自治体レベルでの対応が行われている。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 'เอฟเอโอ'ชูแนวคิดสุขภาพหนึ่งเดียว ป้องกันโรคติดต่อระหว่างสัตว์และคน
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: FAO promotes the One Health concept to prevent zoonotic diseases transmitted between animals and humans.
article.articleSummary: FAO promotes One Health to curb zoonotic diseases transmitted between animals and humans, highlighting that environmental degradation, climate change, and an El Niño-driven peak in late 2026 will worsen droughts, floods, water contamination from poultry farms, and cross-species pathogen spread. Three Asia-Pacific policy recommendations: (1) integrate wildlife and environmental context with human–animal disease surveillance to identify risks and justify biosecurity and ecosystem restoration; (2) invest in capacity building—experts, laboratories, veterinarians—to assess risk, monitor unusual diseases in wildlife and domestic animals, and communicate across sectors; (3) develop national plans with source-prevention measures, clear responsibilities, and sustained funding for wildlife and environment agencies to evaluate links among wildlife, livestock, and human disease risk. Thailand: FAO-supported avian influenza surveillance and cross-border control centers. Cambodia: wildlife health surveillance linked to human infection signals; H5N1 detected in poultry in March 2026 indicated human infection risk. Indonesia: training for wildlife/environment professionals; Sulawesi project unites government, researchers, and communities to mitigate zoonotic risk and conserve biodiversity.

triage.headline_ja: FAO、動物と人間の間で伝播する人獣共通感染症を防ぐため『ワンヘルス』の概念を推進
triage.triage_reason: FAOによるOne Health政策推進に関する一般的な啓発記事であり、特定の国における新規感染症アウトブレイクの発生報告ではないため。
triage.notes: 記事はFAOのOne Health政策に関する一般的な啓発記事で、カンボジアでの過去のH5N1検出（2026年3月）に言及しているが、カンボジアは対象国リストに含まれない。タイ・インドネシア・中国は発生地域として付与されているが、記事本文では具体的なアウトブレイク発生国としてではなく、サーベイランス体制や研修プログラムの文脈でのみ言及されているため、verified_locationsには含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: أبو قرين يدعو لرفع جاهزية ليبيا أمام إيبولا وتعزيز الترصد الوبائي دون وصم المهاجرين
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Abu Qareen calls for boosting Libya's readiness to face Ebola and strengthening epidemiological surveillance without stigmatizing migrants.
article.articleSummary: Libya should boost readiness to confront Ebola, specifically Bundibugyo ebolavirus, by strengthening epidemiological surveillance, early warning systems, rapid-response teams, and isolation capacity. The warning follows the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda that began in May, described by the WHO as a public health emergency of international concern and the largest recorded for this strain. There is currently no licensed vaccine or targeted treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola. Transmission is primarily through direct contact with blood or bodily fluids and with contaminated surfaces and medical instruments; it is not airborne. Early detection, safe patient handling and remains, isolation, and meticulous contact tracing are essential to interrupt transmission. Socioeconomic fragility, weak health systems, conflict, and mistrust raise risk; Libya should enhance border and port surveillance, laboratory capacity, PPE stocks, and One Health collaboration, and avoid stigmatizing migrants while providing testing and care. Regular drills and regional cooperation are urged.

triage.headline_ja: アブ・カライン氏、リビアのエボラ対応力強化と移民への偏見なき疫学的監視の強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRC・ウガンダで発生中のエボラ（Bundibugyoエボラウイルス）がWHOによりPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）と宣言され、同株として史上最大規模の流行とされているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 本記事はリビアの備え強化を主題とするが、実際の発生国はDRC・ウガンダ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。リビアは発生国ではなく警戒を呼びかける側のため除外。WHOがPHEIC宣言した史上最大規模のBundibugyoエボラ流行であり、ワクチン・治療法が未確立である点は重大なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: H5N1 Vaccine: India develops first homegrown bird flu shot for launch
article.articleSummary: India launches its first indigenously developed H5N1 avian influenza vaccine, an inactivated shot targeting Clade 2.3.2.1a of the H5N1 virus. Developed by ICAR and NIHSAD, the vaccine aims to protect against clade circulating in India, addressing outbreaks in chickens where the virus causes nearly 100% mortality and substantial financial losses to poultry farmers and trade. Infections by this clade have also been detected in other animal species, including mammals, with three human cases reported recently. There is currently no specific commercially available vaccine in India for this clade, making the new vaccine crucial for country preparedness and outbreak control. Globally, since 2003, WHO records 1,003 human H5N1 cases and 479 deaths across 25 countries, underscoring the public health risk. Past outbreaks such as in 2006 caused estimated direct and indirect losses of Rs. 2,200-3,000 crore.

triage.headline_ja: H5N1ワクチン：インドが初の国産鳥インフルエンザワクチンを開発、発売へ
triage.triage_reason: インド国内でH5N1クレード2.3.2.1aによる家禽の高致死率アウトブレイクと直近のヒト感染例3件が報告されており、公衆衛生上の深刻性と貿易・経済への影響が認められるため、フルリスク評価への移行を検討する。
triage.notes: 記事は主にICAR/NIHSADによる国産H5N1ワクチン開発を報じているが、クレード2.3.2.1aによる家禽での高致死率アウトブレイクと直近のヒト感染例3件の存在が明記されており、継続的な監視が必要。ヒト症例の詳細（発生時期・場所・転帰）は不明。

article.articleHeadline: இந்தியாவில் முதல்முறை.. பறவைக் காய்ச்சலைத் தடுக்க H5N1 தடுப்பூசி தயாரிப்பு
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: For the first time in India... H5N1 vaccine production to prevent avian influenza.
article.articleSummary: As of 18 November 2026, India domestically produced the H5N1 avian influenza vaccine for poultry. Tamil Nadu and Andhra Pradesh have reported poultry deaths linked to avian flu, underscoring outbreak concerns. The Indian Council of Agricultural Research in Bhopal developed a dedicated H5N1 vaccine to protect chickens. A single-dose formulation provides up to six months of immunity, suitable for layer and breeding flocks. A ceremony on Friday will see Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan dedicate the vaccine to the nation. This marks the first time India has produced an H5N1 vaccine domestically, reflecting a national effort to mitigate poultry industry losses and control avian influenza spread through vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: インドで初めて... 鳥インフルエンザ予防のためH5N1ワクチンを製造
triage.triage_reason: ヒト感染ではなく家禽における鳥インフルエンザワクチン開発に関する内容であり、人への健康リスクは現時点で示されていないが、家禽での発生状況は継続して注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は家禽向けH5N1ワクチンの国内製造開始に関する内容で、ヒト感染例は報告されていない。タミル・ナードゥ州とアンドラ・プラデーシュ州で家禽の死亡が報告されているが、人への健康影響は不明。

article.articleHeadline: The DRC's Ebola outbreak remains out of control
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), driven by the Bundibugyo strain, is spiralling at a record pace and described as Africa’s biggest-ever Ebola outbreak by geographic reach. The crisis persists despite a surge in funding, with frontline workers unpaid for months and critical shortages of medical equipment. The absence of effective treatments or vaccines has contributed to a higher fatality, with around 50% of confirmed infections resulting in death—the highest Ebola mortality on record. Widespread misinformation and violence further hamper containment and response efforts. Funding gaps are acute: authorities report more than $700 million remains unaccounted for by the DRC, according to the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention. The outbreak is portrayed as out of control, underscoring ongoing operational and resource challenges in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクは制御不能な状態が続く
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)が地理的拡大・致死率50%という記録的規模で制御不能化しており、IHR基準の複数該当とスクリーニング基準の複数該当、社会的関心の高さからフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 資金不足(7億ドル超の不透明な資金)、医療従事者未払い、誤情報・暴力による対応阻害など、アウトブレイク制御の深刻な課題が報告されている。アフリカ史上最大規模のエボラアウトブレイクとされる。

article.articleHeadline: Nhân rộng mô hình phòng, chống bệnh dại tại Hà Nội
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scaling up the rabies prevention and control model in Hanoi
article.articleSummary: Rabies prevention and control model in Hanoi, with a delegation from Đồng Nai learning the approach of converting dog and cat meat traders’ livelihoods. Grounded in a One Health framework, the Hanoi program aims to cut rabies transmission at its source while safeguarding livelihoods, contributing to Vietnam’s goal of zero rabies deaths by 2030. Rabies is nearly 100% fatal after symptom onset, with dogs as the primary source. The 14-ward pilot, approved on July 24, 2025, is led by Hanoi’s Department of Agriculture and Environment and the Animal Husbandry, Veterinary and Fisheries sector, with technical support from Soi Dog Foundation and SBCC Vietnam. It links voluntary cessation with training, startup support, and market access. As of 18 November 2026, after about 1 year of implementation, 28 establishments stopped selling or slaughtering dogs/cats, 25 households joined new livelihoods, with Giang Vo ward the first to quit. Success stories include moves to billiards, beverages, retail, and online sales.

triage.headline_ja: ハノイにおける狂犬病予防・対策モデルの拡大
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病対策プログラムの進捗報告であり、新規症例やアウトブレイクの報告ではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事はハノイ市の狂犬病予防対策モデル（One Healthアプローチ）の進捗紹介であり、新規感染事例やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。既存の政策的取り組みの拡大に関する内容。

article.articleHeadline: Authorities order culling of 26,000 domestic birds in India's Kerala amid bird flu outbreak
article.articleSummary: On 18 November 2026, authorities in Kerala’s Alappuzha district ordered the culling of more than 26,000 domestic birds amid an avian influenza outbreak. The virus was confirmed in quails, ducks, and chickens on two farms, prompting containment measures. Six rapid response teams were deployed to carry out culling, with two additional teams on standby. A 10-km surveillance zone was declared around the affected farms to monitor spread. Avian influenza is caused by the H5N1 influenza virus and is a highly infectious respiratory disease in birds; the article notes it can occasionally infect humans. The response reflects standard outbreak controls focused on rapid removal of infected birds and area-wide surveillance to prevent further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: インドのケララ州で鳥インフルエンザ発生、家禽2万6000羽の殺処分命令
triage.triage_reason: 家禽でのH5N1感染が確認され殺処分・監視区域設定などの対応がとられているが、ヒト感染例は報告されておらず、現時点では動物衛生事象に留まるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はケララ州アラプーザ県の養鶏場（ウズラ・アヒル・鶏）でのH5N1確認と殺処分・10km監視区域設定を報じているが、ヒトへの感染例は言及されていない。H5N1は散発的にヒト感染を起こしうるため今後の続報（ヒト感染の有無）を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: दुनियाभर में कोरोना के नए वैरिएंट PJ.2.1 की दस्तक, कितना खतरनाक और भारत के लिए कितनी चिंता? - Sanjeevni Today
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global emergence of the new coronavirus variant PJ.2.1: How dangerous is it and how concerned should India be? - Sanjeevni Today.
article.articleSummary: PJ.2.1, a new SARS-CoV-2 variant, was first identified in Ontario, Canada in May 2026 and has since appeared in the United States, Singapore, Australia, New Zealand, and Europe. It is a sub-variant of the JN.1 lineage. Early data show no evidence that PJ.2.1 causes more severe disease, hospitalization, or death than prior variants. Lab studies suggest vaccine-induced antibodies may offer some protection, but real-world effectiveness is unproven. Symptoms resemble typical COVID-19 or cold-like illness: sore throat, runny nose or congestion, cough, fever, headache, body aches, fatigue, and possibly altered taste or smell; diagnosis requires RT-PCR and, if needed, genomic sequencing. India: as of November 2026, no confirmed cases; INSACOG sequencing and surveillance should be strengthened. WHO does not list PJ.2.1 as a Variant of Interest or Under Monitoring. Precautions include masks in crowded spaces, hand hygiene, and isolation if symptomatic; vaccination and boosters remain important, especially for elderly or immunocompromised.

triage.headline_ja: 世界各地で新型コロナウイルスの新変異株PJ.2.1が出現：どの程度危険で、インドにとってどれほど懸念されるか？
triage.triage_reason: 新変異株PJ.2.1が複数国で確認され国際的拡大はみられるが、WHOはVOI/VUMに未分類で重症度増加の証拠もなく、インドでは確定症例が報告されていないため、現時点ではフルRRAに進む根拠が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事は新変異株PJ.2.1のグローバルな出現を報じる一般的情報記事。カナダ・米国・シンガポール・オーストラリア・ニュージーランド・欧州で確認されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれない。インドは対象国だが2026年11月時点で確定症例なしと明記されており、懸念材料としてINSACOGによる監視強化が推奨されているに留まる。WHOはPJ.2.1をVariant of InterestまたはUnder Monitoringに分類していない。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta Mpox: Cabo Frio confirma caso em paciente de outra cidade e Búzios apura suspeita; veja a situação na Região dos Lagos - CIC7 Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox Alert: Cabo Frio confirms a case in a patient from another city and Búzios investigates a suspected case; see the situation in the Lakes Region - CIC7 News
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) case confirmed in Cabo Frio, Brazil. A patient treated in the municipal health network tested positive; the patient is not a resident, and their home city was notified to trigger epidemiological surveillance. The specimen was sent to Lacen-RJ for confirmation, with the Municipal Health Secretariat confirming the result and following SES-RJ and Ministério da Saúde protocols. In the Lakes Region, no confirmed Mpox in Arraial do Cabo, Búzios, São Pedro da Aldeia, Iguaba Grande or Araruama. Búzios reports one suspected case under investigation; Iguaba Grande had a suspected case in October that was discarded. Arraial do Cabo and São Pedro da Aldeia reported no notifications; Araruama had nine suspected cases in 2026, all ruled out. Mpox transmission is by close contact with lesions, fluids, or contaminated objects; symptoms include skin eruptions, fever, headache, body pains, and lymphadenopathy. Suspected cases should seek healthcare and avoid close contact until evaluated.

triage.headline_ja: Mpoxアラート：カボ・フリオが他都市の患者の症例を確認、ブジオスも疑い例を調査中 ― 湖沼地域の状況
triage.triage_reason: 単発の確認例と疑い例（多くは否定済み）であり、通常のサーベイランス範囲内の散発事例として扱われている。重症度や拡大の兆候は報告されていない。
triage.notes: ブラジル・リオデジャネイロ州湖沼地域での散発的なMpox症例報告。既存の公衆衛生対応プロトコルに沿って処理されており、地域的・国際的拡大の兆候は記事内に見られない。

article.articleHeadline: പക്ഷിപ്പനിക്കെതിരെ തദ്ദേശീയമായി വാക്സിൻ വികസിപ്പിച്ച് ഇന്ത്യ. നവംബർ 20-ന് കേന്ദ്ര കൃഷിമന്ത്രി ശിവരാജ് സിംഗ് ചൗഹാൻ രാജ്യത്തിന് സമർപ്പിക്കും. എച്ച്5 എൻ1 വൈറസിനെതിരായ വാക്സിൻ വികസിപ്പിച്ചത് ഭോപ്പാലിലെ ഐ.സി.എ.ആർ സ്ഥാപനം. പൗൾട്രി മേഖലയ്ക്ക് വലിയ ആശ്വാസമാകും
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India develops an indigenous vaccine against avian influenza. On November 20, Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan will present it to the nation. The vaccine against the H5N1 virus was developed at an ICAR institute in Bhopal. It will be a great relief for the poultry sector.
article.articleSummary: India develops indigenous H5N1 avian influenza vaccine at ICAR-NIHSAD in Bhopal; on 2026-11-20, Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan will present it to the nation. The vaccine targets H5N1 and aims to shield the poultry sector as outbreaks reemerge. In Tamil Nadu’s Cuddalore district, around 150,000 chickens were burned and about 90,000 more culled within a one-kilometer radius. In Andhra Pradesh’s Anantapur district, the disease posed a major challenge. In 2025, avian influenza spread across Maharashtra, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Andhra Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Telangana, Karnataka, and Bihar, threatening farmers. While primarily affecting birds, rare human infections are possible, underscoring public health relevance. The vaccine’s commercial availability, price, and usage guidelines will be announced soon.

triage.headline_ja: インドが鳥インフルエンザに対する国産ワクチンを開発。11月20日にシヴラージ・シン・チョウハン中央農業大臣が国民に披露予定。H5N1ウイルスに対するワクチンはボパールのICAR系機関が開発。養鶏業界にとって大きな安堵となる見込み。
triage.triage_reason: 複数州（マハラシュトラ、チャッティースガル、アーンドラプラデーシュ等）で家禽間のH5N1感染が再拡大し大規模な殺処分が実施されており、農業省がワクチン開発・提供という形で対応に動いている点で政府の関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事は主に家禽（養鶏産業）への影響とワクチン開発に関するもので、ヒトへの感染事例は『稀』と記載されるのみで具体的な人症例報告はない。公衆衛生面よりも家禽産業・農業政策的な関心が主体。

article.articleHeadline: A telomere-to-telomere gap-free genome assembly of the plague host Himalayan marmot - Scientific Data
article.articleSummary: Telomere-to-telomere gap-free genome assembly of the plague host Himalayan marmot provides a high-quality reference genome for the species. This data descriptor, open access and published in Scientific Data (2026), lists authors including Shixiong Li, Qi Yin, Shuqing Ma, Xiaogang Yin, Jianbing Li, Ke Xu, Yixin Ma, Jinrou Quan, Jiefei Gao, Jingpeng Liu, Danyan Jian, Ruihai Zhang, Qitao Zhang, Chengcheng Deng, Yuechen Sun, Wenlong Zhao, Rui Qi, among others. The article notes early sharing with a permanent DOI and a Version of Record that may be updated. The work delivers genomic resources intended to support future investigations related to the Himalayan marmot as a plague host in genomic research contexts.

triage.headline_ja: ペスト宿主ヒマラヤマーモットのテロメア・ツー・テロメア・ギャップフリーゲノムアセンブリ - Scientific Data
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はヒマラヤマーモットのゲノム解読に関する学術論文であり、実際のペスト発生や公衆衛生事象を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はゲノム研究の成果報告であり、実際の感染症発生事例ではないため、地域の特定事象としては扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: Brazil Monitors Isolated Awá After Approach Near Guajajara Village | EconoTimes
article.articleSummary: As of 18 November 2026, isolated Awá Indigenous people in Arariboia, Maranhão, Brazil, are under monitoring after a preliminary approach near a Funai access-control post and Tawari Guajajara village, which began on Nov. 16. MPI, Funai and Sesai describe the contact as not a confirmation of ongoing interaction and reiterate Brazil's non-contact policy to protect the Awá's health and autonomy. Officials warn that the Awá have had little exposure to some infectious agents, so illnesses common elsewhere could pose serious danger; the risk of outbreaks or epidemics exists if contact occurs. A situation room coordinates responses to possible contact and disease risk. Survival International estimates about 20 people were involved and reportedly asked for yams; government statements do not confirm group size or food requests. Earlier, fires and encroachment prompted signs of isolated groups in Sept 2025, with monitoring continuing.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、グアジャジャラ村付近での接触後、孤立アワ族を監視
triage.triage_reason: 実際の感染症発生は確認されておらず、免疫のない孤立先住民との接触による将来的な感染リスクへの予防的モニタリングの段階であるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 本記事は疾患の発生ではなく、孤立部族（アワ族）と外部社会との接触に伴う将来的な感染症アウトブレイクリスクへの予防的対応を報じるもの。具体的な疾患名や症例情報はなく、Unknown Illnessとして分類されている。

article.articleHeadline: Avicultura catarinense retoma atividades após focos de doença de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santa Catarina poultry industry resumes operations after Newcastle disease outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreaks in Santa Catarina, Brazil, triggered weeks of restrictions in the state’s poultry sector. As of 18 November 2026, the industry resumes normal operations: the movement of birds is reauthorized across Santa Catarina, enabling circulation between farms and other stages of the production chain. In addition to transportation, authorities have allowed the housing of birds on farms, following measures announced after five Newcastle disease foci were identified in the state. The update marks a return to routine poultry logistics and production activity within Santa Catarina, with no further details provided on case counts, laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or human health implications. Details on imports or exports related to the outbreaks are not described.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州の養鶏業、ニューカッスル病発生後に業務再開
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾患（ニューカッスル病）であり、制限措置は既に解除され業務再開段階にあるため、人への健康影響や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 動物（家禽）の疾患に関する記事であり、人獣共通感染症としてのヒトへの感染リスクについての言及はない。既に制限解除・業務再開の段階にあり、新規性・緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Com cinco cidades sob alerta, vacinação contra a chikungunya é finalizada em MS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With five cities under alert, chikungunya vaccination is completed in Mato Grosso do Sul.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya vaccination campaign in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, concluded Oct 30, 2026, after a pilot with Instituto Butantan. The state received 64,452 doses Apr–Sep, with only 10,494 administered (16.3%). The single-dose vaccine targeted adults 18–59 without comorbidities or pregnancy. Five municipalities—Dois Irmãos do Buriti, Bonito, Sidrolândia, Anastácio, Itaporã—had high incidence at campaign end. Vaccination began in Itaporã (Apr 18) and Dourados (Apr 27); initial plan (Apr 10) anticipated 46.5k doses for Dourados and Itaporã. In May, MoH expanded to Amambai, Batayporã, Douradina, Sete Quedas (14.4k doses). Uptake remained low; in Dourados about 4,300 vaccinated by late May (~10% of a 43k target; ~800 Indigenous). The vaccine is live-attenuated, with contraindications including pregnancy, lactation, immunosuppression, uncontrolled chronic disease, or severe allergy. Week-44 data: 13,311 probable, 11,231 confirmed chikungunya cases and 33 deaths in MS; ongoing transmission and vector-control emphasis.

triage.headline_ja: 5都市に警戒指令、マットグロッソドスール州でチクングニアワクチン接種が完了
triage.triage_reason: マットグロッソドスール州で33人の死亡者と11,231人の確定症例が報告されており、ワクチン接種率が低く(16.3%)感染拡大が継続している点から公衆衛生上の懸念がある。
triage.notes: チクングニアはブラジルで流行性疾患であり、本記事はワクチン接種キャンペーンの完了報告が中心。ただし死亡者数・症例数が多く、接種率が低いため継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo: Epidemija ebole se otela kontroli, raste broj zaraženih i umrlih
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: The Ebola epidemic has spiraled out of control, and the number of infected and deceased is rising.
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo virus, is described as the second-largest and fastest-spreading since the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic. Government data cited by Reuters show more than 11,000 infections and over 5,500 deaths since the outbreak was declared on May 15. World Health Organization figures cited in the report indicate over 28,600 infections and more than 11,000 deaths, predominantly in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone. Despite substantial aid, resource shortages, security instability, and weak coordination hinder containment. Healthcare workers in the Democratic Republic of Congo are increasingly targeted in communities that distrust outsiders, complicating response efforts. This situation raises regional health security concerns.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラ出血熱の流行が制御不能に陥り、感染者数・死者数が増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の流行が「制御不能」と報じられ、感染者11,000人超・死者5,500人超という深刻な規模であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事内でWHOの統計としてギニア・リベリア・シエラレオネの数値（28,600人感染・11,000人死亡）が引用されているが、これは2014-2016年の西アフリカエボラ流行時の歴史的データと考えられ、現在進行中のDRC流行（ブンディブギョ株、2026年5月15日宣言）とは別事象である可能性が高い。記事は両者を混同している疑いがあり、フルRRAにて情報源の精査が必要。対象国リストにギニア・リベリア・シエラレオネ・アンゴラは含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: تصاعد الإصابات بإيبولا في شرق الكونغو الديمقراطية وتجاوز الوفيات 5500 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising Ebola cases in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with the death toll surpassing 5,500.
article.articleSummary: As of November 18, 2026, Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo remains out of control, with more than 11,000 infections and over 5,500 deaths, making it the second-largest Ebola outbreak on record globally. Government data show infections and fatalities rising at roughly twice the pace seen during the first six months of the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic, which infected about 28,600 people and killed over 11,000. The current outbreak is linked to the rare Bundibugyo strain and is spreading faster than any prior outbreak. It is the seventeenth Ebola outbreak in the Congo, surpassing the 2018-2020 outbreak (3,481 infections and 2,299 deaths). World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus is monitoring the situation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国東部でエボラ感染が急増、死者数5500人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国東部で記録的規模（感染1万1千人超、死者5500人超）で急拡大しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国東部のみが主題であるため、Angolaはverified_locationsから除外した（対象国リストにも含まれない）。

article.articleHeadline: 1ª morte por mpox no Brasil: o que se sabe sobre sintomas, contágio e prevenção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First mpox death in Brazil: What is known about symptoms, transmission, and prevention.
article.articleSummary: First mpox (monkeypox) death in Brazil occurred in Rio de Janeiro; patient was a man aged 40–49 with immunocompromise. Ministry of Health data on 16 November reported 1,055 confirmed cases, 46 probable, and 617 suspected. Mpox is caused by MPXV, an Orthopoxvirus, with natural reservoirs in African rodents and transmission from animals to humans and via person-to-person contact. Spread occurs mainly through direct contact with skin lesions, bodily fluids, or secretions; contaminated objects can spread it. Symptoms include fever, headache, myalgias, chills, fatigue, and lymphadenopathy; a rash evolves from macules to crusts, affecting the face, mouth, hands, feet, and genital/anal region. Incubation is typically 3–16 days (up to 21); contagious until crusts fall and new skin forms, with recovery in 2–4 weeks. No antiviral exists; care is supportive. Vaccination targets adults 18+, two doses 28 days apart; priority groups include lab workers, HIV patients with CD4 <100, PrEP users, and close contacts after assessment.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで初のmpox（エムポックス）死亡例：症状、感染経路、予防について分かっていること
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで継続中のmpoxアウトブレイクにおいて初の死亡例が報告され、症例数も1,000例超と多く、重症度・流行継続性の観点からWPRO基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: ブラジルでのmpoxアウトブレイクは既知の継続事案だが、初の死亡例報告という重症化の進展があり、保健省による症例集計（確定1,055・疑い617）も継続報告されている。免疫不全者（HIV等）でのリスクが強調されている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Mato Grosso do Sul confirma 1º caso de Mpox em 2026 e investiga três suspeitas da doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mato Grosso do Sul confirms 1st Mpox case in 2026 and investigates three suspected Mpox cases.
article.articleSummary: Mpox in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, confirms its first 2026 case, with three additional suspected infections under investigation by SES-MS amid a regional uptick (notably in Rio de Janeiro). The confirmed patient is a man aged 40–49 with HIV coinfection, diagnosed in Campo Grande in the latter half of September; he did not require hospitalization. Historically, the state recorded 14 confirmations in 2024, 1 in 2023, and 157 in 2022 (the peak), with no Mpox deaths to date. Mpox is caused by the mpox virus (MPXV) and spreads mainly through direct contact with lesions or bodily fluids, contaminated objects, or prolonged close contact; incubation ranges from 3 to 21 days. Symptoms include skin lesions, lymphadenopathy, fever, headache, myalgias, and weakness. Prevention emphasizes avoiding contact with cases, hygiene, isolation, and vaccination with Jynneos/Imvanex for eligible groups (18–49 years with HIV, exposed individuals, and certain professionals).

triage.headline_ja: マトグロッソ・ド・スル州、2026年の第1例目のMpox症例を確認、疑い例3件を調査中
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内で散発的なMpox症例確認であり、地域的増加傾向はあるが重症例や死亡はなく、現時点で国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 既知のエンデミック疾患の地域的な症例報告であり、HIV陽性患者における単発例。リオデジャネイロ州でも増加傾向があるとされるが詳細不明。

article.articleHeadline: India proposes six-day quarantine for Kenyans, other travellers without yellow fever vaccination certificates
article.articleSummary: India seeks six-day quarantine for travellers from areas identified as yellow fever risk if they lack a valid vaccination certificate, under draft Indian Aircraft (Public Health) Rules, 2026. Quarantine ends when the certificate becomes valid or after six days from last exposure, whichever occurs first, reflecting yellow fever’s incubation. The rules, prepared by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare to replace the 1954 Aircraft Rules, would require yellow fever vaccination for departures from risk areas, with WHO-approved vaccines offering protection from day 10 and presumed lifelong validity. A valid certificate would exempt travellers from being treated as suspects on arrival. Kenya is listed among 29 African countries with yellow fever transmission risk, along with Uganda, Ethiopia, Nigeria, Ghana, Burundi, and 13 Central/South American nations. The ministry issued an office memorandum inviting comments on November 16, 2026, as part of broader airport health safeguards.

triage.headline_ja: インドがケニア等からの渡航者に対し黄熱病予防接種証明書がない場合6日間の検疫を提案
triage.triage_reason: 黄熱病の新規発生や異常な流行を報じる内容ではなく、インドの航空衛生規則案（渡航者検疫）に関する行政的な記事であり、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれも実質的な該当がない。
triage.notes: 記事はインド政府による航空機公衆衛生規則案（2026年ドラフト）に関するもので、黄熱病の実際の発生・流行を報じるものではない。アフリカ29か国を『リスク地域』として列挙しているが、具体的発生国ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Instituto Butantan cria centro tecnológico voltado ao estudo e combate de arboviroses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Butantan Institute Creates a Technology Center Focused on the Study and Control of Arboviral Diseases.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Butantan Institute established the Center of Technology in Arboviruses (CeTA) in São Paulo to advance research on dengue, Zika, chikungunya, and yellow fever, focusing on identifying and validating molecular targets that explain and modulate severe inflammatory, neurological, and chronic arthralgia manifestations. The center builds a global-science network with the Ragon Institute (affiliated with MIT, Mass General Brigham, and Harvard) and CNPEM in Campinas, funded by a five-year FAPESP and Butantan Foundation grant. CeTA leverages AI, machine learning, and bioinformatics to model viral–human protein interactions and mine large biological data, enabling faster discovery. It will cover the full development chain from labs to industrial scale, including BSL-3 containment, 3D human preclinical models, and GMP compliance. Goals include validating at least three new molecular targets, filing international patents, advancing two bioproduct or vaccine candidates, and delivering a regulatory dossier ready for clinical trials and SUS-ready solutions.

triage.headline_ja: ブタンタン研究所、アルボウイルス感染症の研究と対策に特化した技術センターを設立
triage.triage_reason: 研究センター設立に関する発表であり、実際の感染症発生・流行事例ではないためシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・ブタンタン研究所によるデング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア熱、黄熱病研究のための技術センター（CeTA）設立に関する発表であり、具体的な発生事例や流行状況を報告するものではない。発生地域としてBrazilが挙げられているが、感染症の実際の発生事例ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Surveillance Identifies Antimalarial Resistance Mutations in Southwestern
article.articleSummary: Clinical surveillance of Plasmodium vivax in southwestern India identified widespread antimalarial resistance mutations across Pvmdr1, Pvcrt-o, Pvdhfr, and Pvdhps in 93 isolates from symptomatic adults collected July 2021–September 2024 at Kasturba Medical College (Manipal), Udupi District Hospital, and Mangaluru District Hospital. Pvmdr1 mutations: M908L in all samples; T958M and F1076L in ~86% and ~85%; Y976F in 2.15%. Pvcrt-o showed a K10 insertion in 26%. Folate-pathway mutations included Pvdhfr S58R (59.13%) and S117N (56.98%), with the S58R+S117N haplotype most common; Pvdhps A383G (26.88%) and A553G (13.97%). While not indicating complete chloroquine resistance, the Y976F mutation in two samples has been linked to reduced chloroquine susceptibility. Authors call for continued molecular surveillance and region-specific antimalarial strategies to address rising resistance in this region.

triage.headline_ja: インド南西部でバンファルシパルムマラリア（三日熱マラリア）の抗マラリア薬耐性変異をサーベイランスで検出
triage.triage_reason: 急性のアウトブレイクではなく、2021年から2024年にかけての分子サーベイランス研究の報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急対応を要する事象ではないため。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術研究（分子サーベイランス）であり、マラリア薬剤耐性変異の検出報告。急性のアウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではないため、現時点ではDISMISSと判断。ただし耐性拡大の動向は今後注視すべき領域。

article.articleHeadline: Platelet to Pleural Fluid ADA Ratio Identifies Tuberculous Pleural Effusion
article.articleSummary: Retrospective, single-center study in Xinxiang, China (The First Affiliated Hospital of Henan Medical University) analyzed 184 pleural effusion cases from 2020–2023 to assess the peripheral platelet-to-pleural fluid ADA ratio for diagnosing tuberculous pleural effusion. Of these, 89 were TB effusions; 95 non-tuberculous (49 malignant, 46 parapneumonic). Pleural fluid ADA was higher in TB cases, driving the ratio (peripheral platelets divided by pleural ADA) lower in TB than in malignant or parapneumonic effusions. ROC analysis yielded an area under the curve of 0.92; at a cut-off of ≤13.2, sensitivity 96.6% and specificity 83.2% (PPV 84.3%, NPV 96.3%). Net reclassification improvement and integrated discrimination improvement indicated the ratio adds value beyond ADA alone, warranting further exploratory research in TB effusion diagnostics.

triage.headline_ja: 血小板・胸水ADA比が結核性胸水を同定
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は診断手法に関する後ろ向き研究報告であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態やアウトブレイクに関する情報ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 単一施設での診断マーカーに関する研究論文であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生事象の報告ではない。
