article.articleHeadline: Bhopal develops indigenous bird flu vaccine for poultry, Shivraj Singh Chouhan to dedicate to nation on Nov 20 - english.punjabkesari.com
article.articleSummary: Bhopal-based ICAR-National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (ICAR-NIHSAD) has developed India's first indigenous inactivated H5N1 Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI) vaccine for poultry, to be unveiled at NIHSAD and dedicated by Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan on November 20. Bird flu (HPAI) outbreaks can cause up to 100% mortality in affected flocks and disrupt trade and farmers’ livelihoods. Since 2006, India has reported more than 500 outbreaks of H5N1 and H5N8. WHO data show 1,003 human H5N1 cases with 479 deaths across 25 countries since 2003, including India. The circulating H5N1 Clade 2.3.2.1a strain has driven most poultry outbreaks; until now no commercial vaccine protected poultry against this strain. The indigenous vaccine aims to reduce economic losses and prevent spread from poultry to other animals and humans, safeguarding India's poultry sector and public health.

triage.headline_ja: ボーパールが家禽用の国産鳥インフルエンザワクチンを開発、シブラージ・シン・チョウハン氏が11月20日に国民に捧げる
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は新規アウトブレイクではなく、既存のH5N1に対する国産ワクチン開発・発表に関する内容であり、現時点で新たな公衆衛生リスクの増大を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン開発・発表に関する科学・政策ニュースであり、新規感染拡大や症例報告ではない。背景情報として過去のH5N1アウトブレイク統計が引用されているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Morcego com raiva é encontrado no bairro São Cristóvão, em Ouro Preto
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabid bat found in the São Cristóvão neighborhood, Ouro Preto.
article.articleSummary: Rabid bat found in the São Cristóvão neighborhood of Ouro Preto, Minas Gerais, Brazil. The animal was collected November 13 after neurological changes and sent to a reference lab in Belo Horizonte; rabies confirmation was reported November 17. No human exposures have been reported. Beginning November 18, workers will visit homes within 500 meters of the site to review vaccination cards for dogs and cats and vaccinate those not up to date in 2026; animals without vaccination records will also be vaccinated. In 2026, 150 animals were vaccinated in the neighborhood, down from 173 last year. The Minas Gerais Health Secretariat notes rabies is transmitted by bites, scratches, or licking of infected animals, and all human cases have been fatal. If exposed, wash with soap and water and seek immediate medical evaluation for preventive treatment. Keep pets indoors at night; notify Zoonoses Surveillance at (31) 3559-3280; avoid handling bats.

triage.headline_ja: オウロ・プレト市サン・クリストヴァン地区で狂犬病のコウモリが発見される
triage.triage_reason: 単一のコウモリの狂犬病確認事例であり、人への曝露は報告されておらず、地域的なルーチン対応（ワクチン接種確認）が行われているのみで、国際的・公衆衛生上の重大な懸念には該当しない。
triage.notes: 狂犬病に感染したコウモリ1匹の発見事例。人への曝露なし、地元保健当局による通常の予防対応（周辺住民へのペットワクチン接種確認）が実施されており、シグナルとしての重大性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: casos suspeitos de Mpox em Divinópolis - Jornal Panorama
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Mpox cases in Divinópolis - Jornal Panorama.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected mpox (monkeypox) cases in Divinópolis, Central-West Minas Gerais, Brazil, are under investigation as of 18 November 2026. A 19-year-old male is isolated at the UPA (Emergency Care Unit) and a 58-year-old woman is hospitalized in Divinópolis; samples collected on 16–17 November were sent to Fundação Ezequiel Dias (Funed) in Belo Horizonte, with results expected by 20 November. Divinópolis has no confirmed mpox cases to date. Minas Gerais state has 42 confirmed mpox cases in 2026, with 172 still under investigation. Transmission occurs mainly through direct contact with skin lesions, bodily fluids, and respiratory secretions, and can spread via contaminated objects. Common symptoms include skin eruptions/lesions, fever, headache, muscle and back pain, lymphadenopathy, and fatigue. Health authorities report isolation and precautionary measures while awaiting laboratory confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: ジヴィノーポリスでMpox疑い例2件を調査中 - Jornal Panorama紙
triage.triage_reason: ミナスジェライス州では既に42例の確定例と172例の調査中例があり、今回の2件の疑い例は既存のアウトブレイク状況下での通常の追加報告であり、新規性・異常性は低いが、検査結果待ちのため継続的な注視が必要。
triage.notes: ミナスジェライス州では2026年に既に42例の確定例があり、本記事はその文脈における地域ニュースの疑い例報告。検査結果（11月20日予定）待ちの段階であり、確定診断後の動向を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Pakar UGM Ingatkan Risiko DBD Meningkat akibat Perubahan Iklim
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UGM expert warns of rising dengue fever risk due to climate change.
article.articleSummary: Yogyakarta, Indonesia — A Gadjah Mada University (UGM) expert warns climate change and rising temperatures could expand the range of dengue-carrying Aedes aegypti mosquitoes, elevating dengue fever (DBD) risk beyond areas once considered unsuitable. Indonesian Health Ministry data through October 2026 show 98,946 dengue cases and 265 deaths across 467 districts/cities in 33 provinces, with 488 of 514 districts reporting year-on-year increases. Disease dynamics vary by local ecology, monsoon patterns, and how communities manage water, which shapes mosquito abundance. Dry seasons do not always lower risk; limited clean water can drive storage in containers that become mosquito habitats, exemplified by the Pontang coastal area. El Niño-related warming may further broaden suitable habitats, potentially allowing Aedes aegypti to persist in subtropical or higher-elevation regions. The study calls for multi-source surveillance, integrating mobility, environmental, and climate data with case reporting to better anticipate dengue spread.

triage.headline_ja: UGM専門家、気候変動によるデング熱リスク上昇を警告
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はインドネシアで既知の風土病であり、本記事は気候変動による将来的リスク拡大に関する専門家の見解・全国統計の紹介であり、新規の異常発生シグナルとは言えないが、症例数・死亡者数の増加傾向は注視を要する。
triage.notes: 全国データでは2026年10月時点で98,946症例・265死亡、514地区中488地区で前年比増加と報告されているが、これは既存のサーベイランスデータに基づく気候変動影響の専門家コメントであり、突発的アウトブレイクのシグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Kitört a járvány Magyarországon, százával fertőződnek meg az emberek!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An outbreak has erupted in Hungary; hundreds of people are getting infected!
article.articleSummary: Diarrheal outbreak in Hungary linked to Bacillus cereus; as of 18 November 2026, 1,495 people affected since the outbreak began on 4 November, with 373 in Zala County experiencing mild diarrhea and vomiting; no hospitalizations reported. Laboratory tests detected Bacillus cereus in four food samples, and eight additional stool samples are under analysis. Preliminary findings point to multiple foods and kitchen practices rather than a single contaminated item; investigation ongoing across counties. The report raises whether the outbreak has reached Hajdú-Bihar, while noting ongoing monitoring. In parallel, Hungary has three travel-associated dengue fever cases this week: two imported infections in Győr-Moson-Sopron (a 30-year-old man and a 26-year-old woman, both having been in Vietnam) and one in Pest County (a 35-year-old woman infected in the Maldives). Dengue presents with fever, headache, and muscle/joint pains; these are imported cases, not confirmed local transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ハンガリーで感染症が発生、数百人が感染！
triage.triage_reason: ハンガリー国内でのバチルス・セレウス菌による軽症の食中毒アウトブレイクと、ベトナム・モルディブ渡航歴のある輸入デング熱症例（現地感染なし）であり、対象国における発生事例に該当しない。
triage.notes: デング熱症例はベトナム・モルディブへの渡航歴による輸入例であり、現地（ベトナム）での発生事例ではないため対象国として計上しない。主な事象であるバチルス・セレウス菌の食中毒もハンガリー国内の事例であり対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Bé gái 4 tuổi tử vong sau 10 ngày mắc sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 4-year-old girl dies after 10 days of dengue fever
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Đắk Lắk Province, Vietnam, led to the death of a 4-year-old girl from Krông Pắc. H.S.N., an Ê Đê child from Ea Wi village, developed fever on 6 November, tested NS1-positive, and was admitted to Krông Pắc Medical Center and then Tay Nguyen Regional General Hospital. By 11 November she progressed to dengue hemorrhagic fever with dengue shock syndrome, severe liver injury, coagulopathy, respiratory failure (grade IV), multiorgan failure, pleural effusions, and gastrointestinal bleeding, dying on 16 November after the family brought her home. Real-time RT-PCR confirmed dengue virus type 1 (DENV-1). The grandmother also had dengue (onset 4 November; NS1-positive; discharged 13 November); other family members were asymptomatic. Public health actions included indoor/outdoor insecticide spraying at the patient’s home and about 100 nearby households, plus community prevention education. As of 16 November 2026, Krông Pắc reported 519 dengue cases and 11 outbreaks, with 3 active.

triage.headline_ja: 10日間のデング熱罹患後、4歳女児が死亡
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ダクラク省における単発の重症デング熱死亡例であり、同省では既に519例・11件のアウトブレイクが報告され地域で対応中だが、デング熱は同国の風土病であり国際的拡大リスクや渡航貿易制限の兆候はない。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムの風土病であり、本件は地方レベルでの既存のアウトブレイク対応（殺虫剤散布、啓発活動）が行われている。重症化・死亡例として注視は必要だが、現時点で国際的な懸念事項には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: No debe cundir el pánico aún, pero los científicos localizan al murciélago que puede provocar la nueva epidemia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There is no need to panic yet, but scientists have identified the bat that could trigger the new epidemic.
article.articleSummary: NiV Nipah virus, first identified in 1999 in Malaysia and Singapore, now prompts containment in India near Kolkata as a new outbreak raises pandemic concerns. Nipah is a zoonotic virus with mortality up to 70%. Primary reservoirs are fruit bats and pigs; transmission occurs bat-to-human, animal-to-human, and human-to-human, including contaminated foods. India has launched containment around Calcutta, with healthcare workers using PPE and active case finding within a 4–45 day incubation window, followed by three months of contact monitoring before declaring the outbreak finished. RT-PCR testing of bats at Alipore Zoo, Calcutta, is under way by the National Institute of Medical Research. No travel-related or exported cases reported yet. West Bengal documented Nipah infections in 2001 and 2007 (at least 50 deaths). Globally, about 760 cases and 437 deaths across Bangladesh, India, Malaysia, Philippines, and Singapore. Spain poses low risk; Nipah is OIE-listed; surveillance continues.

triage.headline_ja: まだパニックになる必要はないが、科学者たちは新たな流行を引き起こす可能性のあるコウモリを特定した
triage.triage_reason: インド・コルカタ近郊でニパウイルスの新規アウトブレイクが発生し、致死率最大70%、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性があり、当局が封じ込め対応を実施中であるためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・コルカタ（西ベンガル州）での新規ニパウイルスアウトブレイクが主題。バングラデシュ、マレーシア、フィリピン、シンガポールは過去の累計統計（760例・437死亡）として言及されているのみで今回の発生地ではないため除外。スペインは低リスクとして言及されているが対象国外。

article.articleHeadline: झारखंड में इबोला को लेकर स्वास्थ्य विभाग सतर्क, मंत्री इरफान अंसारी ने दिए सख्त दिशा- निर्देश
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health department on alert regarding Ebola in Jharkhand; Minister Irfan Ansari issued strict directives.
article.articleSummary: Ebola alert issued in Jharkhand, India as Health Minister Irfan Ansari directs strict adherence to central guidelines. Authorities will boost screening at airports, railway stations, bus stands, and other crowded places; suspected cases must be identified, reported, and treated promptly. A departmental review ordered full implementation of central Ebola guidelines across Rajendra Institute of Medical Sciences (RIMS) in Ranchi, other medical colleges, district hospitals, and related facilities. Hospitals should maintain isolation wards, ensure PPE stock and trained infection-control staff, and transport suspected samples to designated reference labs. All districts must sustain 24-hour surveillance, robust information exchange, and prompt reporting. Ebola is a severe, potentially fatal disease caused by the Ebola virus. Incubation is 2–21 days, with early symptoms of fever, headache, weakness, and muscle pains; later vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, and possible bleeding. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood, vomit, stool, or other body fluids; it is not airborne.

triage.headline_ja: ジャールカンド州でエボラ警戒、保健大臣イルファン・アンサリが厳格な指示を発令
triage.triage_reason: インドでのエボラ確定症例・疑い症例の報告はなく、政府が予防的な警戒態勢・準備指示を出した段階に留まるため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・ジャールカンド州での予防的な準備態勢（スクリーニング強化、隔離病棟整備等）の指示を報じたものであり、実際のエボラ症例発生の報告は本文中に見られない。インドはエボラの流行国ではなく、渡航歴者等の輸入例を想定した備えと推測されるが詳細不明。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta de saúde: casos de hepatite A disparam na região
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health alert: Hepatitis A cases surge in the region.
article.articleSummary: Health alert: Hepatitis A cases surge in Franca, São Paulo state, Brazil, with more than 120 infections reported in recent months, compared with only one confirmed case last year. Hepatitis A is transmitted principally through contaminated water and food and by poor hand hygiene. Early symptoms resemble a common viral illness, but in some patients the infection can progress to hospitalization. Sanitary Surveillance authorities in Franca are investigating the factors driving this rise. The report notes an ongoing regional outbreak, without detailed information on the infection source. Emphasizes need for vigilance in water safety and food handling to prevent transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 健康警報：サンパウロ州でA型肝炎の症例が急増
triage.triage_reason: 過去1年で1件だった症例が120件以上に急増しており、異常な増加かつ感染経路（水・食品・手指衛生）から流行しやすい可能性があるため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・サンパウロ州フランカ市での局地的なA型肝炎症例急増を報じており、感染源は未特定。衛生監視当局が調査中であり、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: بدء تجارب لقاح ضد سلالة من إيبولا فـي الكونجو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vaccine trials against an Ebola strain begin in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Two candidate vaccines against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola are set to enter clinical trials in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the World Health Organization announced. The ongoing outbreak in DRC has recorded 11,376 infections and 5,568 deaths. The epidemic was officially declared on May 15, and Bundibugyo, unlike other Ebola strains, currently has no approved vaccine or therapy. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stated at a Geneva press conference that the two vaccine candidates, developed specifically to counter Bundibugyo, are expected to begin testing as early as next week. The report highlights the deadly, ongoing outbreak in a large central African nation and the urgent need for vaccination strategies amid the absence of licensed interventions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ株に対するワクチン治験開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCで11,376人感染・5,568人死亡という大規模かつ致死率の高いエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の流行が継続中で、承認済みワクチン・治療法が存在しないため国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域に含まれるGenevaおよびSwitzerlandはWHOの記者会見開催地であり、アウトブレイク発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Review Links SFTS Virus Immune Evasion to Clinical Treatment Hurdles
article.articleSummary: SFTS virus (Dabie bandavirus) is a tick-borne pathogen causing severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome, first isolated in Henan, China (2009). China’s surveillance (2010–2023) reports 27,447 confirmed cases and an overall case fatality rate of 4.83%, falling from 12.68% in 2010 to 3.77% in 2023; hospital cohorts show 12–30% CFRs and ICU mortality around 50%. Designated a WHO priority pathogen since 2017, the virus reveals a widening gap between mechanistic understanding and clinical translation. Haemaphysalis longicornis is the main vector; other ticks (R. microplus, I. nipponensis, A. testudinarium) also transmit. Human cases occur in China, Japan, and South Korea; serological/animal evidence exists in Vietnam, Pakistan, Thailand, and Myanmar; H. longicornis has been detected in the United States, signaling spread risk. Human-to-human transmission occurs via blood/fluids; Zhejiang (2023) outbreak included seven of twelve infections from direct blood exposure. The virion is a three-segment RNA virus (L ~6,368 bp; M ~3,378 bp; S ~1,746 bp) with entry via clathrin-mediated endocytosis and receptors including DC-SIGN, CCR2, and LRP1. NSs and NP mediate potent innate and adaptive immune evasion, dampening IFN signaling and antigen presentation in monocytes and B cells.

triage.headline_ja: SFTSウイルスの免疫回避と臨床治療の障壁との関連を示すレビュー
triage.triage_reason: 新規アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、既知の病原体（SFTSウイルス）の免疫回避機序に関する学術レビュー記事であるため直ちにRRAへ進む段階ではないが、重症度や疫学拡大リスクの観点から継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は新規症例やアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、SFTSウイルスの免疫回避メカニズムと臨床治療への課題をまとめた科学的レビュー論文の紹介記事。中国での長期サーベイランスデータ（2010-2023年）や既知の疫学情報が中心で、新規の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。パキスタンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。日本・韓国も対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: HIV and Tuberculosis Co-Infection Rates Dropped in Liangshan Between 2019
article.articleSummary: HIV and tuberculosis co-infection incidence in Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture, Sichuan, China declined from 12.26 to 8.76 per 100,000 population between 2019 and 2024, based on 3,367 confirmed HIV-TB co-infected cases. The chi-square trend was 40.459 (p<0.001), indicating a robust regional decrease largely driven by improvements in historically high-burden counties and by substantial declines among residents under 45, with reductions observed in both genders. Liangshan is a mountainous, resource-limited region with about 5.5 million residents. The study linked tuberculosis surveillance data (TB Information Management System) with HIV/AIDS data (Comprehensive Response Information Management System) for permanent prefectural residents diagnosed 2019–2024, yielding the analytic sample after cleaning. A public health framework—Integrated Prevention and Control of Four Diseases (enacted 2021) and a precision management model piloted in 2017 and expanded to 17 counties by 2021—employed opt-out testing and multi-tier governance to address co-infection. Earlier HIV transmission began among people who inject drugs, then spread via heterosexual contact.

triage.headline_ja: 四川省涼山州における2019年から2024年のHIVと結核の重複感染率の低下
triage.triage_reason: HIV・結核重複感染率が改善傾向にあることを報告する研究記事であり、公衆衛生上の新規脅威や異常事態ではないため、トリアージ対象外と判断する。
triage.notes: 本記事は疫学研究の成果報告であり、感染率は減少傾向にある。新規アウトブレイクや異常事態を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Estados Unidos perdem status de país livre do sarampo após 26 anos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States lose its measles-free status after 26 years.
article.articleSummary: United States loses measles-free status after 26 years, with more than 5,000 confirmed measles cases and six deaths in 2026, all among unvaccinated people. It marks the largest outbreak since the disease’s elimination in 2000 and is linked to declines in vaccination coverage. Disinformation and vaccine resistance are identified as key drivers, with roughly 280,000 preschool children not fully vaccinated. Brazil faced a similar challenge, losing its measles eradication certificate in 2019 and regaining it in 2024, but reporting over 60 measles cases this year. To reclaim measles-free status, transmission must be interrupted for at least one year, while vaccination campaigns and rapid outbreak response are intensified to boost immunity and suppress spread.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、26年ぶりに麻疹排除国としての地位を喪失
triage.triage_reason: 米国で麻疹排除状態が26年ぶりに失われ、5000例超・死亡6例という大規模アウトブレイクが発生しており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性が認められるためIHR基準を2つ以上満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は米国の麻疹排除状態喪失だが、ブラジルも2026年に60例超の麻疹症例を報告しており、対象国として言及されているため含めた。米国はGeoNames対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Sarna humana é identificada em cinco escolas e creches municipais de Ouro Preto
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Human Scabies Identified in Five Municipal Schools and Day-Care Centers in Ouro Preto
article.articleSummary: Ouro Preto, Minas Gerais, Brazil, identified human scabies in five municipal schools and day-care centers: Zezinho Pedrosa Municipal Daycare; Alfredo Baeta Municipal School; Cantinho da Criança Municipal Daycare; Arnaldo Bastos Municipal Daycare; Professor Haydee Antunes Municipal School. City hall suspended classes in affected cohorts and ordered cleaning of facilities; technical teams guide institutions per Sanitary Surveillance and Epidemiological Surveillance guidance. Total number of infected people is still being consolidated. Ouro Preto is among 24 MG municipalities with scabies in November; on November 14, six cases were recorded in a municipal daycare. In the Belo Horizonte Metropolitan Region, Ribeirão das Neves reported 11 cases across two schools, São José da Lapa suspended all municipal units, and Vespasiano paused activities in a municipal and a state school. Scabies is a contagious skin disease caused by a mite; symptoms include intense nocturnal itching; treatment requires medical evaluation and may involve close contacts.

triage.headline_ja: オウロ・プレトの市立学校・保育施設5か所でヒト疥癬が確認される
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は公衆衛生上の重大性が低く国際的拡大リスクも低いが、複数自治体・施設で集団発生し拡大傾向にあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 疥癬はヒトヒト感染する接触性皮膚疾患だが重症度は低く、ミナスジェライス州内の学校・保育施設で局地的に拡大している事例。自治体が休校・消毒等の対応を実施中であり、外部支援の必要性は低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: 2 pupils in Opao die of dengue; school clears breeding sites
article.articleSummary: Two kindergarten pupils at Opao Elementary School in Mandaue City died of dengue in November, prompting a campus cleanup as teachers and parents cleared stagnant-water containers and discarded items to eliminate breeding sites. The school reported 19 pupils testing positive for dengue, with a misting operation preceding a two-day face-to-face class suspension under the Department of Education’s Hinga heat guidelines. City health officials noted dengue activity in 2026 is higher than 2025’s total of 520 cases and three deaths; as of Jan 1–Jul 30, 2026, Mandaue recorded 373 cases and one death. School staff are replacing damaged window screens, and the education department supplied mosquito nets and sprays. Parents are urged to cover water containers and seek medical care if fever develops. Dengue fast lanes offer free lab tests (CBC, platelet counts, NS1), paracetamol, and hydration; surveillance teams check households and barangays coordinate cleanups as part of the 4S strategy.

triage.headline_ja: オパオ地区の児童2人がデング熱で死亡、学校が発生源を除去
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンの学校で季節性デング熱による死亡例が報告されているが、地域レベルの既知の風土病流行であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限の懸念はない。地域保健当局が通常の対応（ファストレーン、燻煙、サーベイランス）を実施中のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: マンダウエ市では2026年の症例数が2025年の年間実績（520例・死亡3名）を既に上回るペースであり、局地的に増加傾向にある点は注視が必要。ただし地方自治体・教育省レベルで対応が完結しており、外部支援の必要性は現時点で確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue-Fieber breitet sich aus: Was Reisende jetzt wissen sollten
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever is spreading: What travelers should know now.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is spreading beyond tropical zones. Through October, global cases exceed 2.5 million with over 1,000 deaths (ECDC). In Bangladesh, about 137,000 infections and 427 deaths; nearly 2,000 hospitalizations on one day in late October. In Southeast Asia, Vietnam reports about 170,700 cases, Cambodia up 137% to mid-October. In Latin America, Brazil has around 1.37 million cases by early October; Mexico, Colombia, Peru, and Bolivia also rising. Europe faces expanding risk as Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus spread; tiger mosquitoes detected in almost 30 countries, established in more than 20. In Germany, tiger mosquitoes along the Rhine and in Berlin, Jena, Nuremberg, with a breeding site in Hannover; all German cases to date are travel-related. Symptoms appear 3–10 days after bite; most infections mild, but warning signs require urgent care. No antiviral; paracetamol recommended; avoid aspirin/ibuprofen. EU-approved vaccine Qdenga for ages 4+; debates on vaccination for frequent travelers.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱が拡大中：旅行者が今知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: 世界的なデング熱症例数・死亡者数の増加とベトナム・ブラジルを含む複数国での大規模流行が報告されており、国際的拡大と公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められるため。
triage.notes: 本記事はドイツ向け旅行アドバイザリーとしてのグローバルなデング熱拡大状況の概観であり、対象国ではベトナム（約170,700例）とブラジル（約137万例）が具体的症例数と共に言及されている。バングラデシュ・メキシコ・コロンビア・ペルー・ボリビア・ドイツは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Opao school intensifies dengue prevention measures after reported deaths
article.articleSummary: Two kindergarten pupils died of dengue in Mandaue City, Cebu (one from Opao, another from Umapad), prompting Opao Elementary School in Barangay Opao to ramp up prevention. With DepEd’s HINGA heat-level two-day suspension in effect (temperature 33–41°C), the school on Nov 18 held a campus-wide cleanup with teachers and PTA to remove standing water, dispose of containers, and cover water storage; it also installed mosquito nets supplied by DepEd through the City Health Office, and replaced old classroom screens while purchasing insecticide sprays. Misting operations occurred on Nov 17 in coordination with the barangay. Parents were advised during the break on home dengue prevention. City Health Officer Dr. Debra Maria Catulong said the Health Office investigates dengue cases and deaths, strengthens the 4S strategy (Search and destroy breeding sites; Self-protection; Seek early consultation; Support fogging only in outbreak areas), and runs a dengue fast lane.

triage.headline_ja: オパオ小学校、デング熱による死亡報告を受け予防対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: セブ州マンダウエ市で幼稚園児2名がデング熱で死亡し、学校・保健当局が対策を強化している。WPRO基準（重症度・持続曝露・流行しやすさ）に複数該当し、行政・メディアの関心も高いためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: デング熱はフィリピンで季節的に頻発する疾患であり、本件はマンダウエ市内の局地的な事例。行政・学校・保健所による既存の4S戦略での対応が進行中であり、国際的拡大リスクは低いが、子どもの死亡例が報告されている点から継続監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Bé gái 8 tuổi tử vong do sốt xuất huyết, Trảng Bom khẩn trương xử lý ổ dịch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 8-year-old girl dies of dengue fever; Trang Bom rushes to contain the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: An 8-year-old girl from Ward Trang Bom, Dong Nai Province, died of severe dengue fever with dengue shock syndrome and multi-organ failure. Onset began 7 Nov with fever, cough, and fatigue; initial visit (9 Nov) at Trảng Bom Regional Medical Center diagnosed dengue (unspecified) with acute upper respiratory infection, with negative Dengue IgM/IgG tests. Reportedly, a private service delivered 500 ml Lactated Ringer’s at home later that day. By 10 Nov she deteriorated, developing shock; she was admitted to Đồng Nai Children’s Hospital in critical condition and died on 13 Nov from severe dengue with shock, multi-organ injury, and acute liver failure. Local authorities launched an outbreak response, including larval source reduction and a 200 m radius insecticide spray around the patient’s home on 14 Nov, with a second spray planned for 21 Nov. Surveillance will continue 14 days post-spraying, aiming to clear clusters within 48 hours. Community is urged to seek timely medical care and avoid home IV therapy. Since early 2026, Đồng Nai CDC reports nearly 22,000 dengue cases and 12 deaths in the city.

triage.headline_ja: 8歳女児がデング熱で死亡、チャンボムで緊急の発生対応
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムのドンナイ省で季節性に流行しているデング熱による死亡例であり、地域全体では約22,000例・12死亡と規模は大きいが、新規性・異常性は低く国際的拡大リスクも限定的なため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムで毎年流行する風土病であり、本記事は個別の重症死亡例と地元当局の対応（殺虫剤散布・サーベイランス）を報じるもの。地域全体の症例数（約22,000例、12死亡）は規模として注視に値するが、国際的な異常事象とは言えない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Balloon Juice - Plagues & Pandemics Update - November 18, 2026
article.articleSummary: Early start to the 2026-27 influenza season with H1N1 dominance and a newly mutated strain. In the United States, as of Nov 12, 2026, COVID-19 infections are growing in 37 states, declining in 2, and unchanged in 9; meanwhile flu has caused 5 child and 2,000 adult deaths this season. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Ebola outbreak has reached 11,407 cases; UNICEF notes 35% of deaths are among children, warnings persist that this could become the worst outbreak as response capacity remains stretched, though first treatment trials offer cautious hope. Moderna’s mRNA-1283 COVID vaccine is linked to fewer medical visits and hospitalizations than Pfizer’s BNT162b2 in older adults; Moderna’s RSV vaccine shows 82% protection against hospitalization in adults 50 and up. Canadian studies estimate vaccine misinformation reduced vaccinations by 2.7–4.7 million, yielding more cases, hospitalizations, and deaths.

triage.headline_ja: Balloon Juice - 感染症・パンデミック アップデート 2026年11月18日
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラアウトブレイクが11,407症例に達し、対応能力逼迫により過去最悪となる懸念が示されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事は複数疾患（インフルエンザ、COVID-19、RSV、エボラ）の総合アップデートだが、対象国に該当するのはDRCのエボラアウトブレイクのみ。米国・カナダの情報は対象国外のため評価対象外。エボラの症例数（11,407）・小児死亡割合（35%）・対応能力逼迫・過去最悪の可能性という点で高リスクシグナルと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Divinópolis tem primeiro caso confirmado de Mpox em 2026 - Portal MPA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Divinópolis records its first confirmed Mpox case in 2026 - Portal MPA.
article.articleSummary: Divinópolis in Minas Gerais, Brazil, reports its first confirmed Mpox case in 2026: a 19-year-old male admitted at UPA Padre Roberto; he is stable and awaiting hospital transfer via state regulation. A second suspected case involves a 58-year-old woman; a lab sample has been collected, with results due by Friday, 20 November 2026. Preventive measures—including isolation of confirmed and suspected patients—are being applied per health protocols. In Minas Gerais this year there are 41 confirmed Mpox cases; Brazil totals 1,099 cases and 1 death in Rio de Janeiro. Mpox is caused by the MPXV virus and transmits mainly through close contact with skin lesions, bodily fluids, or mucous membranes, or via contaminated objects. Incubation is typically 3–21 days; symptoms include skin lesions, lymphadenopathy, fever, headache, muscle pain, chills, fatigue.

triage.headline_ja: ディヴィノーポリスで2026年初のMpox確定症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内で散発的なMpox症例の継続報告であり、単一地域の1例追加という内容。既知の流行であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは明確でないが、国内での感染継続状況として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: ブラジル国内では既にMpoxが流行しており（ミナスジェライス州41例、全国1099例、死亡1例）、今回は散発的な追加症例の報告。地域的・個別の新規性は低いが、継続的な国内感染拡大状況としてモニタリング対象。

article.articleHeadline: 专家：今冬明春多种呼吸道病原体交替叠加 流感是主要威胁
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experts: This winter and next spring, multiple respiratory pathogens will alternate and overlap, with influenza posing the main threat.
article.articleSummary: Influenza remains the main threat among respiratory pathogens this winter and next spring in China, with multiple pathogens likely to co-circulate. In Beijing, experts call for sustained influenza surveillance, multi-disease prevention, rapid response, and expanded vaccination policies. Vaccination is the most effective prevention; children aged 6 months and older without contraindications should be vaccinated, with priority for healthcare workers, children, the elderly, and those with chronic diseases. Early diagnosis and antiviral treatment within 48 hours reduces viral shedding and transmission. For high-risk children, watch for signs beyond fever (lethargy, poor feeding, rapid breathing); emphasize coordination among families, daycare, and hospitals to cut transmission. Hospitals should enforce infection control and timely antiviral therapy, reinforcing a shift from individual treatment to population health and prevention.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家：今冬来春は複数の呼吸器病原体が交互に重なり、インフルエンザが主要な脅威に
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザに関する一般的な予防・注意喚起情報であり、異常な事象や公衆衛生上の重大な影響を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの流行予測・予防啓発に関する専門家見解記事であり、通常の季節性サーベイランス情報の範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: First Case of Disseminated Mycobacterium sherrisii Reported in Indian HIV
article.articleSummary: First reported case of disseminated Mycobacterium sherrisii infection in India, in a 40-year-old man from Maharashtra with advanced HIV (CD4 65 cells/µL). After three months on antiretroviral therapy (ART) and empiric four-drug anti-tubercular therapy at Poona Hospital, he developed immune reconstitution inflammatory syndrome (IRIS) with fever, abdominal distension, and watery diarrhea. Ascitic fluid and stool cultures yielded atypical mycobacteria; PCR ruled out Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex, and MALDI-TOF confirmed Mycobacterium sherrisii. Drug susceptibility testing followed. Therapy was adjusted to a targeted regimen of clarithromycin, ethambutol, and rifabutin, with corticosteroids while continuing ART. The authors emphasize that disseminated M. sherrisii closely mimics tuberculosis, making rapid species-level identification and macrolide-based treatment crucial for outcomes in advanced HIV. This case represents India’s first reported disseminated M. sherrisii infection; rising non-tuberculous mycobacterial diagnoses are linked to molecular diagnostics.

triage.headline_ja: インド初の播種性Mycobacterium sherrisii感染症例、HIV患者で報告
triage.triage_reason: 単一のHIV患者における非結核性抗酸菌症の稀な症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や拡大リスク、社会的関心は認められない。
triage.notes: 本症例は単一患者の臨床報告であり、ヒト-ヒト感染性を持つ病原体ではなく、感染症危機管理上のシグナルとしての意義は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Minister Hands US$1.1M to Ebola Fight
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus–driven Ebola outbreak in DR Congo is ongoing as the country reports 11,376 confirmed cases and 5,568 related deaths per ECDC in its update up to 16 November 2026, the 17th outbreak beginning in 2026 in the Grande Orientale region. A national mobilization led by President Félix Tshisekedi and coordinated by Prime Minister Judith Suminwa Tuluka supports response efforts. On 17 November 2026, Mines Minister Louis Watum Kabamba handed US$1.1 million from the mining sector to the Ebola incident management system (SGI MVE 17) for response coordination; Dr Jean-Jacques Muyembe received the funds. An earlier US$1 million donation came from Chinese-capital mining firms via USMCC in September 2026. The accounts do not name donors or specify budget use. The gift is small relative to outbreak costs, and travelers should follow official health guidance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ鉱業相、エボラ対策に110万米ドルを拠出
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（確定症例11,376例、死亡5,568例）に関する大規模な継続的公衆衛生危機であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年に始まった第17次エボラ流行で、ブンディブギョウイルス株による大規模アウトブレイク。致死率約49%と非常に高い。国家的動員と国際支援（鉱業セクターや中国系企業からの寄付）が行われているが、資金は対応コストに比して小規模。継続的なモニタリングと既存のRRA更新が必要。
