article.articleHeadline: बड़ी खबर: बर्ड फ्लू के खिलाफ भारत का बड़ा स्वदेशी हथियार, पोल्ट्री फार्मों को बचाने के लिए देश की पहली वैक्सीन तैयार, इस दिन होगी लांच | Big News: Indiaâs major indigenous weapon against bird fluâ"the countryâs first vaccine to protect poultry farms is ready; launch set for this date.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Big News: India's major indigenous weapon against bird flu—the country's first vaccine to protect poultry farms is ready; launch set for this date.
article.articleSummary: India unveils its first indigenous avian influenza (H5N1, clade 2.3.2.1a) vaccine for poultry, a inactivated vaccine developed by scientists in Bhopal at ICAR-National Institute for High Security Animals Diseases. The vaccine will be officially dedicated on 20 November 2026 by Union Minister of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare Shivraj Singh Chouhan in Bhopal, aimed at protecting millions of poultry farmers nationwide, including those in Chhattisgarh. Bird flu is highly lethal in birds, with near 100% mortality, triggering culling and farm shutdowns and significant economic disruption. Since 2006 India has reported over 500 outbreaks of H5N1 and H5N8, risking up to 1.5% of GDP and potentially affecting more than 20% of poultry populations. Past losses reached billions of rupees; WHO data indicate 1,003 human infections and 479 deaths across 25 countries since 2003. The vaccine targets the predominant variant and seeks to curb animal-to-human transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 重大ニュース：インドが鳥インフルエンザに対抗する国産の大きな武器を発表、養鶏場を守る国内初のワクチンが完成、発売日も決定
triage.triage_reason: 新規ヒト感染症例の報告ではなく、家禽向け国産ワクチン開発・発売に関する行政・産業ニュースであるが、H5N1の継続的な流行状況とヒトへの感染リスクに言及しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本記事は新規のヒトまたは動物での感染拡大事例の報告ではなく、インド政府による家禽用H5N1ワクチンの開発・発売発表が主題。過去の累積感染データ（2006年以降500件超のアウトブレイク、世界で1,003人感染・479人死亡）への言及はあるが、新規事例ではないためPICKUPには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Konqoda Ebola epidemiyası rekord sürətlə yayılır və ölüm halları artır
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in Congo is spreading at a record pace, and death tolls are rising.
article.articleSummary: Deepening Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, driven by a rare Bundibugyo virus strain, is expanding rapidly. Since May 15, when declared, more than 11,000 people have been infected and about 5,500 have died. This is Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak and, in the six-month span since the declaration, represents the largest scale, surpassing the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic (over 28,600 infections and ~11,000 deaths in Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone). The 2018-2020 outbreak in the region recorded 3,481 infections and 2,299 deaths. Attacks on health workers, vehicles, and surveillance teams by distrustful communities hinder response. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus cites security as a major barrier. MSF notes vital resources and supplies have not reached hot spots beyond Ituri’s epicenter; about $2.9 billion pledged, less than half paid.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行が記録的な速さで拡大し、死者数が増加
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ東部で過去最大規模のエボラ流行（感染者1万1千人超、死者約5,500人）が急速に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）東部イトゥリ州を中心としたエボラ流行についてのもの。シエラレオネ、アンゴラ、リベリア、ギニアは過去の流行との比較として言及されているのみで、現在の発生地域ではないため除外。資金不足（約29億ドルの誓約のうち半分未満しか支払われていない）と治安悪化（医療従事者への攻撃）が対応を妨げており、WHOおよびMSFが国際的な懸念を表明している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Cases More Than Double In 3 Months In DR Congo
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Bundibugyo virus disease Ebola outbreak has more than doubled in three months, with over 11,000 cases and about 5,400 deaths across 67 health zones in eight provinces. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus reported that children account for more than a quarter of confirmed cases and a third of deaths, with seven in ten deaths among children under five. Cross-border risk is real: Kenya reports nine cases linked to an imported case (two deaths); Nigeria reports one imported case. Blanket travel restrictions hinder response and reporting. Progress includes halted rapid transmission in most early epicenters, and laboratories testing the virus have risen from two to more than two dozen. Two candidate Bundibugyo vaccines will join an ongoing trial in coming weeks. Two-thirds of deaths occur outside treatment centers, indicating late detection; about 400–500 new cases are reported weekly.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴでエボラ症例が3ヶ月で倍増
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ（ブンディブギョウ型）が3ヶ月で倍増し11,000症例・5,400死亡に達し、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境伝播も確認されている。IHR4基準すべてに該当する重大な公衆衛生イベント。
triage.notes: ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境症例が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。主たる発生国はDRCであり、週400-500例の新規報告が続く進行中の大規模アウトブレイク。

article.articleHeadline: Chhatarpur Reports 786 New TB Cases In 45 Days, Total Reaches 7,063 Amid Health Concerns In Bundelkhand
article.articleSummary: Chhatarpur (Madhya Pradesh) identified 7,063 TB patients between January 1 and November 17, 2026, including 786 in October and the first 17 days of November. October yielded 639 cases; the first 17 days of November added 147, within a 48-day window. Expanded screening across 549 gram panchayats in Bundelkhand, using handheld X-ray machines, is aimed at screening five to six lakh people annually in a district of about 21–22 lakh. Poverty, malnutrition, and dust exposure from stone-crushing work are key risk factors across age groups, from children to the elderly. Health officials say intensified testing and treatment are needed to meet the state's 2030 TB-free target. National context: India reported declines of 21% in new TB cases and 28% in TB deaths from 2015–2024 under NTEP and PM TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan, with free diagnostics, BPaLM regimens for eligible patients, and Nikshay Poshan Yojana.

triage.headline_ja: チャタルプルで45日間に786件の新規結核症例を報告、累計7,063件に達しバンデルカンド地域で健康懸念広がる
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の地域流行病であり、積極的スクリーニングの成果として症例数が増加しているもので、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 症例増加は積極的スクリーニング拡大（ハンドヘルドX線機器導入）による検出数増加が主因であり、貧困・栄養不良・粉塵曝露等の既知のリスク要因に基づく地域流行。国家レベルでは2015-2024年にTB新規症例・死亡とも減少傾向にあり、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: 2000 إصابة بجدرى القرود شهريا فى العالم.. وإرشادات جديدة للعلاج
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: 2,000 cases of monkeypox per month worldwide, and new treatment guidelines.
article.articleSummary: WHO reports monkeypox transmission worldwide, averaging about 2,000 confirmed cases per month (Jan 2022–Aug 2026). At a virtual emergency seminar on clinical care, Dr. Rosamond Lewis outlined updated WHO guidelines grounded in new evidence. Transmission occurs via close contact, household exposure, sexual contact, and mother-to-child spread; pregnancy carries risk of miscarriage, with up to 50% reported. HIV infection and other sexually transmitted infections heighten susceptibility and risk of severe disease. Africa has seen Madagascar’s large, prolonged outbreak; the DRC struggles with diagnostic capacity amid other health crises, with more than 600 suspected cases monthly. Outside Africa, Brazil reports transmission; Pakistan sees rising cases with infant fatalities in health facilities; Afghanistan reports initial cases; Taiwan notes community transmission. Global risk remains moderate, higher for those with multiple sexual partners and children in endemic areas. Updates cover antiviral use, supportive care, and practical implementation in health facilities, alongside vaccination and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：世界で月間約2000件のサル痘（エムポックス）感染、新たな治療指針を発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの診断能力不足や死亡例、ブラジルを含む複数国での継続的な感染拡大が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大）を複数満たすためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOによる世界的なエムポックス（サル痘）流行状況の概要報告であり、マダガスカル・パキスタン・アフガニスタン・台湾も言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。DRCとブラジルは本文中で具体的な感染状況が述べられており、対象国として確認済み。

article.articleHeadline: OMS mantiene emergencia internacional por brote de ébola en el Congo; van más de 11 mil casos confirmados y 5 mil 600 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO maintains international emergency over Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; more than 11,000 confirmed cases and 5,600 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) with more than 11,000 confirmed cases and about 5,600 deaths. The WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced the continued status after the Emergency Committee met in Geneva, noting the May 17 declaration requires quarterly review. He urged intensified global cooperation and resource mobilization to protect communities in affected areas, many of which are in conflict, and to safeguard healthcare workers, treatment centers, and response teams amid ongoing attacks. About two-thirds of deaths occur outside treatment centers, suggesting late detection and insufficient contact tracing. He also criticized travel restrictions targeting travelers from affected zones, saying they hinder response, undermine livelihoods, and discourage prompt outbreak notification. Current status underscores the need for stronger, well-coordinated public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する国際的緊急事態(PHEIC)を継続。確認症例1万1000人以上、死者5600人以上
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを継続すると発表した大規模エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクであり、IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当するため、フルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: 発生地域にGenève/Switzerlandが含まれるが、これはWHO緊急委員会開催地であり、エボラ発生国ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de dengue caem mais de 85% em SC e estado segue sem mortes pela doença em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue cases drop more than 85% in Santa Catarina, and the state remains without dengue-related deaths in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases decline 85.6% in Santa Catarina in 2026 with no dengue-related deaths confirmed through November 3, 2026. Dive/SC reports 3,496 probable dengue cases from January 4 to November 3, down from 24,266 in the same period in 2025. The Aedes aegypti mosquito remains widespread, detected in 258 of 295 municipalities, with nearly 60,000 breeding sites identified since January; 198 municipalities are infested (mosquito established and reproducing). During the period, 38,032 dengue notifications were received; 34,536 were discarded, 3,496 remained probable. Dengue activity occurred in 147 municipalities. Preventive measures emphasize eliminating standing water in tanks, gutters, plant pots, tires, bottles, and other containers. Symptoms include fever, headache, myalgias/arthralgias, retro-orbital pain, nausea, and a red rash; individuals with these signs should seek health care as ongoing vigilance is needed despite lower case numbers.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州でデング熱症例が85%以上減少、2026年も死亡者なし
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例・死亡者数が前年より大幅に減少しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常事態とは言えず、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列。症例数は大幅減少傾向であり、蚊の生息は継続しているが新規の深刻なリスクは見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberculose : une étude Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) prouve l'efficacité d'un traitement plus court pour les enfants
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis: a Doctors Without Borders (MSF) study proves the effectiveness of a shorter treatment for children.
article.articleSummary: In Uganda and the Philippines, MSF-led prospective study of 214 children with tuberculosis shows a four-month, non-severe, drug-susceptible regimen is feasible and effective in primary care. About 74% were eligible for the 4‑month course from presentation, and 95% completed therapy successfully. The shorter regimen uses the same drugs in child-friendly formulations, reducing travel, daily life disruption, costs, and duration of exposure to side effects. Despite WHO’s 2022 recommendation, uptake remains slow in high-burden settings due to identifying non-severe cases, reliance on clinical assessment and chest radiography, and limited diagnostic capacity plus staff turnover. The 2026 WHO Global TB Report notes about half of children under five with TB were not diagnosed in 2025. MSF suggests up to 89% of children in primary care could benefit, urging governments to invest in training, diagnostics, pediatric medicines, and family support to enable early diagnosis and effective treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 結核：国境なき医師団（MSF）の研究が子供向けのより短期間の治療法の有効性を証明
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は結核治療に関する研究成果の報告であり、新規感染拡大や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではないため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はMSFによる小児結核治療の臨床研究報告であり、アウトブレイクや新規感染拡大の報告ではない。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Divinópolis isola dois moradores sob suspeita de infecção por Mpox
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Divinópolis City Hall Isolates Two Residents Under Suspicion of Mpox Infection.
article.articleSummary: Two Divinópolis residents are isolated with suspected mpox (monkeypox) while awaiting laboratory confirmation. A 19-year-old man is under infectious disease specialist care at the city’s Emergency Care Unit, and a 58-year-old woman remains hospitalized at a local hospital. Samples collected on November 16–17 were sent to Fundação Ezequiel Dias (Funed) in Belo Horizonte; definitive results depend on state laboratory analysis. Divinópolis has no confirmed monkeypox cases to date. In Minas Gerais state, health authorities report 42 positive mpox diagnoses since 2026 began, with 172 more under laboratory investigation. Mpox transmission occurs via direct contact with skin lesions, bodily fluids, respiratory secretions, or contaminated objects. Symptoms include fever, headache, body pains, fatigue, swollen lymph nodes, and rash. Officials urge suspected cases to avoid close contact and seek medical evaluation.

triage.headline_ja: ディヴィノーポリス市役所、Mpox感染疑いの住民2名を隔離
triage.triage_reason: ミナスジェライス州で既に42例の確定例と172例の疑い例があり継続的な発生状況だが、本記事の2例は検査確定前であり情報不足のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ブラジル・ミナスジェライス州では2026年に入り42例の確定例が既に報告されており、既知の継続的流行の一部とみられる。本件2例は検査結果待ちで未確定。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en RDC supera las barreras de los 11.500 casos y...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC surpasses the 11,500-case mark and...
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 11,500 cases and 5,600 deaths, with INSP reporting 11,504 infections and 5,630 fatalities (72 new cases, 39 deaths in the last day). Case fatality rate 48.9% since onset; 3,142 recovered; 1,743 currently hospitalized or in isolation; contact tracing at 81.6%. Epicenter in Ituri province; Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain; no vaccine or approved treatment. MSF calls to protect civilians and health facilities in South Kivu’s Bunyakiri as fighting between the Congolese army and FRN/M23 escalates, with drone attacks near Bulambika and the Bunyakiri referral hospital prompting patient transfers to Maibano. UN relief chief Panseri urges safeguarding medical staff and access to care, in line with International Humanitarian Law. This is the deadliest DRC outbreak, with projections comparing to West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) of 28,616 cases and 11,325 deaths per WHO data.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、感染者数11,500人の壁を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.9%の大規模エボラ流行がIturiを震源に拡大を続け、ワクチン・治療法未承認かつ武力紛争により医療アクセスが脅かされており、国際的対応が必要な深刻事態である。
triage.notes: 発生地域にシエラレオネ、アンゴラ、リベリア、ギニアが含まれるが、これらは2014-2016年西アフリカ流行との比較対象として言及されているのみで、現行の発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（Ituri、South Kivu）に限定される。武力紛争（FRN/M23）による医療アクセス悪化が流行対応をさらに複雑化させている点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Agevisa Intensifica Monitoramento de Vírus Respiratórios e Reforça Importância da Vacinação em Rondônia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: AGEVISA Intensifies Monitoring of Respiratory Viruses and Emphasizes the Importance of Vaccination in Rondônia.
article.articleSummary: Amazonian winter prompts intensified surveillance of respiratory viruses in Rondônia. Agevisa/RO reports October 2026 SRAG (Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome) hospitalizations rose 33% to 61, with Porto Velho accounting for 36 cases (59% of the state total). The rise is not limited to COVID-19; rhinovirus dominated among confirmed cases (15 of 20). No influenza or RSV detected. COVID-19 admissions totaled two, both in Porto Velho, with no deaths. Lacen/RO found about 9% SARS-CoV-2 positivity; none of 139 samples tested positive for influenza. Children under 5 years accounted for 69% of SRAG hospitalizations in October. Vaccination is emphasized: vaccines are free at UBS across 52 municipalities. In Porto Velho, services run weekday 8:00–18:00, including Espaço Saúde at Porto Velho Shopping. Preventive measures include hand hygiene, adequate ventilation, and mask use for symptomatic individuals, especially among at-risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: AGEVISAがロンドニア州で呼吸器ウイルスの監視を強化し、ワクチン接種の重要性を強調
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の呼吸器感染症（SRAG）の通常の監視報告であり、死亡例もなく、ワクチン接種呼びかけを含む定例的な公衆衛生広報であるため、シグナルとして取り上げる必要性は低い。
triage.notes: ブラジル・ロンドニア州における季節性呼吸器疾患（主にライノウイルス）のサーベイランス強化と定期的なワクチン接種啓発の記事。死亡例なし、重症化も限定的。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'épidémie d'Ebola se propage à une vitesse record
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The Ebola outbreak is spreading at a record pace.
article.articleSummary: Six months into the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus, the situation remains dire with over 11,000 cases and 5,400 deaths, children disproportionately affected. Efforts by health authorities and international partners have reduced spread in several regions, strengthened diagnostic and treatment capacities, and trained thousands of health workers. However, 400–500 new cases occur weekly. Insecurity, armed conflict, and attacks on health facilities hinder access to affected populations. The WHO and the UN are calling for increased funding, better access to isolated communities, and stronger protection for healthcare workers. Despite progress, the outbreak is hard to control; reinforcing health systems, ensuring safe field operations, and enhancing community awareness are essential to halt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラ出血熱の流行が記録的な速さで拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱(ブンディブギョウイルス)の大規模流行が継続し、累計11,000例・死者5,400人、週400-500例の新規発生があり、国際支援が要請されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 武力紛争・治安悪化により医療施設への攻撃や隔離地域へのアクセス困難が流行制御を妨げており、WHO・国連が資金・保護強化を要請している。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: பறவைக் காய்ச்சலை ஒழிக்க இந்தியாவின் முதல் H5N1 தடுப்பூசி அறிமுகம்!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India's first H5N1 vaccine launched to eradicate bird flu!
article.articleSummary: On November 20, India will launch its first domestically produced H5N1 vaccine against Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza, developed by the National High Security Animal Disease Control Institute in Bhopal. The inactivated vaccine targets the H5N1 Clade 2.3.2.1a strain responsible for widespread poultry outbreaks in India. A single dose provides protection for about six months and is suitable for both laying and breeding chickens. Vaccinated birds and those infected naturally can be differentiated through serology testing, enabling surveillance and a DIVA-enabled vaccination strategy. The move comes as Tamil Nadu, Kerala, and Andhra Pradesh report intensified outbreaks. In 2006, bird flu outbreaks cost India 2,200–3,000 crore rupees; officials say domestic vaccination will mitigate future losses and safeguard poultry livelihoods and the egg/meat supply chain. Notably, Clade 2.3.2.1a has been detected in mammals and in three humans recently, underscoring the public health benefit of poultry vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ撲滅に向け、インド初のH5N1ワクチンが導入！
triage.triage_reason: H5N1クレード2.3.2.1aが家禽の大規模流行に加え、哺乳類及びヒト3例での検出が報告されており、公衆衛生上の重大性と異常性からIHR基準2項目以上に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はインド国内の家禽向けH5N1ワクチン導入が主題だが、クレード2.3.2.1aが哺乳類及びヒト3例から検出されたとの記述があり、人獣共通感染症としてのリスクを含むためフルRRAでの詳細確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Surto: Seis cidades de MS registram 123 casos de sarna humana em escolas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreak: Six cities in Mato Grosso do Sul report 123 cases of human scabies in schools.
article.articleSummary: Six cities in Mato Grosso do Sul report 123 cases of human scabies in 2026, led by Dourados (74) and Itaporã (34), with Rio Brilhante (6), Amambai (4), Nova Andradina (4), and Douradina (1) also affected. Ongoing outbreaks are concentrated in Dourados and Itaporã; Dourados’ Recanto Raízes daycare center records 49 cases and remains closed indefinitely, while Ceim Beatriz de Barros Bumlai has 15 cases and Ceim Prof. Bertilo Binsfeld has 10. In Itaporã, two creches and two CMEs report cases (Milton Menani with 27; Maria Rodrigues with 7). In Rio Brilhante, six cases are linked to Escola Estadual Lígia Terezinha Martins and one in a creche. Symptoms include intense nocturnal itching, numerous red lesions with crusts, and white tunnel marks on the skin. Transmission is mainly by prolonged direct skin contact and contaminated textiles; prevention emphasizes washing fabrics in hot water (>55°C) and ironing, plus medical treatment to interrupt transmission. The SES-MS notes local municipalities lead investigations; no statewide 2026 notifications were provided.

triage.headline_ja: アウトブレイク：マットグロッソ・ド・スル州6都市の学校で疥癬123例を報告
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は軽症で致死性がなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクは低い。地域内の学校・保育施設に限局した事例で、WHO通知やIHR基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 疥癬（Scabies）はヒゼンダニによる皮膚疾患で、重症度は低く死亡例の報告もない。地域の学校・保育施設内での集団発生であり、地元保健当局（SES-MS）が対応中。国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えないためDISMISS。

article.articleHeadline: DSÖ, KDC'deki Ebola salgınının uluslararası acil durum olmaya devam ettiğini bildirdi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO reports that the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo remains an international public health emergency.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains an International Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) after the Emergency Committee meeting. He calls for expanded resource mobilization and protection of health workers and facilities amid ongoing conflict, with updated guidance for the DRC and other countries to be released in the coming days. The Ituri province outbreak began in a village near the Ebola River; the country declared the outbreak on May 15 after 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths were reported in eastern DRC. The May outbreak involves the Bundibugyo Ebola variant, for which there is no approved treatment or vaccine. The article stresses a global call for intensified response to protect affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態であり続けていると発表
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を継続宣言しており、IHR基準の複数該当が明確であるため。
triage.notes: ワクチン・治療法未承認のブンディブギョ型であり、紛争地域での対応継続中。PHEIC継続宣言済みのためフルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de esporotricose: saiba sintomas, transmissão e como prevenir a doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sporotrichosis Outbreak: Learn the Symptoms, Transmission, and How to Prevent the Disease.
article.articleSummary: Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, reports a 2026 surge in sporotrichosis with 1,465 laboratory-confirmed human cases among 2,752 total notifications (1,051 under investigation) as of 2026-11-18. Domestic cats are the main zoonotic transmitters, with 302 infected animals reported in Guaíba; overall high animal involvement. Transmission occurs when Sporothrix fungi in soil, vegetation, or contaminated materials contact skin, or via scratches, bites, or lesion exposure from infected cats. Symptoms begin with skin lesions that may resemble insect bites, evolving into nodules and lymphocutaneous tracks; the infection can involve bones, joints, mucosa, or disseminate, and pulmonary forms cause cough, shortness of breath, chest pain, and fever, sometimes mimicking tuberculosis. Incubation ranges from about a week to six months. Treatments include itraconazole, potassium iodide, and terbinafine; amphotericin B for severe cases. Brazil’s SUS provides itraconazole and liposomal amphotericin B. Infected cats require veterinary supervision, often with palatable itraconazole formulations and indoor confinement to prevent spread; emphasize protective gloves and proper disposal of sick or dead animals to reduce environmental contamination.

triage.headline_ja: スポロトリコーシスの流行：症状、感染経路、予防法を知る
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・リオグランデドスル州で2026年にスポロトリコーシスの症例が急増（確認症例1,465例）し、動物由来感染が継続している点で異常性と公衆衛生上の懸念があるため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 本イベントは人獣共通感染症（主に猫由来）であり、ヒト-ヒト感染の報告はない。国際的拡大リスクは低いが、地域内での症例急増と重症化（播種性感染・肺病変）がみられるため経過観察とフル評価が望ましい。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H9N2

article.articleHeadline: One Health: Severe H9N2 virus infection in a hospitalized patient without recognized poultry exposure
article.articleSummary: One new human infection with avian influenza A(H9N2) was reported from China (Hunan Province) to WHO during 6–12 November 2026. The patient is a pediatric resident with symptom onset 20 October 2026; exposure to household poultry was reported, and an environmental sample tested positive for influenza A(H9). All close contacts tested negative; the patient has recovered. Since 2015, 190 H9N2 infections have been reported in the Western Pacific Region, including 187 in China, two in Cambodia, and one in Viet Nam, with two deaths (both with underlying conditions). Most infections relate to poultry exposure and are mild; sustained human-to-human transmission is not evident, and community spread risk remains low. Genomic analyses identified A/Guangzhou/23127/2025 (H9N2), G57 genotype, HA lineage B, clade B4.7, closely related to local environmental strains. The findings stress severe disease without known exposure and the need for enhanced genomic surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: One Health：認識された家禽曝露のない入院患者における重症H9N2ウイルス感染
triage.triage_reason: 中国湖南省での新規H9N2感染例（小児、回復済み）で、持続的な人-人感染の証拠はないが、見出しでは既知の曝露なしとされる一方サマリーでは家禽曝露ありと記載され情報に一部矛盾があり、ゲノムサーベイランス強化の必要性が指摘されているため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 見出しは『既知の曝露なしの重症感染』とするが、サマリー本文では『家禽曝露が報告された』と矛盾がある。患者は回復済みで、全ての濃厚接触者は陰性。WPRO地域での過去のH9N2感染は主に軽症で、持続的ヒト-ヒト感染の証拠は確認されていない。ゲノム解析では既知の環境株と近縁。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: คกก.โรคติดต่อฯ เคาะ 'โปลิโอ' เป็นโรคติดต่ออันตราย คุมเข้ม 'โรคพิษสุนัขบ้า'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Communicable Diseases Committee designates 'Polio' as a dangerous communicable disease; tightens controls on 'Rabies'.
article.articleSummary: On 18 November 2026, Thailand designates polio as a dangerous communicable disease under the 2018 Act due to import risk of vaccine-derived poliovirus from Laos and Myanmar, requiring laboratory confirmation for diagnosis. Rabies deaths reached 13 in 2026; authorities mandate integrated bite surveillance and rapid first-dose vaccination, with intensified animal vaccination and stray-animal control by the Department of Livestock, Local Administration, and allied agencies; public communication by the National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Department and Public Relations. The committee also approves two additional international border control points to facilitate trade, investment, transport, and tourism, with updates to the border-control working group. Influenza A/H1N1 accounted for 613,292 cases and 134 deaths in 2026, highest in ages 5–9 and 60+ with chronic disease. Other diseases: 32,007 cases and 7 deaths; 512 cases and 3 deaths (predominantly male with HIV co-infection); dengue in the south, 34,875 cases and 47 deaths; vector control urged and prompt hospital testing for suspected dengue.

triage.headline_ja: 伝染病対策委員会、『ポリオ』を危険な伝染病に指定、『狂犬病』の管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: ラオス・ミャンマーからのワクチン由来ポリオウイルス（VDPV）輸入リスクを理由にタイが対応策を強化しており、国際的拡大リスクと既存の疾病死亡（インフルエンザA・狂犬病・デング熱）による深刻な公衆衛生影響が確認されるため、IHR基準を2つ以上満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はタイ政府によるポリオ（VDPV輸入リスク）の危険感染症指定と狂犬病・インフルエンザA・デング熱に関する既存の国内統計を含む。ラオスも輸入元として言及されるが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。実際のポリオ症例確認は記載なく、リスクベースの予防的措置である点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Lampung Selatan perkuat deteksi dini TBC lewat skrining
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Lampung Strengthens Early Detection of TB Through Screening
article.articleSummary: South Lampung District Health Office in Lampung Selatan, Indonesia, is strengthening early detection of tuberculosis (TB) through active case finding and community health screening, integrated with the Free Health Check Program (CKG) in 2026. The effort earned provincial recognition for posting the highest TB positivity rate in integrated TB tracing under the CKG program. Dinkes chief Devi Arminanto said the award motivates ongoing efforts to intensify case finding, contact tracing, and patient support during treatment, emphasizing that success includes ensuring patients receive follow-up examinations and standard-care treatment to interrupt transmission. The program widens access to screening and raises awareness of TB symptoms, such as prolonged cough, urging people to seek care promptly. The district aims to advance TB elimination through collaboration among local government, health workers, and communities.

triage.headline_ja: 南ランプン、スクリーニングを通じて結核の早期発見を強化
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核対策プログラムの進捗報告であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容はない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による結核早期発見プログラムの表彰・活動報告記事であり、突発的な感染拡大事例ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Jharkhand health minister directs hospitals to be on alert for ebola
article.articleSummary: Ranchi, Jharkhand, on 18 November 2026 directed Rajendra Institute of Medical Sciences (RIMS), state medical colleges, and district hospitals to be on alert for Ebola, ensuring identification, testing, isolation, and treatment of suspected cases. Surveillance and screening will be strengthened at airports, railway stations, bus stands, and crowded places. Some residents have migrated to the Democratic Republic of Congo, where Ebola outbreaks are reported; no returnee information has been received. A 10-bed isolation ward is prepared at RIMS; PPE stocks and essential medical supplies will be maintained; healthcare workers will be trained in infection prevention, control, and safe patient management. Samples from suspected patients must be collected and transported to designated reference laboratories. Authorities emphasize hand hygiene, avoiding contact with bodily fluids, and strict isolation protocols. No Ebola case has been confirmed in Jharkhand; residents are urged not to panic and seek medical care if symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: ジャールカンド州保健大臣、病院にエボラ出血熱への警戒を指示
triage.triage_reason: インド・ジャールカンド州では確定症例はなく、DRCでの流行に備えた予防的な警戒指示にとどまるため、現時点ではフルリスク評価には至らないが、今後の動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・ジャールカンド州がDRCでのエボラ流行を受けて予防的警戒を強化した内容であり、インド国内での確定症例は報告されていない。DRCの流行自体は既知の継続的事象であり、本記事の主眼はインド側の対応措置である。

article.articleHeadline: Se mantiene la emergencia internacional por el brote de ébola en la República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The international emergency remains due to the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains a declared international public health emergency by the World Health Organization (WHO). As of 18 November 2026, the outbreak has surpassed 11,000 laboratory-confirmed cases and about 5,600 deaths. The WHO Emergency Committee, meeting quarterly since the emergency was declared on May 17, called for intensified global cooperation and resources to protect communities, health facilities, and responders, noting many affected areas lie in conflict zones and that health workers have faced attacks. Two-thirds of deaths occur outside treatment centers, indicating late detection and inadequate contact tracing. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged safeguarding frontline staff and response teams. Some countries have imposed travel restrictions on passengers from affected areas, which WHO warns can hinder outbreak response and livelihoods and deter rapid notification.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクによる国際的緊急事態が継続
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを継続宣言しており、11,000例超・死亡5,600人規模の重大な公衆衛生事象。国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施がありIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を継続宣言中。紛争地域での対応困難、医療従事者への攻撃、渡航制限による対応阻害などIHR・WPRO両基準で高リスク。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil mantém certificado de país livre do sarampo apesar do avanço da doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil maintains measles-free country status despite the spread of the disease.
article.articleSummary: Brazil maintained measles-free status in 2026 despite rising regional transmission in the Americas. The Pan American Health Organization (OPAS) kept Brazil’s elimination recognition, citing surveillance and vaccination efforts to prevent endemic circulation. In 2026 Brazil reports 70 confirmed measles cases, a 99.7% drop from the 2019 peak; most import-related cases are in São Paulo (35) and across Amazonas (Tabatinga 9, Benjamin Constant 7, Atalaia do Norte 6, São Paulo de Olivença 4) and Acre (Rio Branco 2). Across the Americas, 58,200 cases and 82 deaths have been recorded as of November 13, 2026, with Bolivia, Mexico and the United States also losing measles-free status that year. Brazil has intensified vigilance and vaccination: Dia S on Nov 4 and Dia D on Nov 7 near the Brazil–Colombia–Peru triple border; more than 16 million vaccine doses were distributed to states and 500,000 to Peru. The measles vaccine (triple viral) is free at UBS for ages 12 months to 59 years.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、麻疹の拡大にもかかわらず麻疹排除国の認証を維持
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内では麻疹排除認証を維持し症例数も限定的（70例、2019年比99.7%減）だが、米州地域全体では58,200例・82人の死亡が報告され、ボリビア・メキシコ・米国が排除国認証を失うなど地域的な感染拡大が継続しているため、越境輸入例の動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルが麻疹排除国認証を維持していることを主題としており、国内の症例は輸入関連で低水準。ただし米州地域全体での感染拡大（58,200例、82死亡）と国境地域（ブラジル・コロンビア・ペルー三国国境）でのワクチン接種強化の記述があり、地域的な流行しやすさの観点から継続監視が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Россельхознадзор назвал причину вспышек болезней животных в Татарстане
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rosselkhoznadzor named the cause of outbreaks of animal diseases in Tatarstan.
article.articleSummary: Rosselkhoznadzor links outbreaks in Tatarstan to worsening global epizootics and unauthorized livestock imports. Foot-and-mouth disease has been detected in Greece, Egypt, Libya, Vietnam, China, Mongolia, and Turkey; African swine fever in Bulgaria, Hungary, Germany, Greece, Spain, Latvia, Lithuania, and Poland; highly pathogenic avian influenza has been reported across nearly all European countries; brucellosis remains under constant monitoring. Bordering Russia, Mongolia, China, and Kazakhstan are of particular concern. To prevent imports, the agency conducted 250 field inspections, 78 planned checks, and 26 investigative visits this year. Quarantine violations (Art. 10.6 of the Russian Code) incur fines: officials 15–30k rubles; citizens 3–5k; legal entities 50–150k. Transport of livestock without veterinary documents carries fines: citizens 3–5k; officials 30–40k; legal entities 300–500k. Monitoring includes hunting grounds and buffer zones around large poultry and pig farms; unauthorized cattle import is cited as a main outbreak driver.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア農業監督庁、タタルスタン共和国における家畜疾病発生の原因を発表
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はロシア（タタルスタン）における家畜検疫体制・摘発状況の報告であり、ベトナム・中国への言及は世界的な口蹄疫発生状況の背景説明に留まり、新規性・異常性のある具体的イベントとは言えない。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア国内（タタルスタン）の家畜検疫・規制当局の活動報告が主眼。ベトナム・中国はFMD発生国として名前が挙がるのみで、具体的な発生状況・規模・時期等の詳細情報は記載されておらず、独立したシグナルとしての重要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en RDC supera las barreras de los 11.500 casos y los 5.600 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC surpasses 11,500 cases and 5,600 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province, northeast; South Kivu in Bunyakiri) has reached 11,504 infections and 5,630 deaths since mid-May, with a 48.9% case-fatality rate. Recovered total 3,142; 1,743 currently hospitalized or in isolation; last day adds 72 cases and 39 deaths; contact tracing at 81.6%. The circulating Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain has no vaccine or approved treatment. MSF warns on protection of civilians and health facilities in Bunyakiri amid intensified fighting since November 6 between Congolese forces and FRN (led by Joseph Kabila, including M23, backed by Rwanda), including drone attacks near Bulambika and the Bunyakiri hospital, prompting patient and staff displacement and service shifts to Maibano. UN and MSF call for adherence to international humanitarian law and safe access to care. The outbreak is the deadliest in DR Congo’s history, with projections to surpass West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic (28,616 cases, 11,325 deaths) per WHO.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、感染者11,500人、死者5,600人の壁を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.9%の大規模エボラアウトブレイクが拡大を続け、ワクチン・治療法がない上に武力紛争による医療アクセス悪化が重なっており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ワクチン・承認治療法のないブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス株が流行中。武力紛争により医療施設・人員への攻撃が発生し、対応能力がさらに低下している点が重大なリスク要因。ルワンダ・アンゴラは発生地域として記載されているが、記事本文では感染確認国としての言及がないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : un centre de traitement d'Ebola opérationnel à Mambasa pour sauver des vies - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: Ebola Treatment Center Up and Running in Mambasa to Save Lives - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Treatment Center (CTE) activities officially launched in the Mambasa health zone, Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. On 18 November 2026, Colonel Maxime Tshitshimbi, the territory’s deputy military administrator, announced the facility is now operational to improve patient care, thanking President Félix Tshisekedi, the health minister, and partners for delivering the project. He urged residents not to hide symptomatic individuals and to seek prompt care at the CTE, noting that medicines and care are free. He reiterated that the Ebola outbreak continues to spread and emphasized basic prevention, including regular handwashing, to slow transmission. A call for strong collaboration among communities, health authorities, and partners to bolster the response was issued. The report does not provide case counts or fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州:マンバサに命を救うためのエボラ治療センターが稼働開始 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州マンバサで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する報道であり、当局自身が『感染拡大が継続している』と明言しているため、重篤な公衆衛生上の影響と流行継続のリスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 症例数・死亡者数など具体的な疫学データは記事に記載されていないが、政府高官が『エボラの流行は拡大を続けている』と明言しており、既知の進行中アウトブレイクの一環と考えられる。続報での症例数・感染経路の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Sintomas de covid: veja o que fazer e quando procurar atendimento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 symptoms: what to do and when to seek medical attention.
article.articleSummary: Suspected COVID-19 should be tested; rapid tests are available at pharmacies and urgent care units (UPAs) in Brazil. Treatment depends on age and severity: non-elderly individuals with mild symptoms and no comorbidities may hydrate and use usual remedies for congestion, fever, and body aches; older adults 65 years or older or immunocompromised patients may receive Paxlovid after a positive test, with antiviral distributed by the government. Monitor for warning signs—rapid breathing, shortness of breath, persistent fever, or tachycardia—and seek medical care if they appear. Isolation for five days starts from the first day of symptoms; after that, if in contact with vulnerable people, wear a mask until day 10. Vaccination should wait until symptoms improve. Current vaccination indications include elderly, people with comorbidities, pregnant individuals, and children under five.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19の症状：対処法と受診すべきタイミング
triage.triage_reason: 一般向けの健康啓発記事であり、新規の異常事態や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルにおけるCOVID-19の一般的な症状・対処法・ワクチン接種指針を解説する健康情報記事であり、特定の集団発生や異常事態の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue: combinação de chuva e calor pode elevar número de casos nos próximos meses; Ceará soma mais de 16 mil registros
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue: combination of rain and heat could raise the number of cases in the coming months; Ceará has reported more than 16,000 cases.
article.articleSummary: Dengue risk in Brazil increases as the November 2026–January 2027 period is forecast to favor Aedes aegypti reproduction. Average temperatures are expected to run 1–2°C above seasonal norms, with rainfall typical of late spring into early summer and El Niño effects amplifying the outbreak risk, especially in the Southeast. In Ceará, 16,824 dengue cases were recorded in 2026 according to IntegraSUS (the health department’s data platform). Preventive measures stress eliminating containers and other sites with standing water to reduce mosquito breeding. Dengue vaccination is available in the public network for individuals aged 10–59 years based on Ministry of Health criteria; it is not recommended for older adults, young children, pregnant women, or immunocompromised individuals due to limited safety/efficacy data. For personal protection, regular use of repellents is advised.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：雨と気温上昇の組み合わせが今後数ヶ月の症例数増加を招く可能性；セアラ州では16,000件以上を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで例年見られる季節性デング熱流行の予測記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクなど特筆すべき基準への該当がない。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルで毎年季節性に流行する風土病であり、本記事は気候予測に基づく注意喚起記事。ワクチン接種や予防策の案内が中心で、重症度や異常事態を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Farmers demand relief as lumpy skin disease ravages native Pulikulam calves
article.articleSummary: Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD) is ravaging Pulikulam cattle in Tamil Nadu's Madurai district, with farmers claiming at least 1,000 Pulikulam calves have died since August 2026. Officials say no official cow deaths linked to LSD and note a lack of breed-specific mortality data. The Tamil Nadu Federation of Pastoral Peoples Sangams (TFPPS) warns of a widening outbreak across the district, estimating a minimum economic loss of ₹1 crore (≈ ₹10,000 per calf). They demand ₹10,000 compensation per calf and early-August vaccination campaigns, plus strengthening of the 1962 Mobile Veterinary Service to reach grazing herds. They encourage integrating traditional herbal veterinary practices, including Punniyamoorthy’s betel-leaves-salt-pepper formulation, pending scientific evaluation. Government vaccination drives continue, but some farmers fear reduced milk production from vaccination; authorities urge uptake and direct outreach to pastoral communities.

triage.headline_ja: 農家、ランピースキン病によりプリクラム種子牛が被害を受け救済を要求
triage.triage_reason: 動物感染症（牛のランピースキン病）であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生リスクは認められず、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: ランピースキン病は動物（牛）の感染症であり、ヒトに感染しないためヒト公衆衛生上のシグナルとしては対象外。地域農業・経済への影響と地元の社会的関心はあるが、感染症危機管理の観点からは見送り。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox tem dois casos suspeitos em Divinópolis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox has two suspected cases in Divinópolis.
article.articleSummary: Two suspected mpox cases are under investigation in Divinópolis, in the Central-West region of Minas Gerais, Brazil. A 19-year-old man is isolating at the Divinópolis Urgent Care Unit (UPA) with samples collected on 17 November and sent to Fundação Ezequiel Dias (Funed) in Belo Horizonte for testing. A 58-year-old woman is hospitalized in Divinópolis, with samples sent to Funed on 16 November and results expected by 20 November. Divinópolis has no confirmed mpox cases at this time. State health authorities report 42 confirmed mpox cases in Minas Gerais in 2026, with 172 more under investigation statewide. Mpox spreads mainly via direct contact with skin lesions, bodily fluids, respiratory secretions, and contaminated objects; common symptoms include skin lesions, fever, headache, muscle and back pain, swollen lymph nodes, and fatigue. Officials urge medical evaluation for suspected symptoms and avoiding close contact until assessed.

triage.headline_ja: ディヴィノポリスでMpoxの疑い症例2件
triage.triage_reason: 疑い症例であり確定診断は未了だが、州内で既に42件の確定例と172件の調査中例があり、地域的な拡大傾向が見られるため続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: Mpoxはブラジル国内で既に地域的流行状態（Minas Gerais州で42件確定、172件調査中）にあり、新規疑い例はその延長線上の事象。国際的な異常性は低いが、州内の感染拡大状況の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: India's Malaria Burden: ICMR Flags Gaps In Case Reporting, Warns Of Hidden Plasmodium Species
article.articleSummary: India’s malaria elimination efforts are challenged by gaps in private-sector case reporting, discrepancies between estimated and officially recorded burden, and possible circulation of neglected Plasmodium species, ICMM-NIMR findings indicate. 2015–2025 has seen an 80% reduction in malaria cases and deaths, with reported figures: 2015: 1,169,261 cases and 384 deaths; 2023: 227,564 cases and 83 deaths; 2024: 255,550 cases and 86 deaths; 2025: 181,090 cases and 47 deaths. In 2025, 33 high-burden districts across nine states/UTs accounted for 64% of cases and 54% of deaths. Assam, Mizoram, and Tripura are targeted for focused interventions; Odisha, Chhattisgarh, and Jharkhand have historically substantial burdens. Private-sector reporting is nearly nonexistent, and microscopy-based malaria positivity 3–55 times higher than reported figures in some settings underscores surveillance gaps. ICMR-NIMR’s 2015–16 active surveillance estimated ~4 million cases and ~29,341 deaths (roughly four times national reports; ~3× lower than WHO estimates). Hidden parasites include P. malariae, P. ovale, and P. knowlesi, with limited information.

triage.headline_ja: インドのマラリア負担：ICMRが症例報告のギャップを指摘し、隠れたプラスモジウム種に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: インドのマラリア症例は長期的に減少傾向にあり急性の公衆衛生危機ではないが、報告体制のギャップや未把握の希少種流行の可能性が指摘されており、サーベイランス上の懸念として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 本記事はICMR-NIMRの研究報告に基づくもので、急性のアウトブレイクではなく長期的なマラリア対策・サーベイランス体制の課題を扱っている。報告ギャップ（私的医療機関での報告不足、顕微鏡検査陽性率が公式報告の3〜55倍）やP. malariae、P. ovale、P. knowlesiなどの希少種の潜在的流行が指摘されている点は注視に値する。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Beni : l'unité, la transparence et l'équité prônées pour renforcer la riposte - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Beni: unity, transparency and equity promoted to strengthen the outbreak response - ACP.
article.articleSummary: As of 18 November 2026, in Bungulu commune, Beni, North Kivu, Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak response is urged to be strengthened through unity, transparency, and equity. An emergency meeting called by the Bungulu police mayor, with administration and youth leaders, evaluated the epidemiological situation and energised the response. Participants lamented poor communication between local authorities and field teams, noting that crucial updates such as new case signaling and the Mambango transit center placement are often relayed via social media or flyers. They urged laboratory staff to report positives only for confirmed cases to maintain public trust. Disparities in barrier measures and roadblock practices were criticised. Calls were made for inclusive, community-based sensitisation using youth relay networks and for local authorities to join response operations. Citizens were asked to observe hygiene rules, overcome disease denial, and present promptly to approved health facilities at first symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: ベニにおけるエボラ出血熱:対応強化のため団結・透明性・公平性が提唱される - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR Annex2の即時通報対象疾患であり、コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州で継続的な感染対応が行われていることから、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻性が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事は新規症例数や死亡者数などの定量的データを含まず、既存のエボラ対応体制の運営・コミュニケーション課題に焦点を当てている。北キブ州ベニ地域での継続的アウトブレイクを示唆するため、既存の対応枠組みの一部として扱うべきだが、エボラの性質上PICKUP判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Beni : le renforcement de la sensibilisation communautaire contre Ebola au centre d'un atelier - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni: Strengthening community awareness against Ebola at the center of a workshop - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 18 November 2026, in Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, an Ebola-awareness workshop was launched for community leaders from the Mabakanga and Kanzuli-nzuli health areas. Organized by the NGO Femmes Citoyennes Engagées (asbl), the session gathered teachers, community leaders, religious leaders, and community relay agents. The workshop emphasized community engagement, risk communication, and non-violent communication to enable participants to convey reliable, accurate messages about Ebola and to sustain preventive measures. Persistent hesitancy about the reality of Ebola was noted by organizer David Kabasha. Participants will relay what they learned to peers and broaden awareness across schools, places of worship, and markets, while reinforcing adherence to barrier measures. The initiative supports mobilization against the 17th Ebola outbreak in Nord-Kivu Province.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ：エボラ対策のためのコミュニティ啓発強化を中心としたワークショップ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 記事は既知の第17次エボラ流行（北キブ州）に関するコミュニティ啓発ワークショップの実施報告であり、新規症例数や流行拡大等の疫学的新情報は含まれていないため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 本記事は既存の第17次エボラ流行（北キブ州ベニ）に関する地域啓発活動の報告であり、新規感染データは含まれない。コミュニティの疑念（hesitancy）が言及されており社会的関心はあるが、感染状況の更新情報が不足しているためWATCH評価とした。

article.articleHeadline: Beni : sensibilisation des vendeuses de sauterelles au respect des mesures barrières contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni: Raising awareness among grasshopper sellers to comply with Ebola prevention measures - ACP.
article.articleSummary: On 18 November 2026 in Beni, North Kivu, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, grasshopper vendors were targeted in an Ebola virus disease (EVD) prevention drive. Local volunteers, led by Ménée and in collaboration with One Girl, One Leader (OGOL), the Provincial Youth Council, and Mazungumzo, reinforced barrier measures and regular use of hand sanitizer to curb Ebola transmission amid the region’s ongoing EVD context (the area’s 17th Ebola outbreak). Emmanuel Kandeke Mulume of the Task Force for incident prevention and BEARIC emphasized balancing public health with livelihoods to avoid crowding that could trigger government dispersal actions threatening the vendors’ main income. Participants also questioned officials’ exemplariness, noting vehicles transporting soldiers in apparent contravention of sanitary guidelines; organizers pledged to relay these concerns to authorities to harmonize field behavior. The campaign unfolds in a delicate climate of community resistance and economic activity linked to local trade.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ：バッタ売りの女性たちへのエボラ予防対策遵守の啓発活動 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州ベニで進行中の第17次エボラ流行に関する予防啓発活動の報告であり、新規症例や急変を示す情報はないが、継続中の流行であるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は既知の第17次エボラ流行下での地域啓発活動を報じるものであり、新規感染者数や流行状況の変化についての具体的情報は含まれていない。継続中の公衆衛生危機として引き続き動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: പക്ഷിപ്പനി മനുഷ്യരിലേക്ക് പകരാം: വ്യക്തിഗത സുരക്ഷ ഉറപ്പാക്കണമെന്ന് ആരോഗ്യ വകുപ്പ്
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu can spread to humans: Health Department urges personal safety.
article.articleSummary: Alappuzha, Kerala: Health Department warns that avian influenza (bird flu) seen in birds can spread to humans, though overall risk remains low; infections can cause severe illness and higher mortality. People who handle sick or dead birds should take personal precautions. Human symptoms include fever, intense body aches, cough, diarrhea, sore throat, and shortness of breath; severe signs include coughing up blood and other serious respiratory infections. Those with exposure should not self-treat and should contact nearby health facilities promptly; patients and the public in hospitals should wear masks and adhere strictly to respiratory infection precautions. Key preventive measures: avoid direct contact with infected birds or animals; do not touch dead birds; wash hands with soap and water after contact with secretions or droppings; follow restrictions on sale/use of meat and eggs in areas with confirmed cases; ensure meat and eggs are fully cooked; avoid cross-contamination.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザが人に感染する可能性:衛生局が個人防護の徹底を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザのヒトへの感染リスクについて注意喚起する一般的な啓発記事であり、具体的な感染確定症例の報告はないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 本記事は具体的なヒト感染確定症例を報じたものではなく、衛生局による予防啓発・一般的注意喚起が主旨。鳥での発生状況や人への感染確認事例の有無など詳細情報が不足しており、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue: se notificaron dos nuevos casos y 14 fueron clasificados como probables
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue: two new cases were reported and 14 were classified as probable.
article.articleSummary: Two new dengue cases were reported in the Autonomous City of Buenos Aires (CABA), bringing the season’s total dengue cases to eight, all imported. The origin breakdown includes three cases in the Province of Buenos Aires (PBA) with travel to Brazil and Ecuador; three in CABA with travel to Peru and Brazil; one in Santa Fe with travel to Peru; and one in Santa Cruz with travel to Costa Rica. A total of 1,453 suspected dengue cases were reported, with 746 discarded, 685 still under investigation, and 14 classified as probable. For chikungunya, no new cases were recorded in the latest week; only one case exists in Orán department, Salta, with travel to Bolivia. Although overall risk remains low, the NOA outbreak warrants intensified surveillance and continued testing among acute febrile syndromes to detect new transmission foci.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：新たに2例が報告され、14例が疑い例として分類された
triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチンにおける輸入デング熱・チクングニア熱症例の報告であり、全体リスクは低いとされている。対象国リストに該当する発生国はなく、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも示唆されていない。
triage.notes: 記事はアルゼンチン国内における輸入デング熱・チクングニア熱症例の季節報告であり、ブラジル・ペルー・エクアドル・コスタリカ・ボリビア・フィリピンは患者の渡航歴として言及されているのみで、各国内での発生事例ではないため、対象国としては該当なしと判断した。

article.articleHeadline: പൾസ് പോളിയോ ഇമ്യൂണൈസേഷൻ: 1,01,779 കുട്ടികൾക്ക് തുള്ളിമരുന്ന് നൽകും
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pulse Polio Immunisation: Polio drops will be given to 101,779 children.
article.articleSummary: Pulse Polio immunisation will vaccinate 101,779 children under five in Kasaragod district, Kerala, on November 22. A district-level coordination committee underscored achieving 100% coverage on the first day, including 876 children from other states. The drive will operate 1,188 booths across health facilities, railway stations, bus stands and other sites, with mobile booths and mobile teams to reach hard-to-reach areas and migrant camps. For children who miss the drops on November 22, volunteers will conduct door-to-door campaigns on November 23 and 24. The objective is universal polio protection for all under-five children and to sustain immunisation momentum through extensive outreach.

triage.headline_ja: パルスポリオ予防接種:101,779人の子供にポリオ経口ワクチンを投与
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はインド・ケララ州での定期的なポリオ予防接種キャンペーン（Pulse Polio Immunisation）の実施案内であり、ポリオ発生や症例報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は定例の予防接種活動の告知であり、ポリオ症例の発生報告ではないため対象国の感染症イベントには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: ICMR Flags Widespread Antibiotic Resistance Across India: From E. coli To Typhoid, Which Drugs Are Failing?
article.articleSummary: India's ICMR AMRSN Annual Report 2025, released 2026-11-18, analyzes Gram-negative bacteria (E. coli, Klebsiella pneumoniae, Acinetobacter baumannii, Pseudomonas aeruginosa) and Gram-positive Staphylococcus aureus/Enterococcus across 34 secondary-care hospitals. E. coli shows low susceptibility to third-generation cephalosporins: cefotaxime 18.4%, ceftazidime 24.7%; OPD isolates indicate community resistance. In K. pneumoniae, susceptibility to piperacillin-tazobactam 29.2%, third-gen cephalosporins 23–27%, carbapenems 35–40%, amikacin 44.5%, ceftazidime-avibactam 37.7%, with tigecycline at 79.3%. E. coli ceftriaxone susceptibility across hospital categories falls from 39.8% (Category I) to 11.5% (Category III); meropenem from 80.3% to 67.1%. A. baumannii shows 91.1% carbapenem resistance; OXA-23 dominant, often with NDM co-profiles. S. Typhi and S. Paratyphi A show very low ciprofloxacin susceptibility (2.0% and 0.4%). The report underscores urgent need for diagnostics, rational antibiotic use, and infection prevention to curb resistance in India.

triage.headline_ja: ICMRがインド全土で広範な抗生物質耐性を指摘：大腸菌から腸チフスまで、効かなくなっている薬は？
triage.triage_reason: 特定の急性アウトブレイクではなく、ICMRによる年次AMR(薬剤耐性)サーベイランス報告書であり、既知の傾向の継続を示すもの。即時のリスク評価は不要。
triage.notes: ICMR AMRSN年次報告書に基づく薬剤耐性動向の報告であり、急性の感染症アウトブレイクイベントではない。長期的な公衆衛生課題として継続的な監視は有用だが、単発のシグナルとしてのピックアップ対象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Itaverava registra 6 casos positivos de Covid-19, aponta novo boletim epidemiológico - Correio de Minas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Itaverava records 6 positive COVID-19 cases, points to a new epidemiological bulletin - Correio de Minas
article.articleSummary: Itaverava reports 6 positive COVID-19 cases in its latest epidemiological bulletin released on 18 November 2026. All diagnosed individuals remain in home isolation and under clinical follow-up, while 14 tests returned negative. The Municipal Health Secretariat emphasizes preventive measures under the motto 'Prevention is still the best choice!'. The bulletin notes ongoing case surveillance and reiterates basic recommendations from health authorities, with no mention of hospitalizations or outbreaks beyond the six active cases in Itaverava. The update reflects routine public health monitoring and case management for COVID-19 in the municipality.

triage.headline_ja: イタヴェラーヴァ市、新たな疫学速報でCOVID-19陽性6例を報告 - Correio de Minas
triage.triage_reason: 小規模市町村での日常的なCOVID-19サーベイランス報告であり、入院・重症例・異常な拡大は報告されておらず、通常の公衆衛生モニタリングの範囲内である。
triage.notes: COVID-19は既知の疾患であり、対象国リスト（ブラジルを含む）にも該当しないため、地域要件からも対象外。6例は在宅隔離で管理されており、アウトブレイクの兆候なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Agricultura autoriza retoma alojamento de aves contaminadas pela Doença de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Agriculture authorizes the resumption of housing for birds contaminated with Newcastle disease.
article.articleSummary: In Santa Catarina, Brazil, the Ministry of Agriculture authorized resumption of housing for poultry on farms previously affected by Newcastle disease after they completed cleaning and disinfection procedures. The authorization applies only to properties that have met sanitary requirements. Five foci of Newcastle disease have been identified in the region since October 18. After the first confirmed case, more than 250 commercial poultry farms were inspected across over 3,600 properties. No birds have shown clinical symptoms to date. Surveillance activities continue and export restrictions remain in effect. Newcastle disease is not considered a risk from consuming properly inspected poultry meat and eggs. The measures aim to restore poultry housing while maintaining biosecurity and trade safeguards in Santa Catarina.

triage.headline_ja: 農務省、ニューカッスル病に汚染された家禽の飼育再開を許可
triage.triage_reason: 動物衛生事案であり人への直接的な公衆衛生リスクは低いが、貿易制限（輸出制限）が継続しており、家禽産業への影響と越境拡大リスクの観点から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 動物（家禽）の疾病であり、ヒトへの感染リスクは記事中で明示的に否定されている（適切に検査された鶏肉・卵の消費は安全とされる）。農業・貿易上の影響が主な懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: Porto Velho registra quase 4 mil casos de malária e reforça necessidade de diagnóstico precoce
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Porto Velho records nearly 4,000 malaria cases and reinforces the need for early diagnosis.
article.articleSummary: Porto Velho records 3,959 malaria cases from January 1 to November 13, 2026, up from 3,762 in the same period in 2025. Semusa reported 41,212 diagnostic tests this year. Hotspots are Bacia Leiteira, Terra Santa, Bairro Novo, Km 13/Santa Helena, and Uberaba. Twenty-one malaria cases were detected among pregnant women after 1,395 targeted tests in this group, underscoring prenatal screening. Malaria is transmitted by female Anopheles mosquitoes; symptoms include fever, chills, headaches, sweating, and body pains. Authorities emphasize early diagnosis, prevention, and free diagnosis and treatment through SUS. They recommend repellents, nets, screens, and protective clothing, and advise seeking care at a SUS unit at first symptoms. Semusa maintains surveillance and testing across urban, rural, and riverine communities.

triage.headline_ja: ポルト・ヴェーリョでマラリア症例が4,000件近くに、早期診断の必要性を強調
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ロンドニア州における風土病マラリアの流行地域での例年通りの症例報告であり、前年同期比で若干増加しているものの異常な増加や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: マラリアはロンドニア州の風土病であり、公衆衛生当局が通常の監視・診断強化を実施している状況。症例数は前年と同程度で重症例や死亡の報告はない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1
Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N8

article.articleHeadline: India to launch first indigenous H5N1 bird flu vaccine for chickens tomorrow
article.articleSummary: Dose of indigenous inactivated H5N1 vaccine (Clade 2.3.2.1a) for chickens to be launched on Thursday, 19 November 2026, in India by Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan. Developed by ICAR-NIHSAD in Bhopal; first vaccine in India specifically targeting H5N1 Clade 2.3.2.1a. No prior commercial vaccine for this strain. India has recorded more than 500 bird flu outbreaks involving H5N1 and H5N8 since 2006. HPAI bird flu causes high mortality in poultry and triggers culling and movement restrictions. The vaccine's commercial availability, production arrangements, pricing, and deployment schedule are not specified. Effectiveness depends on widespread deployment, surveillance, early diagnosis, farm biosecurity, and coordinated response. Globally, WHO reports 1,003 human H5N1 cases and 479 deaths across 25 countries since 2003, with India among affected countries. The initiative aims to shield poultry sector and reduce outbreak-related losses and trade disruptions.

triage.headline_ja: インド、明日から鶏用の国産H5N1鳥インフルエンザワクチンを初めて発売
triage.triage_reason: 新規の感染症発生事例ではなく、既存のH5N1鳥インフルエンザ対策としての家禽用ワクチン発売に関する政策・産業ニュースであり、トリアージ対象となる新規アウトブレイク情報は含まれない。
triage.notes: 記事はインドにおける家禽用H5N1ワクチンの発売に関する発表であり、新規の人間感染例やアウトブレイク発生の報告ではない。2006年以降インドで500件超のH5N1/H5N8発生歴があることが背景情報として言及されているが、本記事自体は予防的な産業対策のニュースである。

article.articleHeadline: भोपाल में विकसित हुआ देश का पहला स्वदेशी बर्ड फ्लू टीका, 20 नवंबर को शिवराज सिंह चौहान करेंगे राष्ट्र को समर्पित | Bhopal develops indigenous bird flu vaccine for poultry, Shivraj Singh Chouhan to dedicate to nation on Nov 20
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The country's first indigenous bird flu vaccine developed in Bhopal, Shivraj Singh Chouhan to dedicate it to the nation on November 20.
article.articleSummary: India's ICAR-NIHSAD in Bhopal has developed the country’s first indigenous inactivated vaccine against Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (H5N1) for poultry, targeting clade 2.3.2.1a. The vaccine aims to reduce farm losses and prevent viral spread to other animals and humans. Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan will dedicate the vaccine to the nation on November 20 at NIHSAD. Since 2006, India has reported over 500 outbreaks of H5N1 and H5N8. HPAI can cause up to 100% mortality in flocks, triggering culling and trade restrictions. WHO records 1,003 human H5N1 cases with 479 deaths across 25 countries since 2003. Economic implications include potential GDP slowdown up to 1.5% and over 20% of poultry at risk; 2006 estimates alone cited losses of ₹2,200–₹3,000 crore, with Manipur’s GDP affected by about 0.5%.

triage.headline_ja: ボパールで開発された国産初の鳥インフルエンザワクチン、シヴラージ・シン・チョウハン氏が11月20日に国家に捧げる
triage.triage_reason: 新規の症例発生報告ではなく、家禽向け国産ワクチンの開発・発表に関するニュースであり、現時点で異常な公衆衛生イベントは報告されていない。
triage.notes: 記事は過去の累積データ（2006年以降500件超のH5N1/H5N8アウトブレイク、WHOの累計1,003例・479死亡等）を背景情報として引用しているが、新規の人獣感染イベントではなく、ワクチン開発・発表という政策的ニュースであるためDISMISSと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Aulas são suspensas em escola do Piauí após suspeita de catapora entre estudantes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Classes are suspended at a school in Piauí after suspected chickenpox among students.
article.articleSummary: Chickenpox (varicella) suspected among students at a Lagoa do Piauí school in Piauí, Brazil, prompting class suspension by Sesapi on 18 November 2026. One adolescent remains hospitalized in Teresina for evaluation, while authorities plan a school-wide screening to identify additional cases. Specimens from symptomatic students will be collected and sent to the Laboratory Central de Saúde Pública do Piauí (Lacen-PI), which will supply necessary materials for testing. The incubation period for varicella is 10–21 days, meaning symptoms may appear up to three weeks after exposure; officials emphasize keeping students out of class for at least 10 days while investigations continue. Sesapi met with municipal health managers to coordinate the investigation and data collection.

triage.headline_ja: ピアウイ州の学校で水痘疑いにより授業停止
triage.triage_reason: 水痘は国内でよく見られる疾患で重症度・国際的拡大リスクは低く、学校単位の局所的な対応に留まっているため、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: ブラジル・ピアウイ州の一校における水痘疑い事例。地方保健当局が調査・検査を実施中だが、規模は小さく公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola burial teams in DRC work through health risks and prejudice
article.articleSummary: Ebola burial teams in eastern DRC (Kokola near Beni) operate six months into a deadly outbreak that has infected over 11,000 and killed more than half of those cases, threatening to surpass West Africa’s 2014–2016 toll of 11,000. The Dignified and Safe Burial (DSB) program relies on ECUMAIR community teams and mobile units to perform dignified burials and cut transmission. In Kokola, a team collected the body of someone who died on Nov 17; women like Chimène Mwanaki confront prejudice that they spread Ebola or damage marriage prospects. Oicha health zone supervisor Jean Manina monitors burial work via dashboards and ensures adherence to protocols where ECUMAIR teams are present, while some areas remain uncovered. Bodies are sometimes sampled for Ebola confirmation, fueling community hostility and attacks against responders, who report misperceptions about their role.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ埋葬チーム、健康リスクと偏見と闘いながら活動
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で感染者11,000人超、致死率50%超という大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、2014-2016年西アフリカ流行の規模を超える恐れがあるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC東部（北キブ州、Oicha保健区、Kakola）での既存エボラ流行の埋葬対応に関する内容。発生地域リストにAngolaが含まれるが、記事本文で言及がないため除外した。流行開始から6か月が経過しており既知のアウトブレイクだが、規模拡大の深刻さからフルRRA対象とすべき。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Saúde confirma primeiro caso de mpox em Mato Grosso do Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health confirms first mpox case in Mato Grosso do Sul.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) case confirmed in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, on 2026-11-18: a man aged 41–49 from Campo Grande with immunosuppression, who developed symptoms in September and was lab-confirmed; he had traveled to another state before diagnosis and recovered without hospitalization. The disease is under control in MS, while São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro face higher activity; Brazil confirmed cases total 1,170. MS’s outbreak peaked in 2022 with 157 cases; 2023 saw one; 2024–2025 rose modestly, with early-2026 decline; three suspected cases are under investigation. Brazil has ordered 25,000 doses via PAHO Revolving Fund, expected in about three weeks from a Danish manufacturer; 3,650 doses have been distributed to nine states; MS allocation not specified. Two-dose intradermal vaccination, 28 days apart, at reference centers; prioritized groups include people with HIV/AIDS, PrEP users, lab workers, and high-risk contacts. Transmission mainly sexual or prolonged close contact; common symptoms: fever, lymphadenopathy, and skin eruptions.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、マトグロッソ・ド・スル州で初のMpox症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: 単発の確定症例で入院もなく回復しており、ブラジルでは既に1,170例が確認され管理体制下にあるため、新規性・異常性は低い。
triage.notes: 州単位での初症例報告だが、ブラジル全体では既知の継続的流行であり、ワクチン配布体制も整っている。新規シグナルというよりは既存アウトブレイクの経過報告。

article.articleHeadline: WHO says Ebola outbreak in DR Congo remains public health emergency of international concern
article.articleSummary: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC) after WHO’s Emergency Committee assessment. The agency urges governments and partners to scale up the response and mobilize resources to protect communities over coming months, and to safeguard health workers, medical facilities, and emergency responders amid ongoing conflict. The outbreak has recorded more than 11,300 cases and about 5,500 deaths, with 400–500 new infections per week. Two experimental vaccines targeting Bundibugyo Ebola virus are expected to begin phase 2 clinical trials next week in Congo. Updated recommendations for Congo and other countries are expected in the coming days.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクは国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態(PHEIC)のままであると発表
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを継続認定しており、症例・死亡者数が多数で、国際的関心・支援の必要性が高いためフルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: WHOにより既にPHEIC認定済みの継続事案。症例11,300件超、死者約5,500人、週400-500件の新規感染あり、紛争下での対応継続中。

article.articleHeadline: भोपाल में विकसित हुआ देश का पहला स्वदेशी बर्ड फ्लू टीका, 20 नवंबर को शिवराज सिंह चौहान करेंगे राष्ट्र को समर्पित
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The country's first indigenous avian influenza vaccine developed in Bhopal will be dedicated to the nation by Shivraj Singh Chouhan on November 20.
article.articleSummary: India’s ICAR-National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases in Bhopal has developed the country’s first indigenous inactivated H5N1 highly pathogenic avian influenza vaccine, to be dedicated on November 20 by Chief Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan. The vaccine aims to safeguard poultry, reduce farmers' losses, and curb spread. Bird flu can cause up to 100% mortality in flocks and triggers culling and trade bans that disrupt livelihoods. Since 2006, India has reported over 500 outbreaks of H5N1 and H5N8. Large outbreaks could reduce GDP by about 1.5% and imperil over 20% of the poultry population; 2006 losses were Rs 2300-3000 crore, with Manipur hit by roughly 0.5% of GDP. Globally, WHO reports 1,003 human H5N1 cases and 479 deaths in 25 countries since 2003, with clade 2.3.2.1a predominant in poultry; three human infections reported recently. The vaccine addresses the lack of a commercial vaccine for this clade.

triage.headline_ja: ボパールで国産初の鳥インフルエンザワクチンが開発、11月20日にシブラージ・シン・チョウハン氏が国に捧げる
triage.triage_reason: 新規の発生事例ではなく、家禽用ワクチン開発・発表に関する記事であり、現時点で公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常な感染拡大を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は家禽向けH5N1ワクチンの開発・公式発表に関する内容で、新規のヒトまたは家禽の発生事例を報告するものではない。過去の統計データ（2006年以降の発生件数やWHOの累計症例数）が背景情報として引用されているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de Ebola no Congo tem cerca de 5.600 mortes, diz OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo has about 5,600 deaths, says WHO.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization (WHO) maintains the international health emergency for the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with more than 11,000 confirmed cases and about 5,600 deaths. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced the decision on X after an emergency committee meeting, which will reconvene every three months to monitor the outbreak. The emergency was declared on May 17. Tedros urged government and partner cooperation and resources to protect communities in the coming months. He noted that two-thirds of deaths occur outside treatment centers, suggesting late detection and inadequate contact tracing. He called for greater protection for health workers, care facilities, and field teams, as many communities lie in conflict zones with repeated attacks on health staff. He criticized travel bans on travelers from affected areas as hindering response and livelihoods, and disincentivizing rapid outbreak notification.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行、死者約5,600人とWHOが発表
triage.triage_reason: WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態(PHEIC)を継続中であり、11,000件超の症例と5,600人の死者という深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の問題を含むためIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: WHOはPHEIC継続中であり、紛争地域での医療従事者への攻撃、治療施設外での死亡が多いこと、渡航制限が対応を妨げているとの指摘あり。継続的なフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Strain-specific Ebola vaccines to be trialled in DRC, WHO announces
article.articleSummary: Two Bundibugyo-specific Ebola vaccines will be tested in the DRC’s Tumaini trial using ring vaccination for high-risk contacts. The vaccine candidates are ChAdOx1 (Oxford) and mRNA-1469 (Moderna); Phase 1 completed, Phase 2 begins in Bunia, Ituri, around 26–27 November, with about 140 participants and thousands of contacts enrolled. Ervebo, approved for Zaire strain, is being assessed for cross-protection against Bundibugyo in a Phase 3 trial begun 23 October. The eastern DRC outbreak, declared a public health emergency in May, has 11,376 cases and 5,568 deaths, with six months of rising cases and deaths; two-thirds of deaths occur outside treatment centres. Children exceed 25% of cases and about one-third of deaths. No Bundibugyo-specific vaccines existed before this effort.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、DRCでエボラ出血熱の株特異的ワクチン治験を発表
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で発生中のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクは既に公衆衛生緊急事態として宣言されており、症例数11,376、死亡者5,568人と深刻な影響が続いているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 既にWHOにより公衆衛生緊急事態として宣言されている進行中のアウトブレイクであり、今回の記事はブンディブギョ株特異的ワクチン(ChAdOx1、mRNA-1469)の治験開始を報じるもの。フルリスク評価では既存のアウトブレイク状況の更新として扱う必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : le difficile travail des équipes chargées des enterrements liés à Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The difficult work of teams responsible for Ebola-related burials.
article.articleSummary: Ebola, in the Democratic Republic of the Congo's North Kivu (Oicha, near Beni), is being managed with ECUMAIR community burial teams to ensure dignified and safe rites. Women team leaders face stigma and threats, with locals questioning their participation and alleging they could contaminate spouses or jeopardize marriages. Despite risks, teams collect samples to confirm Ebola as the death cause, sometimes triggering community attacks, such as in Mukakira where a burial team was assaulted and vehicles were pelted. Jean Manina oversees another team focused on adhering to burial protocols to prevent transmission, using a dashboard to trigger deployments; ECUMAIR exists in some health zones, while, in others, the regional mobile team is dispatched. Six months after the outbreak was declared in the DRC, the situation remains out of control, with over 11,000 cases and roughly half of the infected dying, per official data.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラ関連の埋葬を担当するチームの困難な作業
triage.triage_reason: DRCコンゴ民主共和国北キブ州でエボラ出血熱の流行が6か月間続いており、11,000例超・致死率約50%と深刻かつ制御困難な状況にあるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生から6か月経過し、11,000例超・致死率約50%で「制御不能」と報告されている。埋葬チームへの地域社会からの暴力・スティグマも報告されており、対応の困難さと感染拡大リスクの両面で懸念が大きい。

article.articleHeadline: Bhiwandi Reports 2,839 Active TB Cases, Women Patients Outnumber Men By 367
article.articleSummary: 2,839 active TB cases in Bhiwandi, including 1,603 women, 1,236 men, and 230 children up to 14 years; women outnumber men by 367. Dr. Bushra Sayed, TB Department in-charge, directed intensified screening, regular treatment, and expanded Nikshay Mitra support to meet year-end targets and accelerate case finding, reintegrating those who paused testing or treatment. A review with Doctor For You stressed sustaining momentum, counseling reluctant individuals, and engaging corporators and affluent residents to bolster patient aid. Stigma and delayed diagnosis were highlighted as risks that can worsen outcomes, with residents urged to seek medical examination promptly as part of ongoing TB management in Bhiwandi on 2026-11-18.

triage.headline_ja: ビワンディで結核の活動性症例2,839件を報告、女性患者が男性を367人上回る
triage.triage_reason: 既知の地域流行病（結核）に対する通常の行政対応・症例報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスク、社会的関心の高まりは認められない。
triage.notes: 地元自治体による既存のTB対策プログラムの進捗報告であり、地域保健当局内での通常業務の一環と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia eboli w Kongu wymkneła się spod kontroli. Jest już drugą największą w historii
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spiraled out of control. It is already the second-largest in history.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spiraled into the second-largest outbreak on record, driven by the Bundibugyo strain. Since May 2026, the epidemic has infected 11,432 people and killed 5,593 in the DRC, a case fatality of about 50%. By 15 November 2026, WHO and Africa CDC warned that surveillance can no longer track most new infections, as transmission occurs largely outside contact tracing. About 80% of new cases involve people not on known contact lists. The outbreak spans eight provinces—including Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, and Tshopo—with rural areas reporting 400–500 new infections weekly. Violence against health workers and facilities by armed groups, notably the ADF, hampers response; Cantine-Aloya in North Kivu saw 66 civilians killed, including three healthcare workers. International aid of about $2.9 billion is pledged, but less than half has been disbursed. UNICEF notes 28% of cases are children, who account for 35% of deaths; over 2,200 children have been orphaned or separated since May.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が制御不能に。史上2番目の規模に
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約50%、感染者11,432人・死者5,593人の大規模アウトブレイクで、サーベイランスが機能不全に陥り国際的拡大リスクも高いためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 史上2番目の規模のエボラ流行。コンタクトトレーシング外での感染が80%に達し、武装勢力による医療従事者への攻撃も発生。国際支援は誓約額の半分未満しか実施されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Molecular characterization of Plasmodium falciparum MSP-2 allelic diversity and infection complexity in patients attending Bamenda regional hospital, Cameroon
article.articleSummary: Plasmodium falciparum malaria in Cameroon: molecular characterization of MSP-2 allelic diversity and infection complexity in patients at Bamenda Regional Hospital, Bamenda, Cameroon. The study investigates MSP-2 gene diversity and multi-clone infections in a Cameroonian clinical setting using molecular methods. Authors come from the University of Dschang, University of Bamenda, and related Cameroonian laboratories, with international collaborators at KU Leuven (Belgium) and Gannan Medical University (China). The article is Open Access under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. The excerpt lists affiliations and corresponding authors but does not provide patient counts, clinical outcomes, transmission sources, or laboratory-confirmed results. This work supplies baseline data on MSP-2 diversity and infection complexity among Cameroonian malaria patients, contributing to molecular surveillance and understanding of parasite diversity in the region.

triage.headline_ja: カメルーン・バメンダ地域病院を受診した患者におけるPlasmodium falciparum MSP-2対立遺伝子多様性と感染複雑性の分子特性解析
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はカメルーンにおけるマラリア原虫の分子疫学的研究論文であり、対象国（対象リスト）における公衆衛生上の緊急事態や異常な発生を報告するものではない。
