article.articleHeadline: Afrique : l'intelligence artificielle au service de la lutte contre la polio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa: Artificial intelligence in the fight against polio.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization (WHO) uses artificial intelligence to enhance poliomyelitis surveillance in Africa. The WHO Regional Office for Africa, based in Brazzaville, integrates AI into surveillance systems to speed case detection and monitor vaccination campaigns. Weekly data from 47 African countries cover poliovirus circulation, laboratory results, vaccination coverage, and surveillance activities. AI-powered GIS tools let staff query databases in plain language and automatically generate maps, tables, and summaries showing poliovirus detections by country, district, or period. This enables identification of areas with weak surveillance or suboptimal vaccination and cross-links surveillance with vaccination data to better target field interventions. It also helps track supplementary vaccination operations, pinpoint delays and logistical challenges, and speed responses to transmission risks. AI supports, not replaces, epidemiologists and human data checks, and was unveiled on World GIS Day, November 18.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ：ポリオ対策に活用される人工知能
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生イベントではなく、WHOアフリカ地域事務局によるポリオサーベイランスへのAI活用技術を紹介する一般的な記事であり、具体的な症例急増や新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ共和国ブラザビルにあるWHOアフリカ地域事務局の技術導入に関する内容であり、特定の対象国での具体的なポリオ発生事例を報告するものではないため、対象国リストに該当する発生地域は特定できない。DRC・Republic of the Congoは組織所在地として言及されているのみで、疾病発生地としてではない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : le secteur minier contribue à la riposte contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The mining sector contributes to the fight against Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, 18 November 2026 — The mining sector in the Democratic Republic of Congo contributed to the fight against Ebola virus disease (EVD) as part of national mobilization against the 17th outbreak. A cheque for 1,100,000 USD was presented by Mines Minister Louis Watum to Dr. Jean-Jacques Muyembe, general coordinator of the incident management system for the Ebola response. The gesture, described by the Ministry of Mines as solidarity to help protect populations and strengthen the national response to health emergencies, accompanies ongoing efforts against the 17th wave declared in May 2026. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, noted as a rare variant. The contribution underscores sectoral support for government-led measures to control the crisis and coordinate the national response as needed.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：鉱業セクターがエボラ対策に貢献 - ACP通信
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2026年5月から続く第17波エボラ出血熱（稀なブンディブギョ株）の国家対応に関する記事であり、重篤な感染症の継続的流行に関する情報のためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事自体は鉱業セクターからの資金提供に関する内容で新規症例情報はないが、進行中の第17波エボラ流行（稀なブンディブギョ株）という重大イベントの一部であるためPICKUPと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Over 18,600 birds culled in Alappuzha after bird flu confirmed at two farms
article.articleSummary: On Nov 18, 2026, in Alappuzha district, Kerala, avian influenza was confirmed at two poultry farms, triggering culling of 18,620 birds and destruction of 28,040 eggs within a 1 km radius of affected farms in Ambalappuzha North, Ambalappuzha South, and Chennithala-Thripperunthura. Culling totals: 7,116 chickens, 11,057 ducks, 447 quails; ~100 kg feed destroyed. In Ambalappuzha North Ward 11, quails and chickens were positive; in Chennithala-Thripperunthura Ward 1, ducks and chickens were positive. Samples tested positive at the National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (NIHSAD) in Bhopal. Three rapid response teams (doctor, inspectors, attendants, workers) were deployed; PPE worn; remains burnt. A 10-km surveillance zone established; operation led by Animal Husbandry, Veterinary and Health departments with support from Local Self-Government, Police and Food Safety. The WHO notes avian influenza can occasionally infect humans.

triage.headline_ja: アラプーザ県で鳥インフルエンザ確認後、2農場で18,600羽超を殺処分
triage.triage_reason: 家禽のみの鳥インフルエンザ発生で人への感染は報告されておらず、地元当局により迅速に封じ込め対応（殺処分・監視区域設定）が実施されている定型的な動物衛生事案。
triage.notes: 人への感染例は報告されておらず、家禽間のみの発生。NIHSAD（国立高度安全動物疾病研究所）での検査確定、3つの緊急対応チーム投入、10km監視区域設定など、インド当局による標準的な家禽疫病対応が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Situações climáticas extremas reforçam a importância das medidas preventivas contra a dengue - O Jornal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Extreme Weather Events Reinforce the Importance of Preventive Measures Against Dengue Fever
article.articleSummary: Dengue risk in Brazil rises with extreme heat and heavy rains that boost Aedes aegypti breeding. Experts from HU Brasil warn that higher temperatures and altered rainfall patterns accelerate mosquito development, potentially increasing arboviruses such as dengue, chikungunya, zika, and oropouche. In Uberlândia, HC-UFU notes water accumulation in containers and clean standing water as egg deposition sites, underscoring the need for continuous preventive measures. Dengue presents with sudden high fever, myalgia, retro-orbital and joint pain, fatigue, rash, and GI symptoms; warning signs include bleeding, respiratory distress, and severe abdominal pain. Diagnosis combines clinical assessment with molecular testing early, and antibody detection after about one week. Treatment is clinical and supportive, with emphasis on hydration; avoid aspirin. Vaccination with Qdenga (Takeda) is available in SUS since Feb 2024, 2 doses 3 months apart, for ages 10–14, protecting all four serotypes. Vector control and environmental measures remain central.

triage.headline_ja: 異常気象がデング熱予防策の重要性を再認識させる
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱予防に関する一般的な啓発記事であり、異常な流行や新規事例の報告はなく、特定の公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報もない。
triage.notes: 記事は気候変動とデング熱媒介蚊の繁殖リスクに関する啓発・予防情報であり、具体的な症例数増加や流行の異常性についての報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Com 123 casos confirmados em MS, Campo Grande investiga 3 suspeitas de sarna humana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With 123 confirmed cases in Mato Grosso do Sul, Campo Grande investigates 3 suspected cases of human scabies.
article.articleSummary: As of 18 November 2026, Campo Grande, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, investigates three suspected human scabies cases, while the state reports 123 confirmed infections across six interior cities. Dourados and Itaporã have closed daycare centers: Recanto Raízes 49; Beatriz de Barros Bumlai 15; Bertilo Binsfeld 10; Milton Menani 27; Maria Rodrigues 7. Rio Brilhante records six cases (five at Escola Estadual Lígia Terezinha Martins, one in a creche). Douradina has one case; Amambai four; Nova Andradina four (November): two children 3–9, two adults 20–54. Transmission is mainly by direct, prolonged contact. Symptoms: intense nocturnal itching and multiple red lesions with skin tracks; crusted Norwegian scabies can occur in debilitated individuals. Hygiene alone does not prevent transmission; control requires hot-water washing (>55°C), ironing, and medical treatment to eliminate mites and interrupt spread; Campo Grande cases await confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: マトグロッソ・ド・スル州で123例確認、カンポグランデでヒゼンダニ症（疥癬）の疑い3例を調査
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は接触感染で重症度・国際的拡大リスクが低く、IHR基準・社会的関心も該当しないため見送り。
triage.notes: ブラジルで発生しているが、対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるものの(3469034)、疥癬は重症度・国際的影響が低い地域内保健事象であり、トリアージ基準に照らしDISMISSと判断。なお対象国リストにBrazilが含まれるため、地域検証上は該当国として記録する必要があれば追加検討可。

article.articleHeadline: Micareta 2026 de Feira de Santana: Governo Ronaldo prepara esquema de saúde, combate à dengue, segurança e mudanças no funcionamento do comércio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Feira de Santana's Micareta 2026: Ronaldo's government prepares a health plan, dengue control, security, and changes to how commerce operates.
article.articleSummary: Feira de Santana’s Micareta 2026 launches with an integrated health and disease-prevention operation. The festival opens on 18 November 2026 with Mayor José Ronaldo de Carvalho presenting the city key to Rei Momo Marlon Santana. Health planning includes two urgent care units totaling 30 beds: a main unit with 24 beds at the intersection of Avenida Presidente Dutra and Rua João Durval Carneiro, and a second unit with 6 beds beside the Santuário Santo Antônio in Capuchinhos. Most cases will be treated within the festival circuit; transfers, when needed, go to UPAs and six municipal polyclinics, with complex trauma cases referred to Hospital Geral Clériston Andrade (HGCA). A mass-casualty drill (IMV) for about 100 participants is scheduled for 18 November at Unifacs to test command, triage, and transport protocols. Dengue prevention will be intensified, focusing on Aedes aegypti control in the Maneca Ferreira circuit during the event.

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Epidemija ebole u DR Kongu i dalje predstavlja međunarodnu zdravstvenu prijetnju
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to pose an international health threat.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-11-18, the World Health Organization declared the Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo a Public Health Emergency of International Concern following Emergency Committee review. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus reported over 11,300 Ebola virus disease cases and more than 5,500 deaths since the outbreak began, with weekly arrivals of 400–500 new cases. The agency urged all governments and partners to intensify the response and secure resources to protect communities in the coming months, and to safeguard health workers, medical facilities, and emergency responders in areas affected by ongoing armed conflict. Updated recommendations for the Democratic Republic of the Congo and other countries will be released in the coming days. Next week, phase 2 clinical trials of two experimental vaccines developed specifically against Bundibugyo ebolavirus are expected to begin in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は依然として国際的な健康上の脅威である
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを宣言し、死者5,500人超・週400〜500人の新規感染が続くなど深刻かつ国際的拡大リスクが高いため、フルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEIC宣言を行った重大イベント。武力紛争下での対応困難さや新規ワクチン臨床試験開始など続報を要する。

article.articleHeadline: L'OMS affirme que l'épidémie d'Ebola en RDC reste une urgence de santé publique de portée internationale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO affirms that the Ebola outbreak in the DRC remains a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-11-18, the World Health Organization confirms that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The decision follows recommendations from the WHO Emergency Committee. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus called on governments and partners to boost cooperation, mobilize resources, and protect health workers and medical facilities in communities affected by ongoing conflict. Updated recommendations for the DRC and other countries will be issued in the coming days. As of the latest briefing, the outbreak has recorded more than 11,300 cases and 5,500 deaths, with 400–500 new infections reported each week. In parallel, two experimental vaccines specifically developed against Bundibugyo ebolavirus are expected to enter Phase 2 clinical trials in the DRC next week.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱の流行が「国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態」のままであると表明
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICの継続を正式表明し、11,300例超・死者5,500人超、週400〜500人の新規感染という深刻な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、国際的拡大・渡航貿易制限のリスクも高い。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEIC継続を正式発表しており、既存のRRA対象イベントの継続的フォローアップとして扱うべき。紛争地域での対応困難さや医療従事者保護の課題も指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Malária já soma quase 4 mil casos e acende alerta para diagnóstico precoce
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria now totals nearly 4,000 cases and raises an alert for early diagnosis.
article.articleSummary: Malaria in Porto Velho, Brazil, reached 3,959 cases from January 1 to November 13, 2026, up from 3,762 in the same period in 2025, per a municipal epidemiological bulletin. A total of 41,212 diagnostic tests were performed in 2026. The highest-case localities are Bacia Leiteira (200), Terra Santa (146), Bairro Novo (124), Km 13/Santa Helena (119), and Uberaba (89). Transmission occurs via female Anopheles mosquitoes; symptoms include fever, chills, headaches, profuse sweating, and body aches. Twenty-one malaria-positive pregnancies were detected among 1,395 prenatal tests. Prevention emphasizes repellents, bed nets, window screens, and covered clothing, especially in high-transmission areas. Diagnosis and treatment are free through the SUS, with ongoing surveillance and patient follow-up across urban, rural, and riverine communities; prompt care after symptom onset is urged.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア、感染者数がほぼ4000人に達し、早期診断への警鐘鳴らす
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ポルトベーリョにおけるマラリアの地域流行状況報告であり、前年同期比で微増だが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは見られず、既存の風土病管理の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: マラリアは当該地域の風土病であり、前年比約5%増加しているが、既存の地域医療体制（SUS）で対応可能な範囲の報告と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Escola no Piauí suspende aula após alunos apresentarem sintomas de catapora
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: School in Piauí Suspends Class After Students Develop Symptoms of Chickenpox.
article.articleSummary: Varicella (chickenpox) outbreak prompts a temporary suspension of classes at Unidade Escolar Francisco Luís de Moraes in Lagoa do Piauí, Piauí, Brazil, 44 km from Teresina. At least five adolescents developed symptoms in recent days; one is hospitalized in Teresina for diagnostic testing, while others are monitored locally. Sesapi ordered the school closure for about ten days to implement an epidemiological block and prevent further spread. The state laboratory network (Lacen) is providing sampling materials for local teams to collect specimens and send them for lab confirmation of varicella. Varicella is highly contagious and can spread via airborne transmission, direct contact with vesicle fluid, secretions, or contaminated objects; transmission can occur 1–2 days before rash, with an incubation of 10–21 days. Vaccination is available through the SUS, with a routine two-dose schedule at 15 months and 4 years.

triage.headline_ja: ピアウイ州の学校、生徒に水痘の症状が出たため休校
triage.triage_reason: 水痘は一般的な小児感染症であり、単一校での小規模な発生に留まり、国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 水痘は高い伝染性を持つがワクチンで予防可能であり、既に地域保健当局（Sesapi/Lacen）が対応している。重症例や死亡の報告はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Áurea realiza mutirão de combate à dengue | Jornal Bom Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Áurea carries out a dengue-control drive | Jornal Bom Dia
article.articleSummary: Áurea's Municipal Health Department is conducting a dengue-control drive, featuring outreach to residents, preventive measures, and the identification of potential Aedes aegypti breeding sites. The mutirão emphasizes practical steps to curb transmission, including keeping yards and patios clean, removing or emptying containers that can accumulate standing water, and adopting routine precautions to minimize mosquito proliferation. The initiative highlights the critical role of community involvement in vector control and rapid detection of potential breeding habitats to interrupt the dengue life cycle within the municipality of Áurea. Presented on 2026-11-18, the campaign aligns with ongoing public health efforts to reduce dengue risk by targeting common domestic sources of standing water.

triage.triage_reason: 通常の予防的なデング対策活動の報道であり、異常な発生や公衆衛生上の重大な影響を示す情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: "Es el virus más contagioso que conocemos": director de la OPS advierte que sarampión sigue circulando en el Perú
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "It is the most contagious virus we know": PAHO director warns that measles is still circulating in Peru.
article.articleSummary: Measles remains circulating in Peru, with transmission also reported in Brazil, Colombia, and Guatemala; Bolivia, Mexico, and the United States recently lost measles-free certification, while Canada could regain it after two months with no cases. Transmission of the same viral lineage persisted for 12 months, underscoring that elimination has not been achieved. To reach elimination, vaccination coverage must exceed 95% nationally and at all subnational levels. The declines are attributed to health-service access barriers and misinformation, with up to 25% of children not vaccinated during the pandemic. OPS is supporting strategies to identify unvaccinated individuals and bolster immunization: longer clinic hours, weekend vaccination campaigns, and house-to-house vaccination brigades. Emphasis on surveillance to rapidly detect imported cases, identify contacts, and prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: 「これは私たちが知る中で最も感染力の強いウイルスだ」：PAHO事務局長がペルーで麻疹が依然として流行していると警告
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹が南北アメリカの複数国（ペルー、ブラジル、コロンビア、グアテマラ等）で持続的に伝播し、ボリビア・メキシコ・米国が排除認証を失うなど国際的拡大と異常事態が確認されるため、IHR基準を2つ以上満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はペルーにおける麻疹流行であり、対象国リストに含まれるブラジル等は補足的な言及に留まるため、ルールに従いverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: DSÖ: Kongo Demokratik Cumhuriyeti'nde Ebola'dan Ölen Her Üç Kişiden Biri Çocuk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: One of every three people who die from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is a child.
article.articleSummary: Six months after the Bundibugyo-type Ebola virus outbreak was declared in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, cases and deaths continue to rise. The UN reports 1,730 children have died, with hunger worsening and an anticipated 39 million people facing acute food insecurity by early 2027 due to the crisis. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says the heaviest burden falls on children, who account for more than a quarter of confirmed cases and about one-third of deaths; among under-fives, roughly seven of every ten infections are fatal. The outbreak poses cross-border risks, with nine cases in Kenya linked to an imported case from outside the country. Ongoing conflict, displacement, and weak health services in the DRC compound the public health and humanitarian response challenges.

triage.headline_ja: WHO:コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱により死亡する3人に1人は子ども
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のアウトブレイクが継続し、死者数増加、ケニアへの越境感染事例も確認されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ケニアでの9例は輸入症例に関連したものであり、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRC国内の紛争・避難民・食料不安が対応を一層困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: Coceira persistente e bolinhas na pele podem ser sarna humana; veja como se livrar dela mais rápido
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Persistent itching and small bumps on the skin may be human scabies; see how to get rid of it faster.
article.articleSummary: Human scabies (Sarcoptes scabiei) spreads by prolonged skin-to-skin contact and causes intense itching and skin lesions. It can affect anyone and is not linked to hygiene. Symptoms include nocturnal itching and small bumps; itching may persist for weeks after mites are cleared. Diagnosis and treatment require professional evaluation. Treatments include topical permethrin 5% (applied from the neck down and left on for 8–14 hours) or oral ivermectin (weight-based dosing; usually a second dose 7–14 days after the first). Ivermectin is not recommended for pregnancy or children under 15 kg. Close household contacts should be treated simultaneously. Wash clothing and bedding in hot water; seal non-washable items for 72 hours to a week. Home remedies lack proven efficacy; seek medical care if new lesions or itching lasts beyond four weeks. Guidance references the Brazilian Society of Pediatrics and the US CDC.

triage.headline_ja: 持続する痒みと皮膚の小さな発疹は疥癬（ヒゼンダニ症）の可能性；より早く治す方法とは
triage.triage_reason: 一般向け健康情報記事であり、特定の発生事例やアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、公衆衛生上の異常事態や社会的関心の高まりを示す内容もない。
triage.notes: 記事は疥癬の一般的な症状・治療・予防法を解説する健康啓発記事であり、ブラジルや米国における具体的な発生事例やアウトブレイクを報じるものではない。発生地域フィールドの国も記事主題とは関連がないため verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: WHO says Ebola outbreak in DR Congo remains public health emergency of international concern
article.articleSummary: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo remains a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC) as of 2026-11-18, following a decision by the WHO Emergency Committee. The outbreak has recorded more than 11,300 cases and about 5,500 deaths, with 400–500 new infections reported each week. WHO urges intensified international cooperation and resources to protect communities, health workers, medical facilities, and emergency responders amid ongoing conflict. Updated recommendations for Congo and other countries are expected in the coming days. Two experimental vaccines developed against the Bundibugyo Ebola virus are due to begin phase 2 clinical trials next week in Congo, marking a notable step in countermeasures. The situation underscores persistent risk and the need for rapid public health action.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、DRCのエボラ出血熱流行は引き続き国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態であると発表
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICを継続宣言しており、症例数・死者数が多く、IHR基準の複数（深刻性、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEICを継続認定、累計11,300例超、死者約5,500人、週400-500例の新規感染が継続。紛争下での対応困難、ワクチン治験開始予定あり。既にPHEIC宣言済みのためフルRRAによる最新状況の評価・更新が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Կոնգոյում էբոլայի դեպքերն անցել են 11 500-ը․ մահացել է 5630 մարդ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, Ebola cases have surpassed 11,500; 5,630 people have died.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola virus disease has reached 11,504 laboratory-confirmed infections and 5,630 deaths as of November 16, with 3,142 recoveries. The case fatality rate among confirmed cases is about 48.9%. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo virus and continues to strain the health system. WHO data indicate that six months into the outbreak, 400–500 new cases occur weekly. Ongoing challenges include armed conflict, population displacement, and limited access to care in hard-to-reach areas, hindering control efforts. Some initial hotspots have slowed transmission, but progress remains fragile. International partners emphasize early case detection, contact tracing, and the safety of health workers as essential measures to curb further spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱の症例が11,500人を超え、死者5,630人に達した
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョウイルス）のアウトブレイクが6ヶ月間継続し、症例11,504人・死者5,630人（致死率約48.9%）に達している。武力紛争による対応の困難さと継続的な新規感染（週400〜500例）があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率約49%、武力紛争・住民避難・医療アクセス制限により制御が困難。WHOおよび国際パートナーが早期症例発見・接触者追跡・医療従事者の安全確保を強調しており、国際支援が継続的に必要とされる状況。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox: Secretaria de Saúde intensifica monitoramento com foco na prevenção de casos da doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox: Department of Health intensifies surveillance with a focus on preventing mpox cases.
article.articleSummary: Mpox surveillance in Minas Gerais intensifies to curb cases statewide. The SES-MG trains health teams across 28 regional units, monitors cases, and issues epidemiological bulletins to guide municipalities. Mpox is a compulsory-notification disease; municipalities must report in Sinan within 24 hours. Symptoms include fever, headache, myalgia, fatigue, lymphadenopathy, and skin lesions that may appear on the face, hands, feet, mouth, genitals, and anus, lasting up to four weeks. Transmission occurs via contact with lesions or secretions, sexual contact, respiratory droplets, or shared contaminated objects; incubation 6-21 days. Diagnosis is by laboratory testing of lesion secretions or crusts, with samples sent to Lacen-MG/Funed and labs in Juiz de Fora and Diamantina. From January to November, 42 cases were confirmed in Minas, predominantly men aged 15-34; 2025 had 136 cases, 2024 had 68. Vaccination prioritizes HIV/AIDS patients with immunosuppression (CD4 <200), lab workers, and close contacts, ideally within 4 days of exposure, up to 14 days.

triage.headline_ja: Mpox:保健局がmpox症例予防に焦点を当てた監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ミナスジェライス州における既知の風土病（Mpox）の定例的なサーベイランス強化に関する行政報告であり、症例数も減少傾向にあるため、新規異常事象とは判断されない。
triage.notes: 記事はミナスジェライス州保健局（SES-MG）による既存のMpoxサーベイランス体制強化を伝える定例報告。2025年に136例、2024年に68例に対し2026年1-11月は42例と減少傾向であり、地域医療機関内で管理可能な状況と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Rio intensifica ações contra a dengue diante dos riscos do El Niño
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio de Janeiro Intensifies Actions Against Dengue in Light of El Niño Risks.
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro's Health Secretariat (SMS) will intensify actions against dengue, Zika, and chikungunya in 26 neighborhoods to identify and eliminate Aedes aegypti breeding sites. The districts include Santa Teresa, Catete, Portuguesa, Inhaúma, Riachuelo, Parque Colúmbia, Vila da Penha, Praça Seca, Freguesia (Jacarepaguá), Camorim, Rio das Pedras, Cidade de Deus, Anil, Barra da Tijuca, Recreio dos Bandeirantes, Taquara, Vila Kennedy, Realengo, Senador Camará, Campo Grande, Santíssimo, Ilha de Guaratiba, Cosmos, Paciência, Santa Cruz, Sepetiba. In 2026, chikungunya rose 89.3% to 3,015 (vs 322 in 2025), while dengue fell to 4,067 from 9,254 in 2025. About 75% of breeding sites are inside homes. The initiative stresses resident participation; El Niño may intensify heat and irregular rainfall, boosting transmission risk. Since January, over 10.4 million property inspections were conducted and about 1.4 million potential breeding sites treated or eliminated. Residents can request inspections or report sites via Central 1746.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロ、エルニーニョのリスクを前にデング熱対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・ジカ・チクングニアの通常の季節対策に関する行政の予防的取り組みであり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、チクングニア症例の大幅増加（89.3%）とエルニーニョによる感染リスク上昇の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ブラジル・リオデジャネイロ市の行政によるAedes aegypti対策の定例的な取り組み。チクングニア症例数の大幅増加（322→3,015）とデング熱の減少（9,254→4,067）が報告されているが、重症度・死亡例等の詳細は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : une mission présidentielle à Kisangani pour évaluer la riposte contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: A presidential mission to Kisangani to assess the Ebola response - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 18 November 2026, Kisangani in Tshopo province, north-east Democratic Republic of the Congo, hosts a presidential mission led by President Félix-Antoine Tshisekedi to assess the Ebola virus disease response. The delegation aims to gauge prevention, treatment, and care interventions, identify improvements to strengthen the response, and prevent spread to other provinces. Dr. Didier Baitwapala, mission head, said the objective includes understanding community perception, noting resistance in some areas and low adherence to barrier measures, and to explore strategies to boost awareness and local involvement. The visit also reviews collaboration between state services and NGOs, the status of care facilities, healthcare workers, and prospects for sustaining interventions in affected areas, including Mambasa. Kisangani’s strategic position as a crossroads raises concerns about rapid spread if sanitary controls at entry/exit points relax.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州:エボラ対応を評価するため大統領使節団がキサンガニを訪問 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の流行が継続しており、大統領使節団が対応状況を評価するほど公衆衛生上・政治的関心が高い。他州への拡大懸念もありIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はキサンガニ（チョポ州）における大統領の視察に関するもので、マンバサ地域での対応継続にも言及。地域の防疫体制への不安（入出域管理の緩み）が拡大リスクとして指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue ameaça crescer e exige prevenção, já
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Threatens to Grow and Demands Prevention Now.
article.articleSummary: Dengue remains a growing threat in Brazil, with Fiocruz projecting at least 866,000 cases in 2027. Two years ago Brazil endured its worst outbreak, with about 11 million probable cases and 6,445 deaths. As of November 2026, the Health Ministry reported 502,000 probable cases and 379 deaths nationwide; Minas Gerais state had 67,437 probable cases and 53 deaths (as of Nov 16). Worsening El Niño conditions could raise infections by up to 40% in 2027 by altering rainfall and heat patterns that favor Aedes aegypti. Although a dengue vaccine has been available in the SUS since 2024, coverage remains below target; by October 2026 more than 3 million adolescents had only one dose. LIRAa indicates 49.2% of municipalities at elevated infestation risk. Public and individual actions—vector control, removing standing water, cleaning properties, inspecting water tanks and pools, and keeping vaccination up to date—are essential.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱、拡大の脅威あり、今すぐ予防が必要
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで毎年発生している季節性のデング熱流行に関する社説記事であり、新規性・異常性は低いが、死亡者数・感染者数の規模が大きく、El Niñoによる2027年の感染拡大予測もあるため、今後の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事は社説であり、ブラジルで既に継続中の季節性デング熱流行とワクチン接種率の低さ、El Niñoによる2027年の感染拡大予測について論じている。新規の異常事象ではなく既知の年次流行パターンの延長と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Más de 1.700 niños perdieron la vida por ébola en República Democrática del Congo - teleSUR
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 1,700 children died of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - teleSUR
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed more than 1,700 children and adolescents. From May 15 to November 4, 2026, UNICEF records show 2,959 confirmed infections in those under 18. About 80% of pediatric deaths occurred outside specialized medical centers, highlighting barriers to access, delayed diagnoses, and fragile health infrastructure in North Kivu. In North Kivu, nearly one-quarter of confirmed infections are in children under five. At the Butembo Ebola Treatment Center, 24 of 30 hospitalized children died between June and September, underscoring lethality when care is late. UNICEF and Doctors Without Borders say children have been systematically excluded from clinical trials, vaccination campaigns, and experimental treatments against Bundibugyo virus in recent months. They urge immediate pediatric focus, psychosocial support for orphans, safe school environments, preservation of routine immunization, and equitable access to vaccines and therapies.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラにより1,700人以上の子どもが死亡 - teleSUR
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州でのエボラ(ブンディブギョウイルス)流行により小児を中心に多数の死者・感染者が発生しており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ医療脆弱性・対策不足も指摘されるためフルRRAに進めるべき事案。
triage.notes: UNICEFとMSFが小児への対応不足（臨床試験・ワクチン接種・治療からの除外）を指摘しており、脆弱な医療インフラと高致死率が懸念される。ブンディブギョウイルス（Bundibugyo virus）による流行である点に留意。

United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Especialistas discutem barreira vacinal após avanço do sarampo nas Américas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experts Discuss Immunization Barrier After Measles Spread in the Americas.
article.articleSummary: Measles elimination status in the Americas has been revoked for the United States, following a PAHO/OPAS decision announced on November 17, 2026; Bolivia and Mexico are also affected, with Canada previously holding elimination status. Brazil, which had regained measles-free status in 2024 after losing it in 2019, faces renewed debate on requiring proof of measles vaccination for travelers entering the country from the United States. Experts note that loss of elimination occurs when transmission is sustained for more than 12 months. Since 2024, at least 10 countries have lost elimination status, including Sri Lanka, Armenia, Austria, Azerbaijan, Spain, and the United Kingdom. Vaccination coverage dropped from 83.5% to 81% (2019–2023), with a 40% rise in cases among children under five. In the US, as of last Thursday, 7,701 measles cases and nine deaths were reported by the CDC. Brazilian officials and ethicists debate proportionality and non-discrimination of travel vaccine proof.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家、米州における麻疹拡大後の予防接種障壁について議論
triage.triage_reason: 米州における麻疹排除状態の喪失（米国・ボリビア・メキシコ）とブラジルでの渡航者へのワクチン証明要求を巡る政策論争が報じられており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大・渡航制限）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルの新聞によるもので、米州全体での麻疹排除状態喪失とそれに伴うブラジルの渡航者向けワクチン証明要求の政策論争が主題。対象国リストのうちブラジルのみが記事の主題国として該当し、米国・メキシコ・ボリビア・カナダ等は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Estudo identifica bactérias em amostras de café torrado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Study identifies bacteria in roasted coffee samples.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian coffee study detects bacteria in roasted samples from Campinas, São Paulo. Researchers at the University of Campinas (Unicamp) analyzed 78 roasted coffee samples from 26 products (20 ground coffees and 6 bean coffees) across three production lots, sold in supermarkets in Campinas. Bacteria from nine genera and 18 species were identified, dominated by Bacillus (57.14%) and Staphylococcus (23.21%), with Staphylococcus warneri, Bacillus licheniformis, and Bacillus subtilis among the most frequent species; coliforms were detected in three ground coffee samples. No Salmonella or Escherichia coli were found. In a storage experiment, Staphylococcus epidermidis and Klebsiella pneumoniae remained viable in vacuum-packed coffee at 25°C for up to 42 days. However, conventional preparation with hot water and paper filters prevented recovery of tested microorganisms in the brewed beverage. The study emphasizes hygienic-sanitary controls post-roast, during grinding, handling, and packaging. Journal of Food Science, September 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 焙煎コーヒーのサンプルから細菌を検出した研究
triage.triage_reason: 研究室レベルの食品科学研究であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。大腸菌やサルモネラも検出されておらず、通常の抽出工程で微生物は除去されている。
triage.notes: 本記事は焙煎コーヒーの微生物学的品質に関する学術研究報告であり、ヒトの感染症発生事例を報告するものではない。疾患名（Paratyphoid, E.coli, Typhoid）はBluedotのタグ付けであり、記事内容とは直接関係がない（むしろE.coliやSalmonellaは検出されていない）。

article.articleHeadline: México ya no es un país libre de sarampión: ¿qué pasó? - Alto Nivel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico is no longer a measles-free country: what happened? - Alto Nivel
article.articleSummary: Measles losses: Mexico, the United States, and Bolivia have been stripped of measles-free (endemic transmission-free) status by the Pan American Health Organization after sustained viral transmission for at least 12 months. The decision, announced November 17, 2026, followed an independent technical committee’s review (November 10–13). Mexico saw endemic transmission since February 1, 2025, reaching the 12‑month threshold in February 2026; UNICEF notes the outbreak has affected children aged 1–4 and totals over 13,900 cases in 2026, with 20,701 cases reported 2025–2026 and 14 active cases (12 in Chiapas, 2 in Quintana Roo). The United States recorded over 5,400 cases in 2026, with 96% of cases in unvaccinated or vaccination-status-unknown individuals. Bolivia’s outbreak began in 2025, breaking over two decades of local transmission with more than 100 cases in 2026. Recovery requires interrupting endemic transmission for 12 consecutive months and closing vaccination gaps; Brazil’s 2019 loss and 2024 recovery are cited as precedents. Actions include vaccination and strengthened surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコは麻疹排除国ではなくなった：何が起きたのか？ - Alto Nivel
triage.triage_reason: PAHOがメキシコ・米国・ボリビアの麻疹排除（エンデミック伝播なし）ステータスを剥奪した重大イベントで、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大）に複数該当するためフルRRA検討対象とする。ただし対象国リストには該当国なし。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はメキシコ・米国・ボリビアにおける麻疹排除ステータス喪失であり、ブラジルは2019年喪失・2024年回復の過去事例として言及されているのみで現事象の発生地ではない。対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）のいずれも現事象の発生国に該当しないため verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: DSÖ'den Kongo'daki Ebola salgınına ilişkin açıklama: 'Uluslararası acil durum devam ediyor'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO statement on the Ebola outbreak in Congo: 'The international emergency continues'.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo persists as an international public health emergency, with over 11,300 cases and more than 5,500 deaths reported and hundreds of new infections each week. World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said after the Emergency Committee meeting that the emergency status should be maintained. Weekly new cases run about 400–500. The WHO urged governments and partners to expand the response and mobilize resources to protect communities in the coming months. Amid ongoing armed conflict, protecting health workers, facilities, and rapid-response teams remains critical. Updated guidance for the DRC and other countries is expected in the coming days. Two experimental vaccines developed specifically against Bundibugyo Ebola virus are due to enter Phase II trials in the DRC next week, assessing safety, immunogenicity, and dosing in broader populations.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴのエボラ流行について声明:「国際的緊急事態は継続中」
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEICとして緊急事態の継続を宣言しており、死者5,500人超・週400-500件の新規感染が続く深刻な流行であり、IHR基準の複数該当とフルRRAの必要性が明らか。
triage.notes: WHOにより国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態(PHEIC)として継続認定されており、武力紛争下での対応困難、新規ワクチン臨床試験開始など状況は依然流動的。続報の精査が必要。

article.articleHeadline: കോംഗോയിൽ എബോള മരണം 5,568 ആയി
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola deaths in Congo rise to 5,568.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has produced 11,376 infections and 5,568 deaths as of November 14, with the epidemic officially confirmed on May 15 in the Kantine-Aloy region near Beni, North Kivu. The disease is caused by the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no approved treatment. Despite international donors pledging about $2.9 billion, only $1.3 billion has been received, hampering response. Months of unpaid health workers have driven strikes and hindered control activities. An Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) attack near Beni, about 50 km from the city, killed 33 civilians and forced hundreds to seek safety or treatment at centers. The violence jeopardizes infection-control measures and contact-tracing efforts, with UN Africa CDC and UN officials warning that even identifying and following contacts is highly dangerous amid the outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ死者数5,568人に達する
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（Bundibugyoエボラウイルス）流行が大規模化し致死率も高く、資金不足・武力紛争による対応困難が国際的懸念となっているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 致死率は約49%(5568/11376)と非常に高い。武力紛争（ADF攻撃）により接触者追跡や感染対策が著しく阻害されており、資金不足（誓約額29億ドルのうち13億ドルのみ受領）も深刻な課題となっている。

article.articleHeadline: भोपाळमध्ये पहिली स्वदेशी बर्ड फ्ल्यू लस तयार - पुरोगामी विचाराचे एकमत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First domestically produced avian influenza vaccine developed in Bhopal — consensus among progressive thinkers.
article.articleSummary: India’s National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (NIHSAD) in Bhopal has developed the country’s first domestically produced avian influenza vaccine against H5N1, clade 2.3.2.1. This inactivated vaccine provides six months of protection per dose in chickens, benefiting layers and breeders due to their longer lifespans. Trials showed favorable results in egg-laying and breeding birds, and the vaccine will be used primarily for layer and breeder vaccination. Launch is scheduled for November 20, 2026, by Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan at NIHSAD. Previously, India had no domestic vaccine for this strain, which can cause near 100% mortality and huge economic losses in the poultry sector. Since 2006, India has logged over 500 outbreaks, with estimated losses of ₹2,200–₹3,000 crore. Reducing poultry infection and enforcing biosecurity can lower human risk; WHO reports 1,003 human cases and 479 deaths worldwide since 2003.

triage.headline_ja: ボーパールで国産初の鳥インフルエンザワクチンが開発 ― 進歩的な意見の一致
triage.triage_reason: 新規感染症発生を報告する記事ではなく、インド国産の鳥インフルエンザ(H5N1)ワクチン開発・発売に関するニュースであり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン開発・発売に関する発表であり、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。農業相による発売イベントが予定されているため政府の関心は認められるが、公衆衛生上の緊急シグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Campo Grande investiga 3 casos de sarna humana e suspende aula em Emei
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campo Grande investigates three cases of human scabies and suspends classes at EMEI
article.articleSummary: Three suspected scabies cases are under investigation in Campo Grande, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, with no confirmed outbreak in the capital as of November 18, 2026. The Escola Municipal de Educação Infantil Jasmim Ibrahim Bacha in Bairro Nova Lima suspended activities on Nov 18 for pest-control work; officials have not confirmed that the cases involve students. In 2025, Campo Grande recorded three scabies cases. Scabies is a mite-caused skin disease causing intense nocturnal itching and skin lesions; transmission occurs mainly through prolonged close contact or sharing clothing, towels, or bedding. School suspensions are not automatic and are based on assessments by health and education authorities, preserving children's identities. Symptomatic individuals should seek care at a USF, and close contacts should be evaluated with reinforced hygiene measures. Scabies is not nationally notifiable; in Mato Grosso do Sul, 112 records in Dourados, Itaporã, and Nova Andradina have led to temporary school suspensions.

triage.headline_ja: カンポグランデで疥癬の疑い例3件を調査、市立幼稚園で授業を一時休止
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は軽症で局所的な事例であり、国際的拡大や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められず、社会的関心も限定的なため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 疥癬は届出義務のない軽症皮膚疾患で、学校での一時的な休校措置はあるが感染症危機管理上の優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil mantém eliminação do sarampo após avanço da doença em países das Américas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil maintains measles elimination after the disease's spread in countries across the Americas.
article.articleSummary: Brazil maintains measles elimination status, recognized by the Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) after vaccination and surveillance efforts. In the Americas, Bolivia, Mexico, and the United States lost elimination status in 2026 after 12 months of transmission, with the United States reporting over 5,000 measles cases and six deaths in 2026 among unvaccinated people. Brazil logged 70 laboratory-confirmed measles cases in 2026, linked to importations and concentrated in São Paulo (35), Tabatinga (9), Benjamin Constant (7), Atalaia do Norte (6), São Paulo de Olivença (4), and Rio Branco (2). Health authorities conduct active case finding, epidemiological investigations, contact tracing, and vaccination blocking. The measles vaccine (MMR) is two-dose at 12 and 15 months, with free vaccination for those up to 59 years who are not vaccinated. A dose-zero strategy was used in select areas for infants 6–11 months, including parts of São Paulo and Amazonas and other states.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、アメリカ大陸諸国での麻疹拡大後も麻疹排除状態を維持
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルは麻疹排除状態を維持しているが、輸入症例による70例の確認症例があり、米州地域全体での麻疹拡大・排除地位喪失という状況は注視が必要なため。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルの麻疹排除状態維持が主題。米国・ボリビア・メキシコでの排除地位喪失にも言及しているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれない。ブラジル国内の症例は輸入関連で、公衆衛生対応（接触者追跡、ワクチン接種強化等）が行われている。

article.articleHeadline: Nova variante da Covid-19 está a espalhar-se e já chegou à Europa. O que se sabe?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new variant of COVID-19 is spreading and has already reached Europe. What is known?
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 variant PJ.2.1, first identified in Canada in May, has spread to Europe (Spain — Catalonia, Basque Country, Madrid region; France; Netherlands) and is reported in the United States, Australia, New Zealand, Israel and Brazil. Described as a saltation variant, PJ.2.1 carries numerous spike protein mutations that may enhance entry into human cells and transmission. Symptoms align with other COVID-19 variants and resemble influenza-like illness: fever, cough, sore throat, nasal congestion, myalgias, fatigue, headaches, chills, appetite loss, and altered taste or smell; rare cases include shortness of breath, hearing loss, skin changes, foot lesions, persistent hiccups, and brain fog. No evidence yet of increased severity; data on hospitalization and mortality remain limited. Updated LP.8.1 vaccines neutralize PJ.2.1, with antibody effectiveness about 1.8-fold lower than against LP.8.1, and less reduction than for other variants. As of 2026-11-18.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルスの新変異株が拡大、すでに欧州にも到達。何がわかっているか？
triage.triage_reason: 新変異株PJ.2.1が複数国に拡大しているが重症度増加の証拠はなく、対象国（ブラジル）での発生は確認されるものの詳細情報が不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は主にヨーロッパ・北米・オセアニアでの拡大を報じており、ブラジルは感染確認国の一つとして言及されているのみで詳細情報はない。重症度増加の証拠はないとされるが、多数のスパイク変異を有する点で監視継続が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo-Kinshasa: Över 5 000 döda i ebola och hungerkris
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Over 5,000 dead in Ebola and hunger crisis.
article.articleSummary: As of 18 November 2026, the Ebola outbreak in Kongo Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of Congo, has killed more than 5,000 people. The United Nations reports that containment measures intended to slow transmission have severely disrupted local food supplies, with farmers and traders hindered from working. To curb spread, authorities have banned travel between certain villages and restricted fishing, deepening a hunger crisis. Residents face a stark dilemma: go hungry or risk infection by violating restrictions. The report underscores the intertwined humanitarian impact of the ongoing outbreak and the public health measures in the affected region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ（キンシャサ）：エボラ出血熱と飢餓危機で5,000人以上死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱による5,000人超の死亡という重大な公衆衛生インパクトがあり、渡航制限や食料危機など複合的な人道危機を伴うため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 死者数5,000人超という規模は非常に大きく、国連報告による食料危機との複合災害化が進行中。継続的なモニタリングと国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Malária registra 3.959 casos em Porto Velho em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria Records 3,959 Cases in Porto Velho in 2026
article.articleSummary: Porto Velho, Brazil, reported 3,959 malaria cases from January 1 to November 13, 2026, up from 3,762 in the same period in 2025 (an increase of 197, about 5.2%). A total of 41,212 diagnostic tests were performed this year. Five localities recorded the highest case counts, underscoring ongoing transmission in urban, rural, and riverine communities. Malaria is transmitted by female Anopheles mosquitoes; common symptoms include fever, chills, headache, heavy sweating, and body aches. Health authorities urge prompt medical care at the first signs, as early diagnosis enables appropriate treatment and lowers complication risk. Notably, 21 malaria cases were detected among pregnant women in 2026, from 1,395 tests in this group, highlighting prenatal risk and the need for monitoring. Diagnosis and treatment are provided free by SUS. Semusa continues surveillance, testing, and patient follow-up in Porto Velho; authorities urge avoidance of self-medication and timely exams.

triage.headline_ja: ポルトベーリョで2026年にマラリア3,959例を記録
triage.triage_reason: マラリアはブラジル・ロンドニア州における既知の地域流行病であり、前年比5.2%増と大きな変化はなく、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 地域の風土病としての定期報告であり、症例数の増加は軽微。保健当局(Semusa)による通常のサーベイランス活動の一環と見られる。

article.articleHeadline: Aparecida de Goiânia emite alerta após aumento de 33% nos casos de meningite - Brazil Urgente
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Aparecida de Goiânia issues an alert after a 33% increase in meningitis cases - Brazil Urgente
article.articleSummary: Aparecida de Goiânia, Brazil, issued an epidemiological alert after a 33% rise in confirmed meningitis cases. By 2026-11-18, the city had 20 confirmed meningitis cases in 2026, up from 15 in all of 2025. Pneumococcal meningitis (Streptococcus pneumoniae) was the most common form in both periods. Meningitis can progress rapidly, causing serious complications, sequelae, and death. Vaccination is the main prevention. The alert was sent to public and private health facilities, including hospitals, UPAs, CAIS, and UBSs, to reinforce surveillance, early case identification, and immediate prevention and control. People with suspected meningitis should seek care promptly, ideally at a Unidade Básica de Saúde; more severe cases should go to a UPA or CAIS.

triage.headline_ja: アパレシーダ・デ・ゴイアニア、髄膜炎症例33%増加を受けて警戒を発令 - Brazil Urgente
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル一都市での髄膜炎（主に肺炎球菌性）症例の増加だが、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はなく、小規模な地域的事象であるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 肺炎球菌性髄膜炎は一般にヒト-ヒト感染が限定的であり、ワクチンで予防可能。市の保健当局が監視強化を実施中で、現時点では地域内対応可能な事象と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Secretaria confirma 2º caso de mpox em Mato Grosso do Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: State Health Secretariat Confirms 2nd mpox Case in Mato Grosso do Sul.
article.articleSummary: As of 18 November 2026, Mato Grosso do Sul confirms a second mpox case, diagnosed on 17 November; patient is clinically stable and in isolation. The year’s total confirms rise to two, with 27 discarded and two suspected under investigation. The first case, reported in September in Campo Grande, involved a man aged 41–49 living with HIV who had traveled to Rio de Janeiro and did not require hospitalization. A Haitian child in São Gabriel do Oeste had a suspected case that tested negative. Laboratory confirmation occurs at Lacen/MS, with positive samples sent to Fiocruz for viral genotyping. Vaccination: Brazil’s Health Ministry announced 25,000 doses, expected in ~3 weeks; 3,650 doses have been distributed to nine states (e.g., Rio de Janeiro, Ceará, Distrito Federal); MS’s receipt not detailed. Vaccination targets high-risk groups; two-dose schedule (28 days) at reference centers. Mpox transmission mainly sexual and close contact; symptoms include fever, lymphadenopathy, and vesicular rash resembling varicella.

triage.headline_ja: 州保健局、マット・グロッソ・ド・スルで2例目のmpox症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: 州内でmpox症例数が少数（2例）にとどまり重症例・死亡の報告もないが、ワクチン配布状況や今後の症例推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ブラジル保健省による全国的なワクチン配布（25,000回分）が言及されており、国レベルでの対応が進行中。マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州では症例数が少なく、患者は安定しており隔離中。

article.articleHeadline: BH tem 26 casos de mpox em 2026 e amplia vacinação. Saiba quem pode se vacinar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Belo Horizonte has 26 mpox cases in 2026 and expands vaccination. Find out who can get vaccinated.
article.articleSummary: Belo Horizonte, Brazil reports 26 mpox cases in 2026 and is expanding vaccination from Nov 19 after the Ministry of Health sent 200 doses. Initially, vaccination targets people living with HIV/AIDS with CD4 counts below 100 cells/mm³; from Nov 19 eligibility extends to HIV/AIDS patients with CD4 under 200, PrEP users, and laboratory technicians who handle mpox samples. From Nov 30, vaccination opens to all people living with HIV/AIDS regardless of CD4. Nationally, Brazil had 1,023 mpox cases in 2026 with one death as of Nov 12, up from 73 to 179 in three weeks. Vaccination sites in Belo Horizonte include Hospital Eduardo de Menezes; URS Centro-Sul / Travel Health Service; CTA SAE Sagrada Família; CTR Orestes Diniz; and Crie (serving private patients, SAE Unifenas, PrEP users, and lab staff). PrEP patients vaccinating at a different unit must show proof of use. Mpox is Monkeypox, causing skin lesions and flu-like symptoms, spreading person-to-person; details on addresses/hours are on the city portal.

triage.headline_ja: ベロオリゾンテ市、2026年にMpox症例26件、ワクチン接種を拡大。接種対象者を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでMpox症例が全国的に増加傾向（3週間で73→179件）にあり、ワクチン接種対象を拡大する動きがあるが、重篤度や国際的拡大の明確な根拠はなく、既知の流行病原体に対する継続的な公衆衛生対応として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はベロオリゾンテ市のワクチン接種拡大に関する地方行政ニュースであり、全国的な症例増加傾向（73→179件/3週間）は注視すべき情報。HIV陽性者やPrEP利用者など脆弱層への接種拡大が中心的内容。

article.articleHeadline: Doença altamente contagiosa: uma pessoa com sarampo pode infectar outras 18; baixa vacinação preocupa especialistas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Highly contagious disease: one person with measles can infect 18 others; low vaccination coverage concerns experts.
article.articleSummary: Measles remains highly transmissible: one infected person can spread to up to 18 susceptible individuals. In Brazil, first-dose coverage reaches about 94.66% of children under one (Jan–Aug 2026), but second-dose coverage trails at 79.78%, with about 3,589 municipalities (nearly 65%) under 95%. National case load rose 71% year-over-year, with São Paulo and Amazonas accounting for 95% of notifications. In the Americas, 57,666 confirmed cases and 81 deaths across 17 countries/territories in 2026 make it the worst year since 2004. Guatemala reports the region’s largest outbreak (34,748 cases, 53 deaths); the United States has lost measles-free status after 12 months of continuous transmission; Mexico is under review for elimination. The situation underscores that two-dose vaccination and strong surveillance are needed to prevent importations and new transmission chains.

triage.headline_ja: 高い感染力を持つ疾患：麻疹感染者1人が最大18人に感染させる可能性；低いワクチン接種率に専門家が懸念
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで麻疹症例が前年比71%増加し、ワクチン接種率（特に2回目接種）が目標を下回る自治体が約65%に達するなど、地域全体で麻疹の再興が進行しており、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル（サンパウロ州・アマゾナス州が全国症例の95%を占める）を主題とし、米州全体（グアテマラ、米国、メキシコ等）の麻疹流行状況も言及しているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de dengue caem 91% em Curitiba; Prefeitura mantém mutirões até dezembro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue cases fall 91% in Curitiba; City Hall maintains mass dengue-control campaigns until December.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Curitiba, Brazil, continues to decline: after a 2024 peak of 17,762 cases (971/100,000), 2025 confirmed dengue fell to 1,575 (down 91%), and by November 18, 2026, the city had 180 cases (10/100,000). To sustain control, the City Hall’s Curitiba sem Mosquito mutirão runs through December, with outreach in the Boqueirão and Boa Vista regional areas. Health agents are visiting Eucaliptos Health Unit in Alto Boqueirão and Vila Esperança in Atuba (16–19 November), advising residents on dengue prevention. Recyclables, tires (up to two) and up to 1 m3 of bundled yard waste may be collected on scheduled days: 24 November (Eucaliptos area) and 26 November (Vila Esperança area). The program, plus releases of Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti, aims to reduce transmission of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya.

triage.headline_ja: クリチバでデング熱症例が91%減少;市は12月まで集中対策活動を継続
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例は大幅に減少しており、市の通常の予防活動を報じる内容で、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はクリチバ市のデング熱症例が前年比91%減少したことと、12月まで続く蚊対策活動（Wolbachia感染蚊の放出含む）を報じる定例的な公衆衛生広報記事であり、新たなアウトブレイクやリスク増大を示す内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : évaluation de la riposte nationale contre Ebola, le choléra et la rougeole - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: evaluation of the national response to Ebola, cholera and measles - ACP
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, 18 November 2026 — The Democratic Republic of Congo’s National Institute of Public Health (INSP) held a weekly multisectoral coordination meeting to evaluate the national epidemiological situation and interventions against Ebola, cholera and measles. Ebola: 11,376 cumulative cases as of 15 November 2026, with 3,033 recoveries and about 1,000 active cases in treatment centres and transit sites, across eight provinces and 68 health zones; case fatality stands at 48.6%. Contact tracing improved from 69% to 83% in one week, but deeper analyses are required on fluctuations, community deaths, and positives among contacts. An intra-action review from Kisangani should be finalized and shared to accelerate improvements. Vaccination supply is a priority to sustain campaigns and research. Cholera: 1,577 cases and 33 deaths in Week 45; World Bank support will deploy teams to ten provinces; preventive vaccination continues in Equateur, Mai-Ndombe and Kinshasa, with North and South Kivu bearing ~50% of cases. Measles emphasizes resilience and transition to routine services.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：エボラ、コレラ、はしかに対する国家対応の評価 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ累計11,376例・致死率48.6%という深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威が継続しており、コレラ・はしかも併発する複合的な公衆衛生危機であるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にEcuadorが含まれているが記事内容と無関係であり、対象国リストにも含まれないため除外。本記事はDRC国内のエボラ・コレラ・はしかに関する国家対応評価会合の報告であり、エボラの致死率の高さと感染規模から継続監視・フル評価が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: River Connectivity Restructures Mpox Transmission Risk Across Rural
article.articleSummary: Mpox incidence forecasts in Maï-Ndombe province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, improve when models incorporate multimodal river-road connectivity, but provincial-scale fit declines. In a 2022–2025 study published in the International Journal of Health Geographics, researchers integrated environmental friction surfaces with inter-zone interaction and a metapopulation S-E-I-R framework to quantify how riverways and sparse roads shape Mpox spread. Using a Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process to derive barrier weights, dense forest and water emerge as dominant friction barriers (0.31 each), followed by hydromorphic zones (0.15), slope (0.12), forest mosaics (0.091), and savanna (0.053). Travel speeds of 30–50 km/h on roads and 5–10 km/h on navigable waterways feed a least-cost path and an enhanced gravity model, with origin zones (<50,000) seeding transmission to destinations (>50,000). Baseline transmission rate 0.4695; Monte Carlo simulations quantified diagnostic/reporting uncertainties. Findings show epidemic trajectories are conditioned by asymmetric connectivity rather than uniform spread.

triage.headline_ja: 河川の連結性がコンゴ民主共和国農村部におけるMpox感染リスクを再構築する
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はMaï-Ndombe州における過去（2022-2025年）のMpox伝播モデルに関する学術研究の紹介であり、新規の発生事例や公衆衛生上の緊急事態の報告ではないため。
triage.notes: 記事は学術誌International Journal of Health Geographicsに掲載された数理モデル研究の紹介記事であり、具体的な症例数や新規アウトブレイクの報告は含まれていない。DRCはMpoxの既知流行国であり、本記事単独でシグナルとして扱う根拠は乏しい。

article.articleHeadline: Uso de antibiótico sem receita: especialistas alertam para bactérias resistentes no Paraná
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Use of antibiotics without a prescription: experts warn about antibiotic-resistant bacteria in Paraná.
article.articleSummary: Paraná, Brazil — Experts warn that taking antibiotics without a prescription or stopping treatment early fuels antibiotic resistance and the emergence of 'superbugs.' The alert comes ahead of World Antibiotic Awareness Week, coordinated by the UN and WHO. The Paraná State Health Secretariat (Sesa) and the Regional Medical Council (CRM-PR) say self-medication can delay diagnosis, cause serious adverse reactions, and mask symptoms, underscoring the need for professional evaluation before antibiotics. Incorrect use—such as wrong dosing, skipping doses, or using antibiotics for viral infections like influenza or colds—can allow susceptible bacteria to be eliminated while resistant strains thrive, potentially requiring more toxic drugs. Disbiosis and allergic reactions are additional risks. In Paraná, pharmacies are routinely inspected, and the National Prescription Control System (SNCR) tracks controlled medications to strengthen oversight and promote electronic prescribing.

triage.headline_ja: 処方箋なしの抗生物質使用:専門家がパラナ州での耐性菌について警告
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、抗生物質耐性に関する一般的な啓発記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はインフルエンザや風邪に対する不適切な抗生物質使用と薬剤耐性菌出現の一般的な啓発キャンペーン(世界抗生物質啓発週間)に関するものであり、具体的な感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とする。

article.articleHeadline: Bahia recebe 500 doses de vacina contra mpox em meio ao avanço da doença no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bahia receives 500 doses of mpox vaccine amid the spread of the disease in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) vaccines in Brazil: Bahia will receive 500 doses in November as part of the Health Ministry’s effort to bolster protection for priority groups amid the disease’s spread. Nationwide, 1,055 mpox cases have been confirmed. The Health Ministry, via the Pan American Health Organization Revolving Fund, secured 25,000 doses of the only mpox vaccine. In addition to Bahia, Rio de Janeiro gets 2,000 doses; Ceará 400; Piauí 300; Paraná 250; and the Federal District, Paraíba, Amapá, and Goiás each 100 doses. Distributions follow requests from state health secretaries to support municipal rollout. Vaccination targets groups most vulnerable to infection or severe disease, including people living with HIV/AIDS with greater immune compromise, PrEP users, laboratory workers exposed to the virus, and individuals with medium or high-risk exposure to suspected or confirmed mpox cases, assessed by health services.

triage.headline_ja: バイアはブラジル国内でのmpox感染拡大の中、mpoxワクチン500回分を受領
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのmpox感染拡大は既知の継続的流行であり、本記事はワクチン配布という行政対応の進捗報告に留まるため、新規の異常事態とは言えないが、感染拡大の動向は引き続き注視が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジル国内で1,055例のmpox感染が確認されており、PAHOの支援を受けてワクチン配布が進められている。HIV陽性者など免疫不全者が優先接種対象。既存の流行事案のフォローアップ記事であり、新規シグナルとしての緊急性は高くないが、感染者数の推移やワクチン効果について継続的な監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Kisangani : annonce d'un projet d'appui aux ménages affectés par l'épidémie - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Kisangani: Announcement of a project to support households affected by the outbreak - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Kisangani, Democratic Republic of the Congo: In Kisangani, capital of Tshopo province in the northeast, the NGO Stars-RDC announced a project to support households affected by the Ebola virus disease outbreak. The program emphasizes income-generating activities to revitalize vulnerable families and prevent further socioeconomic deterioration, especially where a breadwinner has died or daily farming/work has been interrupted. Professor Jules Lwamba, Stars-RDC focal point, said the initiative will also strengthen community awareness and adherence to prevention measures, by assisting the Provincial Health Division (DPS) to publicize guidance and coordinate with other humanitarian actors. Initially launched in Bas-Uele and Haut-Uele provinces, the intervention has been extended to Tshopo due to the health emergency. Official launch of activities is planned for next week, highlighting intensified collaboration between authorities and development partners.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニのエボラ出血熱：流行で被害を受けた世帯支援プロジェクトの発表 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行がバスウエレ・オートウエレ州からチョポ州（キサンガニ）へ拡大しており、重症度・社会的影響・国際支援の必要性が確認されるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ流行の継続・新規州（チョポ州）への拡大を示す支援プロジェクト発表であり、既存アウトブレイクの悪化・拡大を示唆するためPICKUPと判断。具体的な感染者数・死亡者数・国際伝播の有無は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : 109 cas confirmés et 48 décès d'Ebola enregistrés au 18 novembre - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: 109 confirmed cases and 48 Ebola deaths recorded as of November 18 - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 18 November 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo's Tshopo Province (Kisangani) reported 109 confirmed Ebola cases, 48 deaths, 48 recoveries, and 4 active infections, yielding a 44% case fatality rate. Seven of the province's 23 health zones are affected. The provincial health division (DPS) announced the tally during an evaluation meeting at the governorate in Kisangani, presented by Dr. Bay Lisongomi, acting head of the division. With the outbreak persisting, authorities call for sustained epidemiological surveillance, rapid identification of suspected cases, and rigorous contact tracing to interrupt transmission chains and prevent new contamination. Emphasis is also placed on proper clinical management for the four currently hospitalized patients. The DPS notes that community mobilization, strict adherence to barrier measures, and continued collaboration with health service providers are essential to halt the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州:11月18日時点でエボラ出血熱の確定症例109件、死亡48人を記録 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱の確定症例109件・死亡48人（致死率44%）が報告され、複数の保健地区に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 7/23の保健地区に拡大しており、致死率44%と高い。継続的なサーベイランスと接触者追跡が呼びかけられている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Beni : distribution de dispositifs de prévention dans les services et lieux publics - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Beni: Distribution of Prevention Measures in Health Facilities and Public Places - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, specifically the Beni health zone, with 11 laboratory-confirmed cases out of 36 total notified as of 17 November 2026. In Beni city, a philanthropic initiative distributed Ebola prevention materials—hand-washing kits and disinfectants—to health facilities and public places in Mulekera and other districts to reinforce barrier measures amid the 17th Ebola epidemic in the province. The action was led by Papy Bulere Lwanzo Muyisa, who emphasized supporting the health response during a period of cross-border and economic disruption. Local authorities, including bourgmestre Dieudonné Ngongo Mayanga, welcomed the effort and called for broader community involvement. The report also notes ongoing cross-border trade impacts and security concerns related to ADF violence.

triage.headline_ja: ベニにおけるエボラ出血熱：保健施設や公共の場での予防用具の配布 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州ベニ保健地区で検査確定11例を含む36例が報告されているエボラ出血熱の進行中のアウトブレイク（同州17回目の流行）であり、重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威かつヒト-ヒト感染のリスクが高いため。
triage.notes: ADFによる治安不安や越境貿易への影響も報告されており、感染拡大や対応の複雑化が懸念される。フルリスク評価（RRA）への移行を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Porto Alegre realiza censo de cães e gatos contra doença transmissível a humanos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Porto Alegre carries out a census of dogs and cats to combat a disease transmissible to humans
article.articleSummary: Esporotrichosis (sporotrichosis), a fungal disease that primarily affects cats and can be transmitted to humans, is prompting Porto Alegre to launch Censo Pet to estimate dog and cat populations, evaluate sterilization programs, and investigate feline sporotrichosis prevalence. State data show 2,510 animals notified with the disease across Rio Grande do Sul in 2026, with 1,465 human cases confirmed. In Porto Alegre, 142 feline cases have been reported; Canoas 156; Guaíba more than 300 cats positive. The fungus often resides in claws and spreads via scratches or bites. The census uses home visits by trained field teams, screening cats, collecting samples when indicated, and aims to conduct about 7,000 interviews across all city regions from 8:30 to 17:30 until February, with results expected within a year. 2023 city estimates were 533,873 dogs and 281,532 cats.

triage.headline_ja: ポルト・アレグレ市、人に感染しうる疾患対策のため犬猫の国勢調査を実施
triage.triage_reason: リオグランデ・ド・スル州で猫由来のスポロトリコーシスが1,465人のヒト感染例を伴い継続しており、行政が大規模な動物調査に乗り出すなど社会的・行政的関心が高まっているため。
triage.notes: スポロトリコーシスはブラジルで既知の人獣共通感染症であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、州内での症例数の多さと行政の積極的対応（Censo Pet）から継続的な動向把握が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Rio amplia vacinação contra mpox após 1ª morte confirmada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio de Janeiro expands mpox vaccination after the first confirmed death.
article.articleSummary: Rio de Janeiro expands mpox vaccination to PrEP users who have never been vaccinated, with a six-month medical report. The expansion follows the city’s first mpox death in 2026, in an immunosuppressed patient. Vaccination starts Tuesday, November 17, 2026, while supplies last; the city has 5,000 doses from the Ministry of Health. The program also targets people living with HIV/AIDS at higher risk; adults 18+ with CD4 counts under 200 cells/mm³ remain eligible. Two-dose schedule with a 28-day interval; not part of the routine National Immunization Program. Vaccination sites include Botafogo, Zona Norte, Zona Oeste, CEVAA, and CRIE/INI Fiocruz. Rio has 297 mpox cases and 1 death in 2026; São Paulo leads with 409; transmission is mainly via contact with lesions.

triage.headline_ja: リオデジャネイロ、mpox初の死亡確認後にワクチン接種を拡大
triage.triage_reason: リオデジャネイロで2026年のmpox初の死亡例が確認され、ワクチン接種対象を拡大しており、HIV感染者等への流行しやすさや社会的関心の高まりが見られるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: リオデジャネイロとサンパウロでmpox症例が継続的に報告されており（リオ297例・1死亡、サンパウロ409例）、HIV陽性者やPrEP利用者を対象としたワクチン接種拡大が行われている。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候は記事内に見られない。

article.articleHeadline: പക്ഷിപ്പനി: 18,620 വളർത്തുപക്ഷികളെ നശിപ്പിച്ചു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu: 18,620 domestic poultry destroyed.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza outbreak in Alappuzha district, Kerala, led to destruction of 18,620 domestic poultry within 1 km containment zones around outbreak centers in Amappuzha North and Chennaithal-Tripunthur panchayats. Total culled: 7,331 birds at Amappuzha North and 11,289 at Chennaithal-Tripunthur. A rapid response team—including a doctor, two live-stock inspectors, two attendants, and four workers—carried out culling and burning of culled birds, with eggs and byproducts also destroyed. In Amappuzha North, figures include 1,636 large hens, 5,225 small hens, 447 ducks, and 3 roosters, along with 40 eggs. In Amblappuzha South, 20 birds were culled. In Chennaithal-Tripunthur, 235 hens, 586 roosters, 10,468 rooster chicks, and 28,000 eggs were destroyed. The article documents outbreak containment actions without detailing the infection source or laboratory confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ：18,620羽の家禽を殺処分
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州で家禽の鳥インフルエンザ発生に伴う殺処分が実施されたが、人への感染例や検査確定情報は記載されておらず、現時点では動物衛生上の封じ込め対応にとどまる。
triage.notes: 人への感染例の報告はなく、家禽における鳥インフルエンザ発生と防疫対応（殺処分・焼却）の記録。ウイルス株（H5N1等）の確認情報は記載なし。今後の人獣共通感染リスクのモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Morte de adolescente de 13 anos por dengue é a oitava registrada em Pernambuco em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death of a 13-year-old due to dengue is the eighth registered in Pernambuco in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Eight dengue deaths in Pernambuco in 2026, including a 13-year-old boy from Limoeiro (Agreste) who died August 14; confirmation released November 18 by SES-PE in Arboviroses Bulletin No. 45, with data through November 14. The state records 55,119 dengue cases this year: 24,387 probable, 13,673 confirmed, and 746 severe dengue; 39 deaths have been discarded; one confirmed death is alóctone (infection and death outside Pernambuco). Incidence distribution spans 86 municipalities with low, 51 medium, and 45 high. Recife leads with 3,810 probable cases; Jaboatão dos Guararapes has 3,389. Interior hotspots include Terra Nova at 3,618.2/100k; Petrolândia 3,453.9; Passira 2,901.4. Chikungunya totals reach 7,955 (2,435 probable, 462 confirmed; no deaths). Zika has 1,454 notifications (118 probable; no confirmed), including 19 pregnant women. Prevention emphasizes eliminating Aedes aegypti breeding sites.

triage.headline_ja: 13歳のデング熱による死亡、2026年ペルナンブコ州で8例目として登録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ペルナンブコ州でデング熱の流行が継続し死亡例も発生しているが、ブラジルの風土病的な季節性流行であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため、経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルで毎年流行する風土病であり、州保健局(SES-PE)が定期的にモニタリング・報告を行っている。症例数・死亡者数は多いが、既存の公衆衛生対応の枠内と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Centre proposes mandatory six-day quarantine for unvaccinated passengers from yellow fever-risk countries
article.articleSummary: India proposes a mandatory six-day quarantine for passengers arriving from yellow fever–risk countries who lack a valid yellow fever vaccination certificate. The list covers 29 African nations and 13 Central/South American countries, with Uganda, Ethiopia, Nigeria, Ghana, Burundi, Kenya and Venezuela among those named. The draft Indian Aircraft Rules (Public Health), 2026, will replace the Indian Aircraft Health Rules, 1954. It states vaccination against yellow fever shall be required for travelers leaving areas where WHO has determined a risk of transmission; holders of valid certificates will not be treated as suspects. Quarantine would occur at designated facilities, with passenger costs for quarantine and airlines for transport. The draft also mandates licensing of airport food outlets/health kitchens under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, and empowers airport health officers to seek health documents and travel history. Public comments are due within one month, with submissions to the Civil Aviation Ministry.

triage.headline_ja: インド政府、黄熱病リスク国からの未接種者に対し強制6日間検疫を提案
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はインドが黄熱病リスク国からの渡航者に対する検疫規則案を提案したという行政・政策ニュースであり、実際の黄熱病アウトブレイクや新規感染事例の報告ではないため、シグナルとしての重要性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はインドの民間航空省による検疫規則案（渡航者健康管理政策）に関するもので、特定国での黄熱病の新規発生や流行拡大を報じるものではない。挙げられたアフリカ・中南米諸国は『リスク国』として一般的に列挙されているのみで、具体的な発生事例の記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: Haut-Uele : plaidoyer pour le renforcement des équipes et matériels anti-Ebola à Rungu - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Upper-Uele: Advocacy for Strengthening Teams and Ebola Response Equipment in Rungu - ACP
article.articleSummary: Upper-Uele Ebola response reinforced: In the Rungu health zone of Haut-Uele, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, interim Territorial Administrator Marguerite Anzoka urged authorities to bolster Ebola response by providing more health teams and essential supplies (inputs) to advance the outbreak response. She stressed that some community members still doubt the disease’s reality and warned that funerary practices ignoring safety measures fuel transmission. The call emphasized strict adherence to health directives and protective measures. Anzoka highlighted ongoing collaboration with traditional authorities, local chiefs, and village leaders to pool efforts and intensify control of the epidemic. She thanked provincial authorities for their commitment and noted effective sensitization efforts since the outbreak declaration, with messages disseminated rapidly to the population to eradicate the epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: オート・ウエレ州：ルング地区でのエボラ対応チーム・資機材強化を求める訴え - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱の既存アウトブレイクが継続しており、地域行政から対応強化の訴えが出ている。公衆衛生への深刻な影響とヒト-ヒト感染リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 既存のエボラアウトブレイクに関する継続報道。コミュニティの疾病否定や危険な葬儀慣行が感染拡大リスクを高めている点に注意。地方行政からの支援要請があり、外部支援の必要性が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : une mission provinciale annoncée pour relancer la riposte contre Ebola à Bafwasende - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: a provincial mission announced to relaunch the Ebola response in Bafwasende - ACP
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Tshopo province, authorities plan a provincial mission to relaunch Ebola response activities in Bafwasende, about 264 km east of Kisangani. The Ebola program was suspended after violence led to the death of a nurse on October 24 and attacks on health facilities, prompting withdrawal of providers and humanitarian partners. This disruption weakened epidemiological surveillance, case detection, and community outreach amid rumors and misinformation about Ebola. Dr. Bay Lisongomi, interim provincial health division head, said the mission will bring health and politico-administrative leaders together to restore operations by securing community engagement and trust. Objectives include enhancing collaboration between authorities and communities, facilitating the return of health workers, and promoting acceptance of prevention and control measures. Reinstatement of activities depends on improved security and sustained community commitment.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州：バフワセンデでエボラ対応を再開するための州派遣団が発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ対応が暴力により中断し、サーベイランス・症例検出が弱体化している。ヒト-ヒト感染リスクのある既知の重篤感染症であり、国際的拡大・渡航貿易制限のリスクも伴うためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 暴力事件（看護師死亡、医療施設への攻撃）により医療従事者・人道支援パートナーが撤退し、エボラ対応が中断。治安改善とコミュニティの協力が再開の前提条件とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Palmas mantém vigilância e orienta população sobre a mpox - O Jornal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Palmas maintains surveillance and guides the public about mpox
article.articleSummary: Palmas, Brazil, maintains mpox surveillance as nationwide activity rises. The capital has had no confirmed mpox cases since 2022, yet Brazil reports 1,170 confirmed mpox cases in 2026 with one death in Rio de Janeiro. Among Tocantins' neighbors, Maranhão has 12 cases; Goiás and Bahia 8 each; Pará 6; Piauí 1; Mato Grosso none; Distrito Federal 46 this year. Proximity to Tocantins and direct flights to Brasília keep Semus alert; officials urge prevention: avoid contact with objects, clothing, or utensils used by someone with mpox; transmission can occur via skin contact, kissing, sex, and sweat. Symptoms include skin lesions, fever, lymphadenopathy, headache, myalgias, chills, weakness. Most cases are mild/moderate; recovery in 2–4 weeks; severe in immunosuppressed. Vaccination: 25,000 doses via OPAS Revolving Fund; storage at -20°C, use within 4 weeks after thaw. WHO guidance: no mass vaccination; targeted groups include HIV patients with CD4 <100, two-dose regimen 28 days apart.

triage.headline_ja: パルマス市、Mpoxに関する住民への情報提供と監視体制を継続
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル全土でMpox症例が継続的に報告されているが、本記事は地方自治体の既存監視体制継続・注意喚起に関するルーティン報告であり、新規の異常事態や急激な拡大は確認されない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル国内（特にトカンチンス州パルマス市）における既存のMpoxサーベイランス継続と予防啓発に関する内容。2026年時点で全国1,170例・死亡1例が報告されているが、本記事自体は新規の異常発生を示すものではなく、HIV患者等高リスク群への的を絞ったワクチン接種方針も既存のWHOガイダンスに沿ったもの。

article.articleHeadline: prevenção à dengue em São José da Barra - Jornal Panorama
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue prevention in São José da Barra - Panorama Newspaper
article.articleSummary: 18 November 2026 — In São José da Barra, Brazil, dengue prevention was led by the municipal health department. Workers in the Works Sector participated in an awareness activity organized by the Prefeitura through the Secretaria Municipal de Saúde. A team from the endemic disease control unit instructed attendees on eliminating Aedes aegypti breeding sites and adopting preventive measures to avert dengue transmission. The session, part of the Health at Work program, brought prevention guidance into the workplace and daily routines, emphasizing the identification and removal of potential mosquito habitats. Workers were encouraged to participate in locating vector sources at work and at home to reduce proliferation. No case counts or laboratory confirmations are mentioned in the article; the emphasis is educational outreach to mitigate dengue risk.

triage.headline_ja: サンジョゼ・ダ・バラでデング熱予防活動 - パノラマ新聞
triage.triage_reason: 症例数や発生状況の報告はなく、単なる教育的予防啓発活動の記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常性や緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は症例報告ではなく、自治体による予防啓発活動（職場での蚊の発生源対策）に関する内容。
