article.articleHeadline: دراسة مجهولة تفجر الجدل.. إدارة ترامب تطالب بالتحقيق في تسريب فيروس كوفيد-19 | القاهرة الاخبارية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unknown study sparks controversy... The Trump administration calls for an investigation into the leak of the COVID-19 virus | Cairo News
article.articleSummary: Controversy over the origins of SARS-CoV-2 centers on the March 2020 Nature Medicine paper The Proximal Origin of SARS-CoV-2, which argued against laboratory engineering or a lab leak as the source of COVID-19 and helped frame debates in the United States and United Kingdom about the virus’s origins in Wuhan, China. The Trump administration pressed for an official, independent inquiry into claims that senior US scientists Anthony Fauci and Francis Collins, along with British scientist Jeremy Farrar (Wellcome Trust), contributed substantially to the paper without attribution. The Telegraph cited undisclosed inputs and considered whether the paper should be corrected or withdrawn. Emails later showed that Fauci, Collins, and Farrar discussed the manuscript and the possibility of a lab incident before publication; Farrar and Ed Holmes (University of Sydney) estimated a 50:50 and 60:40 chance of a laboratory leak. After publication, biosafety concerns were not listed, and public debate waned.

triage.headline_ja: 不明な研究が論争を引き起こす…トランプ政権がCOVID-19ウイルス流出の調査を要求 | カイロ・ニュース
triage.triage_reason: 2020年のCOVID-19起源論争に関する政治的・科学的スキャンダル報道であり、現在進行中の感染症発生や公衆衛生上の新規リスクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はCOVID-19パンデミック起源（武漢研究所流出説）をめぐる2020年当時の科学者間のやり取りや論文内容に関する政治的調査要求を扱ったもので、現在の感染症発生事例ではない。公衆衛生上の新規シグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Com 433 casos confirmados, SP recebe mil novas doses de vacina contra Mpox
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With 433 confirmed cases, São Paulo receives 1,000 new doses of Mpox vaccine.
article.articleSummary: São Paulo, Brazil reports mpox (formerly monkeypox) with 433 confirmed cases in the state, about 37% of Brazil’s 1,170 total. The state health department received 1,000 new mpox vaccine doses from the Ministry of Health; distribution to Epidemiological Surveillance Groups begins Monday, Nov 23, to allocate to municipalities as needed. Brazil has purchased 25,000 doses; the national stock has already supplied nine states with 3,650 doses, including Rio de Janeiro, Ceará, and the Federal District. Vaccination eligibility prioritizes HIV/AIDS-positive adults with CD4 counts below 100 or 200 cells/mm³; PrEP users; laboratory workers handling mpox samples; all PLHIV regardless of CD4; and medium/high-risk contacts after health service evaluation. Mpox is caused by an Orthopoxvirus; transmission occurs via close contact with lesions or contaminated objects; common symptoms include fever, rash, mucosal lesions, lymphadenopathy, headaches, muscle pain, and fatigue, typically lasting 2–4 weeks. Preventive measures include hand hygiene, avoiding shared linens and intimate contact with infected individuals, and isolation if suspected or confirmed.

triage.headline_ja: 確認症例433件、サンパウロ州がMpoxワクチン新規1000回分を受領
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州で既知のMpoxアウトブレイクに対するワクチン配布という継続的な公衆衛生対応の報道であり、急激な症例増加や新規変異株などの異常性は確認できないため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はサンパウロ州における既存のMpox流行への対応（ワクチン配布）に関する日常的な公衆衛生報道であり、HIV陽性者やPrEP利用者など性感染リスクのある集団への接種優先が記載されている。新規症例の急増や新たな伝播経路等の異常性は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Từ phòng nghiên cứu 8 giường ở TP HCM đến dấu ấn trong điều trị sốt rét toàn cầu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: From an Eight-Bed Research Room in Ho Chi Minh City to a Milestone in Global Malaria Treatment.
article.articleSummary: OUCRU began in 1991 with eight-bed malaria unit at Ho Chi Minh City’s Infectious Diseases Hospital and has grown into an international network of 700+ staff across Ho Chi Minh City, Hanoi, Nepal, and Indonesia, focusing on infectious diseases. Early artemisinin trials in severe malaria reduced mortality from ~40% to 10% by 2000 and informed Vietnam guidelines and WHO recommendations. The unit later studied typhoid fever, isolating multi-drug resistant Salmonella Typhi in An Minh, Kiên Giang, advancing antimicrobial resistance research. Other areas include tetanus, dengue, tuberculosis, meningitis, HIV, and emerging infections. OUCRU expanded to Nepal (2003), Hanoi (2006), and Indonesia (2008). It supported SARS, H1N1, and Covid-19 through RECOVERY; during a three-week hospital lockdown, it stored >10,000 samples and processed >2,000 daily, delivering genome sequences in 24–48 hours. D-Skepe for dengue and training local scientists are current priorities.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市の8床の研究室から世界的なマラリア治療の功績へ
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は研究機関OUCRUの歴史的功績を紹介する特集記事であり、現在進行中の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は研究機関OUCRUの30年以上にわたる歴史と功績（マラリア、腸チフス、デング熱等の研究）を紹介する回顧的な特集記事であり、現在の感染症アウトブレイクイベントではないため、地理的な発生国の特定対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Infant Meningitis Case Linked to Suspected Neurogenic Lower Urinary Tract
article.articleSummary: Two-month-old male infant with protracted meningitis caused by extended-spectrum beta-lactamase–producing Escherichia coli (ESBL-EC) at South China Hospital and Shenzhen University. The infection led to septic shock and subdural fluid collections. Despite meropenem, fever and abnormal subdural fluid persisted; intermittent dexamethasone and neurosurgical subdural drainage were performed. Serial neuroimaging revealed extensive brain injury with bilateral frontal cortical encephalomalacia and left temporal encephalomalacia, plus intracranial hemorrhages. At five months, urological evaluation showed neurogenic-type lower urinary tract dysfunction: reduced bladder compliance, detrusor overactivity, and elevated post-void residual; left vesicoureteral reflux grade III. Spinal MRI excluded gross cord lesions, though localization to supraspinal micturition centers remained uncertain. Management included clean intermittent catheterization and antibiotic prophylaxis; recurrent febrile UTIs occurred. Growth deceleration was noted between six and twelve months, with partial stabilization by fifteen months. The authors emphasize early multidisciplinary care and need for further research on antibiotic/corticosteroid regimens in severe pediatric CNS infections.

triage.headline_ja: 乳児髄膜炎症例、神経因性下部尿路機能障害の疑いと関連
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生やヒト-ヒト感染の懸念を示す情報はない。個別の臨床経過に関する症例報告であり、感染症危機管理上のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 単一の乳児症例に関する臨床症例報告であり、公衆衛生イベントとしての集団発生や感染拡大の兆候は記載なし。地域（深セン）は特定されているが、対象国リストにおいても疫学的シグナルとしての重要性は低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: U SAD-u više od 7000 zaraženih ospicama, šire se i drugdje u svijetu, sad su u sto zemalja...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the United States, more than 7,000 measles cases, spreading to other parts of the world as well, now in 100 countries...
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks spread from the United States to about 100 countries, with the United States reporting more than 7,000 cases and 13 deaths this year, marking the country’s 26-year return to transmission after losing its elimination status. Vaccination coverage has fallen to 92% among children, below the 95% threshold for herd immunity. The PAHO notes that Mexico and Bolivia have also lost elimination status due to gaps in immunization. Globally, measles cases are reported in about 100 countries, with Bangladesh recording the highest numbers—nearly 65,000 cases and 1,353 deaths between April and September, amid vaccine shortages. Indonesia has about 33,000 cases, and Guatemala about 28,000. Croatia has three cases, Serbia five. Experts warn that measles and pertussis are highly contagious; severe complications include encephalitis, myocarditis, pneumonia, and the rare but fatal SSPE years after infection. Reestablishing elimination requires interrupting transmission for at least 12 months with documented evidence.

triage.headline_ja: 米国で麻疹感染者7000人超、世界各地にも拡大、現在100カ国で確認
triage.triage_reason: 世界的な麻疹流行で100カ国に拡大し、複数国で排除状態の喪失や多数の死亡例が報告されている。IHR基準に複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 記事は米国・中南米・バルカン諸国・バングラデシュ・インドネシアなど世界的な麻疹流行を扱うが、対象国リストに該当するのはインドネシア（約33,000例）のみ。バングラデシュは最多感染国だが対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Újra támad a csonttörő láz: a rettegett fertőzést küldföldről hozták haza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever strikes again: The dreaded infection was brought back from abroad.
article.articleSummary: Three dengue infections imported to Hungary in the latest weekly data: two cases in Győr-Moson-Sopron (a 30-year-old man and a 26-year-old woman) with exposure in Vietnam during the incubation period, and a third case in Pest County (a 35-year-old woman) infected in the Maldives. In Komárom-Esztergom county for Nov 2–6, week: 6 Campylobacter enteritis, 3 salmonellosis, 2 infectious hepatitis, 1 hepatitis A, 1 scarlet fever, and 1 varicella. Nationwide week 45 tallies: 133 Campylobacter, 62 salmonellosis, 35 rotavirus, 31 hepatitis A, 40 infectious hepatitis (hepatitis infectiosa), 38 scarlet fever, 82 varicella. Early November mass gastroenteritis outbreak in Zala County affects 1,495 people (373 with vomiting/diarrhea); four foods contained Bacillus cereus; no hospitalizations; investigation ongoing. NNGYK reports 438 infectious-disease cases in week 45, about 6% fewer than week 44 (468).

triage.headline_ja: デング熱が再び猛威を振るう：恐れられている感染症が海外から持ち込まれた
triage.triage_reason: ハンガリー国内の定例感染症サーベイランス報告であり、デング熱はベトナム・モルディブ渡航による輸入例、その他の疾患も季節性の通常範囲内で、対象国での流行事象ではない。
triage.notes: ベトナム・モルディブは症例の渡航歴（曝露地）として言及されているのみで、当該国での流行発生を示すものではないため、対象国リストに該当する国はverified_locationsに含めない。記事の主題はハンガリー国内の定例感染症統計報告。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola no Congo já soma 5.600 mortes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has already reached 5,600 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains an international health emergency, with over 11,000 confirmed cases and about 5,600 deaths to date. The World Health Organization maintains the emergency declared on May 17, with the committee reviewing the status every three months. A key concern cited by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus is that two-thirds of deaths occur outside treatment centers, signaling late detection and insufficient contact tracing. He stressed protecting health professionals, facilities, and community teams, noting many affected communities lie in conflict areas where health workers have been attacked. Tedros also criticized travel restrictions on travelers from affected regions, arguing they hinder outbreak response, livelihoods, and timely notification, undermining transparency needed to control Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱、死者5,600人に達する
triage.triage_reason: WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態として維持しており、死者数11,000例超・死亡5,600人という深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の問題が明確にIHR基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: WHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態(PHEIC相当)として継続的に監視している既存アウトブレイクの続報。紛争地域での医療従事者への攻撃や渡航制限への批判など、対応上の課題が継続している。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19. Nova variante que entra mais facilmente nas células humanas está a espalhar-se rapidamente e já chegou à Europa - 24 Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19. A new variant that enters human cells more easily is spreading rapidly and has already reached Europe - 24 Notícias.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 variant PJ.2.1 is spreading internationally, with a greater ability to enter human cells. First detected in May in Canada, PJ.2.1 has since been identified in the United States, Spain, Canada, the Netherlands, Australia, New Zealand, Israel, and Brazil. In Spain, local transmission chains have been reported in Catalonia, the Basque Country, and the Madrid area. A team from the Deutsches Primatenzentrum notes rapid spread in Canada, the United States, and Spain, and anticipates rising cases in the Netherlands and France, potentially reaching Germany. There is no evidence that PJ.2.1 causes more severe disease or new symptoms than other SARS-CoV-2 variants. Antibodies from the current booster vaccination neutralize PJ.2.1, suggesting vaccination remains protective, though future mutations could reduce protection. The article highlights ongoing viral evolution and possible immune escape via spike protein mutations, especially in prolonged infections.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19。ヒト細胞によりdễ入りやすい新変異株が急速に拡大し、すでに欧州に到達
triage.triage_reason: 新変異株PJ.2.1が複数国（カナダ、米国、欧州各国、オーストラリア、ニュージーランド、イスラエル、ブラジル）で検出され、ヒト細胞への侵入性が高いとされ国際的拡大が確認されているため、フルRRAでの評価が望ましい。
triage.notes: PJ.2.1変異株は現行ブースターワクチンで中和可能とされ、重症度増加の証拠はないが、国際的な感染拡大と免疫逃避の可能性があるため継続監視が必要。対象国の中ではブラジルのみ発生報告あり。

article.articleHeadline: Pernambuco soma oitava morte por dengue de 2026; vítima é adolescente sem comorbidades
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pernambuco records eighth dengue death in 2026; victim is an adolescent without comorbidities.
article.articleSummary: Pernambuco records its eighth dengue death in 2026: a 13-year-old resident of Limoeiro in the Agreste region died on August 14, with no comorbidities. The SES-PE Arboviroses Epidemiological Bulletin No. 45, released November 18, 2026, also lists seven prior dengue fatalities this year: a 65-year-old man from Recife who died in Rio de Janeiro on February 18; a 15-year-old girl without comorbidities from Tacaratu (Sertão) who died April 14; a 93-year-old woman from Parnamirim (Sertão) who died May 5; a 60-year-old man from Olinda in the Recife Metropolitan Region who died May 7; a 58-year-old woman with comorbidity from Paulista (Recife Metropolitan Region) who died July 17; a 9-year-old boy from Paulista (Recife Metropolitan Region) who died July 17 with no prior illnesses; and a 19-year-old man with comorbidity from Recife who died August 20. From 4 January to 14 November 2026, 55,119 dengue cases were notified (up 29% vs 2025), with 13,673 confirmed, 746 of them severe. Notified chikungunya: 7,955 (462 confirmed); Zika: 1,454 (no confirmed cases).

triage.headline_ja: ペルナンブコ州、2026年のデング熱による死者が8人目に；被害者は基礎疾患のない10代の少女
triage.triage_reason: ペルナンブコ州で2026年のデング熱による死者が8人目となり、症例数も前年比29%増加、重症例746件を記録するなど重症度・曝露継続性の基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: デング熱はブラジルの季節性流行であり、例年の公衆衛生当局による疫学週報（SES-PE Boletim No.45）に基づく報告。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、症例数増加と重症化・死亡例の多さから継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 820 millions retracés, grève des soignants à Butembo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 820 million traced, healthcare workers' strike in Butembo
article.articleSummary: As of 18 November 2026, Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo shows about $820 million traced of roughly $1.2 billion mobilized, with donors pledging around $2.9 billion. About $1.2 billion has been paid or is in process; the African Union puts visibility at ~ $820 million including spent and available funds. A government-partner meeting is planned to align funds with Kinshasa priorities; only about 30% of organizations have reported figures. An October alert noted $962 million disbursed to responders, but only ~ $220 million declared, leaving over $700 million untracked. In Butembo (Nord-Kivu) and nearby zones, private treatment centers have been on strike since 12 November, demanding written contracts, adherence to official risk-prize scales, and reduced pay gaps, risking patient care. UN agencies and MSF warn that payment delays and supply gaps slow the response; nearly 2,000 beds in 104 treatment/transit centers and more than two dozen laboratories are involved. Authorities are pursuing biometric payroll pilots to ensure electronic payments.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対応：8億2000万ドルが追跡済み、ブテンボで医療従事者ストライキ
triage.triage_reason: エボラという重篤な感染症の進行中アウトブレイクにおいて、資金未追跡問題と医療従事者ストライキが患者ケアと対応能力を脅かしており、国際支援の必要性や政府・国際機関の高い関心が示されているため。
triage.notes: 記事は新規症例数や感染拡大そのものよりも、エボラ対応の資金管理問題とブテンボでの民間治療センターのストライキに焦点を当てている。ストライキが患者ケアと流行対応能力に悪影響を及ぼす可能性があり、既存のエボラ流行の管理継続性に関わる重要な情報としてフルRRAでの精査が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: La DEA y la corrupción, Sheinbaum en APEC y el sarampión en México
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The DEA and corruption, Sheinbaum at APEC, and measles in Mexico.
article.articleSummary: Mexico City, 18 November 2026 — DEA Director Terry Cole argues corruption in Mexico fuels cartel networks, a point linked to the run-up to Claudia Sheinbaum’s meeting with Donald Trump at the APEC summit in China. The piece contrasts a session with Xi Jinping lasting over two hours with a 31-minute encounter with Trump, questioning any shared agenda with the United States. Health context notes Mexico loses its measles-free status, with official figures outlining vaccine approvals and expenditures. The article ties anti-corruption and governance issues to international diplomacy at APEC, framing measles status and vaccination funding within Mexico’s current public health and security landscape as of 18 November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: DEAと汚職、APECでのシェインバウム大統領、そしてメキシコの麻疹
triage.triage_reason: メキシコの麻疹排除ステータス喪失に軽く言及しているが、記事の主題は政治・外交・汚職問題であり、対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に該当する感染症発生国もないため見送り。
triage.notes: 記事は政治・外交コラムであり、麻疹関連の詳細情報（症例数、感染状況等）は含まれていない。またメキシコは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: हरियाणा के सभी 23 जिलों को 31 दिसंबर तक एचआईवी... | UNI Varta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: HIV in all 23 districts of Haryana by December 31 | UNI Varta.
article.articleSummary: Chandigarh, November 18, 2026 — Haryana aims to bring all 23 districts under the HIV/AIDS Safe District framework by December 31, 2026. The Health and Family Welfare Department directed accelerated HIV testing, treatment access, and regular patient monitoring to achieve uniform control statewide. Additional Chief Secretary Dr. Sumita Mishra announced the target at the Chandigarh workshop titled 'Secur ity Pledge' (सुरक्षा संकल्प कार्यशाला), noting that HIV testing coverage rose from 85.2% in July 2026 to 94.7% in October 2026. The initiative emphasizes expanded testing, ensured linkage to care, initiation of antiretroviral therapy, and ongoing surveillance across districts. The report does not provide district-level case or mortality figures. If realized, the plan would signify comprehensive HIV containment across Haryana, aligning preventive and treatment services with the Safe District objective.

triage.headline_ja: ハリヤナ州の全23県を12月31日までにHIV/エイズ・セーフディストリクト化へ | UNI Varta
triage.triage_reason: これは新規アウトブレイクではなく、既存のHIV対策プログラム（検査率向上・治療アクセス拡大）に関する行政施策の発表であり、緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はHIV流行の急拡大ではなく、ハリヤナ州保健当局による既存プログラム（HIV/AIDS Safe District枠組み）の推進目標発表。症例数・死亡数の記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Global Systematic Review Reveals High Toxoplasma gondii Diversity in Camels
article.articleSummary: Toxoplasma gondii shows high genetic diversity in Camelidae and Equidae worldwide, based on a systematic review of 20 studies (103 isolates) across five continents. Unlike human/ruminant populations where Type II dominates, these hosts harbor predominantly atypical and mixed genotypes, highlighting their value as sentinels of regional parasite diversity. Americas (17 isolates) lacked Type I/III, with 88.2% atypical; Africa (18 isolates) had no Type I and 83.3% atypical. Asia (54 isolates) displayed the greatest complexity, with 61.1% mixed infections; China I (ToxoDB #9) emerged as the dominant single lineage. Europe (14 isolates) was dominated by Type III (57.1%). Phylogenetic analysis using 11 multilocus markers grouped isolates into three core lineages (Type I–III). Environmental exposure to diverse oocysts appears to drive infection, underscoring camelids/equids as potential reservoirs of zoonotic, genetically complex T. gondii strains.

triage.headline_ja: 世界的な系統的レビューにより、ラクダおよびウマにおけるトキソプラズマ原虫の高い遺伝的多様性が明らかに
triage.triage_reason: 特定の国・地域における急性アウトブレイクではなく、世界的な系統的レビュー（学術研究）であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や社会的関心を示す要素がない。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定国での発生事例ではなく、過去20研究・103株を対象とした系統的レビュー論文。発生地域として中国等が付与されているが、記事の主題は地域別（アメリカ・アフリカ・アジア・ヨーロッパ）の遺伝的多様性比較であり、対象国リストに該当する具体的アウトブレイクの記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil cria sala de crise após contacto com grupo isolado na Amazónia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil sets up a crisis room after contact with an isolated group in the Amazon.
article.articleSummary: Brazil set up a crisis room by FUNAI and the Indigenous Health Secretariat (SESAI) after the first contact in 50 years between the Awá, an isolated Indigenous group, and neighboring Guajajara communities in Terra Indígena Arariboia, Maranhão. The contact occurred at Tauari village, where 15 Awá individuals—men, women, and children armed with bows and arrows—were seen receiving food from Guajajara in a forested area; Guajajara recorded images on mobile phones. The crisis room aims to guide regional staff on procedures and to avoid forced contact, given the heightened epidemiological vulnerability of isolated communities, which lack the same immunological defenses and risk death from diseases like influenza. Brazil counts about 114 isolated or lightly contacted groups. Authorities suggest the approach may reflect pressure from illegal invasions, deforestation, fires, and illegal mining/logging. The government emphasizes non-forced contact and continues protection programs and Guardiões da Floresta.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、アマゾンの孤立部族との接触後に危機管理室を設置
triage.triage_reason: 免疫学的に脆弱な孤立先住民集団との50年ぶりの接触により、インフルエンザ等の感染症リスクが懸念され、政府が危機管理室を設置する異例の対応を取ったため、WPRO基準複数該当かつ政府の高い関心が確認される。
triage.notes: 実際の感染症アウトブレイクは報告されておらず、孤立部族の免疫学的脆弱性に基づく予防的な危機管理対応である点に留意。続報でインフルエンザ等の実際の感染確認があるか注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Com surto em MS, suspeitas de sarna humana fecham Emei no Nova Lima, em Campo Grande
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With an outbreak in Mato Grosso do Sul, suspected cases of human scabies shut down the municipal preschool in Nova Lima, Campo Grande.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of human scabies in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, triggers school closures as three suspected cases force the shutdown of Emei Jasmim Ibrahim Bacha in Campo Grande’s Nova Lima on Nov 18, 2026. State authorities report 123 confirmed cases in 2026, though Campo Grande says there is no municipality-wide outbreak. Dourados hosts the largest cluster, with 49 cases at Ceim Recanto Raízes and a continued closure; Ceim Beatriz de Barros Bumlai has 15 cases and Ceim Prof. Bertilo Binsfeld 10. In Itaporã, centers briefly closed but reopened; Milton Menani records 27 cases and Maria Rodrigues 7. Rio Brilhante reports six cases (five at Escola Estadual Lígia Terezinha Martins, one at a creche). Nova Andradina logs four cases in November: two children aged 3–9, and two adults aged 20–34 and 50–54. Transmission occurs via prolonged skin contact; symptoms include intense nocturnal itching and skin lesions; hot-water washing and ironing are recommended in outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: マットグロッソ・ド・スル州で発生、疥癬の疑いでカンポグランデのノバリマ保育園が閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は公衆衛生上の重大性・国際拡大リスクは低いが、学校閉鎖が相次ぎ地域的な集団発生が継続しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 疥癬はヒトからヒトへの接触感染で重症度は低いが、複数の学校・保育施設で集団発生が継続しており地域の公衆衛生当局が対応中。国際的な影響は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa Proíbe Lote De Muçarela Após Encontrar Bactéria; Veja Marca E Número - Rnews
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa Bans Mozzarella Batch After Finding Bacteria; See Brand and Lot Number - Rnews
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Anvisa banned sale, distribution, and consumption of Italy brand sliced mozzarella after a lab test found Listeria monocytogenes in batch 180926. The measure, announced November 12, targets only this batch from Agroindústria Santo Anjo Ltda, with a voluntary recall by the producer. Consumers should check the lot code and must not eat any product labeled 180926, even if within shelf life or refrigerated. Listeria monocytogenes can cause listeriosis, with symptoms such as fever, muscle aches, nausea and diarrhea; severe cases include headache, neck stiffness, confusion, and neurological complications. At-risk groups include pregnant women, newborns, older adults, and the immunocompromised. Bacteria can multiply at refrigeration temperatures, so chilling does not ensure safety. Preserve packaging and proof of purchase, contact the seller or manufacturer for recall details, and seek medical care if symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: アンヴィザ（ブラジル衛生当局）、細菌検出によりモッツァレラチーズのロットを禁止 - ブランドとロット番号を確認
triage.triage_reason: 単一ロットの予防的な製品回収事案であり、現時点で実際の発症報告や拡大の兆候はなく、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれも明確には該当しない。
triage.notes: イタリアブランドの製品だが製造・流通・規制対応はブラジル国内で発生しており、実際の発生国としてはBrazilのみ該当。感染者の報告は記事中に明記されていない（予防的回収措置）。

article.articleHeadline: Goiás intensifica ações e mobiliza para busca ativa contra sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Goiás intensifies actions and mobilizes for active case finding against measles.
article.articleSummary: As of 18 November 2026, measles prevention efforts are underway in Goiás, Brazil. A Secretaria da Saúde de Goiás (SES-GO) mobilizes all 246 municipalities for active search of suspected measles cases from 16 to 26 November 2026, coordinating primary care, urgent care units, public and private hospitals, community health workers, and Lacen-GO. The aim is to confirm absence of viral circulation, close epidemiological gaps, and ensure the state remains transmission-free. Goiás reports no confirmed measles cases in 2026 but stresses constant vigilance due to circulation elsewhere, high mobility, and a second-dose MMR vaccination rate of 66.91%, below the 95% goal. Measles is highly transmissible; one infected person can spread to up to 18 susceptible individuals. Sought signs: fever with maculopapular rash, plus cough, coryza, or conjunctivitis. Travelers or contacts with recent exposure should seek care; all active-search actions must be logged by 26 November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ゴイアス州、麻疹に対する積極的症例探索のための対策を強化・動員
triage.triage_reason: 確定症例はゼロで、予防的な積極的疫学調査の実施を伝える内容であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列。確定症例なしで予防的な積極的症例探索活動の報告に留まる。MMRワクチン接種率が目標値95%を下回る66.91%である点は今後の動向として留意すべきだが、現時点では介入不要。

article.articleHeadline: Chuva e calor elevam alerta para dengue nos próximos meses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rain and heat raise dengue alert in the coming months.
article.articleSummary: Rain and heat driven by El Niño raise dengue risk in Brazil’s Southeast from November through January, as Aedes aegypti expansion could boost dengue, chikungunya, and Zika transmission. Temperatures may be 1–2°C above expectations; Rio de Janeiro’s average rose from 26.5°C to 27.1°C. INMET notes about 1,800 mm of rain in 2024 and 1,750 mm in 2025 for the region, creating favorable mosquito habitats. Health data show November 2023–January 2024 Brazil logged over 185,000 dengue cases, about 95,000 in the Southeast; the next cycle tallied 210,000 nationwide, with 88,000 in the Southeast. Dengue deaths in the Southeast rose from 48 to 62; chikungunya fell from 12,400 to 9,800; Zika from 890 to 640. New dengue serotypes 3 and 4 circulate. Temperatures 25–30°C extend mosquito life to ~30 days; below 15°C reduces to ~10 days. Prevention emphasizes eliminating breeding sites and vaccination under SUS for eligible groups; vector control remains essential.

triage.headline_ja: 雨と暑さがもたらす今後数ヶ月のデング熱警報の上昇
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱等のリスク上昇に関する予測記事であり、既知の季節的流行パターンの範囲内だが、新規血清型の流入や症例数増加の傾向があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 気候要因（エルニーニョ、降雨量・気温上昇）によるデング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱媒介蚊の増加予測記事。新規デング熱血清型3・4の流通が指摘されており、継続的なモニタリングが望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Estoque de vacina contra mpox acaba no Rio em meio à alta de casos | Rio de Janeiro | O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox vaccine stock runs out in Rio amid a surge in cases | Rio de Janeiro | O Dia
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) cases rise in Rio de Janeiro as municipal vaccine stocks run out. Over 5,000 doses have been administered, exhausting stock provided by the Ministry of Health; a new shipment arrived 18 November 2026, and vaccination resumes when doses arrive. Rio de Janeiro state has 396 mpox notifications, 297 in the city; between September and November, 205 infections were confirmed by the Rio Epidemiological Observatory. The surge follows 2022’s higher activity, and mpox death in 2026 occurred on 13 November at Evandro Chagas Institute in Rio, in a patient with severe immunosuppression. Mpox is an Orthopoxvirus; symptoms include fever and skin eruptions progressing from red spots to vesicles and crusts, with lesions on the face, hands, genitals. Transmission is via close contact; prevention emphasizes avoiding contact with lesions, not sharing items, and seeking care for suspicious eruptions. Vaccination targets HIV-positive adults 18+ with CD4 <200; expansion awaits vaccine lots.

triage.headline_ja: リオでMpoxワクチン在庫が枯渇、症例急増のさなかに
triage.triage_reason: リオデジャネイロでMpox症例が急増し、ワクチン在庫が枯渇、重症免疫不全患者の死亡例も発生しており、WPRO基準の複数（重症度・曝露継続・流行しやすさ・管理可能性）に該当し社会的関心も高いため。
triage.notes: HIV陽性かつCD4<200の高リスク層向けワクチン接種が中断している点が懸念。新規ロット到着で再開予定だが供給の安定性は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Sesau investiga três casos suspeitos de sarna humana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sesau investigates three suspected cases of human scabies
article.articleSummary: Three suspected cases of human scabies are under investigation in Campo Grande, Brazil, with patients’ ages not disclosed. Officials say there is no outbreak in the capital and municipal schooling continues normally; school closures are not automatic and will be decided by health and education authorities, with cases monitored and privacy preserved. Scabies is caused by the mite Sarcoptes scabiei and causes intense itching, especially at night, along with skin lesions, red bumps, crusts and irritated skin. The most affected areas include between the fingers, wrists, elbows, armpits, abdomen, navel, waist, buttocks, genital region, and nipples. Transmission occurs through direct prolonged skin contact, sharing clothing, towels or bedding, and close contact in group settings. Preventive measures focus on hygiene, cleaning personal items and shared surfaces. There were three scabies cases reported in 2025; no outbreak is confirmed.

triage.headline_ja: セサウ、疑いのあるヒト疥癬3例を調査
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬の疑い例3件のみで、当局はアウトブレイクを否定しており、重症度・国際拡大リスクともに低い。
triage.notes: 地方自治体はアウトブレイクを否定しており、学校閉鎖も予定されていない。疥癬は慢性的な皮膚疾患で国際的な公衆衛生リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Capital registra 2 casos confirmados de Monkeypox e investiga outras 2 suspeitas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Capital records two confirmed Monkeypox cases and is investigating two other suspected cases.
article.articleSummary: Two confirmed monkeypox cases in Campo Grande, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, with two additional suspected cases under investigation as of 17 November 2026. The second confirmed case is linked to a Campo Grande patient; the individual is clinically stable and in isolation. The first confirmed case, reported in September, involved a Campo Grande resident with travel history to Rio de Janeiro. The state recorded 31 mpox notifications, including two confirmed, 27 discarded, and two under investigation. A suspected case involving a child from Haiti in São Gabriel do Oeste was ruled out after laboratory testing. Diagnostic testing for mpox in MS is performed at LACEN/MS; positive samples are sent to Fiocruz in Rio de Janeiro for viral genotyping to determine the lineage. SES/MS emphasizes notification, investigation, and ongoing epidemiological surveillance in coordination with municipal health authorities.

triage.headline_ja: 州都（カンポグランデ）でMpox確定症例2件を記録、さらに2件を調査中
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の限定的な小規模発生で、確定症例は少数、臨床的に安定しており、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも示唆されていない。
triage.notes: 州保健当局（SES/MS）による通常の監視・調査活動の一環であり、既知のMpox対応体制（LACEN/MS、Fiocruzでのゲノム解析）が機能している。ハイチ由来の疑い例は検査で否定済み。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19: Nova variante se espalha! Quais os sintomas e as diferenças? - O melhor da informação!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19: New variant spreads! What are the symptoms and the differences? - The best of information!
article.articleSummary: New COVID-19 variant PJ.2.1 is spreading globally in 2026, with cases reported in the United States, Spain, France, Australia, New Zealand, Israel, and Brazil. PJ.2.1 is a lineage derived from MC.10.1.7, itself from JN.1, circulating until May 2025. A October study in the Journal of Infection found the spike protein of PJ.2.1 binds more strongly to the ACE2 receptor on human cells, potentially contributing to rising cases. No unique symptom set identified for PJ.2.1; common symptoms include cough, fever, sore throat, nasal congestion, muscle aches, and fatigue. Possible loss of taste/smell, respiratory or digestive symptoms may occur but are not exclusive. The study did not assess hospitalizations or deaths, and no vaccine- or antibody-escape signals were found; vaccines remain effective. PCR/antigen tests confirm infection; the article notes a broad symptom list from Mirror Online.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19：新変異株が拡大中！症状と違いは？
triage.triage_reason: 新変異株PJ.2.1が複数国で拡大しているが、重症度や入院・死亡への影響は未評価であり、ワクチン効果も維持されているため、現時点でのフルRRA移行基準には達しない。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルメディアによる一般向け解説記事で、新変異株の感染力増加（ACE2結合強化）を報告しているが、重症度・入院・死亡データは未評価。ワクチン効果は維持されており、既知のJN.1系統派生株であるため疫学的に新規性は低い。ブラジルは発生国リストに含まれるが、記事自体は世界的動向の一般報道であり、ブラジル特有の深刻な状況を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Mosquito menace stings Hyderabad
article.articleSummary: Hyderabad reports a rising mosquito menace across almost all localities, with swarms entering homes after sunset and intensifying at night despite authorities' claims of control. Residents cite sharp evening spikes in nuisance from Old City, Golconda, Nampally, Red Hills, Rajendranagar, Banjara Hills, Jubilee Hills, Film Nagar, Madhapur, Kukatpally, KPHB, Uppal, LB Nagar, Tolichowki (Samatha Colony), Mallepally, and Begumpet, plus along the Musi riverbank where open nalas breed. Daytime levels are tolerable, but evening-to-night swarms persist, forcing nets, repellents, and electric devices. Hospitals report fever, body aches, cough, and cold; suspected dengue and influenza-like illnesses add to the health burden. In Malkajgiri’s ICRISAT Enclave, over 50 families warned of dengue, malaria, and chikungunya fears. GHMC says fogging and anti-larval operations run daily; residents urge intensified fogging, drain cleaning, and garbage removal. A four-week sanitation drive since November 9 covers 30 GHMC circles.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊の大量発生がハイデラバードを悩ませる
triage.triage_reason: ハイデラバードで蚊媒介感染症（デング熱、マラリア、チクングニア）への懸念と疑い症例が報告されているが、確定症例数や重症度に関する具体的データがなく、季節性の衛生問題としての側面が強いため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は蚊の発生による生活への影響が主題で、デング熱・マラリア・チクングニア・インフルエンザ様疾患は疑い例として言及されるのみ。確定診断数や死亡者数などの定量データは記載なし。GHMCによる日常的な防疫活動（燻蒸、幼虫駆除、清掃キャンペーン）が既に実施されており、外部支援の必要性も示唆されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Pernambuco confirma oitava morte por dengue em 2026; vítima era adolescente de 13 anos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pernambuco confirms eighth dengue fever death in 2026; victim was a 13-year-old adolescent.
article.articleSummary: Pernambuco confirms eight dengue deaths in 2026, including a 13-year-old resident of Limoeiro who died August 14. From January through November 14, 2026, dengue notifications reached 55,119, up 29% from 2025, with 13,673 confirmed and 746 severe. The eight fatalities span Recife, Tacaratu, Parnamirim, Olinda, Paulista, and Limoeiro; the 13-year-old had no comorbidities. Other deaths include a 65-year-old man from Recife who died in Rio de Janeiro (Feb 18); a 15-year-old girl from Tacaratu (Apr 14); a 93-year-old woman from Parnamirim (May 5); a 60-year-old man from Olinda (May 7); a 58-year-old woman from Paulista (with comorbidity, July 17); a 9-year-old boy from Paulista (July 17); and a 19-year-old man from Recife (Aug 20). High dengue incidence in 45 municipalities; 51 medium, 86 low. Chikungunya: 7,955 notifications, 462 confirmed; Zika: 1,454 notifications, none confirmed as of Arboviruses Epidemiological Bulletin No. 45 (weeks 4 Jan–14 Nov 2026).

triage.headline_ja: ペルナンブコ州、2026年のデング熱による8人目の死者を確認。犠牲者は13歳の少年
triage.triage_reason: デング熱はブラジルで季節性流行がある既知の疾患であり、本記事は定例疫学速報（第45号）に基づく通常の経過報告。死亡例や重症例はあるが、異常性や国際的拡大・渡航制限リスクは認められないため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ペルナンブコ州の定例疫学速報に基づく季節性デング熱の報告。前年比29%増加しているが、ブラジル国内では例年の流行パターンの範囲内であり、外部支援の必要性や国際的関心の高まりを示す情報はない。チクングニア熱・ジカ熱も併記されているが、いずれも深刻な異常事態を示す記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: Campinas confirma terceira morte por febre maculosa em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campinas confirms third death from Rocky Mountain spotted fever in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Campinas, São Paulo, reports three Rocky Mountain spotted fever deaths in 2026. The latest victim, a 54-year-old man, likely contracted the infection at Unicamp's Barão Geraldo campus; symptoms began September 11 and he died September 20 in a private hospital. Two additional 2026 infections—May and July at Parque Portugal (Lagoa do Taquaral)—involved a 19-year-old woman and a 30-year-old man who recovered; they live in other municipalities and aren't counted in Campinas' statistics. The 30-year-old’s case had park warnings enabling early treatment. Investigations traced the route through the university to identify tick vectors, with reinforced vegetation management and risk signage. Transmission is by ticks infected with Rickettsia rickettsii; the region is endemic in wooded areas with capybaras and horses. Control measures include the Arbovirus/Zoonoses Committee and Law 16.418/2023, plus capybara control since 2024 at Taquaral and Lago do Café.

triage.headline_ja: カンピーナス、2026年の紅斑熱（ロッキー山紅斑熱）による3人目の死者を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・カンピーナスで続発する紅斑熱（マダニ媒介性、Rickettsia rickettsii）による死亡例だが、ヒト-ヒト感染はなく、地域は既知の流行地で既存の対策委員会・法律・カピバラ駆除プログラムが機能しているため、国際的拡大リスクは低いが地域内での継続曝露が見られるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: マダニ媒介性の紅斑熱はブラジル・サンパウロ州の既知の流行地で発生しており、公衆衛生当局（Arbovirus/Zoonoses Committee、州法16.418/2023）により既に監視・対策（植生管理、警告標識、カピバラ駆除）が実施されている。ヒト-ヒト感染はなく、国際的拡大の懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Govt sets national guidelines for sewage testing as early warning tool to detect disease outbreaks
article.articleSummary: India publishes National Guidelines on Wastewater Surveillance for Pathogens, developed by NCDC and APSI-India, released by Dr Rakesh Gupta. The guidelines standardize sample collection, testing, and interpretation with IDSP to use wastewater as a warning tool for pathogens and disease trends. They list priority targets: poliovirus, SARS-CoV-2, influenza, RSV, measles, hepatitis A and E, dengue, and cholera; plus antimicrobial resistance genes and unknown pathogens. Sampling can occur at sewage treatment plants, sewer networks, open drains, and hospital outlets; catchments of 100k–300k people in cities; avoid septic tanks, latrines, or open fields. Routine sampling: weekly or biweekly; results uploaded to IHIP within 48 hours; escalations if a serious pathogen is detected, levels rise over two consecutive cycles, or a novel variant is found. Use includes targeted diagnostics, vaccination drives, GIS mapping, and water-quality actions; AMR monitoring is exploratory. Limitations: cannot identify individuals or exact case counts; trends require multiple sampling points.

triage.headline_ja: 政府、疾病発生検知の早期警戒ツールとして下水検査に関する国家ガイドラインを策定
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、下水サーベイランスに関する政策・ガイドライン策定の発表であり、現時点で公衆衛生上の異常事態や緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は具体的な感染症の発生事例ではなく、インド政府による下水サーベイランスの国家ガイドライン策定に関する政策発表。実際の疾病発生地域は特定されていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: പക്ഷിപ്പനി; 18,620 വളർത്തുപക്ഷികളെ നശിപ്പിച്ചു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza; 18,620 domestic birds culled.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza outbreak in Kerala triggers culling of 18,620 domestic birds across Ambalapuzha North, Ambalapuzha South, and Chennithala–Thripunithura panchayats in Alappuzha district as of 18 November 2026. Within one kilometer of infection centers, Ambalapuzha North center culled 7,331 birds (1,636 large chickens, 5,225 small chickens, 447 ducks, 3 roosters) and destroyed 40 eggs; Chennithala–Thripunithura center culled 11,289 birds (235 hens, 586 roosters, 10,468 chicks) and 28,000 eggs; Ambalapuzha South center culled 20 birds. Overall counts: 7,116 hens, 11,057 roosters, 447 ducks; 28,040 eggs; and 100 kg of meat destroyed. Birds from farms and households were burned. A rapid-response team—doctor, two live-stock inspectors, two attendants, four workers—led the culling and disposal. This reflects confirmed avian influenza activity in the region.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ；家禽18,620羽を殺処分
triage.triage_reason: 家禽における鳥インフルエンザ発生で人への感染は報告されておらず、地域の防疫チームにより迅速に殺処分・封じ込めが行われている。国際的拡大や渡航貿易制限の兆候もなく、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 人への感染報告はなく、家禽における鳥インフルエンザの発生・殺処分対応に関する地方ニュース。インドのケララ州で定期的に発生している事案であり、国際的な懸念材料は現時点で確認されない。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة العالمية: انطلاق تجارب لقاح ضدّ سلالة من فيروس إيبولا في الكونغو الأسبوع المقبل
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Launch of vaccine trials against a strain of the Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo next week.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 11,376 cases and 5,568 deaths as of November 18, 2026. The outbreak was officially declared on May 15, 2026. Two candidate vaccines, developed specifically to counter the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, are set to enter clinical trials next week, according to World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus at a Geneva briefing. There is currently no licensed vaccine or approved treatment for this Ebola strain. The development marks a rapid international effort to advance countermeasures amid the ongoing outbreak in the DRC and to evaluate these vaccines as part of the response in the near term.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関:コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスの一系統に対するワクチン治験が来週開始
triage.triage_reason: DRCでBundibugyo型エボラの大規模アウトブレイク（11,376症例、5,568死亡）が継続中であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響・国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 致死率約49%と非常に高く、ワクチン・治療薬が未承認である点が深刻度を高めている。Genève/Switzerlandは発生地ではなくWHO発表の場所であるため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Sábado tem mutirão contra dengue na região do Novo Horizonte, em Piracicaba | Rápido no Ar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There will be a dengue-control drive on Saturday in the Novo Horizonte region of Piracicaba | Rápido no Ar
article.articleSummary: Dengue-control drive set for Saturday, 21 November, in Piracicaba’s Novo Horizonte region, with PMCA/CCZ teams visiting Kobayat Líbano, Parque dos Sabiás, Jardim Santa Maria, Vila Liberdade, Novo Horizonte and Santa Fé I–III (8:00–14:00) to collect waste that can harbor Aedes aegypti. Meeting point: Varejão do Novo Horizonte, Rua Lauro Fernandes de Campos Ferrari, 45. By 17 November provisional data, there were 9,299 notifications and 91 dengue confirmations, with no deaths; in 2025 the figures were 25,312/5,830/5 and in 2024 64,223/29,415/16. The effort promotes household inspections, removal of standing water, and engagement with health agents for guidance. Free repellent is available for pregnant women and dengue patients at health units. Dengue vaccination is available for 10–14-year-olds at municipal clinics (two doses, 3-month interval).

triage.headline_ja: 11月21日(土)、ピラシカーバ市ノヴォ・オリゾンテ地区でデング熱対策一斉清掃活動を実施
triage.triage_reason: 地域の恒例的なデング熱対策（清掃活動・啓発）に関する記事であり、死亡者なし・症例数も前年より減少傾向にあるため、異常性や公衆衛生上の重大な懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 死者ゼロ、症例数は前年・前々年と比較して減少傾向（2024年: 64,223件/死亡16名 → 2025年: 25,312件/死亡5名 → 2026年途中経過: 9,299件/死亡0名）。地域行政による定例的な蚊対策・ワクチン接種の案内記事。

article.articleHeadline: Campinas registra terceira morte por febre maculosa em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campinas records third death from Brazilian spotted fever in 2026.
article.articleSummary: As of 18 November 2026, Campinas, São Paulo, records three confirmed deaths from Brazilian spotted fever (Rickettsia rickettsii) among residents in 2026. The 54-year-old man developed symptoms 11 September and died 20 September; infection is considered likely at the Universidade Estadual de Campinas (Unicamp) Barão Geraldo campus. Earlier 2026 Campinas cases include a 19-year-old woman (May) and a 30-year-old man (July); both recovered but reside in other municipalities, so they are not counted in Campinas’ total. Investigations linked exposure to Parque Taquaral, prompting vector surveys, reinforced warnings, and improved signage. The disease is transmitted by the lone star tick (carrapato-estrela). Public health actions include the Municipal Arboviroses and Zoonoses Committee, vegetation management in parks, and capybara population control ongoing since 2024. In 2025 Campinas reported six fatal cases.

triage.headline_ja: カンピーナスで2026年3人目のブラジル紅斑熱（ロッキー山紅斑熱）による死亡例を記録
triage.triage_reason: マダニ媒介性のロッキー山紅斑熱によりカンピーナス市内で2026年に3例目の死亡が確認され、重症度（死亡例の継続）と曝露の継続性が認められ、地域メディア・行政委員会の注目も高いため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 本疾患はマダニ媒介性で人-人感染は認められず、国際的拡大リスクは低い。ただし地域内で継続的な死亡例・曝露が報告され、市当局（Municipal Arboviroses and Zoonoses Committee）が対応中。2024年以降の継続的ベクター対策・カピバラ個体数管理など既存の管理体制があり、外部支援の必要性は低いと見られる。

article.articleHeadline: Divinópolis confirma primeiro caso de mpox em 2026; Minas tem 42 registros, calcula SES
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Divinópolis confirms the first mpox case in 2026; Minas Gerais has 42 recorded cases, according to SES.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) case confirmed in Divinópolis, Minas Gerais, Brazil: a 19-year-old patient is clinically stable and awaiting hospital transfer; a second suspected case, a 58-year-old woman, is hospitalized with results due by 20 November. In MG, 42 mpox cases were reported through 17 November, led by Belo Horizonte with 20; Contagem and Juiz de Fora with six each; Uberlândia four; single cases in Confins, Formiga, Manhuaçu, Ribeirão das Neves, Santa Luzia and Sete Lagoas. The circulating variant is clade II, subclade IIb. Transmission occurs mainly via direct contact with lesions, body fluids or mucous membranes, or prolonged close contact with secretions or contaminated objects. Symptoms include skin lesions, lymphadenopathy, fever, headache, myalgias, chills and weakness; no specific antiviral; management is supportive. Belo Horizonte vaccination expansion to 200 doses targets people living with HIV/AIDS with low CD4 counts, PrEP users, and lab workers, with broader eligibility by Nov 30. Vaccination sites include Hospital Eduardo de Menezes.

triage.headline_ja: ディヴィノーポリスで2026年初のエムポックス症例確認、ミナスジェライス州は42例に
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ミナスジェライス州でクレードIIbのエムポックス症例が継続的に報告されており(累計42例)、ヒト-ヒト感染のリスクはあるが、重症度は低く国際的な影響は確認されていないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: クレードIIb（2022年以降世界的に流行している系統）であり、既知の病原体・既存の公衆衛生対応の枠組み内。地方自治体がワクチン接種拡大で対応中であり、外部支援の必要性は示唆されていない。

article.articleHeadline: New dengue test promises early detection
article.articleSummary: Lucknow-based CSIR-NBRI hosted the 73rd annual day lecture where Padma Shri Navin Khanna highlighted an indigenous dengue diagnostic kit developed with ICGEB that can detect dengue from the first day of fever, unlike conventional tests that confirm later. Khanna said timely diagnosis is critical as dengue can turn severe with little warning, and the new kit could expand access to early testing in resource-constrained settings while reducing India's dependence on imported diagnostics. The technology, presented at the event, aims to shorten the window to treatment and help prevent severe complications. NBRI director Zabeer Ahmed noted ongoing interdisciplinary collaboration and industry partnerships. In the year, NBRI reported 185 research papers, two Indian patents, and four patent applications (including one international filing).

triage.headline_ja: 新たなデング熱検査法が早期発見を可能に
triage.triage_reason: 新規診断キットの開発・発表に関する科学技術ニュースであり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報ではないため。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の新規診断キット開発に関する学術・技術発表であり、感染症の発生や流行を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: South Sudan: Senior United Nations (UN) official urges action to boost Ebola prevention efforts
article.articleSummary: South Sudan's UN Humanitarian Coordinator Ramanathan Balakrishnan called for urgent action to strengthen preparedness for a potential Ebola outbreak, launching a three-month, $7 million plan to close critical gaps identified in a recent Government-WHO simulation. Gaps include inadequate ambulance services, limited laboratory capacity, PPE shortages, and shortcomings in contact tracing and entry-point screening. Although South Sudan has not reported any Ebola cases, risk persists due to the ongoing Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak and cross-border movement. Since mid-July, more than 5,000 people have entered Nabanga in South Sudan from the DRC fleeing Ebola. Earlier, Emergency Relief Coordinator Fletcher allocated $6 million from the UN CERF in June to bolster surveillance, testing, community engagement, and access to healthcare, underscoring concerted international support for border areas.

triage.headline_ja: 南スーダン：国連高官がエボラ予防対策強化への行動を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの継続的なエボラアウトブレイクと南スーダンへの越境人口移動（5,000人超）があり、国際的拡大リスクと国際支援の必要性が明確に示されている。IHR基準2つ以上に該当。
triage.notes: 南スーダン自体はエボラ症例未報告だが、DRCでの継続中アウトブレイクが主題であり、国境地帯Nabangaへの避難民流入（5,000人超）がリスク要因。South SudanおよびSudanは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Nova variante da Covid-19 já está a espalhar-se pela Europa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new COVID-19 variant is already spreading across Europe.
article.articleSummary: PJ.2.1, a new COVID-19 variant, is spreading and has reached Europe, with active community transmission in Catalonia, the Basque Country, Madrid, Spain. It has been detected in the United States, Spain, France, Canada, the Netherlands, Australia, New Zealand, Israel, and Brazil. First identified in Canada in May, PJ.2.1 carries genetic changes that may enhance cellular entry and transmission. It descends from a lineage circulating through May 2025 and is described as an evolutionary leap due to a burst of mutations, often linked to prolonged infections. Clinically, it resembles influenza or a cold: fever, cough, nasal congestion, myalgias, fatigue, headaches, chills, loss of smell/taste, and GI symptoms; rare cases of dyspnea, hearing loss, skin and foot lesions, refractory hiccups, and brain fog have been reported. No evidence yet of greater severity; more data needed on hospitalizations and mortality. Vaccines adapted to LP.8.1 neutralize PJ.2.1 with about a 1.8-fold reduction in efficacy.

triage.headline_ja: 新たなCOVID-19変異株が既に欧州で拡大している
triage.triage_reason: 新変異株PJ.2.1が欧州・米州など複数国で市中伝播を伴い拡大しており、細胞侵入・伝播性を高める可能性のある遺伝子変化を有する点でIHR基準（国際的拡大リスク・異常性）を2つ満たすため。
triage.notes: 重症度に関する明確な増加傾向は現時点で報告されていないため、今後のRRAでは入院・死亡データの推移を注視する必要がある。ブラジルは記事内で検出国として明記されているため対象国として記載。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox tem 42 casos confirmados em MG em 2026; veja os sintomas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox has 42 confirmed cases in Minas Gerais in 2026; see the symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (Monkeypox) in Minas Gerais, Brazil: 42 confirmed cases in 2026 through November. The SES-MG intensified epidemiological surveillance and provides free testing at Primary Health Care units (UBSs). Municipalities must notify cases within 24 hours via Sinan; 28 Regional Health Units receive capacity-building support. Transmission occurs through contact with skin lesions, bodily secretions or respiratory droplets, sexual contact, and sharing contaminated objects. Symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain, fatigue, lymphadenopathy, and skin lesions—face, hands, feet, mouth, genitals, or anal regions. Diagnosis is by laboratory testing on lesion material; there is no specific treatment; care is supportive. In 2025 there were 136 cases and 68 in 2024; in 2026 most confirmations are in men aged 15–34, with no severe cases or hospitalizations. Vaccination is prioritized for people with HIV/AIDS/immunosuppressed status, laboratory workers at biosafety level 2, and direct contacts of suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州で2026年にMpox確定42例、症状を解説
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ミナスジェライス州における既知のMpox流行の定例サーベイランス報告であり、2025年の136例から減少傾向、重症例・入院もなく、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 2024年68例、2025年136例、2026年42例と減少傾向。主に15-34歳男性に集中、性的接触等による感染経路。既存の公衆衛生体制（SES-MG、UBS無料検査、Sinan通知義務）で管理されており、新規の国際的懸念は確認されない。

article.articleHeadline: Creche tem 21 casos confirmados de sarna e outros 45 suspeitos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Daycare has 21 confirmed cases of scabies and 45 more suspected cases.
article.articleSummary: Casa da Criança Meimei, a nonprofit daycare in Jardim Alto São Francisco, Campo Grande, Brazil, reports 21 confirmed scabies cases (14 children, 7 staff) and 45 suspected in the same facility as of November 18, 2026. The first confirmed case was a baby on November 11; cases rose rapidly, prompting school closure and comprehensive cleaning of bedding and surfaces. Sesau advised sealing all items in bags for seven days after cleaning to suffocate the parasite. Despite measures, cases continued to emerge, and another closure occurred. The institution serves children and adolescents aged 6 months to 15 years in after-school programs, totaling 556 people. Reopening awaits authorization from Vigilância Sanitária; no date is set. Scabies is not on Brazil’s national notifiable list; SES assists in outbreaks. Transmission is via prolonged skin contact; treatment combines topical or oral medications and simultaneous treatment of close contacts; environmental hygiene is essential.

triage.headline_ja: 保育施設で疥癬確定21例、疑い45例
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は重症度・国際的拡大リスクが低く、単一施設内の局地的アウトブレイクであり、国の届出対象疾患でもないためフルRRAの必要性は低い。
triage.notes: 疥癬は接触感染で重症化リスクは低く、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とはみなされない。施設内アウトブレイクとして地域保健当局が対応中。

article.articleHeadline: Curitiba confirma novo caso de Mpox em novembro; Paraná soma 14 em 2026 | Band
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Curitiba confirms new Mpox case in November; Paraná totals 14 cases in 2026 | Band
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) in Paraná, Brazil: Curitiba reported a new mpox case in November 2026, bringing its 2026 total to five and Paraná’s to 14—the state’s highest annual tally. The latest case is the first since August; 13 cases had been recorded by August, with November adding one more. All 14 cases in 2026 belong to Mpox Clade IIb; Clade Ib has not been detected in the state. Mpox spreads via close contact with lesions, body fluids, or mucous membranes, or via contaminated objects; symptoms include skin lesions, fever, headache, and lymphadenopathy, with isolation lasting 2–4 weeks until lesions heal. Paraná received 250 vaccine doses this week, with a stock of 337. Vaccination is targeted to priority groups (e.g., adults with HIV/AIDS, CD4 <100; PrEP users; lab workers) and 18–49-year-olds with medium/high exposure, ideally within 4 days post-exposure and up to 14 days if asymptomatic, at COA/SAE facilities rather than UBS. Health authorities emphasize active surveillance and standardized testing/notification to interrupt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: クリチバで11月に新たなMpox症例を確認、パラナ州の2026年累計は14例に
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・パラナ州で既知のMpox Clade IIbの散発例が継続しているのみで、症例数も少なく、ワクチン供給等の管理体制も機能しており、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: Clade IIbの散発例で、州内でのサーベイランス・ワクチン接種体制が確立されており、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Exame descarta mpox em criança de 8 anos atendida em MS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Test rules out mpox in an 8-year-old child seen in Mato Grosso do Sul.
article.articleSummary: An 8-year-old child, who arrived from Haiti two days before evaluation, was seen in São Gabriel do Oeste, Mato Grosso do Sul, with skin lesions spanning over 20 days and tested negative for mpox. The investigation followed Ministry of Health protocols; samples for mpox and arboviruses were collected and sent to Lacen-MS on 17 November 2026, with the case discarded after laboratory results. Mato Grosso do Sul has 31 suspected mpox notifications in 2026: two confirmed, 27 discarded, and two under investigation. The first mpox diagnosis occurred in September 2026; the second was confirmed on 17 November 2026. The latest patient remains clinically stable, in isolation, and under health surveillance. For confirmed mpox cases, samples are sent to Fiocruz in Rio de Janeiro for viral lineage identification. All suspected mpox cases must be notified and investigated by surveillance teams.

triage.headline_ja: マットグロッソ・ド・スルで診察を受けた8歳児のmpox検査結果は陰性
triage.triage_reason: 本記事の対象症例はmpox陰性と確定しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。同州での他の確定例についても情報は限定的で、新たな懸念材料は示されていない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題である症例はmpox陰性（確定除外）。同州では2026年に31件の疑い例があり、うち2件確定（最新は11/17）だが、詳細情報は乏しく、トリアージ対象としての新規性・緊急性は低い。ハイチは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: What to Know About Ebola in Guinea-Bissau
article.articleSummary: Guinea-Bissau has no known Ebola cases as of 18 November 2026, despite a Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DR Congo), which reports 11,376 cases and 5,568 deaths; toll likely higher. WHO declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern on 17 May 2026; transmission is slowing in some areas but new hotspots emerge. Guinea-Bissau is distant from DR Congo and categorized as low risk. Bundibugyo Ebola symptoms include fever, fatigue, muscle pain, headache, sore throat, then vomiting, diarrhea, rash and kidney/liver problems; incubation is 2–21 days. No licensed vaccine or specific therapy exists for Bundibugyo; Ervebo targets Zaire ebolavirus, while frontline workers in Kisangani were vaccinated since 27 August and a TUMAINI trial began 23 October in Bunia. CDC (28 October 2026) restricts entry for those exposed in DR Congo within 21 days; Europe screening deemed ineffective by ECDC. The outbreak’s true size remains uncertain, and Guinea-Bissau has no 2026 preparedness statement.

triage.headline_ja: ギニアビサウにおけるエボラ出血熱について知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ）アウトブレイクはWHOによりPHEIC宣言済みで、1万件超の症例・5,568人の死者を報告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はギニアビサウにおける（存在しない）エボラ症例の有無についての解説記事だが、実際の発生国はDRCであり、ギニアビサウでは症例報告なし。ギニアビサウは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Paraná tem redução de 68% nos casos da doença Mpox
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Paraná reports a 68% reduction in Mpox cases.
article.articleSummary: Mpox in Paraná fell 68% from 44 cases in 2025 to 14 in 2026, with 3 in Londrina, 2 in Foz do Iguaçu, 5 in Curitiba, and 1 each in Marialva, Maringá, Araucária, and Ivaiporã. Surveillance confirms infections are Orthopoxvirus Clade IIb; Clade 1b from Africa has no records in the state. Sesa maintains active surveillance, daily coordination with regional offices, and standardized protocols across CTAs, hospitals, and vaccination centers to ensure rapid testing and isolation. Paraná received 250 vaccine doses this week, stock 337. Vaccination is not mass; offered at COAs and SAE, not UBS. Priority groups include HIV/AIDS patients with CD4 <100, expanding to CD4 <200 after 10 days and to all PVHA after 20 days, plus PrEP users and lab workers; post-exposure vaccination for 18–49 within 4 days, up to 14 days. Symptoms: abrupt skin lesions, fever, headaches, swollen lymph nodes; seek care.

triage.headline_ja: パラナ州、Mpox症例が68%減少
triage.triage_reason: 症例数が大幅減少しており、Clade 1bの記録もなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念や異常性は認められない。既存の監視・対策体制で管理可能と判断される。
triage.notes: 症例数は減少傾向（44→14件）であり、Clade IIbのみ確認。Clade 1bの記録なし。州保健当局による積極的監視とワクチン接種体制が機能している。

article.articleHeadline: Brucelose passa a ter notificação obrigatória; entenda a doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brucellosis becomes notifiable; understand the disease.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Health Ministry added human brucellosis to the list of compulsory notifiable diseases as of 17 November 2026, published in the Diário Oficial. Health services must report cases to the SINAN system; reporting can occur weekly from suspicion, without waiting for laboratory confirmation. Notifiable data enable detection of unusual case increases, contact tracing, and assessment of control policies to interrupt transmission. Brucellosis is a bacterial infection caused by Brucella species found in cattle, pigs, sheep, and dogs. Transmission occurs via consumption of unpasteurized milk and dairy products or raw or undercooked meat; inhalation of contaminated particles; and contact with infected animals or materials. High-risk groups include veterinarians, breeders, and slaughterhouse workers. Symptoms include fever, weakness, fatigue, loss of appetite, and body and head pains. Treatment uses antibiotics under medical supervision; there is no effective human vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: ブルセラ症が届出義務疾患に追加される；その疾患について解説
triage.triage_reason: これは公衆衛生上の行政措置（届出義務化）に関する記事であり、具体的な症例急増やアウトブレイクの報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル保健省による届出義務化の行政発表であり、具体的な感染事例の増加やアウトブレイクを報じるものではない。対象国リストにブラジルは含まれるが、イベント自体が疾病発生シグナルではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Power Of Community Support Systems In Defeating Drug-Resistant TB
article.articleSummary: MDR-TB case in Delhi highlights community-driven support as essential for treatment adherence. Mahesh, a 55-year-old daily-wage worker in a central Delhi urban slum, was diagnosed with multidrug-resistant TB in early 2025 after X-ray, sputum, and ultrasound investigations at Jhandewalan Chest Clinic and Dr NC Joshi Memorial Hospital. Diagnosis led to treatment initiation in April 2025, but livelihood pressures caused a treatment interruption as he sought work out of town. In October 2025, HPPI frontline workers Shimpi and Geeta (a TB survivor) conducted door-to-door screening, provided counselling, built trust, and coordinated with public services to restart therapy. Mahesh resumed a seven-tablet daily regimen at the chest clinic, despite hot flushes, until a leg fracture required bedrest, posing another risk of interruption. The case underscores the need for integrated community, health system, and social protection support to sustain MDR-TB treatment, echoed during World AMR Awareness Week 2026 and the Union World Conference on Lung Health.

triage.headline_ja: 薬剤耐性結核克服における地域社会支援システムの力
triage.triage_reason: 個別患者のMDR-TB治療継続支援に関する事例紹介記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常な増加や新規アウトブレイクを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 単一患者の治療継続支援に関する啓発記事であり、サーベイランス上のシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Sesau acompanha três casos suspeitos de sarna humana na capital
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sesau monitors three suspected cases of human scabies in the capital.
article.articleSummary: As of 18 November 2026, Campo Grande’s Municipal Health Secretariat (Sesau) is monitoring three suspected human scabies cases; no outbreak is confirmed and investigations are ongoing. In 2025, three cases were reported. Escola Municipal de Educação Infantil Escola Jasmim Ibrahim Bacha in the Nova Lima neighborhood suspended classes on 18 November for disinfestation after a confirmed case, with other units to follow if needed. Guardians were informed via WhatsApp, with guidance on hygiene and privacy preservation; temporary suspensions are evaluated case-by-case by health and education authorities. People with intense nocturnal itching and skin lesions should seek evaluation and treatment at a Family Health Unit (USF). Transmission is mainly via direct prolonged skin contact or sharing clothes, towels, or bedding. Preventive measures include washing clothes and personal items, cleaning surfaces, avoiding shared items, and evaluating close contacts even if asymptomatic.

triage.headline_ja: Sesau、州都で疑い例3件の人疥癬を監視
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は軽症で一般的な皮膚疾患であり、疑い例3件のみで集団発生も未確認。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 疥癬は直接の長時間皮膚接触で感染する一般的な寄生虫症で、致死性や重症度は低い。学校での一時休校措置は予防的対応であり、アウトブレイクは未確認。

article.articleHeadline: Escabiose atinge 6 cidades do sul de MS com pelo menos 144 casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scabies reaches six cities in southern Mato Grosso do Sul with at least 144 cases.
article.articleSummary: Scabies (Sarcoptes scabiei) has spread to at least six southern Mato Grosso do Sul municipalities in Brazil, totaling 144 confirmed cases across Dourados, Itaporã, Amambai, Nova Andradina, Rio Brilhante and Douradina. Dourados reports 74 cases in three municipal childcare centers, including Recanto Raízes with 49; Itaporã records 32 cases (24 cured); Amambai has 18; Nova Andradina 11; Rio Brilhante 9; Douradina has cases but a count was not disclosed. Public health status varies: Amambai labels the cases isolated rather than an outbreak, while others monitor transmission and consider school hygiene actions. In Rio Brilhante, nine cases across three schools prompted partial closure of Escola Estadual Lígia Terezinha (two classrooms), with broader suspensions not yet decided. Nova Andradina reported 11 November cases diagnosed clinically. Officials emphasize treatment, contact tracing, environmental controls, and avoiding stigma; counts may underrepresent true transmission since not all cases seek public health care.

triage.headline_ja: 疥癬がマット・グロッソ・ド・スル州南部の6都市に拡大、少なくとも144例
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は公衆衛生上の重大な脅威ではなく、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクもない、地域限定の軽微な事例。
triage.notes: 疥癬はダニによる皮膚感染症で重症度は低く、学校・保育施設内での集団発生に留まる。地方自治体レベルで対応可能な事案であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: 中國疫情凶險 死亡率比往年高出近5倍 | 病毒實驗室最新統計 | 新冠病毒重症率 | 心梗
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China's outbreak is perilous; mortality rate nearly five times higher than in previous years | Virus Lab's latest statistics | COVID-19 severe-case rate | Myocardial infarction
article.articleSummary: China's COVID-19 outbreak is perilous. This year, a Chinese laboratory reports COVID-19 severe-case rate and mortality are about fivefold higher than in prior years, with deaths at a four-year high since the 2022 policy relaxation. A virologist (pseudonym Zhang) cites rural areas as particularly affected; data suggest SARS-CoV-2 triggers vascular aging via endothelial inflammation, activating coagulation and thrombosis. Repeated infections may accelerate vascular damage, driving premature cardiovascular deaths, with myocardial infarction ranking first. National figures estimate roughly 1 million new acute MI cases annually, and over 2,700 sudden MIs per day, with MI in individuals under 35 rising and those under 45 accounting for more than a quarter of cases. Funeral homes in Inner Mongolia’s Baotou and Beijing report many sudden-MI deaths among 30s–40s, and even younger adults, with crowded services amplifying concern.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の疫病情勢は深刻、死亡率は例年の約5倍に | ウイルス研究所の最新統計 | COVID-19重症化率 | 心筋梗塞
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19重症化率・死亡率が例年の5倍という主張があるが、情報源は匿名の研究者証言や葬儀場の逸話に基づくものであり、公式統計や検証可能なデータが提示されていないため、現時点では続報を注視する段階と判断する。
triage.notes: 情報源（NTDTV/新唐人）は中国政府批判的な論調で知られる媒体であり、匿名の『張』という研究者証言や葬儀場の逸話が主な根拠で、公式の疫学データや査読済み研究の引用がない。内容の信頼性検証が必要であり、WHOや中国当局からの公式発表の有無を継続的に確認すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox: com alta de casos da doença, estados recebem doses adicionais de vacina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox: as mpox cases rise, states receive additional vaccine doses.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) cases rise in Brazil, with 1,170 confirmed and 864 under investigation as of Nov 2026. São Paulo leads with 433 cases, followed by Rio de Janeiro with 416; first mpox deaths have occurred in both states. São Paulo State received 1,000 vaccine doses (600 for the capital) to begin distribution on Nov 23 for priority groups. Rio de Janeiro has vaccinated over 5,000 in the capital; stock was exhausted, and 1,000 more doses were sent to reinforce supplies. This month, 3,850 doses were distributed to states; since January, more than 15,600 have been distributed and 12,200 administered. Brazil increased orders from 20,000 to 25,000 doses from the sole Danish manufacturer; deliveries due in three weeks. Vaccination uses intradermal administration to stretch doses up to fivefold for high-risk groups. Symptoms include 3–21 day incubation and skin lesions; diagnosis by lesion-based molecular tests; no mpox-specific treatment; prevention and isolation emphasized; hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: Mpox:症例増加に伴い、各州に追加ワクチンが配布される
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでMpox症例が急増し初の死亡例が発生、ワクチン供給強化が行われておりIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジル国内（サンパウロ州・リオデジャネイロ州）でのMpox症例急増と初の死亡例、ワクチン供給拡大の記事。国際的拡大や渡航制限に関する記載はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Veja orientações para identificar e prevenir a sarna humana após mais de 110 casos em MS - Ponta Porã Informa - Notícias de Ponta Porã/MS e Pedro Juan Caballero/PY
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: See guidelines to identify and prevent human scabies after more than 110 cases in Mato Grosso do Sul - Ponta Porã Informs - News from Ponta Porã/MS and Pedro Juan Caballero/PY.
article.articleSummary: Human scabies (sarna humana) outbreaks in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, reach at least 117 cases across six municipalities as of 18 November 2026. Campo Grande reports three suspected cases under investigation; Nova Andradina confirmed four on 17 November, with Itaporã and Dourados involved and a total of at least 112 cases in the three cities. Campo Grande closed the Municipal Early Childhood School Jasmim Ibrahim Bacha for sanitization after one confirmed case, with classes suspended for the day. Symptoms include intense nocturnal itching and skin lesions, often between fingers, wrists, underarms, waist, or groin; transmission is primarily direct skin-to-skin contact, though sharing clothing and bedding can spread it. Affected households should seek healthcare; close contacts may require simultaneous treatment. Preventive measures include not sharing personal items, washing and ironing fabrics, and sealing non-washables for seven days; fumigation is not required.

triage.headline_ja: MSで110件以上の症例確認、人疥癬の識別と予防ガイドラインを見る - Ponta Porã Informa
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬はヒト-ヒト直接接触で広がる軽症の皮膚疾患であり、国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限の可能性は低く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当性が乏しい。
triage.notes: 疥癬は寄生虫性皮膚疾患であり重症度は低く、学校の一時休校等の局所対応で管理可能。公衆衛生上の国際的懸念は低いためDISMISSと判定。

article.articleHeadline: São Paulo recebe mil doses de vacina contra mpox após aumento de casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo receives one thousand doses of mpox vaccine after an increase in cases.
article.articleSummary: 1,000 mpox vaccine doses were dispatched to São Paulo as mpox cases rise. Since January, São Paulo state has confirmed 452 mpox cases, surpassing 423 cases recorded in all of last year; no deaths reported. Vaccination targets priority groups: people living with HIV/AIDS with advanced immunosuppression, PrEP users, and laboratory professionals exposed to the virus. Others with medium- or high-risk exposure to suspected or confirmed cases may be vaccinated after health-service evaluation. Doses are allocated according to city population and the epidemiological context. Mpox (caused by MPXV) spreads mainly through direct contact with skin lesions, mucous membranes, and secretions of infected people, including during sexual contact; contaminated objects can transmit. Symptoms include skin and mucosal lesions (genital region), fever, weakness, swollen lymph nodes, muscle and back pain, and head pain.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ、mpox症例増加を受けワクチン1,000回分を受領
triage.triage_reason: WPRO基準（持続的曝露・流行しやすさ）が複数該当し、州保健当局がワクチン配布という政策対応を取っていることから社会的・行政的関心が確認されるため、フルRRAでの精査が望ましい。
triage.notes: サンパウロ州で2026年1月以降452例のmpox症例が確認され、前年通年の423例を既に上回っている。死亡例なし。HIV陽性者・PrEP利用者・検査技師等のハイリスク群への予防接種を目的に1,000回分のワクチンが配布された。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候は見られず、ブラジル国内の公衆衛生対応として管理可能な状況と評価される。

article.articleHeadline: പക്ഷിപ്പനി പ്രതിരോധം: കൊന്നു കത്തിച്ചത് 18,620 വളർത്തുപക്ഷികളെ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu prevention: 18,620 domesticated birds burned.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (bird flu) has been confirmed in two Alappuzha district, Kerala panchayats: Chennithala-Trippunthur and Ambalappuzha North. A total of 18,620 domesticated birds were culled within 1 km of the outbreak sites (11,289 in Chennithala-Trippunthur; 7,331 in Ambalappuzha North). Eight rapid-response teams—each with a doctor, two livestock inspectors, two attendants, and four laborers—carried out the culling under district veterinary and health authorities with PPE. A 10-km surveillance radius around the outbreak centers is in effect; within it, sale and movement of poultry, eggs, meat, skins, and related products are prohibited for one week. Culling within the 1-km ring is complete; poultry farming is banned for three months. No new cases have been reported elsewhere. Some local resistance occurred; authorities intervened. The All Kerala Poultry Federation calls for SOP adoption and a district monitoring committee, noting 15 years of bird flu reporting in Alappuzha and seeking immediate farmer compensation.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ対策：18,620羽の飼育鳥を殺処分・焼却
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州で家禽の鳥インフルエンザ発生による殺処分事例。ヒト感染例の報告はなく、15年来の発生地域で管理体制も機能しているが、鳥インフルエンザの潜在的な流行性は否定できないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 家禽（動物）のみの感染事例でヒト感染報告はなし。地元養鶏業者の抵抗や補償要求があり社会的関心は一定程度存在するが、国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限の兆候はない。過去15年間同地域で発生歴があり、異常性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Catapora ou Mpox? Médica explica diferença após casos suspeitos em Lagoa do PI
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chickenpox or Mpox? A doctor explains the difference after suspected cases in Lagoa do Piauí
article.articleSummary: Seven suspected varicella (chickenpox) cases among public-school students in Lagoa do Piauí, about 40 km from Teresina, are under investigation, with one adolescent hospitalized at the Instituto de Doenças Tropicais Natan Portella for testing. Authorities also consider mpox after learning one student had been in Ceará, where 85 mpox cases were confirmed in 2026 (IntegraSUS), predominantly in Fortaleza (74 cases, ~87%). Health officials suspended in-person classes for five days in affected schools; Sesapi recommends at least ten days and pupil-tracking; varicella incubation is 10-21 days. Infection patterns favor varicella: airborne spread in closed settings and disseminated, itchy lesions; mpox tends to produce localized, painful lesions transmitted mainly via direct contact with lesions. Lab testing is underway at Lacen; confirmation awaits. Adolescents require close monitoring; vaccination status influences symptom severity; attention also advised for pregnant individuals and others.

triage.headline_ja: 水痘？それともMpox？ラゴア・ド・ピアウイでの疑い例を受け医師が違いを説明
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ピアウイ州の学校で水痘疑いの集団発生があり、生徒の一人がセアラ州（2026年にMpox85例確認）滞在歴があることからMpoxとの鑑別が行われているが、臨床像は水痘を強く示唆しており確定診断待ちの段階。
triage.notes: 学校で7例の水痘疑いが報告され、1名入院。保健当局は5〜10日間の休校措置を実施。Mpoxは生徒の渡航歴から鑑別対象として検討されているが、臨床所見（空気感染パターン、広範な痒みを伴う皮疹）は水痘を支持。検査結果待ちの段階であり、確定診断次第で評価を見直す必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Супербактерия Klebsiella pneumoniae атакует Европу: смертность до 70%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Klebsiella pneumoniae superbug attacks Europe: mortality up to 70%
article.articleSummary: Europe faces spread of antibiotic-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae, per the ECDC. Politico, citing ECDC, reports bloodstream infection mortality from this organism at 40–70%, making it among Europe’s most dangerous superbugs. The bacterium transmits readily between patients, complicating treatment as strains have evolved resistance to newer antibiotics. Over six years, Klebsiella pneumoniae bloodstream infections rose 72%, signaling erosion of current therapies and heightened nosocomial risk. ECDC microbiologist Kristian Giske called resistance findings the most concerning among Europe’s superbugs this past year. In the EU, Iceland, and Norway, annual deaths due to antimicrobial resistance total about 35,000. Experts urge stronger antibiotic stewardship and enhanced hospital infection control and epidemiologic surveillance. The article briefly notes a separate Congo cholera outbreak with over 60,000 cases.

triage.headline_ja: スーパーバグ肺炎桿菌がヨーロッパを襲う：致死率最大70%
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題は欧州における薬剤耐性肺炎桿菌であり対象国に該当しないが、末尾でコンゴ民主共和国のコレラ流行（6万例超）に簡潔に言及されており、情報不足のため続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はヨーロッパの薬剤耐性肺炎桿菌（Klebsiella pneumoniae）に関するものであり、ノルウェー・アイスランドは対象国リスト外のため除外。コンゴ民主共和国のコレラ流行（6万例超）は一文のみの言及で詳細情報が不足しているため、独立した続報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Beni: Strengthening community awareness on Ebola at the centre of a workshop - ACP
article.articleSummary: On November 18, 2026, in Beni, North Kivu, DRC, a workshop was launched to strengthen community awareness of Ebola among leaders from Mabakanga and Kanzuli-nzuli health areas. Organized by Femmes Citoyennes Engagées and supported by the RCCE Office of Beni Health Zone, the session gathered teachers, community, religious leaders and community relays. Discussions centered on community engagement, risk communication, and non-violent communication, aiming to equip participants to convey reliable, verified information about the disease. Supervisor David Kabasha warned against reluctance to acknowledge Ebola and urged ongoing awareness-raising across schools, churches, markets, and other venues, stressing that no one is immune and that preventive measures must be followed. Participants were tasked with sharing knowledge and expanding outreach as part of ongoing mobilization for the 17th Ebola outbreak in North Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ：コミュニティ意識啓発ワークショップでエボラ対策を強化 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 記事はDRC北キブ州で進行中の第17次エボラ流行に関するコミュニティ啓発活動の報告であり、新規症例数や死亡者数などの疫学的更新情報は含まれていないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 本記事は第17次エボラ流行（北キブ州）に関連するコミュニティ啓発ワークショップの報告であり、新規感染者数・死亡者数などの最新疫学情報は含まれていない。既知の進行中アウトブレイクの文脈情報として、今後の症例動向や公式発表を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Beni: Grasshopper vendors sensitized on compliance with Ebola preventive measures - ACP
article.articleSummary: Beni, North Kivu, DRC—Grasshopper vendors were sensitized on Ebola virus disease (EVD) preventive measures on November 18, 2026. Volunteers, led by BEARIC staff and in collaboration with One Girl, One Leader (OGOL), the Provincial Youth Council and Mazungumzo, urged regular use of alcohol-based hand sanitizers and adherence to public health guidance to avoid disrupting livelihoods through police dispersal of gatherings. Organizers highlighted the need for leaders to model compliant behavior after reports of overcrowded vehicles sending mixed health signals. The campaign takes place amid ongoing sensitivity since the declaration of the region’s 17th Ebola outbreak, which has at times hampered response efforts. The end-of-year period coincides with a grasshopper season that forms an important local economic activity prior to December celebrations. No outbreak figures or case counts were provided.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ:バッタ売り商人にエボラ予防対策の遵守を啓発
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州ベニで進行中の第17次エボラ流行に関する地域啓発活動の記事であり、新規症例数や流行拡大の具体的データは示されていないため、既存流行の経過観察対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事は既知の第17次エボラ流行下での地域啓発活動を報じるもので、新規症例数や拡大状況の具体的情報はない。流行の継続状況を示すため、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: У Бразилії ізольована група ава вийшла до сусіднього села -- UPI
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Brazil, an isolated AVA group went to the neighboring village -- UPI.
article.articleSummary: About 20 representatives of the isolated Ava Indigenous group in Brazil approached the Tavari village in the Arariboya Indigenous Territory, Maranhão, exchanged yams with the Guajajara community, then returned to the forest. Brazil’s National Indian Foundation (Funai) activated an emergency coordination with Indigenous health services and specialized field teams to monitor the situation and prepare for potential medical emergencies. The episode highlights infection risks for isolated groups with limited historical contact, since any pathogen acquired from outsiders could be deadly. Survival International notes this is the first recent instance of a mass approach by Ava from Arariboya toward others, though it does not necessarily signal intent for sustained contact. Leaders voiced concerns about the physical state of some members (children and the elderly appeared undernourished). Funai maintains a policy of avoiding contact and protecting the right to remain isolated; Arariboya covers over 1 million acres, home to Guajajara communities and isolated Ava groups.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで孤立したアバ族集団が隣村に現れる -- UPI
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な感染症の発生は確認されていないが、孤立先住民族と外部社会との接触による感染リスクの懸念が指摘されており、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本記事は具体的な疾病の発生を報告するものではなく、孤立先住民族と外部社会の接触による感染症リスクの懸念を伝えるもの。Funaiが緊急体制を敷いているが、実際の感染事例は未確認のため疾患名は『Unknown Illness』として扱われている。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cases surge in Eastern Visayas, Bohol
article.articleSummary: Dengue infections surged in Eastern Visayas and Bohol, Philippines, with the DOH reporting 6,710 cases in Eastern Visayas from Jan. 1 to Nov. 7, including 12 deaths, a 110% rise from 3,194 in the same period last year.
