Leyte Province accounted for the largest share (2,142 cases, 32% of the regional total), followed by Northern Samar (1,403), Samar (861), and Tacloban City (790). Regional fatalities include Leyte (5), Northern Samar (3), Eastern Samar (2), and Samar (2). In Bohol, dengue rose by 133% to 5,319 cases and 25 deaths over Jan. 1–Nov. 7, up from 2,282 last year. Tagbilaran City led with 10.7% of provincial cases, and four dengue-related deaths were recorded there; other municipalities included Talibon, Inabanga, Ubay, and Getafe. Dengue is transmitted by Aedes aegypti; symptoms include high fever, severe headache, joint pains, nausea, vomiting, and rashes. Authorities urge community cleanup, elimination of standing water, and protective measures.

triage.headline_ja: イースタン・ビサヤおよびボホールでデング熱症例が急増
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンのイースタン・ビサヤとボホールでデング熱症例・死亡者数が前年比110〜133%増加しており、WPRO基準（重症度・流行しやすさ等）に複数該当し、保健当局・メディアの関心も高いためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: デング熱はフィリピンで毎年流行する既知の疾患だが、今年は複数地域で前年比2倍以上の増加と死亡者数の上昇が報告されており、DOHが対策を呼びかけている。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、国内公衆衛生上の懸念は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue em 2027: projeções estimam 866 mil casos, mas El Niño amplía a incerteza | Portal Fiocruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue in 2027: projections estimate 866,000 cases, but El Niño increases the uncertainty | Fiocruz Portal
article.articleSummary: Brazil’s 2026–27 dengue season is projected at about 866,000 probable cases (uncertainty 569,000–1.6 million), with a national peak in April 2027 and up to 40,000 cases in a single week. Forecasts come from the IMDC InfoDengue-Mosqlimate report presented to the Ministry of Health during a 6 November webinar. Geographic concentration matters more than total burden: Goiás is expected to have the highest incidence, followed by Minas Gerais, Mato Grosso, Mato Grosso do Sul and Tocantins, with increases anticipated in Acre, Rio de Janeiro and Paraná. El Niño is treated as a contingency trigger, not a fixed number, as three models disagree on regional impacts. The forecast does not assume vaccination or atypical events; expansion of DENV-3 could alter risk. Chikungunya is projected at about 94,000 probable cases, mainly in the Northeast (Ceará, Rio Grande do Norte, Paraíba, Sergipe, Piauí), while Mato Grosso do Sul remains the most affected state.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱2027年予測：86万6000例と推計されるが、エルニーニョが不確実性を高める | フィオクルスポータル
triage.triage_reason: 将来予測に基づく統計的シナリオ報告であり、実際の症例急増や異常事態の確認情報ではないが、ブラジルの風土病であるデング熱・チクングニア熱の継続的拡大リスクがあるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本記事は2027年シーズンに向けた予測モデル（IMDC InfoDengue-Mosqlimate）に基づく将来予測であり、現時点での異常発生や症例急増を報じるものではない。保健省への報告・ウェビナーという政府関心の高さはあるが、実際の公衆衛生危機の発生は確認されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Santa Luzia antecipa saída de escolas por risco de contaminação de sarna
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santa Luzia moves up the early dismissal of schools due to risk of scabies transmission.
article.articleSummary: Santa Luzia, in the Belo Horizonte metropolitan area, will dismiss municipal schools at 15:00 on Thursday, Nov 19, for cleaning after suspected scabies cases among students. The Municipal Education Secretariat monitors suspected cases after earlier reports of scabies spread, with localized symptoms observed in some students. Families of those with suspected infection were told to keep children home and seek medical care. Guardians should monitor symptoms over the holiday weekend and not send students to school on Monday, Nov 23 if signs appear. Background: scabies cases drew attention earlier this month after reports among municipal staff and students; on Nov 12-13 the City Council president reported suspected cases and the building was cleaned and temporarily closed. On Nov 15, suspected cases appeared in three schools; on Nov 17 health authorities confirmed cases in Santa Luzia, with patients evaluated, treated, and under follow-up; numbers and locations were not disclosed.

triage.headline_ja: サンタ・ルジア市、疥癬感染リスクにより学校の下校時刻を繰り上げ
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は重症度・国際的拡大リスクが低い局所的な皮膚感染症であり、学校での清掃対応のみで管理可能なため、IHR・WPRO基準にほとんど該当しない。
triage.notes: ブラジルはサンタ・ルジア市（ミナスジェライス州）で発生しているが、Brazilは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列とする。

article.articleHeadline: Divinópolis registra caso positivo de Mpox e investiga possibilidade de paciente contaminada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Divinópolis records a positive Mpox case and investigates the possibility that a patient is contaminated.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) case confirmed in Divinópolis, Central-West Minas Gerais, Brazil—the municipality's first positive case in 2026. A 19-year-old man presents with typical mpox symptoms (skin lesions, fever, lymphadenopathy, headache, myalgia, fatigue) and is stable, receiving care at UPA Padre Roberto and awaiting transfer to a hospital. A second suspected case, a 58-year-old woman, is hospitalized and under investigation; lab results expected by Friday, November 20. Public health measures include patient isolation to minimize transmission. Statewide, Minas Gerais has 42 confirmed mpox cases in 2026 as of November 17. No infection source is disclosed in the article. The information was released by Divinópolis City Hall on November 18, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ディヴィノーポリスでMpox陽性症例を記録、患者の感染経路を調査中
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内で散発的なMpox症例（単発症例および疑い例）が報告されているが、重症度・国際的拡大の兆候はなく、州全体でも既知の流行状況の延長と考えられるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ミナスジェライス州では2026年に累計42例確認されており、既存の流行状況下での新規症例報告と考えられる。重症例や死亡例の報告はなく、患者は安定している。

article.articleHeadline: Com 26 casos, BH reúne mais da metade dos diagnósticos de mpox em MG
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With 26 cases, Belo Horizonte accounts for more than half of mpox diagnoses in Minas Gerais.
article.articleSummary: By 18 November 2026, Belo Horizonte accounts for 26 mpox cases in Minas Gerais, over half of the state's 42 total through 17 November. A Divinópolis resident, 19-year-old, is confirmed; a 58-year-old woman is under investigation, both hospitalized. Belo Horizonte launched vaccination with 200 doses for people living with HIV/AIDS with CD4 counts below 100 cells/mm3. From 19 November, vaccination expands to HIV/AIDS patients with CD4 <200, PrEP users, and laboratory staff handling mpox samples. On 30 November, vaccination will be available to all people living with HIV/AIDS regardless of CD4. The vaccine is MVA-BN (Jynneos), two 0.5 ml doses, 28 days apart; the first-dose window ends by 4 December due to thaw. Vaccination sites include Hospital Eduardo de Menezes, URS Centro-Sul/Travel Health Service, CTA SAE Sagrada Família, CTR Orestes Diniz, and Crie; off-site vaccination requires proof of PrEP use. Details on locations/hours are on the Belo Horizonte city portal.

triage.headline_ja: 26症例で、ベロオリゾンテはミナスジェライス州のmpox診断の半数以上を占める
triage.triage_reason: ミナスジェライス州で症例数が増加し入院例もあり、HIV陽性者を対象としたワクチン接種キャンペーンが開始されるなど、重症度・継続曝露・流行しやすさの観点でWPRO基準に複数該当し、地域社会・行政の関心も高いため。
triage.notes: mpoxはすでに世界的に認知された疾患であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、HIV陽性者など免疫不全者への感染拡大リスクとそれに対するワクチン接種対応が注目される。地域限定の公衆衛生対応として続報を注視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Febre maculosa: Campinas registra terceira morte; infecção teria ocorrido na Unicamp
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rocky Mountain Spotted Fever: Campinas Records Third Death; Infection Reportedly Occurred at Unicamp.
article.articleSummary: Rocky Mountain Spotted Fever (RMSF) in Campinas, Brazil, has produced three confirmed deaths in 2026. The deceased is a 54-year-old man who died September 20 after symptom onset on September 11; infection was likely acquired on the Unicamp campus in Barão Geraldo, and he died at a private hospital in a neighboring municipality. Campinas also reported three RMSF cases in 2026, all fatal; in 2025 there were six confirmed cases with six deaths. An acarological survey at the probable infection site and enhanced risk communication have been launched; vegetation management and personal-protection guidance are being implemented. Two additional probable infections occurred at Parque Taquaral (May and July) in residents of other municipalities—a 19-year-old woman and a 30-year-old man who recovered; these are not counted in Campinas statistics. Transmission is via bite of Rickettsia rickettsii–carrying star ticks in grassy/wooded areas near rivers, lakes, and parks; park signage has been reinforced. Prevention includes ongoing education, health-professional training, and capybara population management; Municipal Law 16.418/2023 requires informing participants about RMSF risk at events in tick-endemic areas.

triage.headline_ja: 紅斑熱（ロッキー山紅斑熱）：カンピーナスで3人目の死亡例、感染はウニカンプ内で発生した可能性
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高い紅斑熱の死亡例が継続発生しており、住民の曝露が継続している可能性があるため、地域の公衆衛生対応状況を含めて確認が必要。
triage.notes: ロッキー山紅斑熱（紅斑熱群リケッチア症）はブラジル・サンパウロ州カンピーナス地域で毎年発生する風土病で、マダニ媒介性のためヒト-ヒト感染はない。2026年は3例全てが死亡（致死率100%）、2025年も6例全てが死亡しており重症度は高い。地元自治体による環境管理・啓発・法規制（市条例16.418/2023）など既存の対応体制があり、国際的な拡大リスクは低いが、継続的な曝露リスクと高致死率から経過観察を推奨する。

article.articleHeadline: திருப்பூரில் டெங்கு தடுப்பு நடவடிக்கை: ஒரே நாளில் 1.5 டன் கழிவுப்பொருள்கள் அகற்றம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue prevention drive in Tiruppur: 1.5 tonnes of waste materials removed in a single day
article.articleSummary: Dengue prevention drive in Tiruppur, Tamil Nadu, removed 1.5 tonnes of mosquito-breeding waste in a single day to curb dengue transmission. Under Tiruppur Municipal Corporation, Commissioner SP Amit directed targeted cleanups in the 4th zone’s wards 40 and 41, focusing on residential and public areas where rainwater stagnation can foster mosquitoes. Municipal workers identified breeding sites and eliminated them, contributing to containment efforts. The 4th zone Assistant Commissioner Vasudevan conducted the survey, with participation from Urban Health Officer Mogan, Zonal Health Officer Rajendran, health inspectors, and health service supervisors. The report highlights ongoing dengue prevention work in the city, though it does not mention any laboratory-confirmed cases or outbreaks. Date reference: Published 18 November 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ティルップールでのデング熱予防活動：1日で1.5トンの廃棄物を除去
triage.triage_reason: ルーチンのデング熱予防・清掃活動の報告であり、確定症例やアウトブレイクの言及がなく、異常性・重篤性・社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 記事は行政によるルーチンの蚊発生源除去活動の報告であり、デング熱の症例数や流行状況についての具体的データはない。対象国リストにIndiaは含まれるが、本件は通常の予防活動報告でありシグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Escalating Ebola Crisis
article.articleSummary: Six months into the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Bundibugyo variant remains out of control. Since May, the death toll has surpassed 5,500 with over 11,000 infections. Infections are rising at double the initial rate; more than 80% of new cases occur outside known contact lists and over 65% of deaths happen outside healthcare facilities. Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya calls the outbreak “still serious, and not under control,” urging donors to release about $1.6 billion in pledged aid, though donors have disbursed over $962 million with roughly $700 million unaccounted. Health workers have gone unpaid, ambulances lack fuel, and MSF warns of governance and oversight gaps hindering the response. The crisis reflects systemic issues—poverty, conflict, governance—exacerbated by expanded mining that increases human-animal Ebola exposure. Politically, President Félix Tshisekedi signed Nov 9 a law critics say could enable a third term, while a rebel alliance warns constitutional changes could derail peace talks. The outbreak unfolds amid regional instability.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ危機が深刻化
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが制御不能で死者5,500人超、感染拡大が加速しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 死者5,500人超、感染者11,000人超と大規模。資金不足・ガバナンス問題・政治的不安定が response を阻害しており、継続的な監視と国際支援が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Paraíba registra 9 casos de Mpox em novembro e chega a 11 infecções em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Paraíba records 9 Mpox cases in November and reaches 11 infections in 2026.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-11-18, Paraíba, Brazil, has confirmed 11 Mpox cases in 2026, with nine reported in November, according to the State Health Secretariat. João Pessoa concentrates the majority with eight cases; Campina Grande, Conceição, and Cabedelo each report one. The state had no Mpox cases in 2025. Vaccination is available for priority groups at reference health services. Reported Mpox symptoms include skin lesions, fever, headache, muscle pains, and fatigue. The article does not specify laboratory confirmation details or infection sources. These figures indicate a recent rise in infections through November 2026, underscoring ongoing public health measures to curb transmission, including targeted vaccination for at-risk populations.

triage.headline_ja: パライバ州、2026年11月にMpox(サル痘)9例を記録し、2026年累計11例に達する
triage.triage_reason: 2025年ゼロから2026年に11例へ増加という異常な傾向はあるが、重症度は低く国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも示されていないため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・パライバ州における地域的なMpox症例増加を報告。重症例や死亡例の記載はなく、ワクチン接種など既存の公衆衛生対応が行われている。

article.articleHeadline: Juazeiro do Norte intensifica ações de combate ao Aedes aegypti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Juazeiro do Norte intensifies actions to combat Aedes aegypti.
article.articleSummary: Juazeiro do Norte, Brazil intensifies vector control ahead of the rainy season with a Day D awareness campaign on November 27 targeting dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. In 2026, the municipality has reported more than 500 dengue cases, per the Health Ministry arbovirus monitoring dashboard. The morning campaign across neighborhoods will distribute leaflets and guidance to residents and businesses on preventing Aedes aegypti breeding. Authorities note about 75% of breeding sites are inside homes, highlighting measures to eliminate water-collecting containers, keep water tanks sealed, and regularly tidy yards. Arboviruses can vary in severity and may cause complications, sequelae, or death; pregnant women, the elderly, and those with comorbidities require special attention.

triage.headline_ja: ジュアゼイロ・ド・ノルテ、ネッタイシマカ対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの一自治体における定例的なデング熱等ベクター対策の広報活動であり、500件のデング症例報告はあるが深刻な拡大や異常事態を示す情報はなく、継続的な注視が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は地方自治体の啓発キャンペーンに関する内容で、雨季を前にしたルーチンの公衆衛生対策。重症度や死亡者数など具体的な被害規模の情報は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde alerta para risco de avanço da dengue após retorno do sorotipo 3 no Acre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health warns of the risk of dengue spread after the return of serotype 3 in Acre.
article.articleSummary: Dengue reintroduction of dengue virus serotype 3 (DENV-3) in Acre, Brazil prompts Sesacre to warn of potential shifts in transmission patterns. By Oct 11, 2026, Acre had 1,877 probable dengue cases for 2026, down 76.6% from 2025; confirmed cases fell 81.2% to 1,357, with zero dengue deaths this year versus six in 2025. The alert, in Epidemiological Bulletin No. 9/2026 by NUDTV, urges intensified surveillance to monitor spread and quickly implement prevention and control measures. To curb DENV-3, municipalities should boost sample collection and lab analyses, eliminate Aedes aegypti breeding sites, and expand vaccination for children and adolescents 10–14. Public guidance calls for weekly inspections, covering water storage, removing standing water, permitting health workers' entry, and personal protection (repellents, screens, nets). Seek care promptly for dengue-like symptoms: fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, body and joint pains; avoid self-medication and monitor for severe signs.

triage.headline_ja: アクレ州でデング熱血清型3型の再流行、感染拡大リスクに警鐘
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・アクレ州でデング熱血清型3型（DENV-3）の再導入が確認されたが、2026年の症例数・死亡数は前年より大幅減少しており、現時点では深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。今後の血清型シフトによる感染拡大の可能性があるため継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 地方衛生当局（Sesacre）による予防的警告であり、症例数・死亡数は前年比で大幅減少。血清型3型の再導入による今後の流行動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de Mpox crescem 20% no Brasil; saiba se a vacina está disponível na rede particular
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox cases rise 20% in Brazil; find out if the vaccine is available in the private network.
article.articleSummary: Mpox cases in Brazil rose 20% in November versus October, with 366 cases recorded by November 17, bringing 2026 totals to 1,170 cases and 1 death. The month-to-date increase follows 304 cases in October (up 229 from September). The states with the most cases are São Paulo (433), Rio de Janeiro (416), and Ceará (100); Acre, Alagoas, Amapá, Mato Grosso and Tocantins reported no cases so far. Vaccination against mpox is available only through the SUS (Public Health System) and is not being deployed as mass vaccination. A global vaccine shortage persists: a single Denmark-based producer prequalified by the WHO; Brazil secured 25,000 doses, with 20,000 initially and 5,000 more via PAHO Revolving Fund. Vaccine must be kept at -20°C and, after thawing, used within four weeks. Intradermal dosing is recommended for specific groups, with two doses 28 days apart.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでMpox症例が20%増加；民間医療網でのワクチン入手可否について
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでMpox症例が継続的に増加しているが、死亡は累計1例のみで重症度は限定的。ワクチン供給不足という管理可能性の懸念があり、続報を注視すべき。
triage.notes: Mpoxは既知の流行疾患であり新規性はないが、症例数増加傾向とワクチン供給不足（世界的な供給制約、PAHO回転基金経由での確保）が継続している点に留意。死亡者数は1名のみで重症度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil mantém eliminação do sarampo após avanço da doença em países das Américas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil Maintains Measles Elimination After the Disease Spreads Across the Americas.
article.articleSummary: Brazil maintains its status as a measles-free country for endemic circulation, a status regained in 2024, confirmed by the Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) on 17 November 2026, amid alerts in the Americas. Mexico, Bolivia and the United States have lost elimination status after 12 months of measles virus circulation; the United States reported over 5,000 cases and six deaths in 2026, all among unvaccinated people. Brazil attributes its maintained status to strengthened epidemiological surveillance and the resumption of vaccination. In 2019 Brazil recorded 21,700 measles cases; by 2023 there were no confirmed cases and the last death occurred in 2021. As of 2026, Brazil has 70 confirmed measles cases, 99.7% below the 2019 peak, linked to importation, with São Paulo (35), Tabatinga (9), Benjamin Constant (7), Atalaia do Norte (6), São Paulo de Olivença (4) and Rio Branco (2) affected.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、アメリカ大陸での麻疹流行拡大後も麻疹排除ステータスを維持
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルは麻疹排除ステータスを維持しており、70例は輸入例に関連し管理下にある。深刻な公衆衛生影響や社会的関心の高まりは確認されず、むしろサーベイランス強化による成功事例として報じられている。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はブラジルの麻疹排除ステータス維持の成功事例。メキシコ、ボリビア、米国は排除ステータスを失ったと言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Mpox avança em SP, supera casos de 2025 e estado recebe mais mil vacinas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox advances in São Paulo, surpasses 2025 cases, and the state receives more than a thousand vaccines.
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) in the state of São Paulo, Brazil, shows a rising trend in 2026 with 452 confirmed cases through November 18, up from 423 in all of 2025; no deaths reported in 2026 by that date. A new shipment of 1,000 vaccines, part of a 25,000-dose national reinforcement, is being distributed to priority groups to prevent exposure and complications. Vaccination remains targeted, not universal, prioritizing: people living with HIV/AIDS who have greater immunosuppression, PrEP users meeting eligibility, laboratory workers, and individuals with medium- or high-risk exposure after clinical assessment. Distribution considers municipal epidemiology, not population size. Health units should be consulted for eligibility and dose availability; vaccination aims to protect the most vulnerable and enhance ongoing mpox surveillance. Mpox virus causes skin and mucosal lesions with fever and muscle pains; monitoring continues as cases rise.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州でMpoxが拡大、2025年の症例数を上回り、州は1,000回分以上のワクチンを追加受領
triage.triage_reason: サンパウロ州でMpox症例が増加傾向にあるが、死亡例なく、対象を絞ったワクチン接種など既存の管理体制で対応中であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは示されていない。
triage.notes: 症例数は増加傾向だが死亡例なく、既存の国内ワクチン配布・サーベイランス体制で管理されている。継続的な症例数の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Geminivirus Betasatellite Subverts Plant Coat Protein Resistance to Enable
article.articleSummary: Field surveys in October 2024 in tomato greenhouses at Hangzhou, Zhejiang, China identified co-infections of tomato leaf curl New Delhi virus (ToLCNDV), tomato yellow leaf curl China virus (TYLCV-China), and TYLCV with the betasatellite TYLCCNB. The study shows βC1, a betasatellite effector, binds the ToLCNDV coat protein (CP) and directs its ubiquitin-proteasome–dependent degradation, disabling CP-mediated resistance and permitting systemic infection by the viral genome in foliar tissues. Coat protein–mediated resistance has long been used by expressing viral CP to block uncoating, replication, movement, and to trigger RNA silencing and defense signaling. The authors generated transgenic Nicotiana benthamiana expressing ToLCNDV CP; CP accumulation was confirmed by immunoblot. When challenged with TYLCV alone, coat protein–expressing plants developed substantially.

triage.headline_ja: ジェミニウイルスのベータサテライトが植物のコートタンパク質抵抗性を破壊し全身感染を可能にする
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は植物ウイルス（トマトの葉巻病ウイルス）に関する植物病理学研究であり、ヒトの公衆衛生に関連する感染症イベントではない。
triage.notes: 植物病（トマトのジェミニウイルス）に関する学術研究記事であり、ヒト感染症のシグナルには該当しない。発生地域にChina/Zhejiangが付与されているが、植物疾患のため対象国リストには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Venezuela strengthens epidemiological surveillance at regional health meeting in Bogotá
article.articleSummary: Venezuela joins nine Amazon basin and Darien Gap countries in Bogotá for the Technical Workshop and II General Assembly of the Amazon-Darién Network for Emerging Zoonoses with Epidemic Potential (Rade 2026). Participants from Bolivia, Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Panama, Peru, Suriname and Venezuela advance unified early warning protocols for timely detection and risk assessment of zoonotic diseases—those transmitted between animals and humans—in border areas. The initiative, promoted since 2022 by PAHO and WHO with Pandemic Fund support, operates on a One Health framework integrating human, animal, and environmental health. The cross-border collaboration aims to optimize prevention and control of outbreaks with epidemic potential across strategic ecosystems of South and Central America.

triage.headline_ja: ベネズエラ、ボゴタでの地域保健会議で疫学サーベイランスを強化
triage.triage_reason: 特定の疾病アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、アマゾン・ダリエン地域の人獣共通感染症サーベイランス強化に関する多国間会議の報告記事であるため。
triage.notes: 記事は具体的な感染症アウトブレイクを報じるものではなく、PAHO/WHO主導の地域ネットワーク（RADE 2026）の技術ワークショップに関する内容。Brazilを含む複数国が参加国として言及されているが、いずれも実際の疾病発生地ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Belo Horizonte inicia vacinação contra Mpox e amplia público prioritário nesta quinta-feira - BH 24 Horas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Belo Horizonte begins Mpox vaccination and expands the priority group this Thursday - BH 24 Horas.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox vaccination begins in Belo Horizonte, Minas Gerais, Brazil, for groups defined by the Ministry of Health. About 200 doses of MVA-BN (Jynneos) have arrived, with expansion expected from Thursday. The city has 26 confirmed mpox cases in 2026. The campaign started with people living with HIV/AIDS with CD4 counts <100 cells/mm³. On Thursday, eligibility extends to HIV/AIDS patients with CD4 <200, PrEP users, and laboratory workers handling mpox samples. A broader phase on Monday 30 will allow all people living with HIV/AIDS to be vaccinated regardless of CD4, subject to dose availability. The first dose must be given by December 4 due to the vaccine’s shelf life after thawing. The two-dose schedule is 0.5 mL per dose, 28 days apart. Vaccination will occur mainly at facilities where patients receive HIV care or PrEP; others require proof of PrEP use. Future doses depend on federal distribution.

triage.headline_ja: ベロオリゾンテ、Mpoxワクチン接種を開始し木曜日に優先対象者を拡大
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ベロオリゾンテで既存のMpox対策（ワクチン接種拡大）が進行中であり新規の異常事態ではないが、HIV陽性者等ハイリスク層への感染拡大状況を示す情報として継続注視が妥当。
triage.notes: 26例の確認症例があり、自治体主導でワクチン接種が実施されている既知の対応状況。新規の異常発生ではなく、既存流行への対応強化と判断。

article.articleHeadline: நெல்லை மாவட்டத்தில் 1,21,347 குழந்தைகளுக்கு போலியோ சொட்டு: நவ.22-இல் சிறப்பு முகாம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Polio drops for 121,347 children in Nellai district: Special camp on Nov. 22.
article.articleSummary: Polio vaccination drive planned in Tirunelveli (Nellai) district on Sunday, Nov 22, immunizing 121,347 children with polio drops. Of these, 109,092 are five-year-olds and 12,255 are five-to-six-year-olds. A total of 898 camps will operate in rural and urban areas, including bus stands, railway stations, and sites serving migrant workers’ children and brick kiln workers’ children, plus roadside, border post, primary health centers and government hospitals. For seven days, teams will conduct door-to-door vaccination to reach missed children, and those already immunized will also receive drops. The drive involves 3,912 personnel: 770 health department staff, 700 nursing college students, 385 nutrition workers, and 2,057 volunteers. Mothers are urged to bring children to nearby camps to help create a polio-free world. District Collector Ananth Mohan chaired the meeting, with Deputy Director of Health Services Latha and District Health Officer Murali Sankar among attendees.

triage.headline_ja: ネルライ県で12万1347人の子どもにポリオ投与:11月22日に特別キャンプ実施
triage.triage_reason: これはポリオ発生事例ではなく、ルーチンのポリオ予防接種キャンペーンの告知であり、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はポリオの発生や症例報告ではなく、通常の予防接種活動（ポリオドロップ投与キャンペーン）に関する内容である。

article.articleHeadline: Explainer: The US has lost its measles elimination status. Could New Zealand?
article.articleSummary: United States has lost its measles elimination status, per PAHO/WHO, after endemic transmission persisted for at least 12 months; elimination means interrupted endemic spread, not complete absence. Canada also lost elimination in 2025. Since 2025, U.S. measles infections total about 7,700 with 13 deaths, including a New York child’s death this month—the state’s first in 30 years. Loss signals prolonged circulation and higher risk of preventable illness, hospitalization, and death. New Zealand has remained eliminated but is at rising risk as on-time MMR vaccination declines; a 2015–2024 report notes suboptimal first-dose delivery, with over 60% of Māori and about 50% of Pacific children late. New Zealand’s 2019 and 2025–2026 outbreaks (48 linked cases) prompted a vaccination push delivering around 107,000 MMR doses in four months. Global hotspots in 2026 include Bangladesh, Indonesia, and Guatemala.

triage.headline_ja: 解説：米国は麻疹排除状態を失った。ニュージーランドも同様の道をたどるか？
triage.triage_reason: 米国・カナダが麻疹排除状態を喪失し、死亡例・入院例を伴う持続的な地域内伝播が確認されており、公衆衛生上深刻かつ異例の事態でIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事は主に米国・カナダ・ニュージーランドにおける麻疹排除状態の喪失とワクチン接種率低下を扱う解説記事。バングラデシュ・インドネシア・グアテマラは『2026年のグローバルホットスポット』として一文で言及されるのみで、記事の主題ではないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: இந்தியாவின் முதல் பறவைக் காய்ச்சல் தடுப்பு மருந்து: நாளை மறுநாள் நாட்டிற்கு அர்ப்பணிப்பு... | Makkal Osai - மக்கள் ஓசை
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India's first avian influenza preventive medicine: to be dedicated to the nation the day after tomorrow...
article.articleSummary: India's first domestically developed preventive medicine for avian influenza (H5N1, clade 2.3.2.1a) was created by ICAR-National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases (NIHSAD) in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh. It will be dedicated to the nation on 21 November 2026 by Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan at NIHSAD. Avian influenza can cause near 100% mortality in infected poultry, triggering culling and trade restrictions with substantial financial losses for farmers. Since the disease was detected in India in 2006, more than 500 outbreaks have been reported. If the disease spreads aggressively, over 20% of the country’s poultry could be affected, risking a decline of up to 1.5% in domestic GDP growth. Domestic vaccine development provides relief to poultry owners and farmers.

triage.headline_ja: インドの初の鳥インフルエンザ予防薬：明後日に国家へ献呈
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は家禽向け鳥インフルエンザ予防ワクチンの開発・献呈に関する発表であり、人への新規感染事例や急性の公衆衛生リスクの報告ではないため、シグナルとして取り上げる必要性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は家禽の鳥インフルエンザワクチン開発に関する政府発表であり、ヒト感染事例の報告はない。過去の家禽アウトブレイク経済影響の記述はあるが、現時点での新規公衆衛生イベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: Escolas de Santa Luzia vão liberar alunos às 15h na quinta (19) para limpeza após casos de sarna
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santa Luzia schools will release students at 3 p.m. on Thursday (the 19th) for cleaning after cases of scabies.
article.articleSummary: Santa Luzia, part of the Belo Horizonte metro area, will dismiss all schools at 3:00 p.m. on Thursday, November 19, 2026, to clean classrooms after reports of symptoms in several units and a rise in human scabies in Greater Belo Horizonte. Families are advised to monitor children over the long weekend and not send them to class on Monday, November 23 if symptoms appear. Recently, classes were suspended in São José da Lapa, Vespasiano, and Ouro Preto due to increased scabies activity. Scabies is caused by the female mite Sarcoptes scabiei and spreads mainly through prolonged skin contact; sharing towels or bedding is less common. Symptoms include intense itching and small skin lesions. Treatment is topical lotion or doctor-prescribed medication; transmission typically stops about 24 hours after starting treatment. Preventive steps include washing textiles in hot water and sealing unwashable items for at least three days. Seek UBS for suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: サンタ・ルジアの学校、疥癬症例後の清掃のため木曜(19日)午後3時に生徒を下校させる
triage.triage_reason: 疥癬は重症度・国際拡大リスクが低く、局地的な学校対応にとどまるため、IHR・WPRO基準のいずれも該当せず社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: 疥癬はヒト-ヒト感染するが重症度・致死性が低く、学校単位での対応で管理可能。地域メディアでの報道にとどまる。

article.articleHeadline: Why Is the DRC Ebola Outbreak Continuing? Conflict, Contact Tracing Gaps, and Community Trust | Infection Control Today
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) persists six months in, with 11,000+ confirmed cases and 5,000+ deaths; about 400–500 new cases weekly. Cases span East, Central, and West Africa—the widest spread to date and the second-largest outbreak after 2014–2016 West Africa. In the DRC, Ituri and North Kivu account for most cases; eight provinces have reported cases, but only five have active cases in the last month. Conflict, displacement, hunger, and insecurity drive transmission and hamper response, with more than 80 attacks on health facilities and workers since May 15; a November 5 attack killed 66 civilians including 3 health workers. By Nov 16, contact tracing reached 81.6% of contacts (target 95%), with lowest rate in Tshopo at 75.3%. Diagnostic testing capacity exists, but underreporting remains; children constitute >25% of cases and about one-third of deaths, with ~70% mortality among under-5s.

triage.headline_ja: なぜDRCのエボラ流行は続いているのか？紛争、接触者追跡のギャップ、地域社会の信頼問題
triage.triage_reason: DRCで11,000人超の感染、5,000人超の死亡という大規模エボラ流行が6ヶ月以上継続し、史上2番目の規模・最も広範な拡大を示しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: モザンビーク・アンゴラ・中央アフリカ地域はBluedotの地域タグに含まれるが、記事サマリーでは具体的な感染確認地域として言及されておらず、実際の発生はDRC国内（イトゥリ州、北キブ州、ツォポ州等）に限定されるためverified_locationsから除外した。紛争による医療従事者への攻撃（80件以上）、接触者追跡率の目標未達（81.6%/目標95%）、5歳未満児の致死率約70%など、国際支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirose: Governo Ronaldo alerta para riscos de contaminação durante período de chuvas em Feira de Santrana e registra três casos confirmados em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Leptospirosis: Ronaldo's government warns of contamination risks during the rainy season in Feira de Santrana and records three confirmed cases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: As of November 18, 2026, leptospirosis alerts persist in Feira de Santana, Bahia, Brazil, as intensified rains raise floodwater exposure. The illness is caused by Leptospira bacteria, transmitted mainly through contact with water or mud contaminated with urine from infected animals, especially rats. From January to October 2026, the Epidemiological Vigilance registered 11 suspected cases among Feira de Santana residents, with 3 laboratory-confirmed, 5 ruled out, 2 inconclusive, and 1 under investigation. In 2025 there were 19 suspected notifications, with 3 confirmed, 14 discarded, and 2 inconclusive. Symptoms include fever, vomiting, malaise, chills, headache, and muscle pains (notably calves). Incubation ranges 1–30 days (often 5–14). Prevention focuses on avoiding floodwater exposure, protecting skin injuries, and wearing waterproof footwear; prompt medical care is urged for compatible symptoms after flood exposure, to reduce severity and potential fatal outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: レプトスピラ症:ロナウド政権、フェイラ・デ・サンタナにおける雨季の感染リスクを警告、2026年に3件の確定症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の一地域における季節性のレプトスピラ症で、症例数は少なく（確定3件）、例年と同程度の発生状況であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による雨季の注意喚起記事であり、症例数は2025年と同水準（確定3件）で特段の異常は見られない。レプトスピラ症はヒト-ヒト感染せず動物由来の環境曝露が主因。

article.articleHeadline: Divinópolis registra caso de mpox em homem de 19 anos e apura suspeita em mulher - BH 24 Horas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Divinópolis records mpox case in a 19-year-old man and investigates a suspected case in a woman - BH 24 Horas.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox (mpox) case confirmed in Divinópolis, Minas Gerais, Brazil: a 19-year-old man is clinically stable and awaiting hospital transfer per state regulation, while a 58-year-old woman is under investigation with lab samples collected; results expected by 20 Nov. Divinópolis has activated mpox prevention measures, including patient isolation and ongoing clinical monitoring. Minas Gerais reports 42 confirmed mpox cases in 2026 as of 17 Nov, with Belo Horizonte at 20; Contagem and Juiz de Fora six each; Uberlândia four; and single cases in Confins, Formiga, Manhuaçu, Ribeirão das Neves, Santa Luzia, Sete Lagoas. Cases are mainly in males aged 15–34; the circulating lineage is clade II, subclade IIb, linked to the 2022 international outbreak. Symptoms include skin lesions, fever, and lymphadenopathy; treatment is supportive. Belo Horizonte vaccination program began with 200 doses, prioritizing PLWH with low CD4 counts, PrEP users, and lab workers; broader access anticipated by 30 Nov.

triage.headline_ja: ディヴィノーポリスで19歳男性のmpox症例を確認、女性の疑い例も調査中 - BH 24 Horas
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ミナスジェライス州で継続しているmpox（クレードIIb、2022年国際流行株）の症例報告であり、臨床経過は軽症・対応可能で、既知の流行パターンの範囲内であるため新規シグナルというより経過観察対象。
triage.notes: ミナスジェライス州全体で2026年に42例確認、主に15-34歳男性。クレードIIb（2022年国際流行株）で新規性はなし。地元でワクチン接種プログラムや隔離対応が進行中であり、現時点では管理可能な範囲内と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Caxias promove Dia D de combate à dengue, Zika e Chikungunya | Duque de Caxias | O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Caxias promotes D-Day to combat dengue, Zika and Chikungunya | Duque de Caxias | O Dia
article.articleSummary: Duque de Caxias launches a D-Day on Thursday, Nov 19, to combat dengue, Zika, and Chikungunya, led by the SVAVZ under the Municipal Health Secretariat. Five strategic points will host simultaneous activities to boost prevention and curb Aedes aegypti: Parque do Povo in Vila São Luís; Praça da Figueira; Praça do Pilar; Praça de Imbariê; and Praça da Mantiqueira (Xerém). At Parque do Povo, tasks include home visits, fumacê spraying, educational outreach, vector surveillance, rodent and snail control, Rabies vaccination for dogs and cats, Entomological Laboratory activities, and the Programa Acumuladores. Other locales will conduct domicile visits and fumacê to extend coverage. The campaign emphasizes resident participation, continuous home inspections, and eliminating potential breeding sites, with Conta Ovos traps installed to monitor Aedes aegypti circulation and prepare the city for the arbovirus transmission season.

triage.headline_ja: カシアスがデング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア熱対策の「Dデー」を実施

article.articleHeadline: Belo Horizonte inicia vacinação contra a Mpox nesta quinta-feira (19)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Belo Horizonte begins Mpox vaccination this Thursday (the 19th).
article.articleSummary: Belo Horizonte, Brazil begins Mpox vaccination on Thursday, November 19, 2026, after a rise in mpox cases nationwide. The city received 200 extra doses from the Ministry of Health to vaccinate priority groups. The initial phase targets those at highest risk: people living with HIV/AIDS with CD4 counts below 200 cells/mm³; individuals on HIV PrEP; and laboratory workers who handle mpox samples. On November 30, vaccination expands to all people living with HIV/AIDS, regardless of CD4 count. The extra-dose campaign is planned to end on December 4 due to the vaccine’s expiry after thawing. Vaccinations will be carried out at five units: Hospital Eduardo de Menezes; URS Centro-Sul/Traveler Health Service; CTA SAE Sagrada Família; CTR Orestes Diniz; Crie (Centro de Referência de Imunobiológicos Especiais). Addresses and hours are on the city portal.

article.articleHeadline: DPRD Banjarmasin ingatkan pemerintah daerah mewaspdai DBD
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Banjarmasin's DPRD reminds the local government to be vigilant against dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: South Kalimantan's Banjarmasin DPRD warns local government to stay vigilant against dengue fever as the rainy season begins, highlighting that heavy rainfall can create standing water that boosts Aedes aegypti, the dengue vector. Poor sanitation and flooding may raise risks of other diseases. Citizens should adopt clean and healthy living (PHBS), maintain environmental cleanliness, and monitor personal and family health. Preventive measures include 3M Plus and keeping areas free from standing water; eat nutritious foods and drink clean water; use personal protection and boost immunity. Seek medical help promptly for symptoms such as high fever, prolonged diarrhea, vomiting, or shortness of breath. DPRD urges relevant agencies to take preventive actions and warns against self-medication. Collective vigilance and public awareness are key during the rainy season to prevent disease spread in Banjarmasin.

triage.headline_ja: バンジャルマシン市議会、地方政府にデング熱への警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱予防に関する行政からの注意喚起であり、具体的な症例数や異常な流行の報告はなく、通常の季節的対応の範囲内と考えられる。
triage.notes: 雨季に伴う例年の注意喚起であり、具体的な症例数や死亡者数の報告がないため、現時点ではDISMISSと判断。今後の症例数増加報告があればWATCHへ移行を検討。

article.articleHeadline: Ghanaian Hospital Study Finds Intestinal Parasite Infection in Eleven
article.articleSummary: Intestinal parasitic infections were detected in 11.1% (394/3,542) of pregnant women attending antenatal care at Tamale Teaching Hospital in Northern Ghana (2021–2023), with 88.9% negative (3,148). Direct saline wet mount microscopy analyzed archived records; data capture was 97.82% from 3,621 identified. The Northern Ghana setting is described as underdeveloped with limited water, sanitation, and hygiene. Parasites include Entamoeba histolytica/dispar, Giardia, Cryptosporidium, Ascaris lumbricoides, Trichuris, hookworms, and Strongyloides. Maternal intestinal infections are linked to malnutrition, anemia, premature birth, impaired fetal development, and reduced birth weight; in severe cases, maternal-fetal death is possible. Globally about 24% are infected, with higher burdens in sub-Saharan Africa. Prior Ghanaian data show Central Region 19.3% and Ashanti 36.7%. Tamale serves five northern regions and neighboring countries, underscoring the regional relevance of antenatal parasitic surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナの病院研究、妊婦の11%に腸内寄生虫感染を発見
triage.triage_reason: 過去データ（2021-2023年）に基づく研究報告であり、急性の公衆衛生上の脅威や異常な集団発生を示すものではない。既知の風土病的状況の学術的記述に留まる。
triage.notes: 本記事は2021-2023年の後方視的研究報告であり、新規アウトブレイクではない。水・衛生環境の構造的課題を背景とした既知の風土病的腸管寄生虫感染の有病率調査。

article.articleHeadline: Alunos apresentam sintomas de sarna, e cidade da Grande BH mobiliza limpeza em escolas municipais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Students show symptoms of scabies, and a city in the Greater Belo Horizonte area mobilizes cleaning in municipal schools.
article.articleSummary: Santa Luzia, in the Greater Belo Horizonte Metropolitan Region, mobilizes cleaning of municipal schools after students show symptoms of human scabies. On Thursday, November 19, the Santa Luzia Municipal Department of Education will sanitize school furniture and common areas; students will be dismissed at 3 p.m. as a preventive measure. The department has already advised families on school absence and medical treatment, and asks guardians to monitor children over the holiday and weekend; if symptoms are detected, seek medical care and keep the student home on Monday, November 23. Scabies is transmitted mainly by direct, prolonged skin-to-skin contact; shared clothing, towels, and bed linens can also spread it. The mite can survive off the body for 3-7 days. Cleaning and washing of fabrics and objects used by an infected person is essential; wash clothes, towels, and sheets, and treat non-washable items as advised by health teams.

article.articleHeadline: Fungal Infections Identified in Non-ICU Pneumonia Patients Without Classic
article.articleSummary: Hanoi, Vietnam—National Lung Hospital conducted a retrospective cohort of 188 adults with community-acquired pneumonia admitted to general wards (Dec 2024–Jul 2025). Invasive pulmonary fungal infection developed in 12.8% of patients lacking classic immunosuppression. Clinically diagnosed fungal disease occurred in 24 patients (23 pulmonary aspergillosis, 1 mucormycosis). In-hospital mortality was 33.3% among those with invasive fungal infection vs 2.4% without (P<0.001). Multivariable analysis identified three independent risk factors: respiratory viral PCR positivity at admission (adjusted OR 3.15; 95% CI 1.26–8.18), diabetes mellitus (adjusted OR 4.10; 95% CI 1.45–11.55), and peribronchial infiltration on chest CT (adjusted OR 4.70; 95% CI 1.87–12.48). Diagnoses followed adapted 2019 EORTC/MSGERC criteria. Authors urge heightened vigilance and early fungal diagnostic evaluation for non-ICU CAP patients, especially diabetics or those with admission respiratory viral PCR positivity, given substantial mortality differences.

triage.headline_ja: 古典的な免疫抑制のない非ICU肺炎患者に真菌感染症が確認される
triage.triage_reason: 単一医療機関での後ろ向きコホート研究であり、感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態ではない。学術的知見であり、IHR・WPRO基準には該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は単一病院での臨床研究報告であり、アウトブレイクや新興感染症の発生を示すものではない。疾患名は便宜上『Coccidioidomycosis』とタグ付けされているが、実際の内容は院内肺真菌感染症（主にアスペルギルス症）に関する研究。公衆衛生上のシグナルとしては扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: Luly Gil alerta sobre dengue y virus respiratorios en niños
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Luly Gil Warns About Dengue and Respiratory Viruses in Children.
article.articleSummary: {"description":"In Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic, pediatrician Luly Gil reports widespread dengue, influenza, respiratory viruses and gastrointestinal infections in children, urging vigilance for alarm signs to prevent dengue shock. She notes circulating pathogens—dengue, influenza, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), and adenovirus—that can cause fever with changes in platelets and white blood cells, complicating differential diagnosis with dengue. Any child with fever longer than 48 hours, especially with other symptoms, should be evaluated to distinguish dengue from respiratory infections. Respiratory illnesses typically involve fever, cough, sneezing and nasal discharge; dengue often features malaise and retro-orbital pain, requiring medical assessment. Alarm signs include abdominal distension, epistaxis, hematochezia, pallor, hypotension and cold skin, signaling shock after fever subsides—often after day 3. She cites rotavirus and norovirus gastroenteritis; recommends hydration and acetaminophen. Prevention in schools includes rotavirus and influenza vaccination; dengue vaccines exist in some Latin American countries (Brazil) but not in the Dominican Republic."

article.articleHeadline: Estados Unidos pierde el estatus libre de sarampión tras 26 años
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States loses measles-free status after 26 years.
article.articleSummary: By November 12, 2026, the United States reported 5,412 confirmed measles cases—the highest since 1991—with at least 10 associated deaths. PAHO declared that the United States, Mexico, and Bolivia have lost measles elimination status after endemic transmission persisted for 12 months, elevating the Americas’ public health risk to very high. Measles remains extremely contagious, with each case potentially infecting up to 18 others, and outbreaks concentrated where vaccination coverage is low. First-dose coverage in the region is around 33% meeting 95%; second-dose coverage about 20%. In the United States, school-entry MMR vaccination fell from 95.2% in 2019–2020 to 92.4% in 2025–2026. Complications include pneumonia, encephalitis, severe diarrhea, ear infections, and blindness. Elimination had been achieved in 2024 (Venezuela, Brazil); Canada’s 2025 transmission prompted a regional setback, making recovery steeper.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、26年ぶりに麻疹排除状況を喪失
triage.triage_reason: 米国・メキシコ・ボリビアがPAHOにより麻疹排除状況を喪失したと宣言され、死亡例を伴う大規模流行（5,412症例、最多since1991）が発生。IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の高い該当数から、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 本イベントは米国・メキシコ・ボリビア（および言及されたカナダ、ベネズエラ、ブラジルの過去の排除達成状況）に関するものであり、指定対象国（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）のいずれも記事の主題として発生していないため、verified_locationsは空とした。ブラジルは2024年に排除達成した過去の事例として言及されているのみで、現在のイベントの主体ではない。
